name: Schoenflies.StronglyAccessible.mono
statement:
theorem StronglyAccessible.mono (h : StronglyAccessible D p) (hDE : D ⊆ E) :
    StronglyAccessible E p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, hd, hball⟩ := h
  exact ⟨q, r, hr, hd, hball.trans hDE⟩

name: Schoenflies.StronglyAccessible.exists_ne
statement:
theorem StronglyAccessible.exists_ne (h : StronglyAccessible D p) :
    ∃ q ∈ D, p ≠ q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, hd, hball⟩ := h
  refine ⟨q, hball (mem_ball_self hr), fun hpq => ?_⟩
  rw [← hpq, dist_self] at hd
  exact absurd hd.symm hr.ne'

name: Schoenflies.stronglyAccessible_of_isMinOn
statement:
theorem stronglyAccessible_of_isMinOn {a : Plane} (hq : q ∉ C) (ha : a ∈ C)
    (hmin : ∀ b ∈ C, dist q a ≤ dist q b) (hD : connectedComponentIn Cᶜ q ⊆ D) :
    StronglyAccessible D a
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < dist q a := dist_pos.2 fun h => hq (h ▸ ha)
  refine ⟨q, dist q a, hpos, rfl, ?_⟩
  
  have hball : ball q (dist q a) ⊆ Cᶜ := by
    intro z hz hzC
    rw [mem_ball, dist_comm] at hz
    exact absurd (hmin z hzC) (not_le.2 hz)
  
  exact ((convex_ball q (dist q a)).isPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn
    (mem_ball_self hpos) hball).trans hD

name: Schoenflies.mem_accessCone_iff
statement:
theorem mem_accessCone_iff {x : Plane} :
    x ∈ accessCone p v s ↔ ‖x - p‖ < s ∧ ‖x - p‖ / 2 < inner ℝ v (x - p)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.accessCone_subset_ball_self
statement: theorem accessCone_subset_ball_self : accessCone p v s ⊆ ball p s
proof:
:= fun x hx => by
  rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact hx.1

name: Schoenflies.notMem_accessCone
statement: theorem notMem_accessCone : p ∉ accessCone p v s
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := h.2
  simp at this

name: Schoenflies.accessCone_mono
statement: theorem accessCone_mono (hs : s ≤ s') : accessCone p v s ⊆ accessCone p v s'
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => ⟨hx.1.trans_le hs, hx.2⟩

name: Schoenflies.isOpen_accessCone
statement: theorem isOpen_accessCone : IsOpen (accessCone p v s)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Continuous fun x : Plane => ‖x - p‖ := (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).norm
  have h2 : Continuous fun x : Plane => inner ℝ v (x - p) :=
    continuous_const.inner (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  rw [accessCone, setOf_and]
  exact (isOpen_lt h1 continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt (h1.div_const 2) h2)

name: Schoenflies.mem_accessCone
statement:
theorem mem_accessCone (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hcone : 1 / 2 < inner ℝ v w) (ht : 0 < t) (hts : t < s) :
    p + t • w ∈ accessCone p v s
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : p + t • w - p = t • w := by module
  have hnorm : ‖p + t • w - p‖ = t := by
    rw [hsub, norm_smul, hw, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht, mul_one]
  refine ⟨by rw [hnorm]; exact hts, ?_⟩
  rw [hnorm, hsub, real_inner_smul_right]
  nlinarith

name: Schoenflies.accessCone_nonempty
statement: theorem accessCone_nonempty (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (hs : 0 < s) : (accessCone p v s).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨p + (s / 2) • v, mem_accessCone hv ?_ (by linarith) (by linarith)⟩
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hv]
  norm_num

name: Schoenflies.openSegment_subset_accessCone
statement:
theorem openSegment_subset_accessCone (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hcone : 1 / 2 < inner ℝ v w) (hs : 0 < s) :
    openSegment ℝ p (p + s • w) ⊆ accessCone p v s
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hαβ, rfl⟩
  have hα' : α = 1 - β := by linarith
  subst hα'
  have hx : (1 - β) • p + β • (p + s • w) = p + (β * s) • w := by module
  rw [hx]
  exact mem_accessCone hw hcone (by positivity) (by nlinarith)

name: Schoenflies.accessCone_subset_ball
statement:
theorem accessCone_subset_ball (hr : 0 < r) (hpq : ‖q - p‖ = r) (hs : s ≤ r) :
    accessCone p (r⁻¹ • (q - p)) s ⊆ ball q r
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hlt, hcone⟩
  set d := ‖x - p‖ with hd
  set I := inner ℝ (q - p) (x - p) with hI
  
  rw [real_inner_smul_left] at hcone
  have hmul : r * (d / 2) < r * (r⁻¹ * I) := by
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcone hr
  have hcancel : r * (r⁻¹ * I) = I := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_mul]
  rw [hcancel] at hmul
  
  have hcs : I ≤ r * d := by
    have := real_inner_le_norm (q - p) (x - p)
    rwa [hpq] at this
  have hd0 : 0 < d := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (x - p)]
  have hdr : d < r := hlt.trans_le hs
  
  have hxq : x - q = (x - p) - (q - p) := by module
  have key : ‖x - q‖ ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
    rw [hxq, norm_sub_sq_real, hpq, real_inner_comm]
    nlinarith
  rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
  exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 hr.le key

name: Schoenflies.tangent_cone
statement:
theorem tangent_cone (hr : 0 < r) (hpq : ‖q - p‖ = r) (hw : ‖w‖ = 1)
    (hcone : 1 / 2 < inner ℝ (r⁻¹ • (q - p)) w) (ht : 0 < t) (htr : t < r) :
    p + t • w ∈ ball q r
proof:
:=
  accessCone_subset_ball hr hpq le_rfl (mem_accessCone hw hcone ht htr)

name: Schoenflies.StronglyAccessible.exists_cone
statement:
theorem StronglyAccessible.exists_cone (h : StronglyAccessible D p) :
    ∃ v : Plane, ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ ∃ r > 0, ∀ s ≤ r, accessCone p v s ⊆ D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, hd, hball⟩ := h
  have hpq : ‖q - p‖ = r := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hd
  refine ⟨r⁻¹ • (q - p), ?_, r, hr, fun s hs => (accessCone_subset_ball hr hpq hs).trans hball⟩
  rw [norm_smul, hpq, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hr), inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne']

name: Schoenflies.StronglyAccessible.openSegment_subset
statement:
theorem StronglyAccessible.openSegment_subset (h : StronglyAccessible D p) :
    ∃ z ∈ D, p ≠ z ∧ openSegment ℝ p z ⊆ D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, hd, hball⟩ := h
  refine ⟨q, hball (mem_ball_self hr), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hpq
    rw [← hpq, dist_self] at hd
    exact absurd hd.symm hr.ne'
  · rintro x ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hαβ, rfl⟩
    have hα' : α = 1 - β := by linarith
    subst hα'
    refine hball ?_
    have hx : (1 - β) • p + β • q - q = (1 - β) • (p - q) := by module
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hx, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith),
      ← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm, hd]
    nlinarith

name: Schoenflies.exists_countable_dense_stronglyAccessible
statement:
theorem exists_countable_dense_stronglyAccessible (hC : IsCompact C) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hDopen : IsOpen D) (hDC : D ⊆ Cᶜ) (hDmax : ∀ q ∈ D, connectedComponentIn Cᶜ q ⊆ D)
    (hCD : C ⊆ closure D) :
    ∃ A ⊆ C, A.Countable ∧ (∀ a ∈ A, StronglyAccessible D a) ∧ C ⊆ closure A
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨S, hScount, hSdense⟩ := TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_dense Plane
  
  have hnear : ∀ x : Plane, ∃ a, a ∈ C ∧ ∀ b ∈ C, dist x a ≤ dist x b := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, haC, hmin⟩ :=
      hC.exists_isMinOn hCne (Continuous.continuousOn (continuous_const.dist continuous_id))
    exact ⟨a, haC, fun b hb => isMinOn_iff.1 hmin b hb⟩
  choose f hfC hfmin using hnear
  refine ⟨f '' (S ∩ D), ?_, (hScount.mono inter_subset_left).image f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨x, -, rfl⟩
    exact hfC x
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact stronglyAccessible_of_isMinOn (hDC hx.2) (hfC x) (hfmin x) (hDmax x hx.2)
  · 
    intro p hp
    rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
    intro ε hε
    
    obtain ⟨y, hyD, hy⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.1 (hCD hp) (ε / 2) (by linarith)
    
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδD⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hDopen y hyD
    obtain ⟨z, hzS, hz⟩ := hSdense.exists_dist_lt y (lt_min hδ (by linarith : 0 < ε / 2 - dist p y))
    have hzD : z ∈ D := hδD (by rw [mem_ball, dist_comm]; exact hz.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
    have hpz : dist p z < ε / 2 := by
      have := (dist_triangle p y z).trans_lt
        (by linarith [hz.trans_le (min_le_right δ (ε / 2 - dist p y))] :
          dist p y + dist y z < ε / 2)
      exact this
    
    refine ⟨f z, ⟨z, ⟨hzS, hzD⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    have h1 : dist z (f z) ≤ dist z p := hfmin z p hp
    have h2 : dist p (f z) ≤ dist p z + dist z (f z) := dist_triangle _ _ _
    rw [dist_comm z p] at h1
    linarith

name: Schoenflies.polyAccessible_of_mem
statement: theorem polyAccessible_of_mem (ha : a ∈ Ω) : PolyAccessible Ω a
proof:
:=
  ⟨[a], by simp, rfl, by simpa using ha, by simp⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyAccessible.mono
statement: theorem PolyAccessible.mono (h : PolyAccessible Ω a) (hsub : Ω ⊆ S) : PolyAccessible S a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vs, hvs, hhead, hlast, hint⟩ := h
  exact ⟨vs, hvs, hhead, hsub hlast, hint.trans hsub⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyAccessible.of_openSegment
statement:
theorem PolyAccessible.of_openSegment (hz : z ∈ Ω) (hseg : openSegment ℝ a z ⊆ Ω) :
    PolyAccessible Ω a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨[a, z], by simp, rfl, by simpa using hz, ?_⟩
  rw [poly_pair]
  rintro x ⟨hxseg, hxa⟩
  rw [mem_singleton_iff] at hxa
  
  rcases eq_or_ne x z with rfl | hxz
  · exact hz
  · exact hseg (mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right (Ne.symm hxa) (Ne.symm hxz) hxseg)

name: Schoenflies.StronglyAccessible.polyAccessible
statement: theorem StronglyAccessible.polyAccessible (h : StronglyAccessible Ω a) : PolyAccessible Ω a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, -, hseg⟩ := h.openSegment_subset
  exact PolyAccessible.of_openSegment hz hseg

name: Schoenflies.polyAccessible_of_poly
statement:
theorem polyAccessible_of_poly {vs : List Plane} (h : vs ≠ []) (hhead : vs.head h = a)
    (hlast : vs.getLast h ≠ a) (hsub : poly vs \ {a} ⊆ Ω) : PolyAccessible Ω a
proof:
:=
  ⟨vs, h, hhead, hsub ⟨getLast_mem_poly h, hlast⟩, hsub⟩

name: Schoenflies.polyAccessible_of_poly'
statement:
theorem polyAccessible_of_poly' {vs : List Plane} (h : vs ≠ []) (hlast : vs.getLast h = a)
    (hhead : vs.head h ≠ a) (hsub : poly vs \ {a} ⊆ Ω) : PolyAccessible Ω a
proof:
:= by
  have hrev : vs.reverse ≠ [] := by simpa using h
  refine polyAccessible_of_poly hrev ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [List.head_reverse]; exact hlast
  · rw [List.getLast_reverse]; exact hhead
  · rw [poly_reverse]; exact hsub

name: Schoenflies.PolyAccessible.exists_simple
statement:
theorem PolyAccessible.exists_simple (h : PolyAccessible Ω a) (ha : a ∉ Ω) :
    ∃ z ∈ Ω, a ≠ z ∧ ∃ (vs : List Plane) (hv : vs ≠ []),
      vs.head hv = a ∧ vs.getLast hv = z ∧ poly vs \ {a} ⊆ Ω ∧ IsArcBetween (poly vs) a z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vs, hvs, hhead, hlast, hint⟩ := h
  set z := vs.getLast hvs with hz
  have hne : a ≠ z := fun hcon => ha (hcon ▸ hlast)
  obtain ⟨ws, hws, hwhead, hwlast, hwsub, hwarc⟩ :=
    exists_simple_poly_of_poly (isConnected_poly hvs).2 hne
      (hhead ▸ head_mem_poly hvs) (getLast_mem_poly hvs)
  exact ⟨z, hlast, hne, ws, hws, hwhead, hwlast,
    fun x hx => hint ⟨hwsub hx.1, hx.2⟩, hwarc⟩

name: Schoenflies.biUnion_list_map
statement:
theorem biUnion_list_map {ι : Type*} (f : ι → Set Plane) (l : List ι) :
    (⋃ A ∈ l.map f, A) = ⋃ i ∈ l, f i
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, biUnion_list_cons (fun A : Set Plane => A),
      biUnion_list_cons f, ih]

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_poly_of_biUnion_finite
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_of_biUnion_finite {ι : Type*} {s : Set ι} {A : ι → Set Plane}
    (hs : s.Finite) (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, IsPolygonal (A i))
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (⋃ i ∈ s, A i)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : a ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, A i) (hb : b ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, A i) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws ⊆ (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set l : List ι := hs.toFinset.toList with hl
  have hlmem : ∀ i, i ∈ l ↔ i ∈ s := by
    intro i; rw [hl, Finset.mem_toList, hs.mem_toFinset]
  have hU : (⋃ B ∈ l.map A, B) = ⋃ i ∈ s, A i := by
    rw [biUnion_list_map]
    exact iUnion_congr fun i => iUnion_congr_Prop (hlmem i) fun _ => rfl
  have hpoly : ∀ B ∈ l.map A, IsPolygonal B := by
    intro B hB
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hB
    exact hA i ((hlmem i).1 hi)
  have := exists_simple_poly_of_union hpoly (hU ▸ hconn) hab (hU ▸ ha) (hU ▸ hb)
  rwa [hU] at this

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_poly_pinned
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_pinned {ι : Type*} {s : Set ι} {A : ι → Set Plane} {E : Set Plane}
    (hs : s.Finite) (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, IsPolygonal (A i))
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (⋃ i ∈ s, A i)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : a ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, A i) (hb : b ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, A i)
    (hS : (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) \ E ⊆ S) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws ⊆ (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) ∧ poly ws \ E ⊆ S ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ws, hws, hhead, hlast, hsub, harc⟩ :=
    exists_simple_poly_of_biUnion_finite hs hA hconn hab ha hb
  exact ⟨ws, hws, hhead, hlast, hsub, fun x hx => hS ⟨hsub hx.1, hx.2⟩, harc⟩

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_poly_of_isPolygonal_pinned
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_of_isPolygonal_pinned {Y E : Set Plane} (hY : IsPolygonal Y)
    (hconn : IsPreconnected Y) (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : a ∈ Y) (hb : b ∈ Y) (hS : Y \ E ⊆ S) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws ⊆ Y ∧ poly ws \ E ⊆ S ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ws, hws, hhead, hlast, hsub, harc⟩ :=
    exists_simple_poly_of_isPolygonal hY hconn hab ha hb
  exact ⟨ws, hws, hhead, hlast, hsub, fun x hx => hS ⟨hsub hx.1, hx.2⟩, harc⟩

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_arc_of_biUnion_finite
statement:
theorem exists_simple_arc_of_biUnion_finite {ι : Type*} {s : Set ι} {A : ι → Set Plane}
    (hs : s.Finite) (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, IsPolygonal (A i))
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (⋃ i ∈ s, A i)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : a ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, A i) (hb : b ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, A i) :
    ∃ P ⊆ (⋃ i ∈ s, A i), IsPolygonal P ∧ IsArcBetween P a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ws, -, -, -, hsub, harc⟩ :=
    exists_simple_poly_of_biUnion_finite hs hA hconn hab ha hb
  exact ⟨poly ws, hsub, ⟨ws, rfl⟩, harc⟩

name: Schoenflies.exists_crosscut_of_biUnion_finite
statement:
theorem exists_crosscut_of_biUnion_finite {ι : Type*} {s : Set ι} {A : ι → Set Plane}
    (hs : s.Finite) (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, IsPolygonal (A i))
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (⋃ i ∈ s, A i)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (haC : a ∈ C) (hbC : b ∈ C)
    (ha : a ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, A i) (hb : b ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, A i)
    (hmeet : (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) ∩ C ⊆ {a, b}) (hD : (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) \ C ⊆ D) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws ⊆ (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b ∧
      poly ws ∩ C = {a, b} ∧ poly ws \ {a, b} ⊆ D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ws, hws, hhead, hlast, hsub, harc⟩ :=
    exists_simple_poly_of_biUnion_finite hs hA hconn hab ha hb
  have haw : a ∈ poly ws := hhead ▸ head_mem_poly hws
  have hbw : b ∈ poly ws := hlast ▸ getLast_mem_poly hws
  refine ⟨ws, hws, hhead, hlast, hsub, harc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine subset_antisymm (fun x hx => hmeet ⟨hsub hx.1, hx.2⟩) ?_
    rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [⟨haw, haC⟩, ⟨hbw, hbC⟩]
  · 
    rintro x ⟨hx, hxab⟩
    exact hD ⟨hsub hx, fun hxC => hxab (hmeet ⟨hsub hx, hxC⟩)⟩

name: Schoenflies.exists_crosscut_arc_of_biUnion_finite
statement:
theorem exists_crosscut_arc_of_biUnion_finite {ι : Type*} {s : Set ι} {A : ι → Set Plane}
    (hs : s.Finite) (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, IsPolygonal (A i))
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (⋃ i ∈ s, A i)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (haC : a ∈ C) (hbC : b ∈ C)
    (ha : a ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, A i) (hb : b ∈ ⋃ i ∈ s, A i)
    (hmeet : (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) ∩ C ⊆ {a, b}) (hD : (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) \ C ⊆ D) :
    ∃ P ⊆ (⋃ i ∈ s, A i), IsPolygonal P ∧ IsArcBetween P a b ∧
      P ∩ C = {a, b} ∧ P \ {a, b} ⊆ D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ws, -, -, -, hsub, harc, hcut, hint⟩ :=
    exists_crosscut_of_biUnion_finite hs hA hconn hab haC hbC ha hb hmeet hD
  exact ⟨poly ws, hsub, ⟨ws, rfl⟩, harc, hcut, hint⟩

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_poly_of_polyAccessible
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_of_polyAccessible (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hconn : IsPreconnected Ω)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : PolyAccessible Ω a) (hb : PolyAccessible Ω b) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws \ {a, b} ⊆ Ω ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨as, has, hahead, halast, haint⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨bs, hbs, hbhead, hblast, hbint⟩ := hb
  
  obtain ⟨ms, hms, hmsub, hmhead, hmlast⟩ :=
    exists_poly_of_isPreconnected hΩ hconn halast hblast
  
  set U : Set Plane := poly as ∪ (poly ms ∪ poly bs) with hU
  have hlist : (⋃ vs ∈ [as, ms, bs], poly vs) = U := by
    rw [biUnion_list_cons (fun vs : List Plane => poly vs),
      biUnion_list_cons (fun vs : List Plane => poly vs),
      biUnion_list_cons (fun vs : List Plane => poly vs), hU]
    simp
  have hconnU : IsPreconnected U := by
    refine (IsConnected.union ?_ (isConnected_poly has) (IsConnected.union ?_
      (isConnected_poly hms) (isConnected_poly hbs))).2
    · exact ⟨as.getLast has, getLast_mem_poly has,
        Or.inl (hmhead ▸ head_mem_poly hms)⟩
    · exact ⟨ms.getLast hms, getLast_mem_poly hms, hmlast ▸ getLast_mem_poly hbs⟩
  
  have hUΩ : U \ {a, b} ⊆ Ω := by
    rintro x ⟨hx, hxab⟩
    rcases hx with hx | hx | hx
    · exact haint ⟨hx, fun hxa => hxab (Or.inl (hahead ▸ hxa))⟩
    · exact hmsub hx
    · exact hbint ⟨hx, fun hxb => hxab (Or.inr (hbhead ▸ hxb))⟩
  have haU : a ∈ U := Or.inl (hahead ▸ head_mem_poly has)
  have hbU : b ∈ U := Or.inr (Or.inr (hbhead ▸ head_mem_poly hbs))
  obtain ⟨ws, hws, hwhead, hwlast, hwsub, hwarc⟩ :=
    exists_simple_poly_of_biUnion (L := [as, ms, bs]) (hlist ▸ hconnU) hab
      (hlist ▸ haU) (hlist ▸ hbU)
  rw [hlist] at hwsub
  exact ⟨ws, hws, hwhead, hwlast, fun x hx => hUΩ ⟨hwsub hx.1, hx.2⟩, hwarc⟩

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_arc_of_polyAccessible
statement:
theorem exists_simple_arc_of_polyAccessible (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hconn : IsPreconnected Ω)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : PolyAccessible Ω a) (hb : PolyAccessible Ω b) :
    ∃ P : Set Plane, IsPolygonal P ∧ IsArcBetween P a b ∧ P \ {a, b} ⊆ Ω
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ws, -, -, -, hsub, harc⟩ :=
    exists_simple_poly_of_polyAccessible hΩ hconn hab ha hb
  exact ⟨poly ws, ⟨ws, rfl⟩, harc, hsub⟩

name: Schoenflies.exists_crosscut_of_polyAccessible
statement:
theorem exists_crosscut_of_polyAccessible (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hconn : IsPreconnected Ω)
    (hdisj : Disjoint Ω C) (hab : a ≠ b) (haC : a ∈ C) (hbC : b ∈ C)
    (ha : PolyAccessible Ω a) (hb : PolyAccessible Ω b) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws \ {a, b} ⊆ Ω ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b ∧ poly ws ∩ C = {a, b}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ws, hws, hhead, hlast, hsub, harc⟩ :=
    exists_simple_poly_of_polyAccessible hΩ hconn hab ha hb
  refine ⟨ws, hws, hhead, hlast, hsub, harc, subset_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · 
    rintro x ⟨hxw, hxC⟩
    by_contra hxab
    exact (hdisj.ne_of_mem (hsub ⟨hxw, hxab⟩) hxC) rfl
  · rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [⟨hhead ▸ head_mem_poly hws, haC⟩, ⟨hlast ▸ getLast_mem_poly hws, hbC⟩]

name: Graph.pointSet_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem pointSet_eq_biUnion (G : Graph Plane β) (drawing : β → ℝ → Plane) :
    pointSet G drawing =
      ⋃ i ∈ (Sum.inl '' V(G) ∪ Sum.inr '' E(G) : Set (Plane ⊕ β)),
        Sum.elim (fun v : Plane => ({v} : Set Plane)) (edgeArc drawing) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [biUnion_union, biUnion_image, biUnion_image]
  simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, biUnion_of_singleton]
  rfl

name: Graph.exists_simple_poly_of_pointSet
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_of_pointSet [G.Finite]
    (hpoly : ∀ e ∈ E(G), IsPolygonal (edgeArc drawing e))
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (pointSet G drawing)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : a ∈ pointSet G drawing) (hb : b ∈ pointSet G drawing) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws ⊆ pointSet G drawing ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : (Sum.inl '' V(G) ∪ Sum.inr '' E(G) : Set (Plane ⊕ β)).Finite :=
    ((G.finite_vertexSet).image _).union ((G.finite_edgeSet).image _)
  have hA : ∀ i ∈ (Sum.inl '' V(G) ∪ Sum.inr '' E(G) : Set (Plane ⊕ β)),
      IsPolygonal (Sum.elim (fun v : Plane => ({v} : Set Plane)) (edgeArc drawing) i) := by
    rintro (v | e) hi
    · exact ⟨[v], rfl⟩
    · refine hpoly e ?_
      rcases hi with ⟨x, -, hx⟩ | ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩
      · exact absurd hx (by simp)
      · exact (Sum.inr_injective hx') ▸ hx
  rw [pointSet_eq_biUnion G drawing] at hconn ha hb ⊢
  exact exists_simple_poly_of_biUnion_finite hfin hA hconn hab ha hb

name: Schoenflies.IsPolygonalCrosscut.connectedComponentIn_cover_eq
statement:
theorem connectedComponentIn_cover_eq {z : Plane} (hz : z ∈ cover K) (hzC : z ∉ C.carrier) :
    connectedComponentIn C.carrierᶜ z = farRegion C.carrier y
proof:
:=
  h.regionPairC.left.connectedComponentIn_eq C.isSeparating_carrier
    (diff_subset_farRegion h.avoids ⟨hz, hzC⟩)

name: Schoenflies.IsPolygonalCrosscut.inter_cover_nonempty
statement:
theorem inter_cover_nonempty {Q : Set Plane} {w₁ w₂ : Plane}
    (hconn : IsPreconnected Q) (hside : Q ⊆ farRegion C.carrier y)
    (hw₁ : w₁ ∈ closure Q) (hw₂ : w₂ ∈ closure Q)
    (hw₁A : w₁ ∈ C.arc a k) (hw₁B : w₁ ∉ C.arc (a + k) (m + 3 - k))
    (hw₂B : w₂ ∈ C.arc (a + k) (m + 3 - k)) (hw₂A : w₂ ∉ C.arc a k) :
    (Q ∩ cover K).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hempty
  rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem] at hempty
  
  have hsub : Q ⊆ farRegion C.carrier y \ cover K :=
    fun z hz => ⟨hside hz, fun hzK => hempty z ⟨hz, hzK⟩⟩
  
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : Q.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hQ
    rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hQ
    rw [hQ, closure_empty] at hw₁
    simp at hw₁
  have hzcell : z ∈ farRegion J₁.carrier y ∪ farRegion J₂.carrier y := by
    rw [← h.region_eq]; exact hsub hz
  
  rcases hzcell with hz₁ | hz₂
  · have hQ₁ : Q ⊆ farRegion J₁.carrier y := by
      have hcc := hconn.subset_connectedComponentIn hz hsub
      rwa [h.cell_isComponent₁ z hz₁] at hcc
    have hmem : w₂ ∈ closure (farRegion J₁.carrier y) ∩ C.carrier :=
      ⟨closure_mono hQ₁ hw₂, C.arc_subset_carrier _ _ hw₂B⟩
    rw [h.closure_cell_inter₁] at hmem
    exact hw₂A hmem
  · have hQ₂ : Q ⊆ farRegion J₂.carrier y := by
      have hcc := hconn.subset_connectedComponentIn hz hsub
      rwa [h.cell_isComponent₂ z hz₂] at hcc
    have hmem : w₁ ∈ closure (farRegion J₂.carrier y) ∩ C.carrier :=
      ⟨closure_mono hQ₂ hw₁, C.arc_subset_carrier _ _ hw₁A⟩
    rw [h.closure_cell_inter₂] at hmem
    exact hw₁B hmem

name: Schoenflies.IsPolygonalCrosscut.arc_inter_cover_nonempty
statement:
theorem arc_inter_cover_nonempty {P : Set Plane} {w₁ w₂ : Plane}
    (hP : IsArcBetween P w₁ w₂) (hside : P \ {w₁, w₂} ⊆ farRegion C.carrier y)
    (hw₁A : w₁ ∈ C.arc a k) (hw₁B : w₁ ∉ C.arc (a + k) (m + 3 - k))
    (hw₂B : w₂ ∈ C.arc (a + k) (m + 3 - k)) (hw₂A : w₂ ∉ C.arc a k) :
    (P ∩ cover K).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hzQ, hzK⟩ := h.inter_cover_nonempty hP.isPreconnected_diff hside
    hP.left_mem_closure_diff hP.right_mem_closure_diff hw₁A hw₁B hw₂B hw₂A
  exact ⟨z, hzQ.1, hzK⟩

name: Schoenflies.IsPolygonalCrosscut.alternating_inter_nonempty
statement:
theorem alternating_inter_nonempty {A B P : Set Plane} {p q w₁ w₂ : Plane}
    (hA : C.arc a k = A) (hB : C.arc (a + k) (m + 3 - k) = B)
    (hAB : A ∩ B = ({p, q} : Set Plane))
    (hP : IsArcBetween P w₁ w₂) (hside : P \ {w₁, w₂} ⊆ farRegion C.carrier y)
    (hw₁ : w₁ ∈ A \ ({p, q} : Set Plane)) (hw₂ : w₂ ∈ B \ ({p, q} : Set Plane)) :
    (P ∩ cover K).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  
  refine h.arc_inter_cover_nonempty hP hside (hA ▸ hw₁.1) ?_ (hB ▸ hw₂.1) ?_
  · rw [hB]; exact fun hmem => hw₁.2 (hAB ▸ Set.mem_inter hw₁.1 hmem)
  · rw [hA]; exact fun hmem => hw₂.2 (hAB ▸ Set.mem_inter hmem hw₂.1)

name: Schoenflies.IsPolygonalCrosscut.alternating_inter_nonempty_of_same_side
statement:
theorem alternating_inter_nonempty_of_same_side {A B P : Set Plane} {p q w₁ w₂ z : Plane}
    (hz : z ∈ cover K) (hzC : z ∉ C.carrier)
    (hA : C.arc a k = A) (hB : C.arc (a + k) (m + 3 - k) = B)
    (hAB : A ∩ B = ({p, q} : Set Plane))
    (hP : IsArcBetween P w₁ w₂)
    (hside : P \ {w₁, w₂} ⊆ connectedComponentIn C.carrierᶜ z)
    (hw₁ : w₁ ∈ A \ ({p, q} : Set Plane)) (hw₂ : w₂ ∈ B \ ({p, q} : Set Plane)) :
    (P ∩ cover K).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  h.alternating_inter_nonempty hA hB hAB hP
    (hside.trans (h.connectedComponentIn_cover_eq hz hzC).subset) hw₁ hw₂

name: Schoenflies.IsPolygonalCrosscut.alternating_inter_nonempty_inside
statement:
theorem alternating_inter_nonempty_inside {A B P : Set Plane} {p q w₁ w₂ : Plane}
    (hy : y ∈ outside C.carrier)
    (hA : C.arc a k = A) (hB : C.arc (a + k) (m + 3 - k) = B)
    (hAB : A ∩ B = ({p, q} : Set Plane))
    (hP : IsArcBetween P w₁ w₂) (hside : P \ {w₁, w₂} ⊆ inside C.carrier)
    (hw₁ : w₁ ∈ A \ ({p, q} : Set Plane)) (hw₂ : w₂ ∈ B \ ({p, q} : Set Plane)) :
    (P ∩ cover K).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  h.alternating_inter_nonempty hA hB hAB hP
    (hside.trans (C.isSeparating_carrier.farRegion_eq_inside hy).symm.subset) hw₁ hw₂

name: Schoenflies.IsPolygonalCrosscut.alternating_inter_nonempty_outside
statement:
theorem alternating_inter_nonempty_outside {A B P : Set Plane} {p q w₁ w₂ : Plane}
    (hy : y ∈ inside C.carrier)
    (hA : C.arc a k = A) (hB : C.arc (a + k) (m + 3 - k) = B)
    (hAB : A ∩ B = ({p, q} : Set Plane))
    (hP : IsArcBetween P w₁ w₂) (hside : P \ {w₁, w₂} ⊆ outside C.carrier)
    (hw₁ : w₁ ∈ A \ ({p, q} : Set Plane)) (hw₂ : w₂ ∈ B \ ({p, q} : Set Plane)) :
    (P ∩ cover K).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  h.alternating_inter_nonempty hA hB hAB hP
    (hside.trans (C.isSeparating_carrier.farRegion_eq_outside hy).symm.subset) hw₁ hw₂

name: Schoenflies.alternating_crosscuts
statement:
theorem alternating_crosscuts {A B P : Set Plane} {p q w₁ w₂ : Plane}
    (h : IsPolygonalCrosscut C J₁ J₂ K a k y)
    (hA : C.arc a k = A) (hB : C.arc (a + k) (m + 3 - k) = B)
    (hAB : A ∩ B = ({p, q} : Set Plane))
    (hP : IsArcBetween P w₁ w₂) (hside : P \ {w₁, w₂} ⊆ farRegion C.carrier y)
    (hw₁ : w₁ ∈ A \ ({p, q} : Set Plane)) (hw₂ : w₂ ∈ B \ ({p, q} : Set Plane)) :
    (P ∩ cover K).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  h.alternating_inter_nonempty hA hB hAB hP hside hw₁ hw₂

name: Schoenflies.Plane.perp_neg
statement: theorem perp_neg (u : Plane) : perp (-u) = -perp u
proof:
:= by
  ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [perp]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.mem_carrier_iff
statement: theorem mem_carrier_iff {x : Plane} : x ∈ A.carrier ↔ ∃ i ≤ n, x ∈ A.edge i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [carrier, Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.edge_subset_carrier
statement: theorem edge_subset_carrier (hi : i ≤ n) : A.edge i ⊆ A.carrier
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => mem_carrier_iff.2 ⟨i, hi, hx⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.vertex_ne
statement: theorem vertex_ne : A.vertex i ≠ A.vertex (i + 1)
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := A.vertex_inj h; omega

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.sub_ne_zero_of_edge
statement: theorem sub_ne_zero_of_edge : A.vertex (i + 1) - A.vertex i ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  sub_ne_zero.2 (vertex_ne (A := A) (i := i)).symm

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.len_pos
statement: theorem len_pos : 0 < A.len i
proof: := norm_pos_iff.2 sub_ne_zero_of_edge

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.isDirection_tang
statement: theorem isDirection_tang : IsDirection (A.tang i)
proof: := isDirection_dir sub_ne_zero_of_edge

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.len_smul_tang
statement: theorem len_smul_tang : (A.len i) • A.tang i = A.vertex (i + 1) - A.vertex i
proof:
:= by
  rw [tang, dir, smul_smul, len, mul_inv_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 sub_ne_zero_of_edge),
    one_smul]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.vertex_succ_eq
statement: theorem vertex_succ_eq : A.vertex (i + 1) = A.vertex i + (A.len i) • A.tang i
proof:
:= by
  rw [len_smul_tang]; module

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.back_eq
statement: theorem back_eq : A.back i = -A.tang i
proof:
:= by
  rw [back, tang, dir, dir, norm_sub_rev (A.vertex i) (A.vertex (i + 1))]
  module

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.isDirection_back
statement: theorem isDirection_back : IsDirection (A.back i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [back_eq, IsDirection, norm_neg]; exact isDirection_tang.norm

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.perp_back
statement: theorem perp_back : perp (A.back i) = -perp (A.tang i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [back_eq, perp_neg]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.det_rays_ne_zero
statement: theorem det_rays_ne_zero (hi : i < n) : det (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, h₁⟩ := dir_eq_smul (sub_ne_zero.2 (vertex_ne (A := A) (i := i)))
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, h₂⟩ := dir_eq_smul (sub_ne_zero_of_edge (A := A) (i := i + 1))
  rw [back, tang, h₁, h₂, det_smul_left, det_smul_right]
  exact mul_ne_zero hc₁.ne' (mul_ne_zero hc₂.ne' (A.corner i hi))

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.off_zero_zero
statement: theorem off_zero_zero : A.off i 0 0 = A.vertex i
proof: := by rw [off]; module

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.pt_zero
statement: theorem pt_zero : A.pt i 0 = A.vertex i
proof: := off_zero_zero

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.pt_eq
statement: theorem pt_eq : A.pt i c = A.vertex i + c • A.tang i
proof: := by rw [pt, off, zero_smul, add_zero]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.pt_len
statement: theorem pt_len : A.pt i (A.len i) = A.vertex (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pt_eq, ← vertex_succ_eq]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.off_sub_vertex
statement: theorem off_sub_vertex : A.off i t s - A.vertex i = t • A.tang i + s • perp (A.tang i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [off]; module

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.pt_sub_vertex
statement: theorem pt_sub_vertex : A.pt i c - A.vertex i = c • A.tang i
proof:
:= by
  rw [pt, off_sub_vertex, zero_smul, add_zero]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.dist_pt_vertex
statement: theorem dist_pt_vertex : dist (A.pt i c) (A.vertex i) = |c|
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, pt_sub_vertex, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, isDirection_tang.norm, mul_one]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.off_sub_vertex_succ
statement:
theorem off_sub_vertex_succ :
    A.off i t s - A.vertex (i + 1) = (t - A.len i) • A.tang i + s • perp (A.tang i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [off, vertex_succ_eq]; module

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.off_sub_vertex_succ_ray
statement:
theorem off_sub_vertex_succ_ray :
    A.off i t s - A.vertex (i + 1) =
      (A.len i - t) • A.back i - s • perp (A.back i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [off_sub_vertex_succ, perp_back, back_eq]
  module

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.dist_off_vertex_le
statement: theorem dist_off_vertex_le : dist (A.off i t s) (A.vertex i) ≤ |t| + |s|
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, off_sub_vertex]
  calc ‖t • A.tang i + s • perp (A.tang i)‖ ≤ ‖t • A.tang i‖ + ‖s • perp (A.tang i)‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
    _ = |t| + |s| := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_perp,
          isDirection_tang.norm, mul_one, mul_one]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.dist_off_vertex_succ_le
statement:
theorem dist_off_vertex_succ_le :
    dist (A.off i t s) (A.vertex (i + 1)) ≤ |t - A.len i| + |s|
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, off_sub_vertex_succ]
  calc ‖(t - A.len i) • A.tang i + s • perp (A.tang i)‖
      ≤ ‖(t - A.len i) • A.tang i‖ + ‖s • perp (A.tang i)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = |t - A.len i| + |s| := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_perp,
          isDirection_tang.norm, mul_one, mul_one]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.dist_pt_vertex_succ
statement: theorem dist_pt_vertex_succ : dist (A.pt i c) (A.vertex (i + 1)) = |c - A.len i|
proof:
:= by
  rw [pt, dist_eq_norm, off_sub_vertex_succ, zero_smul, add_zero, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    isDirection_tang.norm, mul_one]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.dist_off_pt
statement: theorem dist_off_pt : dist (A.off i t s) (A.pt i t) = |s|
proof:
:= by
  rw [pt, dist_eq_norm, show A.off i t s - A.off i t 0 = s • perp (A.tang i) by
    rw [off, off]; module, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_perp, isDirection_tang.norm,
    mul_one]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.coordAlong_off
statement: @[simp] theorem coordAlong_off : coordAlong (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) (A.off i t s) = t
proof:
:=
  coordAlong_param isDirection_tang _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.coordAcross_off
statement: @[simp] theorem coordAcross_off : coordAcross (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) (A.off i t s) = s
proof:
:=
  coordAcross_param isDirection_tang _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.off_coord
statement:
theorem off_coord (A : PolyArc n) (i : ℕ) (x : Plane) :
    x = A.off i (coordAlong (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x) (coordAcross (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x)
proof:
:=
  frame_decomp isDirection_tang _ _

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.mem_edge_iff
statement:
theorem mem_edge_iff {x : Plane} :
    x ∈ A.edge i ↔ ∃ c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (A.len i), x = A.pt i c
proof:
:= by
  rw [edge, segment_eq_image' ℝ]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨θ, ⟨hθ0, hθ1⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨θ * A.len i, ⟨mul_nonneg hθ0 len_pos.le, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · nlinarith [len_pos (A := A) (i := i)]
    · rw [pt_eq, ← len_smul_tang]
      simp [smul_smul]
  · rintro ⟨c, ⟨hc0, hc1⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨c / A.len i, ⟨div_nonneg hc0 len_pos.le, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [div_le_one len_pos]; exact hc1
    · rw [pt_eq, ← len_smul_tang]
      simp [smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (len_pos (A := A) (i := i)).ne']

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.pt_mem_edge
statement: theorem pt_mem_edge (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (A.len i)) : A.pt i c ∈ A.edge i
proof:
:=
  mem_edge_iff.2 ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.vertex_mem_edge
statement: theorem vertex_mem_edge : A.vertex i ∈ A.edge i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pt_zero]; exact pt_mem_edge ⟨le_refl _, len_pos.le⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.vertex_succ_mem_edge
statement: theorem vertex_succ_mem_edge : A.vertex (i + 1) ∈ A.edge i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pt_len]; exact pt_mem_edge ⟨len_pos.le, le_refl _⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.vertex_mem_carrier
statement: theorem vertex_mem_carrier (hi : i ≤ n) : A.vertex i ∈ A.carrier
proof:
:=
  edge_subset_carrier hi vertex_mem_edge

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.mem_edge_sub
statement:
theorem mem_edge_sub {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ A.edge i) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ x - A.vertex i = c • A.tang i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, ⟨hc0, _⟩, rfl⟩ := mem_edge_iff.1 hx
  exact ⟨c, hc0, pt_sub_vertex⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.mem_edge_sub_succ
statement:
theorem mem_edge_sub_succ {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ A.edge i) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ x - A.vertex (i + 1) = c • A.back i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, ⟨hc0, hc1⟩, rfl⟩ := mem_edge_iff.1 hx
  refine ⟨A.len i - c, by linarith, ?_⟩
  rw [pt, off_sub_vertex_succ, back_eq, zero_smul, add_zero]
  module

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.vertex_add_smul_back
statement: theorem vertex_add_smul_back : A.vertex (i + 1) + c • A.back i = A.pt i (A.len i - c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pt_eq, back_eq, vertex_succ_eq]
  module

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.mem_edge_of_smul_back
statement:
theorem mem_edge_of_smul_back (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ A.len i) :
    A.vertex (i + 1) + c • A.back i ∈ A.edge i
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertex_add_smul_back]
  exact pt_mem_edge ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.mem_edge_of_smul_tang
statement:
theorem mem_edge_of_smul_tang (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ A.len i) :
    A.vertex i + c • A.tang i ∈ A.edge i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pt_eq]; exact pt_mem_edge ⟨hc0, hc1⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.isCompact_edge
statement: theorem isCompact_edge : IsCompact (A.edge i)
proof: := isCompact_segment _ _

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.continuous_pt
statement: theorem continuous_pt (A : PolyArc n) (i : ℕ) : Continuous (A.pt i)
proof:
:= by
  have h : A.pt i = fun c : ℝ => A.vertex i + c • A.tang i := funext fun _ => pt_eq
  rw [h]
  exact continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.vertex_notMem_edge
statement:
theorem vertex_notMem_edge (hi : i ≤ n + 1) (hj : j ≤ n) (h1 : i ≠ j) (h2 : i ≠ j + 1) :
    A.vertex i ∉ A.edge j
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i (n + 1) with hlt | hge
  · 
    have hi' : i ≤ n := by omega
    have hmem : A.vertex i ∈ A.edge j ∩ A.edge i := ⟨hx, vertex_mem_edge⟩
    have hsub := A.edges_meet j hj i hi' (Ne.symm h1) hmem
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hsub
    rcases hsub with h | h
    · exact h1 (A.vertex_inj h)
    · exact h2 (A.vertex_inj h)
  · 
    have hin : i = n + 1 := by omega
    subst hin
    have hjn : j ≠ n := fun h => h2 (by omega)
    have hmem : A.vertex (n + 1) ∈ A.edge j ∩ A.edge n := ⟨hx, vertex_succ_mem_edge⟩
    have hsub := A.edges_meet j hj n (le_refl n) hjn hmem
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hsub
    rcases hsub with h | h
    · exact h1 (A.vertex_inj h)
    · exact h2 (A.vertex_inj h)

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.pt_mem_trimmed
statement:
theorem pt_mem_trimmed {lam : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc lam (A.len i - lam)) :
    A.pt i c ∈ A.trimmed i lam
proof: := ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.isCompact_trimmed
statement: theorem isCompact_trimmed {lam : ℝ} : IsCompact (A.trimmed i lam)
proof:
:=
  isCompact_Icc.image (A.continuous_pt i)

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.trimmed_subset_edge
statement: theorem trimmed_subset_edge {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) : A.trimmed i lam ⊆ A.edge i
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
  exact pt_mem_edge ⟨le_trans hlam.le hc.1, le_trans hc.2 (by linarith)⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.trimmed_disjoint_edge
statement:
theorem trimmed_disjoint_edge {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (hi : i ≤ n) (hj : j ≤ n) (hij : j ≠ i) :
    Disjoint (A.trimmed i lam) (A.edge j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro x ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ hx
  have hc0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ c := le_trans hlam.le hc.1
  have hcl : c ≤ A.len i := le_trans hc.2 (by linarith)
  have hmem : A.pt i c ∈ A.edge i ∩ A.edge j := ⟨pt_mem_edge ⟨hc0, hcl⟩, hx⟩
  have hsub := A.edges_meet i hi j hj (Ne.symm hij) hmem
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hsub
  rcases hsub with h | h
  · have h0 : |c| = 0 := by rw [← dist_pt_vertex (A := A) (i := i) (c := c), h, dist_self]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hc0] at h0
    linarith [hc.1]
  · have h0 : |c - A.len i| = 0 := by
      rw [← dist_pt_vertex_succ (A := A) (i := i) (c := c), h, dist_self]
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)] at h0
    linarith [hc.2]

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.off_sub_mem_arcL_start
statement:
theorem off_sub_mem_arcL_start (hi : i < n) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsm : s * |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))| <
      t * |det (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))|) :
    A.off (i + 1) t s - A.vertex (i + 1) ∈ arcCCW (A.tang (i + 1)) (A.back i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [off_sub_vertex]
  exact (germs_split' (det_rays_ne_zero hi) hs hsm).1.2

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.off_sub_mem_arcR_start
statement:
theorem off_sub_mem_arcR_start (hi : i < n) (hs : s < 0)
    (hsm : (-s) * |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))| <
      t * |det (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))|) :
    A.off (i + 1) t s - A.vertex (i + 1) ∈ arcCCW (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h : A.off (i + 1) t s - A.vertex (i + 1) =
      t • A.tang (i + 1) - (-s) • perp (A.tang (i + 1)) := by
    rw [off_sub_vertex]; module
  rw [h]
  exact (germs_split' (det_rays_ne_zero hi) (by linarith) hsm).2.2

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.off_sub_mem_arcL_finish
statement:
theorem off_sub_mem_arcL_finish (hi : i < n) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsm : s * |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))| <
      (A.len i - t) * |det (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))|) :
    A.off i t s - A.vertex (i + 1) ∈ arcCCW (A.tang (i + 1)) (A.back i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [off_sub_vertex_succ_ray]
  exact (germs_split' (det_rays_ne_zero hi) hs hsm).1.1

name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.off_sub_mem_arcR_finish
statement:
theorem off_sub_mem_arcR_finish (hi : i < n) (hs : s < 0)
    (hsm : (-s) * |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))| <
      (A.len i - t) * |det (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))|) :
    A.off i t s - A.vertex (i + 1) ∈ arcCCW (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h : A.off i t s - A.vertex (i + 1) =
      (A.len i - t) • A.back i + (-s) • perp (A.back i) := by
    rw [off_sub_vertex_succ_ray]; module
  rw [h]
  exact (germs_split' (det_rays_ne_zero hi) (by linarith) hsm).2.1

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.lam_pos
statement: theorem lam_pos : 0 < S.lam
proof: := lt_trans S.rho_pos S.rho_lt_lam

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.R_pos
statement: theorem R_pos : 0 < S.R
proof: := by have := S.lam_pos; linarith [S.two_lam_lt_R]

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.rho_lt_R
statement: theorem rho_lt_R : S.rho < S.R
proof:
:= by
  have := S.lam_pos; have := S.rho_lt_lam; linarith [S.two_lam_lt_R]

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.lam_lt_R
statement: theorem lam_lt_R : S.lam < S.R
proof: := by have := S.lam_pos; linarith [S.two_lam_lt_R]

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.mem_blockL_iff
statement:
theorem mem_blockL_iff : x ∈ S.blockL i ↔
    S.lam < coordAlong (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x ∧
      coordAlong (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x < A.len i - S.lam ∧
      0 < coordAcross (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x ∧
      coordAcross (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x < S.rho
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.mem_blockR_iff
statement:
theorem mem_blockR_iff : x ∈ S.blockR i ↔
    S.lam < coordAlong (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x ∧
      coordAlong (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x < A.len i - S.lam ∧
      -S.rho < coordAcross (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x ∧
      coordAcross (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x < 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.mem_tube_iff
statement:
theorem mem_tube_iff : x ∈ S.tube i ↔
    S.lam < coordAlong (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x ∧
      coordAlong (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x < A.len i - S.lam ∧
      -S.rho < coordAcross (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x ∧
      coordAcross (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x < S.rho
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.mem_blockL_off
statement:
theorem mem_blockL_off {t s : ℝ} : A.off i t s ∈ S.blockL i ↔
    S.lam < t ∧ t < A.len i - S.lam ∧ 0 < s ∧ s < S.rho
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_blockL_iff, PolyArc.coordAlong_off, PolyArc.coordAcross_off]

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.mem_blockR_off
statement:
theorem mem_blockR_off {t s : ℝ} : A.off i t s ∈ S.blockR i ↔
    S.lam < t ∧ t < A.len i - S.lam ∧ -S.rho < s ∧ s < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_blockR_iff, PolyArc.coordAlong_off, PolyArc.coordAcross_off]

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.mem_tube_off
statement:
theorem mem_tube_off {t s : ℝ} : A.off i t s ∈ S.tube i ↔
    S.lam < t ∧ t < A.len i - S.lam ∧ -S.rho < s ∧ s < S.rho
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_tube_iff, PolyArc.coordAlong_off, PolyArc.coordAcross_off]

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.isOpen_blockL
statement: theorem isOpen_blockL : IsOpen (S.blockL i)
proof: := isOpen_strip _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.isOpen_blockR
statement: theorem isOpen_blockR : IsOpen (S.blockR i)
proof: := isOpen_strip _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.isOpen_tube
statement: theorem isOpen_tube : IsOpen (S.tube i)
proof: := isOpen_strip _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.isOpen_sectorL
statement: theorem isOpen_sectorL : IsOpen (S.sectorL i)
proof: := isOpen_cone (isOpen_arcCCW _ _)

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.isOpen_sectorR
statement: theorem isOpen_sectorR : IsOpen (S.sectorR i)
proof: := isOpen_cone (isOpen_arcCCW _ _)

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.convex_blockL
statement: theorem convex_blockL : Convex ℝ (S.blockL i)
proof: := convex_strip _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.convex_blockR
statement: theorem convex_blockR : Convex ℝ (S.blockR i)
proof: := convex_strip _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.isConnected_sectorL
statement: theorem isConnected_sectorL (hi : i < n) : IsConnected (S.sectorL i)
proof:
:=
  isConnected_cone_arcCCW _
    (by rw [det_comm]; exact neg_ne_zero.2 (PolyArc.det_rays_ne_zero hi)) S.R_pos

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.isConnected_sectorR
statement: theorem isConnected_sectorR (hi : i < n) : IsConnected (S.sectorR i)
proof:
:=
  isConnected_cone_arcCCW _ (PolyArc.det_rays_ne_zero hi) S.R_pos

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.blockL_subset_tube
statement: theorem blockL_subset_tube : S.blockL i ⊆ S.tube i
proof:
:= fun _ hy =>
  ⟨hy.1, hy.2.1, by linarith [S.rho_pos, hy.2.2.1], hy.2.2.2⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.blockR_subset_tube
statement: theorem blockR_subset_tube : S.blockR i ⊆ S.tube i
proof:
:= fun _ hy =>
  ⟨hy.1, hy.2.1, hy.2.2.1, by linarith [S.rho_pos, hy.2.2.2]⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.sectorL_subset_ball
statement: theorem sectorL_subset_ball : S.sectorL i ⊆ ball (A.vertex (i + 1)) S.R
proof: := cone_subset_ball

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.sectorR_subset_ball
statement: theorem sectorR_subset_ball : S.sectorR i ⊆ ball (A.vertex (i + 1)) S.R
proof: := cone_subset_ball

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.exists_foot
statement:
theorem exists_foot (h : x ∈ S.tube i) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.Icc S.lam (A.len i - S.lam), dist x (A.pt i c) < S.rho
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := S.mem_tube_iff.1 h
  refine ⟨coordAlong (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) x, ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [PolyArc.pt_eq, dist_foot PolyArc.isDirection_tang, abs_lt]
  exact ⟨h3, h4⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.pt_mem_edge_of_trim
statement:
theorem pt_mem_edge_of_trim {c : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc S.lam (A.len i - S.lam)) :
    A.pt i c ∈ A.edge i
proof:
:=
  PolyArc.pt_mem_edge ⟨le_trans S.lam_pos.le hc.1, le_trans hc.2 (by linarith [S.lam_pos])⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.germ_ineq
statement:
theorem germ_ineq (hi : i < n) {t s : ℝ} (ht : S.lam < t) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s < S.rho) :
    s * |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))| < t * |det (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))|
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < |det (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))| := abs_pos.2 (PolyArc.det_rays_ne_zero hi)
  have habs : (0 : ℝ) ≤ |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))| := abs_nonneg _
  have h1 : s * |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))| ≤
      s * (1 + |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))|) := by nlinarith
  have h2 : s * (1 + |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))|) <
      S.rho * (1 + |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))|) := by nlinarith
  have h3 := S.germ i hi
  nlinarith

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.blockL_sub_mem_arcL_start
statement:
theorem blockL_sub_mem_arcL_start (hi : i < n) (h : x ∈ S.blockL (i + 1)) :
    x - A.vertex (i + 1) ∈ arcCCW (A.tang (i + 1)) (A.back i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := S.mem_blockL_iff.1 h
  rw [PolyArc.off_coord A (i + 1) x]
  exact PolyArc.off_sub_mem_arcL_start hi h3 (S.germ_ineq hi h1 h3 h4)

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.blockL_sub_mem_arcL_finish
statement:
theorem blockL_sub_mem_arcL_finish (hi : i < n) (h : x ∈ S.blockL i) :
    x - A.vertex (i + 1) ∈ arcCCW (A.tang (i + 1)) (A.back i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := S.mem_blockL_iff.1 h
  rw [PolyArc.off_coord A i x]
  exact PolyArc.off_sub_mem_arcL_finish hi h3
    (S.germ_ineq hi (by linarith) h3 h4)

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.blockR_sub_mem_arcR_start
statement:
theorem blockR_sub_mem_arcR_start (hi : i < n) (h : x ∈ S.blockR (i + 1)) :
    x - A.vertex (i + 1) ∈ arcCCW (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := S.mem_blockR_iff.1 h
  rw [PolyArc.off_coord A (i + 1) x]
  exact PolyArc.off_sub_mem_arcR_start hi h4
    (S.germ_ineq hi h1 (by linarith) (by linarith))

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.blockR_sub_mem_arcR_finish
statement:
theorem blockR_sub_mem_arcR_finish (hi : i < n) (h : x ∈ S.blockR i) :
    x - A.vertex (i + 1) ∈ arcCCW (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := S.mem_blockR_iff.1 h
  rw [PolyArc.off_coord A i x]
  exact PolyArc.off_sub_mem_arcR_finish hi h4
    (S.germ_ineq hi (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith))

name: Schoenflies.mem_iUnion_le_nat
statement:
theorem mem_iUnion_le_nat {α : Type*} {F : ℕ → Set α} {m : ℕ} {x : α} :
    x ∈ (⋃ i, ⋃ (_ : i ≤ m), F i) ↔ ∃ i ≤ m, x ∈ F i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop]

name: Schoenflies.mem_iUnion_lt_nat
statement:
theorem mem_iUnion_lt_nat {α : Type*} {F : ℕ → Set α} {m : ℕ} {x : α} :
    x ∈ (⋃ i, ⋃ (_ : i < m), F i) ↔ ∃ i < m, x ∈ F i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop]

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.tube_notMem_edge
statement:
theorem tube_notMem_edge (hi : i ≤ n) (hj : j ≤ n) (hji : j ≠ i) (h : x ∈ S.tube i) :
    x ∉ A.edge j
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hd⟩ := S.exists_foot h
  have := S.sep_trim_edge i hi j hj hji c hc x hx
  rw [dist_comm] at hd
  linarith [S.rho_pos]

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.block_notMem_own_edge
statement: theorem block_notMem_own_edge (h : x ∈ S.blockL i ∪ S.blockR i) : x ∉ A.edge i
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := PolyArc.mem_edge_iff.1 hx
  have hzero : coordAcross (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) (A.pt i c) = 0 := by
    rw [PolyArc.pt]; exact PolyArc.coordAcross_off
  rcases h with h | h
  · have hpos := (S.mem_blockL_iff.1 h).2.2.1
    rw [hzero] at hpos; exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  · have hneg := (S.mem_blockR_iff.1 h).2.2.2
    rw [hzero] at hneg; exact lt_irrefl 0 hneg

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.block_notMem_carrier
statement: theorem block_notMem_carrier (hi : i ≤ n) (h : x ∈ S.blockL i ∪ S.blockR i) : x ∉ A.carrier
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := PolyArc.mem_carrier_iff.1 hx
  by_cases hij : j = i
  · exact S.block_notMem_own_edge h (hij ▸ hxj)
  · have htube : x ∈ S.tube i :=
      h.elim (fun h => S.blockL_subset_tube h) (fun h => S.blockR_subset_tube h)
    exact S.tube_notMem_edge hi hj hij htube hxj

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.tube_notMem_ball_vertex
statement:
theorem tube_notMem_ball_vertex (hi : i ≤ n) (hj : j ≤ n + 1) (hj1 : j ≠ i) (hj2 : j ≠ i + 1)
    (h : x ∈ S.tube i) : x ∉ ball (A.vertex j) S.R
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hd⟩ := S.exists_foot h
  have hsep := S.sep_vertex_edge j hj i hi hj1 hj2 _ (S.pt_mem_edge_of_trim hc)
  have h1 : dist (A.vertex j) (A.pt i c) ≤ dist (A.vertex j) x + dist x (A.pt i c) :=
    dist_triangle _ _ _
  rw [mem_ball, dist_comm] at hx
  linarith [S.rho_lt_R]

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.sector_notMem_far_edge
statement:
theorem sector_notMem_far_edge (hi : i ≤ n + 1) (hj : j ≤ n) (h1 : i ≠ j) (h2 : i ≠ j + 1)
    (h : x ∈ ball (A.vertex i) S.R) : x ∉ A.edge j
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  have := S.sep_vertex_edge i hi j hj h1 h2 x hx
  rw [mem_ball, dist_comm] at h
  linarith [S.R_pos]

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.sectorL_notMem_carrier
statement: theorem sectorL_notMem_carrier (hi : i < n) (h : x ∈ S.sectorL i) : x ∉ A.carrier
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := PolyArc.mem_carrier_iff.1 hx
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · rw [hji] at hxj
    obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := PolyArc.mem_edge_sub_succ hxj
    exact ((notMem_arcCCW_smul (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1)) hc).2) (he ▸ h.1)
  by_cases hjs : j = i + 1
  · rw [hjs] at hxj
    obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := PolyArc.mem_edge_sub hxj
    exact ((notMem_arcCCW_smul (A.tang (i + 1)) (A.back i) hc).1) (he ▸ h.1)
  · exact S.sector_notMem_far_edge (by omega) hj (fun he => hjs he.symm)
      (fun he => hji (by omega)) h.2 hxj

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.sectorR_notMem_carrier
statement: theorem sectorR_notMem_carrier (hi : i < n) (h : x ∈ S.sectorR i) : x ∉ A.carrier
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := PolyArc.mem_carrier_iff.1 hx
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · rw [hji] at hxj
    obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := PolyArc.mem_edge_sub_succ hxj
    exact ((notMem_arcCCW_smul (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1)) hc).1) (he ▸ h.1)
  by_cases hjs : j = i + 1
  · rw [hjs] at hxj
    obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := PolyArc.mem_edge_sub hxj
    exact ((notMem_arcCCW_smul (A.tang (i + 1)) (A.back i) hc).2) (he ▸ h.1)
  · exact S.sector_notMem_far_edge (by omega) hj (fun he => hjs he.symm)
      (fun he => hji (by omega)) h.2 hxj

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.blockL_subset_chainL

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.mem_sideL_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sideL_iff :
    x ∈ S.sideL ↔ (∃ i ≤ n, x ∈ S.blockL i) ∨ (∃ i < n, x ∈ S.sectorL i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sideL, mem_iUnion_le_nat]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, hxk⟩
    cases k with
    | zero => exact Or.inl ⟨0, Nat.zero_le n, hxk⟩
    | succ k =>
        rcases hxk with h | h
        · exact Or.inr ⟨k, by omega, h⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨k + 1, hk, h⟩
  · rintro (⟨i, hi, h⟩ | ⟨i, hi, h⟩)
    · exact ⟨i, hi, S.blockL_subset_chainL i h⟩
    · exact ⟨i + 1, by omega, Or.inl h⟩

statement:

    x ∈ S.sideR ↔ (∃ i ≤ n, x ∈ S.blockR i) ∨ (∃ i < n, x ∈ S.sectorR i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sideR, mem_iUnion_le_nat]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, hxk⟩
    cases k with
    | zero => exact Or.inl ⟨0, Nat.zero_le n, hxk⟩
    | succ k =>
        rcases hxk with h | h
        · exact Or.inr ⟨k, by omega, h⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨k + 1, hk, h⟩
  · rintro (⟨i, hi, h⟩ | ⟨i, hi, h⟩)
    · exact ⟨i, hi, S.blockR_subset_chainR i h⟩
    · exact ⟨i + 1, by omega, Or.inl h⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.sideL_subset_nbhd

:= by

  · exact Or.inl (mem_iUnion_le_nat.2 ⟨i, hi, S.blockL_subset_tube h⟩)

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.ball_diff_carrier_subset
statement:
theorem ball_diff_carrier_subset (hi : i < n) :
    ball (A.vertex (i + 1)) S.R \ A.carrier ⊆ S.sectorL i ∪ S.sectorR i
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨hy, hyc⟩
  have hne : y - A.vertex (i + 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact hyc (h ▸ PolyArc.vertex_mem_carrier (i := i + 1) (by omega))
  rcases mem_ray_or_mem_arcCCW' (PolyArc.det_rays_ne_zero hi) hne with
    ⟨c, hc, hcy⟩ | ⟨c, hc, hcy⟩ | harc | harc
  · 
    refine absurd ?_ hyc
    have hd : dist y (A.vertex (i + 1)) = c := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hcy, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        (PolyArc.isDirection_back (A := A) (i := i)).norm, mul_one, abs_of_pos hc]
    rw [mem_ball, hd] at hy
    have hy' : y = A.vertex (i + 1) + c • A.back i := by rw [← hcy]; module
    rw [hy']
    exact PolyArc.edge_subset_carrier (by omega)
      (PolyArc.mem_edge_of_smul_back hc.le (le_trans hy.le (S.R_le_len i (by omega))))
  · 
    refine absurd ?_ hyc
    have hd : dist y (A.vertex (i + 1)) = c := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hcy, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        (PolyArc.isDirection_tang (A := A) (i := i + 1)).norm, mul_one, abs_of_pos hc]
    rw [mem_ball, hd] at hy
    have hy' : y = A.vertex (i + 1) + c • A.tang (i + 1) := by rw [← hcy]; module
    rw [hy']
    exact PolyArc.edge_subset_carrier (by omega)
      (PolyArc.mem_edge_of_smul_tang hc.le (le_trans hy.le (S.R_le_len (i + 1) (by omega))))
  · exact Or.inr ⟨harc, hy⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨harc, hy⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.tube_diff_carrier_subset
statement:
theorem tube_diff_carrier_subset (hi : i ≤ n) :
    S.tube i \ A.carrier ⊆ S.blockL i ∪ S.blockR i
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩, hyc⟩
  rcases lt_trichotomy (coordAcross (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) y) 0 with h | h | h
  · exact Or.inr (S.mem_blockR_iff.2 ⟨h1, h2, h3, h⟩)
  · refine absurd ?_ hyc
    have hy0 : y = A.pt i (coordAlong (A.vertex i) (A.tang i) y) := by
      rw [PolyArc.pt, ← h]; exact PolyArc.off_coord A i y
    rw [hy0]
    exact PolyArc.edge_subset_carrier hi (PolyArc.pt_mem_edge
      ⟨by linarith [S.lam_pos], by linarith [S.lam_pos]⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (S.mem_blockL_iff.2 ⟨h1, h2, h, h4⟩)

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.nbhd_diff_carrier
statement: theorem nbhd_diff_carrier : S.nbhd \ A.carrier = S.sideL ∪ S.sideR
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rintro y ⟨hy, hyc⟩
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, hyi⟩ := mem_iUnion_le_nat.1 hy
      rcases S.tube_diff_carrier_subset hi ⟨hyi, hyc⟩ with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (S.blockL_subset_sideL hi h)
      · exact Or.inr (S.blockR_subset_sideR hi h)
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, hyi⟩ := mem_iUnion_lt_nat.1 hy
      rcases S.ball_diff_carrier_subset hi ⟨hyi, hyc⟩ with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (S.sectorL_subset_sideL hi h)
      · exact Or.inr (S.sectorR_subset_sideR hi h)
  · rintro y (hy | hy)
    · exact ⟨S.sideL_subset_nbhd hy, fun hc => Set.disjoint_left.1 S.sideL_disjoint_carrier hy hc⟩
    · exact ⟨S.sideR_subset_nbhd hy, fun hc => Set.disjoint_left.1 S.sideR_disjoint_carrier hy hc⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.isOpen_nbhd
statement: theorem isOpen_nbhd : IsOpen S.nbhd
proof:
:=
  (isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => S.isOpen_tube).union
    (isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_ball)

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.nbhd_subset
statement: theorem nbhd_subset : S.nbhd ⊆ D
proof:
:= by
  rintro y (hy | hy)
  · obtain ⟨i, hi, hyi⟩ := mem_iUnion_le_nat.1 hy
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hd⟩ := S.exists_foot hyi
    exact S.tube_subset i hi c hc (mem_ball.2 hd)
  · obtain ⟨i, hi, hyi⟩ := mem_iUnion_lt_nat.1 hy
    exact S.ball_subset i hi hyi

name: Schoenflies.isConnected_iUnion_chain
statement:
theorem isConnected_iUnion_chain {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {F : ℕ → Set α} :
    ∀ N : ℕ, (∀ k ≤ N, IsConnected (F k)) → (∀ k < N, (F k ∩ F (k + 1)).Nonempty) →
      IsConnected (⋃ k, ⋃ (_ : k ≤ N), F k)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero =>
      intro hconn _
      have h : (⋃ k, ⋃ (_ : k ≤ 0), F k) = F 0 := by
        ext y
        rw [mem_iUnion_le_nat]
        exact ⟨fun ⟨k, hk, hy⟩ => by rwa [Nat.le_zero.1 hk] at hy, fun hy => ⟨0, le_refl 0, hy⟩⟩
      rw [h]
      exact hconn 0 (le_refl 0)
  | succ N ih =>
      intro hconn hmeet
      have h : (⋃ k, ⋃ (_ : k ≤ N + 1), F k) = (⋃ k, ⋃ (_ : k ≤ N), F k) ∪ F (N + 1) := by
        ext y
        simp only [mem_iUnion_le_nat, Set.mem_union]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨k, hk, hy⟩
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (N + 1) with hlt | hge
          · exact Or.inl ⟨k, by omega, hy⟩
          · exact Or.inr (by rwa [show k = N + 1 by omega] at hy)
        · rintro (⟨k, hk, hy⟩ | hy)
          · exact ⟨k, by omega, hy⟩
          · exact ⟨N + 1, le_refl _, hy⟩
      rw [h]
      obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := hmeet N (by omega)
      exact IsConnected.union ⟨z, mem_iUnion_le_nat.2 ⟨N, le_refl N, hz1⟩, hz2⟩
        (ih (fun k hk => hconn k (by omega)) fun k hk => hmeet k (by omega))
        (hconn (N + 1) (le_refl _))

name: Schoenflies.exists_offset_bound
statement:
theorem exists_offset_bound {ε b X k : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hb : 0 < b) (hX : 0 < X) (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ σ < ε ∧ σ < b ∧ σ * k < X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨min (min (ε / 2) (b / 2)) (X / (2 * k)),
    lt_min (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by positivity), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (by linarith)
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)) (by linarith)
  · have h : min (min (ε / 2) (b / 2)) (X / (2 * k)) ≤ X / (2 * k) := min_le_right _ _
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hk.le
    have h3 : X / (2 * k) * k = X / 2 := by field_simp
    rw [h3] at h2
    linarith

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.lam_lt_three_halves_lam

proof: := by have := S.lam_pos; linarith

statement: theorem three_halves_lam_lt (hi : i ≤ n) : 3 * S.lam / 2 < A.len i - S.lam

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.overlap_dist_lt

  S.mem_blockL_off.2 ⟨S.lam_lt_three_halves_lam, S.three_halves_lam_lt (by omega),

:= by
  have h1 : S.lam < A.len i - 3 * S.lam / 2 := by
    have := S.lam_pos; have := S.four_lam_lt_len i (by omega); linarith
  exact S.mem_blockL_off.2 ⟨h1, by have := S.lam_pos; linarith, by linarith [S.rho_pos],

proof:

  exact S.mem_blockR_off.2 ⟨h1, by have := S.lam_pos; linarith, by linarith [S.rho_pos],
    by linarith [S.rho_pos]⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.mem_overlapL_start
statement:
theorem mem_overlapL_start (hi : i < n) :
    A.off (i + 1) (3 * S.lam / 2) (S.rho / 2) ∈ S.blockL (i + 1) ∩ S.sectorL i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨S.mem_blockL_overlap_start hi,
    S.blockL_sub_mem_arcL_start hi (S.mem_blockL_overlap_start hi), ?_⟩
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt PolyArc.dist_off_vertex_le ?_
  rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [S.lam_pos] : (0:ℝ) < 3 * S.lam / 2),
    abs_of_pos (by linarith [S.rho_pos] : (0:ℝ) < S.rho / 2)]
  exact S.overlap_dist_lt

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.mem_overlapL_finish
statement:
theorem mem_overlapL_finish (hi : i < n) :
    A.off i (A.len i - 3 * S.lam / 2) (S.rho / 2) ∈ S.blockL i ∩ S.sectorL i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨S.mem_blockL_overlap_finish hi,
    S.blockL_sub_mem_arcL_finish hi (S.mem_blockL_overlap_finish hi), ?_⟩
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt PolyArc.dist_off_vertex_succ_le ?_
  rw [show A.len i - 3 * S.lam / 2 - A.len i = -(3 * S.lam / 2) by ring,
    abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith [S.lam_pos] : (0:ℝ) < 3 * S.lam / 2),
    abs_of_pos (by linarith [S.rho_pos] : (0:ℝ) < S.rho / 2)]
  exact S.overlap_dist_lt

    S.blockR_sub_mem_arcR_start hi (S.mem_blockR_overlap_start hi), ?_⟩

  rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [S.lam_pos] : (0:ℝ) < 3 * S.lam / 2),
    abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith [S.rho_pos] : (0:ℝ) < S.rho / 2)]
  exact S.overlap_dist_lt

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.mem_overlapR_finish
statement:
theorem mem_overlapR_finish (hi : i < n) :

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.isConnected_chainL
statement: theorem isConnected_chainL (hk : k ≤ n) : IsConnected (S.chainL k)
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact S.isConnected_blockL (Nat.zero_le n)
  | succ k =>
      exact IsConnected.union ⟨_, (S.mem_overlapL_start (by omega)).2,
        (S.mem_overlapL_start (by omega)).1⟩ (S.isConnected_sectorL (by omega))
        (S.isConnected_blockL hk)

  | succ k =>
      exact IsConnected.union ⟨_, (S.mem_overlapR_start (by omega)).2,
        (S.mem_overlapR_start (by omega)).1⟩ (S.isConnected_sectorR (by omega))
        (S.isConnected_blockR hk)

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.chainL_meet
statement: theorem chainL_meet (hk : k < n) : (S.chainL k ∩ S.chainL (k + 1)).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, S.blockL_subset_chainL k (S.mem_overlapL_finish hk).1,
    Or.inl (S.mem_overlapL_finish hk).2⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.chainR_meet

proof:
:=

    Or.inl (S.mem_overlapR_finish hk).2⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcStrip.isConnected_sideR
