        · exact ⟨d.face₁, Set.mem_insert _ _, d.subRel_face₁_iff.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr h))⟩
        · exact ⟨d.face₂, Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _),
            d.subRel_face₂_iff.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr h))⟩
      · exact ⟨F, Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨hF, hFf⟩),
          d.subRel_of_old hσ (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hF) hσf
            hFf hsub⟩
    · rcases hσ with (⟨hσ, -⟩ | hσ) | hσ
      · exact ⟨d.face₁, Set.mem_insert _ _,
          d.subRel_face₁_iff.2 (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inl hσ)))⟩
      · exact ⟨d.face₁, Set.mem_insert _ _,
          d.subRel_face₁_iff.2 (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr hσ)))⟩
      · rcases hσ with rfl | rfl
        · exact ⟨d.face₁, Set.mem_insert _ _, d.subRel_face₁_iff.2 (Or.inl rfl)⟩
        · exact ⟨d.face₂, Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _),
            d.subRel_face₂_iff.2 (Or.inl rfl)⟩
  outerEdge_unique := by
    intro f hf
    rw [splitFace_outerGraph] at hf
    have hfE : f ∈ E(S.skel) := S.outerGraph_le.edgeSet_mono hf
    have hfc : f ∈ S.cells := S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet hfE
    have hff : f ≠ d.face := fun h => S.faces_ne_edgeSet d.face_mem hfE h.symm
    have hfear : f ∉ d.earCells := by
      rintro (hh | hh)
      · rcases d.mem_cells_of_mem_ear_vertexSet hh hfc with rfl | rfl
        exacts [S.vertexSet_ne_edgeSet d.source_mem_skel hfE rfl,
          S.vertexSet_ne_edgeSet d.target_mem_skel hfE rfl]
      · exact d.edge_fresh hh hfc
    obtain ⟨F, ⟨hF, hsub⟩, huniq⟩ := hS.outerEdge_unique hf
    by_cases hFf : F = d.face
    · subst hFf
      
      have hcells : f ∈ d.cells₁ ∨ f ∈ d.cells₂ := by
        rcases d.sub_face.1 hsub with h | h | h
        exacts [absurd h hff, Or.inl h, Or.inr h]
      have hexcl : ¬ (f ∈ d.cells₁ ∧ f ∈ d.cells₂) := fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ =>
        d.paths_disjoint ((d.edge_mem_cells₁_iff hfE).1 h₁) ((d.edge_mem_cells₂_iff hfE).1 h₂)
      have hother : ∀ T, T ∈ S.faces → T ≠ d.face → ¬ S.sub f T := fun T hT hTf hsubT =>
        hTf (huniq T ⟨hT, hsubT⟩ ▸ rfl)
      rcases hcells with h | h
      · refine ⟨d.face₁, ⟨Set.mem_insert _ _, d.subRel_face₁_iff.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr h))⟩,
          fun T hT => ?_⟩
        rcases hT.1 with rfl | rfl | ⟨hT', hT''⟩
        · rfl
        · rcases d.subRel_face₂_iff.1 hT.2 with hh | hh | hh
          · exact absurd (hh ▸ hfc) d.face₂_notMem
          · exact absurd hh hfear
          · exact absurd ⟨h, hh⟩ hexcl
        · exact absurd ((d.old_subRel_iff hfc (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hT') hff hT'').1 hT.2)
            (hother T hT' hT'')
      · refine ⟨d.face₂, ⟨Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _),
          d.subRel_face₂_iff.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr h))⟩, fun T hT => ?_⟩
        rcases hT.1 with rfl | rfl | ⟨hT', hT''⟩
        · rcases d.subRel_face₁_iff.1 hT.2 with hh | hh | hh
          · exact absurd (hh ▸ hfc) d.face₁_notMem
          · exact absurd hh hfear
          · exact absurd ⟨hh, h⟩ hexcl
        · rfl
        · exact absurd ((d.old_subRel_iff hfc (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hT') hff hT'').1 hT.2)
            (hother T hT' hT'')
    · refine ⟨F, ⟨Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨hF, hFf⟩),
        d.subRel_of_old hfc (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hF) hff hFf hsub⟩, fun T hT => ?_⟩
      rcases hT.1 with rfl | rfl | ⟨hT', hT''⟩
      · rcases d.subRel_face₁_iff.1 hT.2 with hh | hh | hh
        · exact absurd (hh ▸ hfc) d.face₁_notMem
        · exact absurd hh hfear
        · exact absurd (huniq d.face ⟨d.face_mem, d.sub_face.2 (Or.inr (Or.inl hh))⟩).symm hFf
      · rcases d.subRel_face₂_iff.1 hT.2 with hh | hh | hh
        · exact absurd (hh ▸ hfc) d.face₂_notMem
        · exact absurd hh hfear
        · exact absurd (huniq d.face ⟨d.face_mem, d.sub_face.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr hh))⟩).symm hFf
      · exact huniq T ⟨hT', (d.old_subRel_iff hfc (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hT') hff hT'').1 hT.2⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.parent_of_mem_newCells
statement: theorem parent_of_mem_newCells {σ : γ} (h : σ ∈ d.newCells) : d.parent σ = d.face
proof:
:= by
  rw [parent]; exact if_pos h

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.parent_of_notMem_newCells
statement: theorem parent_of_notMem_newCells {σ : γ} (h : σ ∉ d.newCells) : d.parent σ = σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [parent]; exact if_neg h

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.parent_of_mem_cells
statement: theorem parent_of_mem_cells {σ : γ} (h : σ ∈ S.cells) : d.parent σ = σ
proof:
:=
  d.parent_of_notMem_newCells (notMem_newCells_of_mem_cells h)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.sub_parent_of_mem_cells₁
statement: theorem sub_parent_of_mem_cells₁ {σ : γ} (h : σ ∈ d.cells₁) : S.sub (d.parent σ) d.face
proof:
:= by
  rw [d.parent_of_mem_cells (d.cells₁_subset h)]; exact d.sub_face.2 (Or.inr (Or.inl h))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.sub_parent_of_mem_cells₂
statement: theorem sub_parent_of_mem_cells₂ {σ : γ} (h : σ ∈ d.cells₂) : S.sub (d.parent σ) d.face
proof:
:= by
  rw [d.parent_of_mem_cells (d.cells₂_subset h)]; exact d.sub_face.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr h))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.sub_parent_of_mem_earCells
statement:
theorem sub_parent_of_mem_earCells (hS : S.CombInvariants) {σ : γ} (h : σ ∈ d.earCells) :
    S.sub (d.parent σ) d.face
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · by_cases hc : σ ∈ S.cells
    · rcases d.mem_cells_of_mem_ear_vertexSet h hc with rfl | rfl
      · exact d.sub_parent_of_mem_cells₁ d.source_mem_cells₁
      · exact d.sub_parent_of_mem_cells₁ d.target_mem_cells₁
    · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨h, by
        rintro (rfl | rfl)
        exacts [hc d.source_mem_cells, hc d.target_mem_cells]⟩))]
      exact hS.sub_refl d.face_mem_cells
  · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells (Or.inl (Or.inr h))]; exact hS.sub_refl d.face_mem_cells

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.sub_parent
statement:
theorem sub_parent (hS : S.CombInvariants) {σ τ : γ} (h : (S.splitFace d).sub σ τ) :
    S.sub (d.parent σ) (d.parent τ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hσ, hτ, -, -, h⟩ | ⟨rfl, hσ⟩ | h | ⟨rfl, h⟩ | ⟨rfl, h⟩
  · rw [d.parent_of_notMem_newCells hσ, d.parent_of_notMem_newCells hτ]; exact h
  · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells hσ]; exact hS.sub_refl d.face_mem_cells
  · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells (Or.inl (Or.inr h.edge_mem))]
    exact d.sub_parent_of_mem_earCells hS (Or.inl h.vertex_mem)
  · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells d.face₁_mem_newCells]
    rcases h with rfl | h | h
    · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells d.face₁_mem_newCells]; exact hS.sub_refl d.face_mem_cells
    · exact d.sub_parent_of_mem_earCells hS h
    · exact d.sub_parent_of_mem_cells₁ h
  · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells d.face₂_mem_newCells]
    rcases h with rfl | h | h
    · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells d.face₂_mem_newCells]; exact hS.sub_refl d.face_mem_cells
    · exact d.sub_parent_of_mem_earCells hS h
    · exact d.sub_parent_of_mem_cells₂ h

name: Schoenflies.GeneratedStructure.combInvariants
statement:
theorem _root_.Schoenflies.GeneratedStructure.combInvariants {S₀ S : CellStructure γ}
    (h : GeneratedStructure S₀ S) (h₀ : S₀.CombInvariants) : S.CombInvariants
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | base => exact h₀
  | subdivideEdge _ d ih => exact d.combInvariants ih
  | splitFace _ d ih => exact d.combInvariants ih

name: Schoenflies.GeneratedStructure.trans
proof:
:= by
  induction h₂ with
  | base => exact h₁
  | subdivideEdge _ d ih => exact ih.subdivideEdge d
  | splitFace _ d ih => exact ih.splitFace d

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.sub_parent_comp
statement:
theorem sub_parent_comp {S : CellStructure γ} (hS : S.CombInvariants) (d₁ : S.SubdivData)
    (d₂ : (S.subdivideEdge d₁).SplitData) {σ τ : γ}
    (h : ((S.subdivideEdge d₁).splitFace d₂).sub σ τ) :
    S.sub (d₁.parent (d₂.parent σ)) (d₁.parent (d₂.parent τ))
proof:
:=
  d₁.sub_parent hS (d₂.sub_parent (d₁.combInvariants hS) h)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.subset_closure
statement:
theorem subset_closure (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells) (hτ : τ ∈ S.cells)
    (hsub : S.sub σ τ) : R.cell σ ⊆ closure (R.cell τ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.closure_eq hτ]
  exact Set.subset_biUnion_of_mem (u := fun ρ => R.cell ρ) (show σ ∈ _ from ⟨hσ, hsub⟩)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.sub_of_mem
statement:
theorem sub_of_mem (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells) (hτ : τ ∈ S.cells)
    {z : Plane} (hzσ : z ∈ R.cell σ) (hzτ : z ∈ closure (R.cell τ)) : S.sub σ τ
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.closure_eq hτ] at hzτ
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hzρ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hzτ
  by_cases hne : σ = ρ
  · exact hne ▸ hρ.2
  · exact absurd hzρ (Set.disjoint_left.1 (h.disjoint hσ hρ.1 hne) hzσ)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.sub_of_subset_closure
statement:
theorem sub_of_subset_closure (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells)
    (hτ : τ ∈ S.cells) (hsub : R.cell σ ⊆ closure (R.cell τ)) : S.sub σ τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h.nonempty hσ
  exact h.sub_of_mem hσ hτ hz (hsub hz)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.sub_iff_subset_closure
statement:
theorem sub_iff_subset_closure (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells)
    (hτ : τ ∈ S.cells) : S.sub σ τ ↔ R.cell σ ⊆ closure (R.cell τ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.subset_closure hσ hτ, h.sub_of_subset_closure hσ hτ⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.frontier_property
statement:
theorem frontier_property (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells) (hτ : τ ∈ S.cells) :
    R.cell σ ⊆ closure (R.cell τ) ∨ Disjoint (R.cell σ) (closure (R.cell τ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : Disjoint (R.cell σ) (closure (R.cell τ))
  · exact Or.inr hd
  · refine Or.inl (h.subset_closure hσ hτ ?_)
    rw [Set.not_disjoint_iff] at hd
    obtain ⟨z, hzσ, hzτ⟩ := hd
    exact h.sub_of_mem hσ hτ hzσ hzτ

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.sub_refl
statement: theorem sub_refl (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells) : S.sub σ σ
proof:
:=
  h.sub_of_subset_closure hσ hσ _root_.subset_closure

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.sub_trans
statement:
theorem sub_trans (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells) (hτ : τ ∈ S.cells)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ S.cells) (h₁ : S.sub σ τ) (h₂ : S.sub τ ρ) : S.sub σ ρ
proof:
:= by
  refine h.sub_of_subset_closure hσ hρ ((h.subset_closure hσ hτ h₁).trans ?_)
  simpa using closure_mono (h.subset_closure hτ hρ h₂)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.face_eq
statement:
theorem face_eq (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) {F T : γ} (hF : F ∈ S.faces) (hT : T ∈ S.faces)
    (hopen : IsOpen (R.cell F)) (hsub : R.cell F ⊆ closure (R.cell T)) : F = T
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h.nonempty (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hF)
  obtain ⟨w, hwF, hwT⟩ := mem_closure_iff.1 (hsub hz) (R.cell F) hopen hz
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1
    (h.disjoint (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hF) (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hT) hne) hwF hwT

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.subset_closure_congr
proof:
:=
  ⟨(h₁.sub_iff_subset_closure hσ hτ).symm.trans (h₂.sub_iff_subset_closure hσ hτ),
    h₁.sub_iff_subset_closure hσ hτ, h₂.sub_iff_subset_closure hσ hτ⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.subRel_newVertex_iff
statement:
theorem subRel_newVertex_iff (hS : S.CombInvariants) (d : S.SubdivData) {σ : γ} :
    d.subRel σ d.newVertex ↔ σ = d.newVertex
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h.trans rfl, Or.inl h⟩)⟩
  rcases h with ⟨-, h, -, -, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨-, h | h⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨-, -, h⟩
  · exact absurd (Or.inl rfl) h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd h d.newVertex_ne₁
  · exact absurd h d.newVertex_ne₂
  · exact absurd h d.newVertex_ne₁
  · exact absurd h d.newVertex_ne₂
  · exact absurd (hS.sub_mem_right h) d.newVertex_notMem

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.subRel_newEdge₁_iff
statement:
theorem subRel_newEdge₁_iff (hS : S.CombInvariants) (d : S.SubdivData) {σ : γ} :
    d.subRel σ d.newEdge₁ ↔ (σ = d.newEdge₁ ∨ σ = d.newVertex ∨ σ = d.left)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨-, h, -, -, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨-, -, h⟩
    · exact absurd (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)) h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
    · exact absurd h d.newEdge_ne
    · exact absurd (hS.sub_mem_right h) d.newEdge₁_notMem
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.subRel_newEdge₂_iff
statement:
theorem subRel_newEdge₂_iff (hS : S.CombInvariants) (d : S.SubdivData) {σ : γ} :
    d.subRel σ d.newEdge₂ ↔ (σ = d.newEdge₂ ∨ σ = d.newVertex ∨ σ = d.right)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨-, h, -, -, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨-, -, h⟩
    · exact absurd (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)) h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · exact absurd h d.newEdge_ne.symm
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
    · exact absurd (hS.sub_mem_right h) d.newEdge₂_notMem
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, Or.inr rfl⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩))))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.IsRefinement.cell_subset_edge
statement:
theorem cell_subset_edge (href : d.IsRefinement R R') {σ : γ} (hσ : σ ∈ d.newCells) :
    R'.cell σ ⊆ R.cell d.edge
proof:
:= by
  rw [href.cell_edge]
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact fun _ hz => Or.inl (Or.inr hz)
  · exact fun _ hz => Or.inl (Or.inl hz)
  · exact fun _ hz => Or.inr hz

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.IsRefinement.isCellDecomposition
statement:
theorem isCellDecomposition (hS : S.CombInvariants) (href : d.IsRefinement R R')
    (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) : R'.IsCellDecomposition D where
  nonempty
proof:
:= by
    intro σ hσ
    rw [subdivideEdge_cells] at hσ
    rcases hσ with ⟨hσc, hσe⟩ | hσn
    · rw [href.cell_eq hσc hσe]; exact h.nonempty hσc
    · exact href.nonempty hσn
  disjoint := by
    intro σ τ hσ hτ hne
    rw [subdivideEdge_cells] at hσ hτ
    rcases hσ with ⟨hσc, hσe⟩ | hσn <;> rcases hτ with ⟨hτc, hτe⟩ | hτn
    · rw [href.cell_eq hσc hσe, href.cell_eq hτc hτe]; exact h.disjoint hσc hτc hne
    · rw [href.cell_eq hσc hσe]
      exact (h.disjoint hσc d.edge_mem_cells hσe).mono_right (href.cell_subset_edge hτn)
    · rw [href.cell_eq hτc hτe]
      exact (h.disjoint d.edge_mem_cells hτc (Ne.symm hτe)).mono_left
        (href.cell_subset_edge hσn)
    · exact href.disjoint hσn hτn hne
  iUnion_eq := by
    rw [← h.iUnion_eq]
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, hz⟩
      rw [subdivideEdge_cells] at hσ
      rcases hσ with ⟨hσc, hσe⟩ | hσn
      · exact ⟨σ, hσc, by rwa [href.cell_eq hσc hσe] at hz⟩
      · exact ⟨d.edge, d.edge_mem_cells, href.cell_subset_edge hσn hz⟩
    · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, hz⟩
      by_cases hσe : σ = d.edge
      · subst hσe
        rw [href.cell_edge] at hz
        rcases hz with hz | hz
        · rcases hz with hz | hz
          · exact ⟨d.newEdge₁, d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)), hz⟩
          · exact ⟨d.newVertex, d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inl rfl), hz⟩
        · exact ⟨d.newEdge₂, d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)), hz⟩
      · exact ⟨σ, d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_old hσ hσe, by rwa [href.cell_eq hσ hσe]⟩
  closure_eq := by
    intro τ hτ
    rw [subdivideEdge_cells] at hτ
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq, exists_prop]
    rcases hτ with ⟨hτc, hτe⟩ | hτn
    · 
      rw [href.cell_eq hτc hτe, h.closure_eq hτc]
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq, exists_prop]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨σ, ⟨hσc, hσsub⟩, hz⟩
        by_cases hσe : σ = d.edge
        · subst hσe
          rw [href.cell_edge] at hz
          have hnew : ∀ ρ ∈ d.newCells, ((S.subdivideEdge d).sub ρ τ) := fun ρ hρ =>
            (d.newCells_subRel_iff hρ hτc).2 ⟨hτe, hσsub⟩
          rcases hz with hz | hz
          · rcases hz with hz | hz
            · exact ⟨d.newEdge₁, ⟨d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)),
                hnew _ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))⟩, hz⟩
            · exact ⟨d.newVertex, ⟨d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inl rfl),
                hnew _ (Or.inl rfl)⟩, hz⟩
          · exact ⟨d.newEdge₂, ⟨d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)),
              hnew _ (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))⟩, hz⟩
        · exact ⟨σ, ⟨d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_old hσc hσe,
            d.subRel_of_old hσc hτc hσe hτe hσsub⟩, by rwa [href.cell_eq hσc hσe]⟩
      · rintro ⟨σ, ⟨hσ, hσsub⟩, hz⟩
        rw [subdivideEdge_cells] at hσ
        rcases hσ with ⟨hσc, hσe⟩ | hσn
        · exact ⟨σ, ⟨hσc, (d.old_subRel_iff hσc hτc hσe hτe).1 hσsub⟩,
            by rwa [href.cell_eq hσc hσe] at hz⟩
        · exact ⟨d.edge, ⟨d.edge_mem_cells, ((d.newCells_subRel_iff hσn hτc).1 hσsub).2⟩,
            href.cell_subset_edge hσn hz⟩
    · 
      have hleft : d.left ∈ (S.subdivideEdge d).cells :=
        d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_old d.left_mem_cells d.left_ne_edge
      have hright : d.right ∈ (S.subdivideEdge d).cells :=
        d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_old d.right_mem_cells d.right_ne_edge
      rcases hτn with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [href.closure_newVertex]
        refine ⟨fun hz => ⟨d.newVertex, ⟨d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inl rfl),
          (d.subRel_newVertex_iff hS).2 rfl⟩, hz⟩, ?_⟩
        rintro ⟨σ, ⟨-, hσsub⟩, hz⟩
        rwa [(d.subRel_newVertex_iff hS).1 hσsub] at hz
      · rw [href.closure_newEdge₁, ← href.cell_eq d.left_mem_cells d.left_ne_edge]
        constructor
        · rintro (hz | hz)
          · rcases hz with hz | hz
            · exact ⟨d.newEdge₁, ⟨d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)),
                (d.subRel_newEdge₁_iff hS).2 (Or.inl rfl)⟩, hz⟩
            · exact ⟨d.newVertex, ⟨d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inl rfl),
                (d.subRel_newEdge₁_iff hS).2 (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))⟩, hz⟩
          · exact ⟨d.left, ⟨hleft, (d.subRel_newEdge₁_iff hS).2 (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))⟩, hz⟩
        · rintro ⟨σ, ⟨-, hσsub⟩, hz⟩
          rcases (d.subRel_newEdge₁_iff hS).1 hσsub with rfl | rfl | rfl
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hz)
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hz)
          · exact Or.inr hz
      · rw [href.closure_newEdge₂, ← href.cell_eq d.right_mem_cells d.right_ne_edge]
        constructor
        · rintro (hz | hz)
          · rcases hz with hz | hz
            · exact ⟨d.newEdge₂, ⟨d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)),
                (d.subRel_newEdge₂_iff hS).2 (Or.inl rfl)⟩, hz⟩
            · exact ⟨d.newVertex, ⟨d.mem_subdivideEdge_cells_of_new (Or.inl rfl),
                (d.subRel_newEdge₂_iff hS).2 (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))⟩, hz⟩
          · exact ⟨d.right, ⟨hright, (d.subRel_newEdge₂_iff hS).2 (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))⟩, hz⟩
        · rintro ⟨σ, ⟨-, hσsub⟩, hz⟩
          rcases (d.subRel_newEdge₂_iff hS).1 hσsub with rfl | rfl | rfl
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hz)
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hz)
          · exact Or.inr hz

name: Schoenflies.IsCrosscut.inside_inter
statement: theorem IsCrosscut.inside_inter (h : IsCrosscut C P p q) : inside C ∩ P = P \ {p, q}
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (fun z hz => ⟨hz.2, fun hzpq => ?_⟩) fun z hz =>
    ⟨h.sdiff_subset hz, hz.1⟩
  rcases hzpq with rfl | rfl
  exacts [inside_subset_compl hz.1 h.left_mem, inside_subset_compl hz.1 h.right_mem]

name: Schoenflies.IsCrosscut.inside_eq_split
statement:
theorem IsCrosscut.inside_eq_split (hjordan : ∀ S : Set Plane, IsJordanCurve S → IsSeparating S)
    (h : IsCrosscut C P p q) (hcut : IsCutPair C p q A₁ A₂)
    (hcollars : HasArcCollars (inside C) P) :
    inside C = inside (A₁ ∪ P) ∪ inside (A₂ ∪ P) ∪ (P \ {p, q})
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Set.sdiff_union_inter (inside C) P]
  rw [h.inside_diff_eq hjordan hcut hcollars, h.inside_inter]

name: Schoenflies.IsCrosscut.disjoint_side_crosscut
statement:
theorem IsCrosscut.disjoint_side_crosscut
    (hjordan : ∀ S : Set Plane, IsJordanCurve S → IsSeparating S)
    (h : IsCrosscut C P p q) (hcut : IsCutPair C p q A₁ A₂) :
    Disjoint (inside (A₁ ∪ P)) (P \ {p, q})
proof:
:=
  Set.disjoint_left.2 fun _ hz hz' => (h.side_subset hjordan hcut hz).2 hz'.1

name: Schoenflies.crosscut_cell_partition
statement:
theorem crosscut_cell_partition (hjordan : ∀ S : Set Plane, IsJordanCurve S → IsSeparating S)
    (h : IsCrosscut C P p q) (hcut : IsCutPair C p q A₁ A₂)
    (hcollars : HasArcCollars (inside C) P) :
    inside C = inside (A₁ ∪ P) ∪ inside (A₂ ∪ P) ∪ (P \ {p, q}) ∧
      Disjoint (inside (A₁ ∪ P)) (inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∧
      Disjoint (inside (A₁ ∪ P)) (P \ {p, q}) ∧
      Disjoint (inside (A₂ ∪ P)) (P \ {p, q}) ∧
      IsOpen (inside (A₁ ∪ P)) ∧ IsOpen (inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∧
      (inside (A₁ ∪ P)).Nonempty ∧ (inside (A₂ ∪ P)).Nonempty ∧
      closure (inside (A₁ ∪ P)) = inside (A₁ ∪ P) ∪ (A₁ ∪ P) ∧
      closure (inside (A₂ ∪ P)) = inside (A₂ ∪ P) ∪ (A₂ ∪ P)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.inside_eq_split hjordan hcut hcollars, h.disjoint_sides hjordan hcut,
    h.disjoint_side_crosscut hjordan hcut, h.disjoint_side_crosscut hjordan hcut.symm,
    h.isOpen_side hjordan hcut, h.isOpen_side hjordan hcut.symm,
    h.side_nonempty hjordan hcut, h.side_nonempty hjordan hcut.symm,
    h.closure_side hjordan hcut, h.closure_side hjordan hcut.symm⟩

name: Graph.mem_component_iff
statement: theorem mem_component_iff : v ∈ G.component u ↔ G.Reaches u v
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Graph.component_subset_vertexSet
statement: theorem component_subset_vertexSet : G.component u ⊆ V(G)
proof: := fun _ h ↦ Reaches.right_mem h

name: Graph.mem_component_self
statement: theorem mem_component_self (hu : u ∈ V(G)) : u ∈ G.component u
proof: := Reaches.refl hu

name: Graph.component_nonempty
statement: theorem component_nonempty (hu : u ∈ V(G)) : (G.component u).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨u, mem_component_self hu⟩

name: Graph.component_eq_empty
statement: theorem component_eq_empty (hu : u ∉ V(G)) : G.component u = ∅
proof:
:=
  Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun _ h ↦ hu (Reaches.left_mem h)

name: Graph.mem_component_of_reaches
statement:
theorem mem_component_of_reaches (hv : v ∈ G.component u) (h : G.Reaches v w) :
    w ∈ G.component u
proof:
:=
  Reaches.trans hv h

name: Graph.mem_component_of_isLink
statement:
theorem mem_component_of_isLink (hx : x ∈ G.component u) (hl : G.IsLink e x y) :
    y ∈ G.component u
proof:
:=
  mem_component_of_reaches hx (Reaches.of_isLink hl)

name: Graph.mem_component_comm
statement: theorem mem_component_comm : v ∈ G.component u ↔ u ∈ G.component v
proof: := reaches_comm

name: Graph.component_eq_of_mem
statement: theorem component_eq_of_mem (hv : v ∈ G.component u) : G.component v = G.component u
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun _ ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ Reaches.trans hv h, fun h ↦ Reaches.trans (Reaches.symm hv) h⟩

name: Graph.component_eq_or_disjoint
statement:
theorem component_eq_or_disjoint (u v : α) :
    G.component u = G.component v ∨ Disjoint (G.component u) (G.component v)
proof:
:= by
  rcases em (∃ w, w ∈ G.component u ∧ w ∈ G.component v) with ⟨w, hu, hv⟩ | hne
  · exact Or.inl ((component_eq_of_mem hu).symm.trans (component_eq_of_mem hv))
  · exact Or.inr (Set.disjoint_left.2 fun w hw hw' ↦ hne ⟨w, hw, hw'⟩)

name: Graph.iUnion_component
statement: theorem iUnion_component (G : Graph α β) : ⋃ u ∈ V(G), G.component u = V(G)
proof:
:=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.iUnion₂_subset fun _ _ ↦ component_subset_vertexSet)
    fun _ hx ↦ Set.mem_biUnion hx (mem_component_self hx)

name: Graph.induce_component_le
statement: theorem induce_component_le : G.induce (G.component u) ≤ G
proof:
:=
  induce_le component_subset_vertexSet

name: Graph.mem_vertexSet_induce_component
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_vertexSet_induce_component : v ∈ V(G.induce (G.component u)) ↔ G.Reaches u v
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Graph.IsWalk.walkVertices_subset_component
statement:
theorem IsWalk.walkVertices_subset_component (h : G.IsWalk x W y) (hx : x ∈ G.component u) :
    G.walkVertices x W ⊆ G.component u
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => simpa using hx
  | @cons x' w y e W hl _ ih =>
    intro z hz
    rcases mem_walkVertices_cons hl hz with rfl | hz'
    · exact hx
    · exact ih (mem_component_of_isLink hx hl) hz'

name: Graph.IsWalk.induce_component
statement:
theorem IsWalk.induce_component (h : G.IsWalk x W y) (hx : x ∈ G.component u) :
    (G.induce (G.component u)).IsWalk x W y
proof:
:= by
  refine h.anti induce_component_le hx fun g hg ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet (h.edge_mem hg)
  exact ⟨s, t, hst,
    h.walkVertices_subset_component hx (mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered ⟨g, hg, hst.inc_left⟩),
    h.walkVertices_subset_component hx (mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered ⟨g, hg, hst.inc_right⟩)⟩

name: Graph.induce_component_connected
statement: theorem induce_component_connected (hu : u ∈ V(G)) : (G.induce (G.component u)).Connected
proof:
:= by
  refine Connected.of_hub (mem_component_self hu) fun z hz ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := mem_component_iff.1 hz
  exact ⟨W, hW.induce_component (mem_component_self hu)⟩

name: Graph.exists_minLength_isWalk
statement:
theorem exists_minLength_isWalk (h : G.Reaches u v) :
    ∃ W, G.IsWalk u W v ∧ ∀ W', G.IsWalk u W' v → W.length ≤ W'.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀⟩ := h
  have hex : ∃ n, ∃ W, G.IsWalk u W v ∧ W.length = n := ⟨W₀.length, W₀, hW₀, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hlen⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  exact ⟨W, hW, fun W' hW' ↦ hlen ▸ Nat.find_le ⟨W', hW', rfl⟩⟩

name: Graph.IsWalk.isPath_of_minLength
statement:
theorem IsWalk.isPath_of_minLength (h : G.IsWalk u W v)
    (hmin : ∀ W', G.IsWalk u W' v → W.length ≤ W'.length) : G.IsPath u W v
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx => exact .nil hx
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW ih =>
    
    
    have hmin' : ∀ W', G.IsWalk w W' v → W.length ≤ W'.length := fun W' hW' ↦ by
      have := hmin (e :: W') (.cons hl hW')
      simp only [List.length_cons] at this
      omega
    have hP : G.IsPath w W v := ih hmin'
    refine .cons hl hP fun hmem ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTW⟩ := hP.from_visited hmem
    have h₁ : T.length ≤ W.length := (List.subperm_of_subset hT.nodup hTW).length_le
    have h₂ := hmin T hT.isWalk
    simp only [List.length_cons] at h₂
    omega

name: Graph.exists_minLength_isPath
statement:
theorem exists_minLength_isPath (h : G.Reaches u v) :
    ∃ P, G.IsPath u P v ∧ ∀ W, G.IsWalk u W v → P.length ≤ W.length
proof:
:=
  let ⟨W, hW, hmin⟩ := exists_minLength_isWalk h
  ⟨W, hW.isPath_of_minLength hmin, hmin⟩

name: Graph.Connected.exists_minLength_isPath
statement:
theorem Connected.exists_minLength_isPath (h : G.Connected) (hu : u ∈ V(G)) (hv : v ∈ V(G)) :
    ∃ P, G.IsPath u P v ∧ ∀ W, G.IsWalk u W v → P.length ≤ W.length
proof:
:=
  _root_.Graph.exists_minLength_isPath (h.reaches hu hv)

name: Graph.IsWalk.walkVertices_subset_of_deleteVerts
statement:
theorem IsWalk.walkVertices_subset_of_deleteVerts (h : (G.deleteVerts S).IsWalk u W v) :
    G.walkVertices u W ⊆ V(G) \ S
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rcases mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hz with rfl | ⟨g, hg, hinc⟩
  · simpa using h.left_mem
  
  have hgE := h.edge_mem hg
  rw [edgeSet_deleteVerts] at hgE
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst, hs, ht⟩ := hgE
  rcases hinc.eq_or_eq_of_isLink hst with rfl | rfl
  exacts [⟨hst.left_mem, hs⟩, ⟨hst.right_mem, ht⟩]

name: Graph.component_deleteVerts_subset
statement: theorem component_deleteVerts_subset : (G.deleteVerts S).component x ⊆ V(G) \ S
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have := component_subset_vertexSet hz
  rwa [vertexSet_deleteVerts] at this

name: Graph.mem_component_deleteVerts_of_isLink
statement:
theorem mem_component_deleteVerts_of_isLink (hp : p ∈ (G.deleteVerts S).component x)
    (hl : G.IsLink e p q) (hq : q ∉ S) : q ∈ (G.deleteVerts S).component x
proof:
:=
  mem_component_of_isLink hp
    ((deleteVerts_isLink G S).2 ⟨hl, (component_deleteVerts_subset hp).2, hq⟩)

name: Graph.exists_isLink_out_of_component
statement:
theorem exists_isLink_out_of_component {K : Graph α β} (hKG : K ≤ G)
    (h : K.IsWalk x W v) (hx : x ∈ (G.deleteVerts S).component x) (hv : v ∈ S) :
    ∃ p ∈ (G.deleteVerts S).component x, ∃ g ∈ W, ∃ t ∈ S, K.IsLink g p t
proof:
:= by
  have hvL : v ∉ (G.deleteVerts S).component x := fun hmem ↦
    (component_deleteVerts_subset hmem).2 hv
  obtain ⟨g, hg, s, t, hst, hs, ht⟩ := h.crossing hx hvL
  refine ⟨s, hs, g, hg, t, ?_, hst⟩
  by_contra htS
  exact ht (mem_component_deleteVerts_of_isLink hs (hst.mono hKG) htS)

name: Graph.IsTwoConnected.component_two_neighbors
statement:
theorem IsTwoConnected.component_two_neighbors (hG : G.IsTwoConnected) (hS : S ⊆ V(G))
    (ha : a ∈ S) (hb : b ∈ S) (hab : a ≠ b) (hx : x ∈ V(G)) (hxS : x ∉ S) :
    ∃ c ∈ S, ∃ d ∈ S, c ≠ d ∧
      (∃ p ∈ (G.deleteVerts S).component x, ∃ g, G.IsLink g p c) ∧
      (∃ q ∈ (G.deleteVerts S).component x, ∃ g, G.IsLink g q d)
proof:
:= by
  have hxD : x ∈ V(G.deleteVerts S) := by rw [vertexSet_deleteVerts]; exact ⟨hx, hxS⟩
  have hxL : x ∈ (G.deleteVerts S).component x := mem_component_self hxD
  
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := hG.connected.reaches hx (hS ha)
  obtain ⟨p, hp, g, -, c, hc, hgpc⟩ := exists_isLink_out_of_component le_rfl hW hxL ha
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htc⟩ : ∃ t ∈ S, t ≠ c := by
    rcases eq_or_ne a c with rfl | hac
    · exact ⟨b, hb, fun h ↦ hab h.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨a, ha, hac⟩
  have hxc : x ∈ V(G.deleteVerts {c}) :=
    mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne hx fun h ↦ hxS (h ▸ hc)
  have htc' : t ∈ V(G.deleteVerts {c}) := mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne (hS ht) htc
  obtain ⟨W', hW'⟩ := (hG.deleteVerts_connected' c).reaches hxc htc'
  obtain ⟨q, hq, g', -, d, hd, hgqd⟩ :=
    exists_isLink_out_of_component deleteVerts_le hW' hxL ht
  
  have hdc : d ≠ c := by
    have := ((deleteVerts_isLink G {c}).1 hgqd).2.2
    simpa using this
  exact ⟨c, hc, d, hd, fun h ↦ hdc h.symm, ⟨p, hp, g, hgpc⟩, ⟨q, hq, g', hgqd.mono deleteVerts_le⟩⟩

name: Graph.mem_walkVertices_append_singleton
statement:
theorem mem_walkVertices_append_singleton (hy : y ∈ G.walkVertices u (W ++ [e])) :
    y ∈ G.walkVertices u W ∨ G.Inc e y
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hy with rfl | hcov
  · exact Or.inl mem_walkVertices_self
  rw [coveredVertices_append] at hcov
  rcases hcov with h | ⟨g, hg, hinc⟩
  · exact Or.inl (mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered h)
  · obtain rfl : g = e := by simpa using hg
    exact Or.inr hinc

name: Graph.IsTwoConnected.exists_path_through_component
statement:
theorem IsTwoConnected.exists_path_through_component (hG : G.IsTwoConnected) (hS : S ⊆ V(G))
    (ha : a ∈ S) (hb : b ∈ S) (hab : a ≠ b) (hx : x ∈ V(G)) (hxS : x ∉ S) :
    ∃ c ∈ S, ∃ d ∈ S, ∃ P, c ≠ d ∧ G.IsPath c P d ∧
      (∀ y ∈ G.walkVertices c P, y ≠ c → y ≠ d → y ∉ S) ∧
      (∃ y ∈ G.walkVertices c P, y ∉ S) ∧
      ∀ f ∈ P, ∃ y, G.Inc f y ∧ y ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, d, hd, hcd, ⟨p, hp, g, hgpc⟩, ⟨q, hq, g', hgqd⟩⟩ :=
    hG.component_two_neighbors hS ha hb hab hx hxS
  have hpS : p ∉ S := (component_deleteVerts_subset hp).2
  have hqS : q ∉ S := (component_deleteVerts_subset hq).2
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Reaches.exists_isPath (Reaches.trans (Reaches.symm hq) hp)
  have hQvert : G.walkVertices q Q ⊆ V(G) \ S :=
    hQ.isWalk.walkVertices_subset_of_deleteVerts
  have hQG : G.IsPath q Q p := hQ.mono deleteVerts_le
  
  have hcQ : c ∉ G.walkVertices q Q := fun hmem ↦ (hQvert hmem).2 hc
  have hQc : G.IsPath q (Q ++ [g]) c := hQG.extend_at_target hgpc hcQ
  
  have hdQc : d ∉ G.walkVertices q (Q ++ [g]) := by
    intro hmem
    rcases mem_walkVertices_append_singleton hmem with hmem' | hinc
    · exact (hQvert hmem').2 hd
    · rcases hinc.eq_or_eq_of_isLink hgpc with rfl | rfl
      exacts [hpS hd, hcd rfl]
  have hpath : G.IsPath d (g' :: (Q ++ [g])) c := .cons hgqd.symm hQc hdQc
  refine ⟨d, hd, c, hc, _, fun h ↦ hcd h.symm, hpath, fun y hy hyd hyc ↦ ?_,
    ⟨q, mem_walkVertices_cons_of_mem hgqd.symm mem_walkVertices_self, hqS⟩, fun f hf ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    rcases mem_walkVertices_cons hgqd.symm hy with rfl | hy'
    · exact absurd rfl hyd
    rcases mem_walkVertices_append_singleton hy' with hmem | hinc
    · exact (hQvert hmem).2
    · rcases hinc.eq_or_eq_of_isLink hgpc with rfl | rfl
      exacts [hpS, absurd rfl hyc]
  · 
    
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hf with rfl | hf'
    · exact ⟨q, hgqd.inc_left, hqS⟩
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hf' with hf' | hf'
    · have hfE := hQ.isWalk.edge_mem hf'
      rw [edgeSet_deleteVerts] at hfE
      obtain ⟨s, t, hst, hs, -⟩ := hfE
      exact ⟨s, hst.inc_left, hs⟩
    · obtain rfl : f = g := by simpa using hf'
      exact ⟨p, hgpc.inc_left, hpS⟩

name: Graph.IsWalk.of_deleteEdges
statement: theorem IsWalk.of_deleteEdges (h : (G.deleteEdges F).IsWalk u W v) : G.IsWalk u W v
proof:
:=
  h.mono deleteEdges_le

name: Graph.IsWalk.notMem_of_deleteEdges
statement:
theorem IsWalk.notMem_of_deleteEdges (h : (G.deleteEdges F).IsWalk u W v) (hf : f ∈ W) :
    f ∉ F
proof:
:=
  (mem_edgeSet_deleteEdges_iff.1 (h.edge_mem hf)).2

name: Graph.IsPath.of_deleteEdges
statement: theorem IsPath.of_deleteEdges (h : (G.deleteEdges F).IsPath u W v) : G.IsPath u W v
proof:
:=
  h.mono deleteEdges_le

name: Graph.IsPath.deleteEdges
statement:
theorem IsPath.deleteEdges (h : G.IsPath u W v) (hW : ∀ f ∈ W, f ∉ F) :
    (G.deleteEdges F).IsPath u W v
proof:
:=
  h.anti deleteEdges_le (by simpa using h.left_mem)
    fun f hf ↦ mem_edgeSet_deleteEdges_iff.2 ⟨h.edge_mem hf, hW f hf⟩

name: Graph.IsPath.notMem_of_deleteEdges
statement:
theorem IsPath.notMem_of_deleteEdges (h : (G.deleteEdges F).IsPath u W v) (hf : f ∈ W) :
    f ∉ F
proof:
:=
  h.isWalk.notMem_of_deleteEdges hf

name: Graph.Reaches.of_deleteEdges
statement: theorem Reaches.of_deleteEdges (h : (G.deleteEdges F).Reaches u v) : G.Reaches u v
proof:
:=
  h.mono deleteEdges_le

name: Graph.IsWalk.reaches_deleteEdges
statement:
theorem IsWalk.reaches_deleteEdges (h : G.IsWalk u W v) (hW : ∀ f ∈ W, f ∉ F) :
    (G.deleteEdges F).Reaches u v
proof:
:=
  ⟨W, h.deleteEdges hW⟩

name: Graph.IsCycleThrough.isLink
statement: theorem IsCycleThrough.isLink (h : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D) : G.IsLink e u v

name: Graph.IsCycleThrough.isPath
statement: theorem IsCycleThrough.isPath (h : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D) : G.IsPath u D v

name: Graph.IsCycleThrough.notMem
statement: theorem IsCycleThrough.notMem (h : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D) : e ∉ D

name: Graph.IsCycleThrough.liesOnCycle
statement: theorem IsCycleThrough.liesOnCycle (h : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D) : G.LiesOnCycle e

name: Graph.liesOnCycle_iff
statement: theorem liesOnCycle_iff : G.LiesOnCycle e ↔ ∃ u v D, G.IsCycleThrough e u v D
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Graph.LiesOnCycle.edge_mem
statement: theorem LiesOnCycle.edge_mem (h : G.LiesOnCycle e) : e ∈ E(G)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, _, _, hc⟩ := h; hc.isLink.edge_mem

name: Graph.liesOnCycle_of_isLoopAt
statement: theorem liesOnCycle_of_isLoopAt (h : G.IsLoopAt e x) : G.LiesOnCycle e
proof:
:=
  ⟨x, x, [], h, .nil h.left_mem, List.not_mem_nil⟩

name: Graph.liesOnCycle_of_parallel
statement:
theorem liesOnCycle_of_parallel (h : G.IsLink e u v) (h' : G.IsLink f u v) (hef : e ≠ f) :
    G.LiesOnCycle e
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · subst huv
    exact liesOnCycle_of_isLoopAt h
  exact ⟨u, v, [f], h, .single h' huv, by simpa using hef⟩

name: Graph.LiesOnCycle.mono
statement: theorem LiesOnCycle.mono (hHG : H ≤ G) (h : H.LiesOnCycle e) : G.LiesOnCycle e
proof:
:=
  let ⟨u, v, D, hl, hP, hD⟩ := h
  ⟨u, v, D, hl.mono hHG, hP.mono hHG, hD⟩

name: Graph.LiesOnCycle.deleteEdges_reaches
statement:
theorem LiesOnCycle.deleteEdges_reaches (hl : G.IsLink e u v) (h : G.LiesOnCycle e) :
    (G.deleteEdges {e}).Reaches u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u', v', D, hl', hP, hD⟩ := h
  
  have hR : (G.deleteEdges {e}).Reaches u' v' :=
    hP.isWalk.reaches_deleteEdges fun f hf hmem ↦ hD (Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hmem ▸ hf)
  rcases hl.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hl' with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  exacts [hR, hR.symm]

name: Graph.LiesOnCycle.of_deleteEdges_reaches
statement:
theorem LiesOnCycle.of_deleteEdges_reaches (hl : G.IsLink e u v)
    (h : (G.deleteEdges {e}).Reaches u v) : G.LiesOnCycle e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := h.exists_isPath
  exact ⟨u, v, D, hl, hD.of_deleteEdges, fun hmem ↦ hD.notMem_of_deleteEdges hmem rfl⟩

name: Graph.liesOnCycle_iff_deleteEdges_reaches
statement:
theorem liesOnCycle_iff_deleteEdges_reaches (hl : G.IsLink e u v) :
    G.LiesOnCycle e ↔ (G.deleteEdges {e}).Reaches u v
proof:
:=
  ⟨LiesOnCycle.deleteEdges_reaches hl, LiesOnCycle.of_deleteEdges_reaches hl⟩

name: Graph.IsWalk.reaches_deleteEdges_of_liesOnCycle
statement:
theorem IsWalk.reaches_deleteEdges_of_liesOnCycle (h : G.LiesOnCycle e) (hW : G.IsWalk u W v) :
    (G.deleteEdges {e}).Reaches u v
proof:
:= by
  induction hW with
  | nil hx => exact .refl (by simpa using hx)
  | @cons u w v f W hl _ ih =>
    refine Reaches.trans ?_ ih
    by_cases hfe : f = e
    · subst hfe
      exact h.deleteEdges_reaches hl
    · refine (IsWalk.single hl).reaches_deleteEdges fun g hg ↦ ?_
      obtain rfl : g = f := by simpa using hg
      simpa using hfe

name: Graph.Connected.deleteEdges_singleton
statement:
theorem Connected.deleteEdges_singleton (hG : G.Connected) (h : G.LiesOnCycle e) :
    (G.deleteEdges {e}).Connected
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by simpa using hG.nonempty, fun u hu v hv ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [vertexSet_deleteEdges] at hu hv
  exact (hG.reaches hu hv).choose_spec.reaches_deleteEdges_of_liesOnCycle h

name: Graph.IsPath.chord_liesOnCycle
statement:
theorem IsPath.chord_liesOnCycle (hP : G.IsPath u P v) (hl : G.IsLink e u x) (hoff : e ∉ P)
    (hx : x ∈ G.walkVertices u P) : G.LiesOnCycle e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P₁, P₂, rfl, h₁, -, -⟩ := hP.split hx
  exact ⟨u, x, P₁, hl, h₁, fun hmem ↦ hoff (List.mem_append_left _ hmem)⟩

name: Graph.IsAcyclic.not_liesOnCycle
statement: theorem IsAcyclic.not_liesOnCycle (h : G.IsAcyclic) (e : β) : ¬ G.LiesOnCycle e
proof:
:=
  fun hc ↦ h hc.edge_mem hc

name: Graph.isAcyclic_iff
statement: theorem isAcyclic_iff : G.IsAcyclic ↔ ∀ e, ¬ G.LiesOnCycle e
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h e ↦ h.not_liesOnCycle e, fun h _ _ ↦ h _⟩

name: Graph.IsAcyclic.not_isLoopAt
statement: theorem IsAcyclic.not_isLoopAt (h : G.IsAcyclic) (e : β) (x : α) : ¬ G.IsLoopAt e x
proof:
:=
  fun hloop ↦ h.not_liesOnCycle e (liesOnCycle_of_isLoopAt hloop)

name: Graph.IsAcyclic.eq_of_isLink
statement:
theorem IsAcyclic.eq_of_isLink (h : G.IsAcyclic) (hl : G.IsLink e u v) (hl' : G.IsLink f u v) :
    e = f
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hef
  exact h.not_liesOnCycle e (liesOnCycle_of_parallel hl hl' hef)

name: Graph.IsAcyclic.anti
statement: theorem IsAcyclic.anti (hHG : H ≤ G) (h : G.IsAcyclic) : H.IsAcyclic
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hc ↦ h.not_liesOnCycle _ (hc.mono hHG)

name: Graph.IsAcyclic.deleteEdges
statement: theorem IsAcyclic.deleteEdges (h : G.IsAcyclic) (F : Set β) : (G.deleteEdges F).IsAcyclic
proof:
:=
  h.anti deleteEdges_le

name: Graph.IsAcyclic.mem_of_isLink_of_mem_walkVertices
statement:
theorem IsAcyclic.mem_of_isLink_of_mem_walkVertices (hac : G.IsAcyclic) (hP : G.IsPath u P v)
    (hl : G.IsLink e u x) (hx : x ∈ G.walkVertices u P) : e ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hoff
  exact hac.not_liesOnCycle e (hP.chord_liesOnCycle hl hoff hx)

name: Graph.IsBridge.edge_mem
statement: theorem IsBridge.edge_mem (h : G.IsBridge e) : e ∈ E(G)

name: Graph.IsBridge.not_liesOnCycle
statement: theorem IsBridge.not_liesOnCycle (h : G.IsBridge e) : ¬ G.LiesOnCycle e

name: Graph.IsBridge.not_reaches
statement:
theorem IsBridge.not_reaches (h : G.IsBridge e) (hl : G.IsLink e u v) :
    ¬ (G.deleteEdges {e}).Reaches u v
proof:
:=
  fun hR ↦ h.not_liesOnCycle (LiesOnCycle.of_deleteEdges_reaches hl hR)

name: Graph.isBridge_of_not_reaches
statement:
theorem isBridge_of_not_reaches (hl : G.IsLink e u v)
    (h : ¬ (G.deleteEdges {e}).Reaches u v) : G.IsBridge e
proof:
:=
  ⟨hl.edge_mem, fun hc ↦ h (hc.deleteEdges_reaches hl)⟩

name: Graph.isBridge_iff_not_reaches
statement:
theorem isBridge_iff_not_reaches (hl : G.IsLink e u v) :
    G.IsBridge e ↔ ¬ (G.deleteEdges {e}).Reaches u v
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h.not_reaches hl, isBridge_of_not_reaches hl⟩

name: Graph.IsBridge.not_isLoopAt
statement: theorem IsBridge.not_isLoopAt (h : G.IsBridge e) (x : α) : ¬ G.IsLoopAt e x
proof:
:=
  fun hloop ↦ h.not_liesOnCycle (liesOnCycle_of_isLoopAt hloop)

name: Graph.isAcyclic_iff_forall_isBridge
statement: theorem isAcyclic_iff_forall_isBridge : G.IsAcyclic ↔ ∀ e ∈ E(G), G.IsBridge e
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ he ↦ ⟨he, h he⟩, fun h _ he ↦ (h _ he).not_liesOnCycle⟩

name: Graph.IsAcyclic.isBridge
statement: theorem IsAcyclic.isBridge (h : G.IsAcyclic) (he : e ∈ E(G)) : G.IsBridge e
proof: := ⟨he, h he⟩

name: Graph.mem_edgesCover_iff
statement:
theorem mem_edgesCover_iff :
    z ∈ edgesCover drawing W ↔ ∃ e ∈ W, z ∈ edgeArc drawing e
proof:
:= by
  simp [edgesCover]

name: Graph.mem_edgesCover
statement: theorem mem_edgesCover (he : e ∈ W) (hz : z ∈ edgeArc drawing e) : z ∈ edgesCover drawing W
proof:
:=
  mem_edgesCover_iff.2 ⟨e, he, hz⟩

name: Graph.edgesCover_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem edgesCover_nil : edgesCover drawing ([] : List β) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp [edgesCover]

name: Graph.edgesCover_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem edgesCover_cons :
    edgesCover drawing (e :: W) = edgeArc drawing e ∪ edgesCover drawing W
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [edgesCover]

name: Graph.edgesCover_mono
statement: theorem edgesCover_mono (h : W ⊆ D) : edgesCover drawing W ⊆ edgesCover drawing D
proof:
:=
  fun _ hz ↦ let ⟨_, he, hze⟩ := mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hz; mem_edgesCover (h he) hze

name: Graph.edgesCover_subset_pointSet
statement:
theorem edgesCover_subset_pointSet (hW : ∀ e ∈ W, e ∈ E(G)) :
    edgesCover drawing W ⊆ pointSet G drawing
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨e, he, hze⟩ := mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hz
  exact edgeArc_subset_pointSet (hW e he) hze

name: Graph.IsDrawing.ne_of_isLink
statement: theorem IsDrawing.ne_of_isLink (h : IsDrawing G drawing) (hl : G.IsLink e u v) : u ≠ v
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  obtain ⟨g, -, hinj, -, hg0, hg1⟩ := h.edge_isArcBetween hl
  have : (0 : ℝ) = 1 := hinj zero_mem_I one_mem_I (hg0.trans hg1.symm)
  norm_num at this

name: Graph.IsDrawing.not_isLoopAt
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.not_isLoopAt (h : IsDrawing G drawing) (e : β) (u : Plane) :
    ¬ G.IsLoopAt e u
proof:
:=
  fun hloop ↦ h.ne_of_isLink hloop rfl

name: Graph.IsDrawing.first_edge_meets_rest
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.first_edge_meets_rest (h : IsDrawing G drawing) (hl : G.IsLink e u w)
    (hW : ∀ f ∈ W, f ∈ E(G)) (hfresh : u ∉ G.walkVertices w W)
    (hze : z ∈ edgeArc drawing e) (hzW : z ∈ edgesCover drawing W) : z = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hzf⟩ := mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hzW
  
  have hef : e ≠ f := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hfresh (mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered ⟨e, hf, hl.inc_left⟩)
  obtain ⟨-, hinc, hincf⟩ := h.edge_inter hl.edge_mem (hW f hf) hef hze hzf
  rcases hinc.eq_or_eq_of_isLink hl with rfl | rfl
  · exact absurd (mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered ⟨f, hf, hincf⟩) hfresh
  · rfl

name: Graph.IsDrawing.path_isArcBetween
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.path_isArcBetween (h : IsDrawing G drawing) (hP : G.IsPath u W v)
    (hne : W ≠ []) : IsArcBetween (edgesCover drawing W) u v
proof:
:= by
  induction hP with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | @cons u w v e W hl hP hfresh ih =>
    rcases eq_or_ne W [] with rfl | hW
    · 
      obtain rfl : w = v := hP.isWalk.eq_of_nil
      simpa using h.edge_isArcBetween hl
    · refine edgesCover_cons ▸ (h.edge_isArcBetween hl).concatenate (ih hW) ?_
      exact fun z hze hzW ↦
        h.first_edge_meets_rest hl (fun f hf ↦ hP.edge_mem hf) hfresh hze hzW

name: Graph.IsDrawing.detour_isArcBetween
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.detour_isArcBetween (h : IsDrawing G drawing) (hc : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D) :
    IsArcBetween (edgesCover drawing D) u v
proof:
:= by
  refine h.path_isArcBetween hc.isPath fun hD ↦ ?_
  exact h.ne_of_isLink hc.isLink (hD ▸ hc.isPath.isWalk).eq_of_nil

name: Graph.IsDrawing.detour_meets_edge
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.detour_meets_edge (h : IsDrawing G drawing) (hc : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D)
    (hzD : z ∈ edgesCover drawing D) (hze : z ∈ edgeArc drawing e) : z = u ∨ z = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hzf⟩ := mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hzD
  have hef : e ≠ f := fun hEq ↦ hc.notMem (hEq ▸ hf)
  obtain ⟨-, hinc, -⟩ :=
    h.edge_inter hc.isLink.edge_mem (hc.isPath.edge_mem hf) hef hze hzf
  exact hinc.eq_or_eq_of_isLink hc.isLink

name: Graph.IsDrawing.cycle_inter
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.cycle_inter (h : IsDrawing G drawing) (hc : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D) :
    edgesCover drawing D ∩ edgeArc drawing e = {u, v}
proof:
:= by
  have hD := h.detour_isArcBetween hc
  have hE := h.edge_isArcBetween hc.isLink
  refine Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset (fun z hz ↦ h.detour_meets_edge hc hz.1 hz.2) ?_
  rintro z (rfl | rfl)
  exacts [⟨hD.left_mem, hE.left_mem⟩, ⟨hD.right_mem, hE.right_mem⟩]

name: Graph.IsDrawing.cycle_isJordanCurve
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.cycle_isJordanCurve (h : IsDrawing G drawing)
    (hc : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D) : IsJordanCurve (edgesCover drawing (e :: D))
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : IsJordanCurve (edgesCover drawing D ∪ edgeArc drawing e) :=
    IsJordanCurve.of_two_arcs (h.detour_isArcBetween hc)
      (h.edge_isArcBetween hc.isLink).reverse fun z hzD hze ↦ h.detour_meets_edge hc hzD hze
  rw [edgesCover_cons, Set.union_comm]
  exact hJ

name: Graph.IsWalk.left_mem_edgesCover
statement:
theorem IsWalk.left_mem_edgesCover {u v : Plane} {W : List β} (hW : G.IsWalk u W v)
    (hd : IsDrawing G drawing) (hne : W ≠ []) : u ∈ edgesCover drawing W
proof:
:= by
  cases hW with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | cons hl _ => exact mem_edgesCover (List.mem_cons_self ..) (hd.edge_isArcBetween hl).left_mem

name: Graph.IsDrawing.isPolygonal_edgesCover
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.isPolygonal_edgesCover (hd : IsDrawing G drawing)
    (hpoly : ∀ f ∈ E(G), Schoenflies.IsPolygonal (edgeArc drawing f)) :
    ∀ {u v : Plane} {W : List β}, G.IsWalk u W v → W ≠ [] →
      Schoenflies.IsPolygonal (edgesCover drawing W)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v W hW
  induction hW with
  | nil => exact fun h => absurd rfl h
  | @cons u w v f W hl hW ih =>
    intro _
    rcases eq_or_ne W [] with rfl | hWne
    · simpa using hpoly f hl.edge_mem
    · rw [edgesCover_cons]
      exact ((hpoly f hl.edge_mem).union (ih hWne)
        ⟨w, (hd.edge_isArcBetween hl).right_mem, hW.left_mem_edgesCover hd hWne⟩)

name: Graph.finite_vertexSet
statement: theorem finite_vertexSet (G : Graph α β) [G.Finite] : V(G).Finite
proof: := Finite.finite_vertexSet

name: Graph.finite_edgeSet
statement: theorem finite_edgeSet (G : Graph α β) [G.Finite] : E(G).Finite
proof: := Finite.finite_edgeSet

name: Graph.Finite.of_le
statement: theorem Finite.of_le (h : H ≤ G) [G.Finite] : H.Finite
proof:
:=
  ⟨(_root_.Graph.finite_vertexSet G).subset h.vertexSet_mono,
   (_root_.Graph.finite_edgeSet G).subset h.edgeSet_mono⟩

name: Graph.mem_vertexFinset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_vertexFinset [G.Finite] : x ∈ G.vertexFinset ↔ x ∈ V(G)
proof:
:=
  Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _

name: Graph.mem_edgeFinset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_edgeFinset [G.Finite] : e ∈ G.edgeFinset ↔ e ∈ E(G)
proof:
:=
  Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _

name: Graph.coe_vertexFinset
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_vertexFinset [G.Finite] : (G.vertexFinset : Set α) = V(G)
proof:
:=
  Set.Finite.coe_toFinset _

name: Graph.coe_edgeFinset
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_edgeFinset [G.Finite] : (G.edgeFinset : Set β) = E(G)
proof:
:=
  Set.Finite.coe_toFinset _

name: Graph.card_vertexFinset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_vertexFinset [G.Finite] : G.vertexFinset.card = V(G).ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset, coe_vertexFinset]

name: Graph.card_edgeFinset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_edgeFinset [G.Finite] : G.edgeFinset.card = E(G).ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset, coe_edgeFinset]

name: Graph.incidenceSet_eq_setOf
statement: theorem incidenceSet_eq_setOf (G : Graph α β) (x : α) : G.incidenceSet x = {e | G.Inc e x}
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Graph.loopSet_eq_setOf
statement: theorem loopSet_eq_setOf (G : Graph α β) (x : α) : G.loopSet x = {e | G.IsLoopAt e x}
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Graph.finite_incidenceSet
statement: theorem finite_incidenceSet [G.Finite] (x : α) : (G.incidenceSet x).Finite
proof:
:=
  (finite_edgeSet G).subset (G.incidenceSet_subset_edgeSet x)

name: Graph.finite_loopSet
statement: theorem finite_loopSet [G.Finite] (x : α) : (G.loopSet x).Finite
proof:
:=
  (finite_incidenceSet x).subset (G.loopSet_subset_incidenceSet x)

name: Graph.degree_def
statement:
theorem degree_def (G : Graph α β) (x : α) :
    G.degree x = (G.incidenceSet x).ncard + (G.loopSet x).ncard
proof: := rfl

name: Graph.degree_eq_zero_of_notMem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_eq_zero_of_notMem (h : x ∉ V(G)) : G.degree x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : G.incidenceSet x = ∅ := by
    ext e
    simp only [mem_incidenceSet, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    exact fun hx => h hx.vertex_mem
  have h2 : G.loopSet x = ∅ :=
    Set.eq_empty_of_subset_empty (h1 ▸ G.loopSet_subset_incidenceSet x)
  rw [degree_def, h1, h2]
  simp

name: Graph.ncard_loopSet_le_ncard_incidenceSet
statement:
theorem ncard_loopSet_le_ncard_incidenceSet [G.Finite] (x : α) :
    (G.loopSet x).ncard ≤ (G.incidenceSet x).ncard
proof:
:=
  Set.ncard_le_ncard (G.loopSet_subset_incidenceSet x) (finite_incidenceSet x)

name: Graph.ncard_incidenceSet_le_degree
statement: theorem ncard_incidenceSet_le_degree (x : α) : (G.incidenceSet x).ncard ≤ G.degree x
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_add_right _ _

name: Graph.degree_eq_ncard_incidenceSet
statement:
theorem degree_eq_ncard_incidenceSet (h : ∀ e, ¬ G.IsLoopAt e x) :
    G.degree x = (G.incidenceSet x).ncard
proof:
:= by
  have : G.loopSet x = ∅ := by
    ext e
    simpa using h e
  rw [degree_def, this]
  simp

name: Graph.IsLoopAt.two_le_degree
statement: theorem IsLoopAt.two_le_degree [G.Finite] (h : G.IsLoopAt e x) : 2 ≤ G.degree x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ (G.loopSet x).ncard :=
    (Set.ncard_pos (finite_loopSet x)).2 ⟨e, h⟩
  have h2 : 1 ≤ (G.incidenceSet x).ncard :=
    (Set.ncard_pos (finite_incidenceSet x)).2 ⟨e, h.inc⟩
  rw [degree_def]
  omega

name: Graph.degree_pos_of_inc
statement: theorem degree_pos_of_inc [G.Finite] (h : G.Inc e x) : 0 < G.degree x
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 < (G.incidenceSet x).ncard := (Set.ncard_pos (finite_incidenceSet x)).2 ⟨e, h⟩
  rw [degree_def]
  omega

name: Graph.degree_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem degree_eq_zero_iff [G.Finite] : G.degree x = 0 ↔ ∀ e, ¬ G.Inc e x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h e he => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · exact absurd h (degree_pos_of_inc he).ne'
  · have h1 : G.incidenceSet x = ∅ := by
      ext e
      simpa using h e
    have h2 : G.loopSet x = ∅ :=
      Set.eq_empty_of_subset_empty (h1 ▸ G.loopSet_subset_incidenceSet x)
    rw [degree_def, h1, h2]
    simp

name: Graph.ncard_inc_add_ncard_isLoopAt
statement:
theorem ncard_inc_add_ncard_isLoopAt (G : Graph α β) (he : e ∈ E(G)) :
    {x | G.Inc e x}.ncard + {x | G.IsLoopAt e x}.ncard = 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet he
  by_cases huv' : u = v
  · 
    subst huv'
    have hl : G.IsLoopAt e u := huv
    have h1 : {x | G.Inc e x} = {u} := by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      exact ⟨fun h => (hl.eq_of_inc h).symm, fun h => h ▸ hl.inc⟩
    have h2 : {x | G.IsLoopAt e x} = {u} := by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      exact ⟨fun h => (hl.eq_of_inc h.inc).symm, fun h => h ▸ hl⟩
    rw [h1, h2]
    simp
  · 
    have h1 : {x | G.Inc e x} = {u, v} := by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.eq_or_eq_of_isLink huv,
        fun h => h.elim (fun hz => hz ▸ huv.inc_left) (fun hz => hz ▸ huv.inc_right)⟩
    have h2 : {x | G.IsLoopAt e x} = ∅ := by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      intro hz
      exact huv' ((hz.eq_of_inc huv.inc_left).symm.trans (hz.eq_of_inc huv.inc_right))
    rw [h1, h2, Set.ncard_pair huv']
    simp

name: Graph.ncard_setOf_eq_sum_ite
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_filter p s, ← Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨hsub z h, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩

name: Graph.sum_degree_eq_two_mul_ncard_edgeSet
statement:
theorem sum_degree_eq_two_mul_ncard_edgeSet (G : Graph α β) [G.Finite] :
    ∑ x ∈ G.vertexFinset, G.degree x = 2 * E(G).ncard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set ends : β → α → ℕ :=
    fun e x => (if G.Inc e x then 1 else 0) + (if G.IsLoopAt e x then 1 else 0) with hends
  
  have hdeg : ∀ x, G.degree x = ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, ends e x := by
    intro x
    have h1 : (G.incidenceSet x).ncard = ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, if G.Inc e x then 1 else 0 := by
      rw [incidenceSet_eq_setOf]
      exact ncard_setOf_eq_sum_ite _ _ fun z hz => mem_edgeFinset.2 hz.edge_mem
    have h2 : (G.loopSet x).ncard = ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, if G.IsLoopAt e x then 1 else 0 := by
      rw [loopSet_eq_setOf]
      exact ncard_setOf_eq_sum_ite _ _ fun z hz => mem_edgeFinset.2 hz.edge_mem
    rw [degree_def, h1, h2, hends, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  
  have hedge : ∀ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, ∑ x ∈ G.vertexFinset, ends e x = 2 := by
    intro e he
    rw [mem_edgeFinset] at he
    have h1 : {x | G.Inc e x}.ncard = ∑ x ∈ G.vertexFinset, if G.Inc e x then 1 else 0 :=
      ncard_setOf_eq_sum_ite _ _ fun z hz => mem_vertexFinset.2 hz.vertex_mem
    have h2 : {x | G.IsLoopAt e x}.ncard
        = ∑ x ∈ G.vertexFinset, if G.IsLoopAt e x then 1 else 0 :=
      ncard_setOf_eq_sum_ite _ _ fun z hz => mem_vertexFinset.2 hz.vertex_mem
    rw [hends, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← h1, ← h2]
    exact G.ncard_inc_add_ncard_isLoopAt he
  calc ∑ x ∈ G.vertexFinset, G.degree x
      = ∑ x ∈ G.vertexFinset, ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, ends e x := by
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => hdeg x
    _ = ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, ∑ x ∈ G.vertexFinset, ends e x := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ _e ∈ G.edgeFinset, 2 := Finset.sum_congr rfl hedge
    _ = 2 * E(G).ncard := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, card_edgeFinset, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm]

name: Graph.sum_degree_eq_two_mul_card_edgeFinset
statement:
theorem sum_degree_eq_two_mul_card_edgeFinset (G : Graph α β) [G.Finite] :
    ∑ x ∈ G.vertexFinset, G.degree x = 2 * G.edgeFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_edgeFinset]
  exact G.sum_degree_eq_two_mul_ncard_edgeSet

name: Graph.even_sum_degree
statement:
theorem even_sum_degree (G : Graph α β) [G.Finite] :
    Even (∑ x ∈ G.vertexFinset, G.degree x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨E(G).ncard, by rw [G.sum_degree_eq_two_mul_ncard_edgeSet, two_mul]⟩

name: Graph.IsLeaf.mem_vertexSet
statement: theorem IsLeaf.mem_vertexSet (h : G.IsLeaf x) : x ∈ V(G)

name: Graph.IsLeaf.degree_eq_one
statement: theorem IsLeaf.degree_eq_one (h : G.IsLeaf x) : G.degree x = 1

name: Graph.isLeaf_iff
statement: theorem isLeaf_iff : G.IsLeaf x ↔ x ∈ V(G) ∧ G.degree x = 1
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Graph.IsLeaf.not_isLoopAt
statement: theorem IsLeaf.not_isLoopAt [G.Finite] (h : G.IsLeaf x) (e : β) : ¬ G.IsLoopAt e x
proof:
:= by
  intro hl
  have h2 := hl.two_le_degree
  have hd := h.2
  omega

name: Graph.IsLeaf.ncard_incidenceSet
statement:
theorem IsLeaf.ncard_incidenceSet [G.Finite] (h : G.IsLeaf x) :
    (G.incidenceSet x).ncard = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle := ncard_loopSet_le_ncard_incidenceSet (G := G) x
  have hd : (G.incidenceSet x).ncard + (G.loopSet x).ncard = 1 := h.2
  omega

name: Graph.IsLeaf.loopSet_eq_empty
statement: theorem IsLeaf.loopSet_eq_empty [G.Finite] (h : G.IsLeaf x) : G.loopSet x = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hle := ncard_loopSet_le_ncard_incidenceSet (G := G) x
  have hd : (G.incidenceSet x).ncard + (G.loopSet x).ncard = 1 := h.2
  have : (G.loopSet x).ncard = 0 := by omega
  exact (Set.ncard_eq_zero (finite_loopSet x)).1 this

name: Graph.IsLeaf.existsUnique_inc
statement: theorem IsLeaf.existsUnique_inc [G.Finite] (h : G.IsLeaf x) : ∃! e, G.Inc e x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Set.ncard_eq_one.1 h.ncard_incidenceSet
  refine ⟨e, ?_, fun f hf => ?_⟩
  · have : e ∈ G.incidenceSet x := by rw [he]; rfl
    exact this
  · have : f ∈ G.incidenceSet x := hf
    rw [he] at this
    exact this

name: Graph.IsLeaf.exists_isLink
statement:
theorem IsLeaf.exists_isLink [G.Finite] (h : G.IsLeaf x) :
    ∃ e y, y ≠ x ∧ G.IsLink e x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, -⟩ := h.existsUnique_inc
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := he
  refine ⟨e, y, ?_, hy⟩
  rintro rfl
  exact h.not_isLoopAt e hy

name: Graph.IsLeaf.isNonloopAt
statement:
theorem IsLeaf.isNonloopAt [G.Finite] (h : G.IsLeaf x) (he : G.Inc e x) :
    G.IsNonloopAt e x
proof:
:=
  he.isLoopAt_or_isNonloopAt.resolve_left (h.not_isLoopAt e)

name: Graph.isLeaf_of_isNonloopAt
statement:
theorem isLeaf_of_isNonloopAt (hx : x ∈ V(G))
    (h : ∀ f, G.Inc f x ↔ f = e) (hne : G.IsNonloopAt e x) : G.IsLeaf x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
  have h1 : G.incidenceSet x = {e} := by
    ext f
    simpa using h f
  have h2 : G.loopSet x = ∅ := by
    ext f
    simp only [mem_loopSet, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro hf
    exact hne.not_isLoopAt x (((h f).1 hf.inc) ▸ hf)
  rw [degree_def, h1, h2]
  simp

name: Graph.IsDrawing.edge_isArcBetween
statement:
theorem edge_isArcBetween (h : IsDrawing G drawing) ⦃e x y⦄ (hl : G.IsLink e x y) :
    IsArcBetween (edgeArc drawing e) x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc, hi, hlink⟩ := h.edge_param hl.edge_mem
  have base : IsArcBetween (edgeArc drawing e) (drawing e 0) (drawing e 1) :=
    ⟨drawing e, hc, hi, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  rcases hl.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hlink with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact base
  · exact base.reverse

name: Graph.IsDrawing.isArc_edgeArc
statement:
theorem isArc_edgeArc (h : IsDrawing G drawing) {e : β} (he : e ∈ E(G)) :
    IsArc (edgeArc drawing e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := G.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet he
  exact (h.edge_isArcBetween hxy).isArc

name: Graph.IsDrawing.isCompact_edgeArc
statement:
theorem isCompact_edgeArc (h : IsDrawing G drawing) {e : β} (he : e ∈ E(G)) :
    IsCompact (edgeArc drawing e)
proof: := (h.isArc_edgeArc he).isCompact

name: Graph.IsDrawing.arcs_meet_at_vertex
statement:
theorem arcs_meet_at_vertex (h : IsDrawing G drawing) {e f : β} (he : e ∈ E(G)) (hf : f ∈ E(G))
    (hef : e ≠ f) {p : Plane} (hpe : p ∈ edgeArc drawing e) (hpf : p ∈ edgeArc drawing f) :
    p ∈ V(G)
proof:
:=
  (h.edge_inter he hf hef hpe hpf).1

name: Graph.IsDrawing.unique_edge_at
statement:
theorem unique_edge_at (h : IsDrawing G drawing) {e f : β} (he : e ∈ E(G)) (hf : f ∈ E(G))
    {p : Plane} (hpV : p ∉ V(G)) (hpe : p ∈ edgeArc drawing e) (hpf : p ∈ edgeArc drawing f) :
    e = f
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hef
  exact hpV (h.arcs_meet_at_vertex he hf hef hpe hpf)

name: Graph.vertexSet_subset_pointSet
statement: theorem vertexSet_subset_pointSet : V(G) ⊆ pointSet G drawing
proof: := subset_union_left

name: Graph.edgeArc_subset_pointSet
statement:
theorem edgeArc_subset_pointSet {e : β} (he : e ∈ E(G)) :
    edgeArc drawing e ⊆ pointSet G drawing
proof:
:=
  subset_union_of_subset_right (subset_biUnion_of_mem he) _

name: Graph.IsDrawing.isCompact_pointSet
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.isCompact_pointSet [G.Finite] (h : IsDrawing G drawing) :
    IsCompact (pointSet G drawing)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Graph.finite_vertexSet (G := G)).isCompact.union ?_
  exact (Graph.finite_edgeSet (G := G)).isCompact_biUnion fun e he => h.isCompact_edgeArc he

name: Graph.IsDrawing.isClosed_pointSet
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.isClosed_pointSet [G.Finite] (h : IsDrawing G drawing) :
    IsClosed (pointSet G drawing)
proof: := h.isCompact_pointSet.isClosed

name: Graph.IsDrawing.isOpen_exterior
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.isOpen_exterior [G.Finite] (h : IsDrawing G drawing) :
    IsOpen (exterior G drawing)
proof: := h.isClosed_pointSet.isOpen_compl

name: Graph.face_subset_exterior
statement:
theorem face_subset_exterior (G : Graph Plane β) (drawing : β → ℝ → Plane) (base : Plane) :
    face G drawing base ⊆ exterior G drawing
proof:
:=
  connectedComponentIn_subset _ _

name: Graph.mem_face
statement: theorem mem_face (h : base ∈ exterior G drawing) : base ∈ face G drawing base
proof:
:=
  mem_connectedComponentIn h

name: Graph.IsDrawing.isOpen_face
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.isOpen_face [G.Finite] (h : IsDrawing G drawing) (base : Plane) :
    IsOpen (face G drawing base)
proof:
:=
  Schoenflies.Plane.isOpen_connectedComponentIn h.isOpen_exterior

name: Graph.isConnected_face
statement:
theorem isConnected_face (h : base ∈ exterior G drawing) :
    IsConnected (face G drawing base)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨base, mem_face h⟩, isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn⟩

name: Graph.face_eq_or_disjoint
statement:
theorem face_eq_or_disjoint (b c : Plane) :
    face G drawing b = face G drawing c ∨ Disjoint (face G drawing b) (face G drawing c)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (face G drawing b ∩ face G drawing c).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨z, hzb, hzc⟩ := h
    left
    rw [face, face, connectedComponentIn_eq hzb, connectedComponentIn_eq hzc]
  · right
    exact Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.2 (not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 h)

name: Graph.Reaches.reroute
statement:
theorem Reaches.reroute (hV : V(G) ⊆ V(H))
    (hE : ∀ ⦃g p q⦄, G.IsLink g p q → g ≠ e → H.IsLink g p q)
    (hends : ∀ ⦃p q⦄, G.IsLink e p q → H.Reaches p q)
    (h : G.Reaches s t) : H.Reaches s t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := h
  induction hR with
  | nil hx => exact Reaches.refl (hV hx)
  | @cons p w q g R hl _ ih =>
    
    refine Reaches.trans ?_ ih
    by_cases hg : g = e
    · exact hends (hg ▸ hl)
    · exact Reaches.of_isLink (hE hl hg)

name: Graph.Reaches.across_edge_replacement
statement:
theorem Reaches.across_edge_replacement (hV : V(G.deleteVerts {c}) ⊆ V(H))
    (hl : G.IsLink e u v)
    (hE : ∀ ⦃g p q⦄, (G.deleteVerts {c}).IsLink g p q → g ≠ e → H.IsLink g p q)
    (routed : H.Reaches u v ∨ G.Inc e c)
    (h : (G.deleteVerts {c}).Reaches s t) : H.Reaches s t
proof:
:= by
  refine Reaches.reroute (e := e) hV hE (fun p q hpq ↦ ?_) h
  rw [deleteVerts_isLink] at hpq
  obtain ⟨hpq, hp, hq⟩ := hpq
  have hpc : p ≠ c := fun hh ↦ hp (by simp [hh])
  have hqc : q ≠ c := fun hh ↦ hq (by simp [hh])
  rcases routed with hr | ⟨w, hw⟩
  · 
    rcases hl.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hpq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exacts [hr, hr.symm]
  · 
    rcases hw.left_eq_or_eq hpq with hh | hh
    exacts [(hpc hh.symm).elim, (hqc hh.symm).elim]

name: Graph.IsTwoConnected.ear
statement:
theorem IsTwoConnected.ear (hG : G.IsTwoConnected) (hcompat : G.Compatible P)
    (hP : P.IsPathGraph u W v) (huv : u ≠ v) (hu : u ∈ V(G)) (hv : v ∈ V(G)) :
    (G.union P).IsTwoConnected where
  hasThreeVertices
proof:
:= hG.hasThreeVertices.mono (left_le_union G P).vertexSet_mono
  connected := hcompat.union_connected hG.connected hP.connected hu hP.source_mem
  deleteVerts_connected := by
    intro c _
    
    obtain ⟨z, hzG, hzc⟩ : ∃ z, z ∈ V(G) ∧ z ≠ c := by
      by_cases hcu : u = c
      · exact ⟨v, hv, fun hh ↦ huv (hcu.trans hh.symm)⟩
      · exact ⟨u, hu, hcu⟩
    have hGle : G.deleteVerts {c} ≤ (G.union P).deleteVerts {c} :=
      deleteVerts_mono (left_le_union G P) _
    have hPle : P.deleteVerts {c} ≤ (G.union P).deleteVerts {c} :=
      deleteVerts_mono hcompat.right_le_union _
    have hGc : (G.deleteVerts {c}).Connected := hG.deleteVerts_connected' c
    
    have key : ∀ x ∈ V(G), x ≠ c → ((G.union P).deleteVerts {c}).Reaches z x := fun x hx hxc ↦
      (hGc.reaches (mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne hzG hzc)
        (mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne hx hxc)).mono hGle
    refine Connected.of_hub (mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne
      ((left_le_union G P).vertexSet_mono hzG) hzc) fun x hx ↦ ?_
    rw [vertexSet_deleteVerts] at hx
    obtain ⟨hxS, hxc⟩ := hx
    have hxc' : x ≠ c := by simpa using hxc
    rcases (hxS : x ∈ V(G) ∪ V(P)) with hxG | hxP
    · exact key x hxG hxc'
    · 
      rcases hP.reaches_an_end hxP hxc' with hr | hr
      · have hune : u ≠ c := by
          have h₂ := hr.right_mem
          rw [vertexSet_deleteVerts] at h₂
          simpa using h₂.2
        exact (key u hu hune).trans (hr.mono hPle).symm
      · have hvne : v ≠ c := by
          have h₂ := hr.right_mem
          rw [vertexSet_deleteVerts] at h₂
          simpa using h₂.2
        exact (key v hv hvne).trans (hr.mono hPle).symm

name: Graph.IsTwoConnected.replace_edge_by_path
statement:
theorem IsTwoConnected.replace_edge_by_path (hG : G.IsTwoConnected) (hl : G.IsLink e u v)
    (huv : u ≠ v) (hcompat : (G.deleteEdges {e}).Compatible P) (hP : P.IsPathGraph u W v)
    (hnew : ∀ x ∈ V(P), x ≠ u → x ≠ v → x ∉ V(G)) :
    ((G.deleteEdges {e}).union P).IsTwoConnected
proof:
:= by
  set T := G.deleteEdges {e} with hT
  set S := T.union P with hS
  have hTS : T ≤ S := left_le_union T P
  have hPS : P ≤ S := hcompat.right_le_union
  have hVT : V(T) = V(G) := by rw [hT]; simp
  have hu : u ∈ V(G) := hl.left_mem
  have hv : v ∈ V(G) := hl.right_mem
  
  have hGS : ∀ ⦃g p q⦄, G.IsLink g p q → g ≠ e → S.IsLink g p q := by
    intro g p q hg hge
    refine hTS.isLink_mono (show T.IsLink g p q from ?_)
    rw [hT]
    exact ⟨hg, by simpa using hge⟩
  have hVGS : V(G) ⊆ V(S) := by
    rw [hS, vertexSet_union, hVT]
    exact Set.subset_union_left
  
  have hPuv : P.Reaches u v := hP.connected.reaches hP.source_mem hP.target_mem
  refine ⟨hG.hasThreeVertices.mono hVGS, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Connected.of_hub (hVGS hu) fun x hx ↦ ?_
    rcases (hx : x ∈ V(T) ∪ V(P)) with hxT | hxP
    · refine Reaches.reroute (e := e) hVGS hGS ?_
        (hG.connected.reaches hu (by rwa [hVT] at hxT))
      intro p q hpq
      rcases hl.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hpq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exacts [hPuv.mono hPS, (hPuv.mono hPS).symm]
    · exact (hP.connected.reaches hP.source_mem hxP).mono hPS
  intro c _
  
  obtain ⟨z, hzG, hzc⟩ : ∃ z, z ∈ V(G) ∧ z ≠ c := by
    by_cases hcu : u = c
    · exact ⟨v, hv, fun hh ↦ huv (hcu.trans hh.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨u, hu, hcu⟩
  have hTle : T.deleteVerts {c} ≤ S.deleteVerts {c} := deleteVerts_mono hTS _
  have hPle : P.deleteVerts {c} ≤ S.deleteVerts {c} := deleteVerts_mono hPS _
  have hGc : (G.deleteVerts {c}).Connected := hG.deleteVerts_connected' c
  
  have routed : (S.deleteVerts {c}).Reaches u v ∨ G.Inc e c := by
    by_cases hcu : c = u
    · exact Or.inr (hcu ▸ hl.inc_left)
    by_cases hcv : c = v
    · exact Or.inr (hcv ▸ hl.inc_right)
    by_cases hcG : c ∈ V(G)
    · 
      have hcP : c ∉ V(P) := fun hh ↦ hnew c hh hcu hcv hcG
      have hreach : (P.deleteVerts {c}).Reaches u v := by
        rw [deleteVerts_singleton_eq_self hcP]; exact hPuv
      exact Or.inl (hreach.mono hPle)
    · 
      have hcT : c ∉ V(T) := by rw [hVT]; exact hcG
      have hreach : (T.deleteVerts {c}).Reaches u v := by
        rw [deleteVerts_singleton_eq_self hcT, hT]
        exact hG.no_bridge hl
      exact Or.inl (hreach.mono hTle)
  
  have key : ∀ x ∈ V(G), x ≠ c → (S.deleteVerts {c}).Reaches x z := by
    intro x hx hxc
    refine Reaches.across_edge_replacement (e := e) ?_ hl ?_ routed
      (hGc.reaches (mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne hx hxc)
        (mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne hzG hzc))
    · rw [vertexSet_deleteVerts, vertexSet_deleteVerts]
      exact Set.sdiff_subset_sdiff_left hVGS
    · intro g p q hg hge
      rw [deleteVerts_isLink] at hg ⊢
      exact ⟨hGS hg.1 hge, hg.2.1, hg.2.2⟩
  refine Connected.of_hub (mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne (hVGS hzG) hzc) fun x hx ↦ ?_
  rw [vertexSet_deleteVerts] at hx
  obtain ⟨hxS, hxc⟩ := hx
  have hxc' : x ≠ c := by simpa using hxc
  rcases (hxS : x ∈ V(T) ∪ V(P)) with hxT | hxP
  · exact (key x (by rwa [hVT] at hxT) hxc').symm
  · rcases hP.reaches_an_end hxP hxc' with hr | hr
    · have hune : u ≠ c := by
        have h₂ := hr.right_mem
        rw [vertexSet_deleteVerts] at h₂
        simpa using h₂.2
      exact (key u hu hune).symm.trans (hr.mono hPle).symm
    · have hvne : v ≠ c := by
        have h₂ := hr.right_mem
        rw [vertexSet_deleteVerts] at h₂
        simpa using h₂.2
      exact (key v hv hvne).symm.trans (hr.mono hPle).symm

name: Graph.IsTwoConnected.ear_exists
statement:
theorem IsTwoConnected.ear_exists (hG : G.IsTwoConnected) (hK : K.IsTwoConnected) (hKG : K ≤ G)
    (hnl : ∀ ⦃g x⦄, ¬ G.IsLoopAt g x)
    (hproper : (∃ x ∈ V(G), x ∉ V(K)) ∨ (∃ g ∈ E(G), g ∉ E(K))) :
    ∃ a b D g, G.IsPath a D b ∧ a ≠ b ∧ a ∈ V(K) ∧ b ∈ V(K) ∧ g ∈ D ∧ g ∉ E(K)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hout : ∃ x ∈ V(G), x ∉ V(K)
  · obtain ⟨o, hoG, hoK⟩ := hout
    
    obtain ⟨anchor, hanchor⟩ := hK.connected.nonempty
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hG.connected.reaches (hKG.vertexSet_mono hanchor) hoG
    obtain ⟨g, hgR, p, q, hlpq, hpK, hqK⟩ := hR.crossing hanchor hoK
    have hpq : p ≠ q := fun hh ↦ hqK (hh ▸ hpK)
    
    obtain ⟨b, hbK, hbp, -⟩ := hK.hasThreeVertices.exists_ne_ne p p
    have hqG : q ∈ V(G) := hlpq.right_mem
    have hbG : b ∈ V(G) := hKG.vertexSet_mono hbK
    
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := ((hG.deleteVerts_connected' p).reaches
      (mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne hqG (Ne.symm hpq))
      (mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne hbG hbp)).exists_isPath
    have hfresh : p ∉ G.walkVertices q D := by
      rintro hmem
      rcases mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hmem with rfl | ⟨g', hg', hinc⟩
      · exact hpq rfl
      · exact hD.isWalk.notMem_of_inc_of_deleteVerts hinc hg'
    refine ⟨p, b, g :: D, g, .cons hlpq (hD.mono deleteVerts_le) hfresh, Ne.symm hbp, hpK,
      hbK, List.mem_cons_self, fun hgK ↦ ?_⟩
    
    exact hqK ((hKG.isLink_iff hgK).2 hlpq).right_mem
  · 
    push Not at hout
    obtain ⟨g, hgG, hgK⟩ := hproper.resolve_left (by rintro ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩; exact hx' (hout x hx))
    obtain ⟨p, q, hpq⟩ := exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet hgG
    have hne : p ≠ q := by rintro rfl; exact hnl hpq
    exact ⟨p, q, [g], g, .single hpq hne, hne, hout p hpq.left_mem, hout q hpq.right_mem,
      List.mem_cons_self, hgK⟩

name: Graph.IsTwoConnected.grows_by_ear
statement:
theorem IsTwoConnected.grows_by_ear (hG : G.IsTwoConnected) (hK : K.IsTwoConnected)
    (hKG : K ≤ G) (hnl : ∀ ⦃g x⦄, ¬ G.IsLoopAt g x)
    (hproper : (∃ x ∈ V(G), x ∉ V(K)) ∨ (∃ g ∈ E(G), g ∉ E(K))) :
    ∃ B : Graph α β, B.IsTwoConnected ∧ K ≤ B ∧ B ≤ G ∧ ∃ g ∈ E(B), g ∉ E(K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, D, g, hpath, hab, haK, hbK, hgD, hgK⟩ := hG.ear_exists hK hKG hnl hproper
  
  have hearle : G.pathGraphOf a D ≤ G := pathGraphOf_le hpath.isWalk
  have hearP : (G.pathGraphOf a D).IsPathGraph a D b := hpath.isPathGraph_pathGraphOf
  exact ⟨K.union (G.pathGraphOf a D),
    hK.ear (Compatible.of_le_le hKG hearle) hearP hab haK hbK,
    left_le_union _ _, union_le hKG hearle, g,
    Set.mem_union_right _ (hearP.mem_edgeSet hgD), hgK⟩

name: Graph.IsK33Config.x_ne_x
statement: theorem x_ne_x (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (hik : i ≠ k) : x i ≠ x k
proof:
:=
  fun he ↦ hik (h.x_injective he)

name: Graph.IsK33Config.y_ne_y
statement: theorem y_ne_y (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (hjl : j ≠ l) : y j ≠ y l
proof:
:=
  fun he ↦ hjl (h.y_injective he)

name: Graph.IsK33Config.x_ne_y
statement: theorem x_ne_y (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (i j : Fin 3) : x i ≠ y j
proof: := h.ne i j

name: Graph.IsK33Config.y_ne_x
statement: theorem y_ne_x (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (j i : Fin 3) : y j ≠ x i
proof: := (h.ne i j).symm

name: Graph.IsK33Config.eq_of_e_eq
statement: theorem eq_of_e_eq (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (heq : e i j = e k l) : i = k ∧ j = l
proof:
:= by
  have h' : G.IsLink (e i j) (x k) (y l) := by rw [heq]; exact h.isLink k l
  rcases (h.isLink i j).eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq h' with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, -⟩
  · exact ⟨h.x_injective h1, h.y_injective h2⟩
  · exact absurd h1 (h.ne i l)

name: Graph.IsK33Config.e_ne
statement: theorem e_ne (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (hne : ¬ (i = k ∧ j = l)) : e i j ≠ e k l
proof:
:=
  fun heq ↦ hne (h.eq_of_e_eq heq)

name: Graph.IsK33Config.inc_elim
statement: theorem inc_elim (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (hz : G.Inc (e i j) z) : z = x i ∨ z = y j
proof:
:=
  hz.eq_or_eq_of_isLink (h.isLink i j)

name: Graph.IsK33Config.notMem_walkVertices
statement:
theorem notMem_walkVertices (h : IsK33Config G x y e) {W : List β} {w : α} (hzw : z ≠ w)
    (hW : ∀ f ∈ W, ∃ i j, f = e i j ∧ z ≠ x i ∧ z ≠ y j) :
    z ∉ G.walkVertices w W
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  rcases mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hz with rfl | ⟨f, hf, hinc⟩
  · exact hzw rfl
  obtain ⟨i, j, rfl, hxi, hyj⟩ := hW f hf
  rcases h.inc_elim hinc with hh | hh
  exacts [hxi hh, hyj hh]

name: Graph.hexList_eq_map
statement:
theorem hexList_eq_map (e : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → β) :
    hexList e = hexPairs.map fun p ↦ e p.1 p.2
proof: := rfl

name: Graph.mem_hexList_iff
statement: theorem mem_hexList_iff {f : β} : f ∈ hexList e ↔ ∃ p ∈ hexPairs, f = e p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [hexList_eq_map]
  simp only [List.mem_map, eq_comm]

name: Graph.IsK33Config.hexDetour_isPath
statement: theorem hexDetour_isPath (h : IsK33Config G x y e) : G.IsPath (x 0) (hexDetour e) (y 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h5 : G.IsPath (x 1) [e 1 0] (y 0) := .single (h.isLink 1 0) (h.x_ne_y 1 0)
  have h4 : G.IsPath (y 1) [e 1 1, e 1 0] (y 0) := by
    refine .cons (h.isLink 1 1).symm h5 (h.notMem_walkVertices (h.y_ne_x 1 1) ?_)
    rintro f hf
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hf
    rcases hf with rfl
    exact ⟨1, 0, rfl, h.y_ne_x 1 1, h.y_ne_y (by decide)⟩
  have h3 : G.IsPath (x 2) [e 2 1, e 1 1, e 1 0] (y 0) := by
    refine .cons (h.isLink 2 1) h4 (h.notMem_walkVertices (h.x_ne_y 2 1) ?_)
    rintro f hf
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hf
    rcases hf with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨1, 1, rfl, h.x_ne_x (by decide), h.x_ne_y 2 1⟩
    · exact ⟨1, 0, rfl, h.x_ne_x (by decide), h.x_ne_y 2 0⟩
  have h2 : G.IsPath (y 2) [e 2 2, e 2 1, e 1 1, e 1 0] (y 0) := by
    refine .cons (h.isLink 2 2).symm h3 (h.notMem_walkVertices (h.y_ne_x 2 2) ?_)
    rintro f hf
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hf
    rcases hf with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨2, 1, rfl, h.y_ne_x 2 2, h.y_ne_y (by decide)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, 1, rfl, h.y_ne_x 2 1, h.y_ne_y (by decide)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, 0, rfl, h.y_ne_x 2 1, h.y_ne_y (by decide)⟩
  refine .cons (h.isLink 0 2) h2 (h.notMem_walkVertices (h.x_ne_y 0 2) ?_)
  rintro f hf
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hf
  rcases hf with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨2, 2, rfl, h.x_ne_x (by decide), h.x_ne_y 0 2⟩
  · exact ⟨2, 1, rfl, h.x_ne_x (by decide), h.x_ne_y 0 1⟩
  · exact ⟨1, 1, rfl, h.x_ne_x (by decide), h.x_ne_y 0 1⟩
  · exact ⟨1, 0, rfl, h.x_ne_x (by decide), h.x_ne_y 0 0⟩

name: Graph.IsK33Config.hexagon_isCycleThrough
statement:
theorem hexagon_isCycleThrough (h : IsK33Config G x y e) :
    G.IsCycleThrough (e 0 0) (x 0) (y 0) (hexDetour e)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.isLink 0 0, h.hexDetour_isPath, ?_⟩
  simp only [hexDetour, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, not_or]
  exact ⟨h.e_ne (by decide), h.e_ne (by decide), h.e_ne (by decide), h.e_ne (by decide),
    h.e_ne (by decide)⟩

name: Graph.IsK33Config.chord_notMem_hexList
statement: theorem chord_notMem_hexList (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (s : Fin 3) : e s (s + 1) ∉ hexList e
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨p, hp, heq⟩ := mem_hexList_iff.1 hmem
  have key : ∀ (s : Fin 3) (p : Fin 3 × Fin 3), p ∈ hexPairs → ¬ (s = p.1 ∧ s + 1 = p.2) := by
    decide
  exact key s p hp (h.eq_of_e_eq heq)

name: Graph.IsK33Config.chord_ne
statement: theorem chord_ne (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (hst : s ≠ t) : e s (s + 1) ≠ e t (t + 1)
proof:
:=
  h.e_ne (fun hc ↦ hst hc.1)

name: Graph.IsK33Config.hexList_edge_mem
statement: theorem hexList_edge_mem (h : IsK33Config G x y e) {f : β} (hf : f ∈ hexList e) : f ∈ E(G)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := mem_hexList_iff.1 hf
  exact (h.isLink p.1 p.2).edge_mem

name: Graph.mem_hexList
statement:
theorem mem_hexList (e : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → β) {p : Fin 3 × Fin 3} (hp : p ∈ hexPairs) :
    e p.1 p.2 ∈ hexList e
proof:
:=
  mem_hexList_iff.2 ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩

name: Graph.arcA_eq_map
statement:
theorem arcA_eq_map (e : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → β) (s : Fin 3) :
    arcA e s = (arcAPairs s).map fun p ↦ e p.1 p.2
proof: := rfl

name: Graph.arcB_eq_map
statement:
theorem arcB_eq_map (e : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → β) (s : Fin 3) :
    arcB e s = (arcBPairs s).map fun p ↦ e p.1 p.2
proof: := rfl

name: Graph.IsK33Config.arcA_isPath
statement:
theorem arcA_isPath (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (s : Fin 3) :
    G.IsPath (x s) (arcA e s) (y (s + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hab : s ≠ s + 1 := by revert s; decide
  have p3 : G.IsPath (x (s + 1)) [e (s + 1) (s + 1)] (y (s + 1)) :=
    .single (h.isLink (s + 1) (s + 1)) (h.x_ne_y _ _)
  have p2 : G.IsPath (y s) [e (s + 1) s, e (s + 1) (s + 1)] (y (s + 1)) := by
    refine .cons (h.isLink (s + 1) s).symm p3 (h.notMem_walkVertices (h.y_ne_x _ _) ?_)
    rintro f hf
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hf
    rcases hf with rfl
    exact ⟨s + 1, s + 1, rfl, h.y_ne_x _ _, h.y_ne_y hab⟩
  refine .cons (h.isLink s s) p2 (h.notMem_walkVertices (h.x_ne_y _ _) ?_)
  rintro f hf
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hf
  rcases hf with rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨s + 1, s, rfl, h.x_ne_x hab, h.x_ne_y _ _⟩
  · exact ⟨s + 1, s + 1, rfl, h.x_ne_x hab, h.x_ne_y _ _⟩

name: Graph.IsK33Config.arcB_isPath
statement:
theorem arcB_isPath (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (s : Fin 3) :
    G.IsPath (x s) (arcB e s) (y (s + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hac : s ≠ s + 2 := by revert s; decide
  have hcb : s + 2 ≠ s + 1 := by revert s; decide
  have q3 : G.IsPath (x (s + 2)) [e (s + 2) (s + 1)] (y (s + 1)) :=
    .single (h.isLink (s + 2) (s + 1)) (h.x_ne_y _ _)
  have q2 : G.IsPath (y (s + 2)) [e (s + 2) (s + 2), e (s + 2) (s + 1)] (y (s + 1)) := by
    refine .cons (h.isLink (s + 2) (s + 2)).symm q3 (h.notMem_walkVertices (h.y_ne_x _ _) ?_)
    rintro f hf
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hf
    rcases hf with rfl
    exact ⟨s + 2, s + 1, rfl, h.y_ne_x _ _, h.y_ne_y hcb⟩
  refine .cons (h.isLink s (s + 2)) q2 (h.notMem_walkVertices (h.x_ne_y _ _) ?_)
  rintro f hf
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hf
  rcases hf with rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨s + 2, s + 2, rfl, h.x_ne_x hac, h.x_ne_y _ _⟩
  · exact ⟨s + 2, s + 1, rfl, h.x_ne_x hac, h.x_ne_y _ _⟩

name: Graph.mem_edgesCover_map_iff
statement:
theorem mem_edgesCover_map_iff {L : List (Fin 3 × Fin 3)} {p : Plane} :
    p ∈ edgesCover drawing (L.map fun q ↦ e q.1 q.2) ↔
      ∃ q ∈ L, p ∈ edgeArc drawing (e q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hpf⟩ := mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hp
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hf
    exact ⟨q, hq, hpf⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩
    exact mem_edgesCover (List.mem_map_of_mem hq) hpq

name: Graph.mem_hexSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_hexSet_iff {p : Plane} :
    p ∈ hexSet drawing e ↔ ∃ q ∈ hexPairs, p ∈ edgeArc drawing (e q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hexSet, hexList_eq_map]; exact mem_edgesCover_map_iff

name: Graph.mem_arcA_iff
statement:
theorem mem_arcA_iff {p : Plane} :
    p ∈ edgesCover drawing (arcA e s) ↔ ∃ q ∈ arcAPairs s, p ∈ edgeArc drawing (e q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [arcA_eq_map]; exact mem_edgesCover_map_iff

name: Graph.mem_arcB_iff
statement:
theorem mem_arcB_iff {p : Plane} :
    p ∈ edgesCover drawing (arcB e s) ↔ ∃ q ∈ arcBPairs s, p ∈ edgeArc drawing (e q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [arcB_eq_map]; exact mem_edgesCover_map_iff

name: Graph.IsK33Config.hexagon_isJordanCurve
statement:
theorem hexagon_isJordanCurve (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (hd : IsDrawing G drawing) :
    IsJordanCurve (hexSet drawing e)
proof:
:=
  hd.cycle_isJordanCurve h.hexagon_isCycleThrough

name: Graph.IsK33Config.x_mem_hexSet
statement:
theorem x_mem_hexSet (h : IsK33Config G x y e) (hd : IsDrawing G drawing) (i : Fin 3) :
    x i ∈ hexSet drawing e
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ i : Fin 3, ((i, i) : Fin 3 × Fin 3) ∈ hexPairs := by decide
