    refine Connected.of_hub (mem_deleteVerts_singleton_of_ne huK (fun h ↦ hcu h.symm)) ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [vertexSet_deleteVerts] at hx
    have hxc : x ≠ c := fun h ↦ hx.2 (by simp [h])
    rcases hreach x hx.1 hxc with hr | hr
    · exact hr.symm
    · exact (hr.trans hvu).symm

name: Schoenflies.Plane.closedSquare_mono_center
statement:
theorem closedSquare_mono_center (c : Plane) {r s : ℝ} (h : r ≤ s) :
    closedSquare c r ⊆ closedSquare c s
proof: := fun _ hx => le_trans hx h

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_closedSquare_self
statement: theorem mem_closedSquare_self (c : Plane) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : c ∈ closedSquare c r
proof:
:= by
  change supDist c c ≤ r
  rw [supDist_self]; exact hr

name: Schoenflies.Plane.supDist_eq_dist_le
statement: theorem supDist_eq_dist_le (x c : Plane) : supDist x c ≤ dist x c
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact supNorm_le_norm _

name: Schoenflies.Plane.closedBall_subset_closedSquare
statement:
theorem closedBall_subset_closedSquare (c : Plane) (r : ℝ) :
    closedBall c r ⊆ closedSquare c r
proof:
:= fun _ hx =>
  le_trans (supDist_eq_dist_le _ _) (mem_closedBall.1 hx)

name: Schoenflies.Plane.closedSquare_subset_ball
statement:
theorem closedSquare_subset_ball {c : Plane} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    closedSquare c (ρ / 2) ⊆ ball c ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  intro x hx
  have hsup : supDist x c ≤ ρ / 2 := hx
  have hnorm : ‖x - c‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * (ρ / 2) :=
    le_trans (norm_le_sqrt_two_mul_supNorm _)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsup (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2))
  rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
  calc ‖x - c‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * (ρ / 2) := hnorm
    _ < 2 * (ρ / 2) := by
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsqrt (by linarith)
    _ = ρ := by ring

name: Schoenflies.isCompact_parameters_mem
statement:
theorem isCompact_parameters_mem {f : ℝ → Plane} {α β : ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc α β))
    {C : Set Plane} (hC : IsClosed C) : IsCompact {t | t ∈ Icc α β ∧ f t ∈ C}
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {t | t ∈ Icc α β ∧ f t ∈ C} = Icc α β ∩ f ⁻¹' C := rfl
  rw [hset]
  exact isCompact_Icc.of_isClosed_subset
    (hf.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc hC) inter_subset_left

name: Schoenflies.exists_last_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem exists_last_mem_Icc {f : ℝ → Plane} {α β : ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc α β))
    {C : Set Plane} (hC : IsClosed C) {t₀ : ℝ} (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Icc α β) (hmem : f t₀ ∈ C) :
    ∃ s ∈ Icc α β, t₀ ≤ s ∧ f s ∈ C ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc α β, s < t → f t ∉ C
proof:
:= by
  set S : Set ℝ := {t | t ∈ Icc α β ∧ f t ∈ C} with hS
  have hcpt : IsCompact S := isCompact_parameters_mem hf hC
  have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨t₀, ht₀, hmem⟩
  obtain ⟨hsI, hsC⟩ : sSup S ∈ S := hcpt.sSup_mem hne
  refine ⟨sSup S, hsI, le_csSup hcpt.bddAbove ⟨ht₀, hmem⟩, hsC, fun t htI hlt htC => ?_⟩
  
  exact absurd (le_csSup hcpt.bddAbove ⟨htI, htC⟩) (not_le.2 hlt)

name: Schoenflies.exists_first_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem exists_first_mem_Icc {f : ℝ → Plane} {α β : ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc α β))
    {C : Set Plane} (hC : IsClosed C) {t₀ : ℝ} (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Icc α β) (hmem : f t₀ ∈ C) :
    ∃ s ∈ Icc α β, s ≤ t₀ ∧ f s ∈ C ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc α β, t < s → f t ∉ C
proof:
:= by
  set S : Set ℝ := {t | t ∈ Icc α β ∧ f t ∈ C} with hS
  have hcpt : IsCompact S := isCompact_parameters_mem hf hC
  have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨t₀, ht₀, hmem⟩
  obtain ⟨hsI, hsC⟩ : sInf S ∈ S := hcpt.sInf_mem hne
  refine ⟨sInf S, hsI, csInf_le hcpt.bddBelow ⟨ht₀, hmem⟩, hsC, fun t htI hlt htC => ?_⟩
  exact absurd (csInf_le hcpt.bddBelow ⟨htI, htC⟩) (not_le.2 hlt)

name: Schoenflies.exists_last_mem
proof:
:=
  exists_last_mem_Icc hf hC ht₀ hmem

name: Schoenflies.exists_first_mem
proof:
:=
  exists_first_mem_Icc hf hC ht₀ hmem

name: Graph.IsDrawing.notMem_edgeArc_of_not_inc
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.notMem_edgeArc_of_not_inc (h : IsDrawing G drawing) {e : β} (he : e ∈ E(G))
    {v : Plane} (hv : v ∈ V(G)) (hinc : ¬ G.Inc e v) : v ∉ edgeArc drawing e
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := G.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet he
  rcases h.vertex_mem_edgeArc hxy hv hmem with rfl | rfl
  · exact hinc hxy.inc_left
  · exact hinc hxy.inc_right

name: Graph.IsDrawing.exists_square_at
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.exists_square_at [G.Finite] (h : IsDrawing G drawing) {v : Plane}
    (hv : v ∈ V(G)) :
    ∃ r > 0, (∀ w ∈ V(G), w ≠ v → w ∉ Plane.closedSquare v r) ∧
      ∀ e ∈ E(G), ¬ G.Inc e v → Disjoint (Plane.closedSquare v r) (edgeArc drawing e)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hvert⟩ :
      ∃ r > 0, ∀ w ∈ V(G), w ≠ v → w ∉ Plane.closedSquare v r := by
    refine exists_pos_forall_of_finite (Graph.finite_vertexSet (G := G))
      (P := fun w r => w ≠ v → w ∉ Plane.closedSquare v r) ?_ ?_
    · exact fun w δ ε _ hδε hP hne hmem =>
        hP hne (Plane.closedSquare_mono_center v hδε hmem)
    · intro w hw
      by_cases hwv : w = v
      · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun hne => absurd hwv hne⟩
      · 
        
        have hpos : 0 < dist w v := dist_pos.2 hwv
        refine ⟨dist w v / 2, by linarith, fun _ hmem => ?_⟩
        exact absurd (mem_ball.1 (Plane.closedSquare_subset_ball hpos hmem)) (by simp)
  
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hedge⟩ :
      ∃ r > 0, ∀ e ∈ E(G), ¬ G.Inc e v →
        Disjoint (Plane.closedSquare v r) (edgeArc drawing e) := by
    refine exists_pos_forall_of_finite (Graph.finite_edgeSet (G := G))
      (P := fun e r => ¬ G.Inc e v → Disjoint (Plane.closedSquare v r) (edgeArc drawing e))
      ?_ ?_
    · exact fun e δ ε _ hδε hP hinc =>
        Set.disjoint_of_subset_left (Plane.closedSquare_mono_center v hδε) (hP hinc)
    · intro e he
      by_cases hinc : G.Inc e v
      · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun h' => absurd hinc h'⟩
      · have hdisj : Disjoint ({v} : Set Plane) (edgeArc drawing e) :=
          Set.disjoint_singleton_left.2 (h.notMem_edgeArc_of_not_inc he hv hinc)
        obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hsep⟩ :=
          Plane.exists_dist_pos isCompact_singleton (h.isCompact_edgeArc he) hdisj
        refine ⟨ρ / 2, by linarith, fun _ => Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hx hxe => ?_⟩
        have hclose : dist x v < ρ := mem_ball.1 (Plane.closedSquare_subset_ball hρ hx)
        have hfar : ρ ≤ dist v x := hsep v rfl x hxe
        rw [dist_comm] at hfar
        linarith
  refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁ hr₂, fun w hw hne hmem => ?_, fun e he hinc => ?_⟩
  · exact hvert w hw hne (Plane.closedSquare_mono_center v (min_le_left _ _) hmem)
  · exact Set.disjoint_of_subset_left
      (Plane.closedSquare_mono_center v (min_le_right _ _)) (hedge e he hinc)

name: Graph.IsDrawing.exists_vertexSquares
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.exists_vertexSquares [G.Finite] (h : IsDrawing G drawing) :
    ∃ r > 0,
      (∀ v ∈ V(G), ∀ w ∈ V(G), w ≠ v → w ∉ Plane.closedSquare v r) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ V(G), ∀ e ∈ E(G), ¬ G.Inc e v →
        Disjoint (Plane.closedSquare v r) (edgeArc drawing e)) ∧
      ∀ v ∈ V(G), ∀ w ∈ V(G), v ≠ w →
        Disjoint (Plane.closedSquare v r) (Plane.closedSquare w r)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hall⟩ :
      ∃ r > 0, ∀ v ∈ V(G),
        (∀ w ∈ V(G), w ≠ v → w ∉ Plane.closedSquare v r) ∧
        ∀ e ∈ E(G), ¬ G.Inc e v →
          Disjoint (Plane.closedSquare v r) (edgeArc drawing e) := by
    refine exists_pos_forall_of_finite (Graph.finite_vertexSet (G := G))
      (P := fun v r => (∀ w ∈ V(G), w ≠ v → w ∉ Plane.closedSquare v r) ∧
        ∀ e ∈ E(G), ¬ G.Inc e v →
          Disjoint (Plane.closedSquare v r) (edgeArc drawing e)) ?_ ?_
    · rintro v δ ε _ hδε ⟨hP, hQ⟩
      exact ⟨fun w hw hne hmem => hP w hw hne (Plane.closedSquare_mono_center v hδε hmem),
        fun e he hinc =>
          Set.disjoint_of_subset_left (Plane.closedSquare_mono_center v hδε) (hQ e he hinc)⟩
    · exact fun v hv => h.exists_square_at hv
  refine ⟨r / 2, by linarith, fun v hv w hw hne hmem => ?_, fun v hv e he hinc => ?_,
    fun v hv w hw hne => Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hxv hxw => ?_⟩
  · exact (hall v hv).1 w hw hne (Plane.closedSquare_mono_center v (by linarith) hmem)
  · exact Set.disjoint_of_subset_left (Plane.closedSquare_mono_center v (by linarith))
      ((hall v hv).2 e he hinc)
  · 
    have hvx : Plane.supDist x v ≤ r / 2 := hxv
    have hwx : Plane.supDist x w ≤ r / 2 := hxw
    have : Plane.supDist w v ≤ r := by
      have := Plane.supDist_triangle w x v
      rw [Plane.supDist_comm w x] at this
      linarith
    exact (hall v hv).1 w hw (Ne.symm hne) this

name: Graph.not_inc_of_ne
statement:
theorem not_inc_of_ne {e : β} {v w u : Plane} (hlink : G.IsLink e v w) (huv : u ≠ v)
    (huw : u ≠ w) : ¬ G.Inc e u
proof: := fun hinc => (hinc.eq_or_eq_of_isLink hlink).elim huv huw

name: Graph.IsDrawing.closedSquare_disjoint_edgeArc_of_ne
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.closedSquare_disjoint_edgeArc_of_ne {e : β} {v w u : Plane} {r : ℝ}
    (hsq : ∀ e ∈ E(G), ¬ G.Inc e u → Disjoint (Plane.closedSquare u r) (edgeArc drawing e))
    (hlink : G.IsLink e v w) (huv : u ≠ v) (huw : u ≠ w) :
    Disjoint (Plane.closedSquare u r) (edgeArc drawing e)
proof:
:=
  hsq e hlink.edge_mem (not_inc_of_ne hlink huv huw)

name: Graph.IsDrawing.disjoint_of_subset_edgeArc
proof:
:=
  Set.disjoint_left.2 fun _ hxK hxL =>
    Set.disjoint_left.1 hKV hxK (h.arcs_meet_at_vertex he hf hef (hK hxK) (hL hxL))

name: Graph.IsDrawing.exists_core
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.exists_core (h : IsDrawing G drawing) {e : β} {v w : Plane} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hlink : G.IsLink e v w)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (Plane.closedSquare v r) (Plane.closedSquare w r)) :
    ∃ (K : Set Plane) (p q : Plane),
      K ⊆ edgeArc drawing e ∧ IsCompact K ∧ IsArcBetween K p q ∧
      K ∩ Plane.closedSquare v r = {p} ∧ K ∩ Plane.closedSquare w r = {q} ∧
      Disjoint K V(G)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hcont, hinj, himg, hf0, hf1⟩ := h.edge_isArcBetween hlink
  have hv0 : f 0 ∈ Plane.closedSquare v r := by
    rw [hf0]; exact Plane.mem_closedSquare_self v hr.le
  have hw1 : f 1 ∈ Plane.closedSquare w r := by
    rw [hf1]; exact Plane.mem_closedSquare_self w hr.le
  
  obtain ⟨a, haI, -, haD, hafter⟩ :=
    exists_last_mem hcont (Plane.isClosed_closedSquare v r) zero_mem_I hv0
  have hsub : Icc a 1 ⊆ I := fun t ht => ⟨le_trans haI.1 ht.1, ht.2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨b, hbmem, -, hbD, hbefore⟩ :=
    exists_first_mem_Icc (hcont.mono hsub) (Plane.isClosed_closedSquare w r)
      (right_mem_Icc.2 haI.2) hw1
  have hbI : b ∈ I := hsub hbmem
  have hne : a ≠ b := by
    intro hEq
    rw [hEq] at haD
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj haD hbD
  have hIccI : Icc a b ⊆ I := fun t ht => ⟨le_trans haI.1 ht.1, le_trans ht.2 hbmem.2⟩
  
  have hpv : f a ≠ v := by
    intro hEq
    have ha0 : a = 0 := hinj haI zero_mem_I (by rw [hEq, hf0])
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hclose⟩ := Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff.mp (hcont 0 zero_mem_I) r hr
    have ht0 : 0 < min (δ / 2) 1 := lt_min (by linarith) one_pos
    have htI : min (δ / 2) 1 ∈ I := ⟨ht0.le, min_le_right _ _⟩
    have hdist : dist (min (δ / 2) 1) 0 < δ := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos ht0]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
    refine hafter _ htI (by rw [ha0]; exact ht0) (Plane.closedBall_subset_closedSquare v r ?_)
    rw [mem_closedBall, ← hf0]
    exact (hclose htI hdist).le
  
  have hqw : f b ≠ w := by
    intro hEq
    have hb1 : b = 1 := hinj hbI one_mem_I (by rw [hEq, hf1])
    have halt1 : a < 1 := by rw [← hb1]; exact lt_of_le_of_ne hbmem.1 hne
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hclose⟩ := Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff.mp (hcont 1 one_mem_I) r hr
    have hmax1 : max (1 - δ / 2) ((a + 1) / 2) < 1 := max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hmaxa : a ≤ max (1 - δ / 2) ((a + 1) / 2) :=
      le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_right _ _)
    have htmem : max (1 - δ / 2) ((a + 1) / 2) ∈ Icc a 1 := ⟨hmaxa, hmax1.le⟩
    have hdist : dist (max (1 - δ / 2) ((a + 1) / 2)) 1 < δ := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith), neg_sub]
      have := le_max_left (1 - δ / 2) ((a + 1) / 2)
      linarith
    refine hbefore _ htmem (by rw [hb1]; exact hmax1)
      (Plane.closedBall_subset_closedSquare w r ?_)
    rw [mem_closedBall, ← hf1]
    exact (hclose (hsub htmem) hdist).le
  
  have harc : IsArcBetween (f '' Icc a b) (f a) (f b) := by
    have hsubarc := isArcBetween_subarc_of_injOn_I hcont hinj haI hbI hne
    rwa [uIcc_of_le hbmem.1] at hsubarc
  have hKsub : f '' Icc a b ⊆ edgeArc drawing e := by
    rw [← himg]; exact image_mono hIccI
  have hKv : f '' Icc a b ∩ Plane.closedSquare v r = {f a} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, hxD⟩
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht.1 with heq | hlt
      · simp [heq]
      · exact absurd hxD (hafter t (hIccI ht) hlt)
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨⟨a, ⟨le_refl a, hbmem.1⟩, rfl⟩, haD⟩
  have hKw : f '' Icc a b ∩ Plane.closedSquare w r = {f b} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, hxD⟩
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht.2 with heq | hlt
      · simp [heq]
      · exact absurd hxD (hbefore t ⟨ht.1, le_trans ht.2 hbmem.2⟩ hlt)
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨⟨b, ⟨hbmem.1, le_refl b⟩, rfl⟩, hbD⟩
  refine ⟨f '' Icc a b, f a, f b, hKsub, harc.isArc.isCompact, harc, hKv, hKw,
    Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hxK hxV => ?_⟩
  
  
  rcases h.vertex_mem_edgeArc hlink hxV (hKsub hxK) with heq | heq
  · have hmem : x ∈ f '' Icc a b ∩ Plane.closedSquare v r :=
      ⟨hxK, by rw [heq]; exact Plane.mem_closedSquare_self v hr.le⟩
    rw [hKv, mem_singleton_iff] at hmem
    exact hpv (hmem ▸ heq)
  · have hmem : x ∈ f '' Icc a b ∩ Plane.closedSquare w r :=
      ⟨hxK, by rw [heq]; exact Plane.mem_closedSquare_self w hr.le⟩
    rw [hKw, mem_singleton_iff] at hmem
    exact hqw (hmem ▸ heq)

name: Graph.mem_coveredVertices_iff
statement: theorem mem_coveredVertices_iff : x ∈ G.coveredVertices W ↔ ∃ e ∈ W, G.Inc e x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Graph.mem_walkVertices_iff
statement: theorem mem_walkVertices_iff : x ∈ G.walkVertices u W ↔ x = u ∨ x ∈ G.coveredVertices W
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_insert_iff

name: Graph.coveredVertices_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coveredVertices_nil : G.coveredVertices ([] : List β) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp [coveredVertices]

name: Graph.walkVertices_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem walkVertices_nil : G.walkVertices u ([] : List β) = {u}
proof:
:= by
  simp [walkVertices]

name: Graph.mem_coveredVertices
statement: theorem mem_coveredVertices (he : e ∈ W) (hx : G.Inc e x) : x ∈ G.coveredVertices W
proof:
:=
  ⟨e, he, hx⟩

name: Graph.mem_walkVertices_self
statement: theorem mem_walkVertices_self : u ∈ G.walkVertices u W
proof: := Set.mem_insert _ _

name: Graph.mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered
statement:
theorem mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered (hx : x ∈ G.coveredVertices W) :
    x ∈ G.walkVertices u W
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hx

name: Graph.coveredVertices_mono
statement: theorem coveredVertices_mono (h : W₁ ⊆ W₂) : G.coveredVertices W₁ ⊆ G.coveredVertices W₂
proof:
:=
  fun _ ⟨e, he, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨e, h he, hx⟩

name: Graph.walkVertices_mono
statement: theorem walkVertices_mono (h : W₁ ⊆ W₂) : G.walkVertices u W₁ ⊆ G.walkVertices u W₂
proof:
:=
  Set.insert_subset_insert (coveredVertices_mono h)

name: Graph.coveredVertices_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coveredVertices_reverse : G.coveredVertices W.reverse = G.coveredVertices W
proof:
:= by
  simp [coveredVertices]

name: Graph.walkVertices_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem walkVertices_reverse : G.walkVertices u W.reverse = G.walkVertices u W
proof:
:= by
  simp [walkVertices]

name: Graph.coveredVertices_append
statement:
theorem coveredVertices_append :
    G.coveredVertices (W₁ ++ W₂) = G.coveredVertices W₁ ∪ G.coveredVertices W₂
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_coveredVertices_iff, List.mem_append, Set.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he | he, hx⟩
    exacts [Or.inl ⟨e, he, hx⟩, Or.inr ⟨e, he, hx⟩]
  · rintro (⟨e, he, hx⟩ | ⟨e, he, hx⟩)
    exacts [⟨e, Or.inl he, hx⟩, ⟨e, Or.inr he, hx⟩]

name: Graph.coveredVertices_subset_vertexSet
statement: theorem coveredVertices_subset_vertexSet : G.coveredVertices W ⊆ V(G)
proof:
:=
  fun _ ⟨_, _, hx⟩ ↦ hx.vertex_mem

name: Graph.walkVertices_subset_vertexSet
statement: theorem walkVertices_subset_vertexSet (hu : u ∈ V(G)) : G.walkVertices u W ⊆ V(G)
proof:
:=
  Set.insert_subset hu coveredVertices_subset_vertexSet

name: Graph.mem_walkVertices_cons
statement:
theorem mem_walkVertices_cons (hl : G.IsLink e u w) (hx : x ∈ G.walkVertices u (e :: W)) :
    x = u ∨ x ∈ G.walkVertices w W
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hx with rfl | ⟨f, hf, hxf⟩
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  rcases List.mem_cons.1 hf with rfl | hf
  · rcases hxf.eq_or_eq_of_isLink hl with rfl | rfl
    exacts [Or.inl rfl, Or.inr mem_walkVertices_self]
  · exact Or.inr (mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered ⟨f, hf, hxf⟩)

name: Graph.mem_walkVertices_cons_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_walkVertices_cons_of_mem (hl : G.IsLink e u w) (hx : x ∈ G.walkVertices w W) :
    x ∈ G.walkVertices u (e :: W)
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hx with rfl | hx
  · exact mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self, hl.inc_right⟩
  · exact mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered (coveredVertices_mono (List.subset_cons_self _ _) hx)

name: Graph.IsWalk.single
statement: theorem IsWalk.single (hl : G.IsLink e u v) : G.IsWalk u [e] v
proof:
:=
  .cons hl (.nil hl.right_mem)

name: Graph.IsWalk.left_mem
statement: theorem IsWalk.left_mem (h : G.IsWalk u W v) : u ∈ V(G)
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | nil hx => exact hx
  | cons hl _ => exact hl.left_mem

name: Graph.IsWalk.right_mem
statement: theorem IsWalk.right_mem (h : G.IsWalk u W v) : v ∈ V(G)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx => exact hx
  | cons _ _ ih => exact ih

name: Graph.IsWalk.edge_mem
statement: theorem IsWalk.edge_mem (h : G.IsWalk u W v) (he : e ∈ W) : e ∈ E(G)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => simp at he
  | cons hl _ ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
    exacts [hl.edge_mem, ih he]

name: Graph.IsWalk.edgeSet_subset
statement: theorem IsWalk.edgeSet_subset (h : G.IsWalk u W v) : ∀ e ∈ W, e ∈ E(G)
proof: := fun _ he ↦ h.edge_mem he

name: Graph.IsWalk.target_mem_walkVertices
statement: theorem IsWalk.target_mem_walkVertices (h : G.IsWalk u W v) : v ∈ G.walkVertices u W
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact mem_walkVertices_self
  | cons hl _ ih => exact mem_walkVertices_cons_of_mem hl ih

name: Graph.IsWalk.walkVertices_subset
statement: theorem IsWalk.walkVertices_subset (h : G.IsWalk u W v) : G.walkVertices u W ⊆ V(G)
proof:
:=
  walkVertices_subset_vertexSet h.left_mem

name: Graph.isWalk_nil_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isWalk_nil_iff : G.IsWalk u [] v ↔ u = v ∧ u ∈ V(G)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx⟩; exact ⟨rfl, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, hx⟩; exact .nil hx

name: Graph.IsWalk.eq_of_nil
statement: theorem IsWalk.eq_of_nil (h : G.IsWalk u [] v) : u = v
proof: := (isWalk_nil_iff.1 h).1

name: Graph.IsWalk.target_unique
statement: theorem IsWalk.target_unique (h : G.IsWalk u W v) (h' : G.IsWalk u W w) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  induction h generalizing w with
  | nil hx => exact h'.eq_of_nil.symm ▸ rfl
  | @cons u w' v e W hl _ ih =>
    cases h' with
    | cons hl' hW' => exact ih (hl.right_unique hl' ▸ hW')

name: Graph.IsWalk.append
statement:
theorem IsWalk.append (h₁ : G.IsWalk u W₁ w) (h₂ : G.IsWalk w W₂ v) :
    G.IsWalk u (W₁ ++ W₂) v
proof:
:= by
  induction h₁ with
  | nil => simpa using h₂
  | cons hl _ ih => exact .cons hl (ih h₂)

name: Graph.IsWalk.reverse
statement: theorem IsWalk.reverse (h : G.IsWalk u W v) : G.IsWalk v W.reverse u
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx => simpa using IsWalk.nil hx
  | @cons u w v e W hl _ ih =>
    rw [List.reverse_cons]
    exact ih.append (IsWalk.single hl.symm)

name: Graph.IsWalk.mono
statement: theorem IsWalk.mono (hHG : H ≤ G) (h : H.IsWalk u W v) : G.IsWalk u W v
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx => exact .nil (hHG.vertexSet_mono hx)
  | cons hl _ ih => exact .cons (hl.mono hHG) ih

name: Graph.IsWalk.anti
statement:
theorem IsWalk.anti (hHG : H ≤ G) (h : G.IsWalk u W v) (hu : u ∈ V(H))
    (hE : ∀ e ∈ W, e ∈ E(H)) : H.IsWalk u W v
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil hu
  | @cons u w v e W hl _ ih =>
    have he : e ∈ E(H) := hE e List.mem_cons_self
    have hl' : H.IsLink e u w := (hHG.isLink_iff he).2 hl
    exact .cons hl' (ih hl'.right_mem fun f hf ↦ hE f (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hf))

name: Graph.IsWalk.crossing
statement:
theorem IsWalk.crossing {S : Set α} (h : G.IsWalk u W v) (hu : u ∈ S) (hv : v ∉ S) :
    ∃ e ∈ W, ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧ x ∈ S ∧ y ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact absurd hu hv
  | @cons u w v e W hl _ ih =>
    by_cases hw : w ∈ S
    · obtain ⟨f, hf, x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩ := ih hw hv
      exact ⟨f, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hf, x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩
    · exact ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self, u, w, hl, hu, hw⟩

name: Graph.IsPath.isWalk
statement: theorem IsPath.isWalk (h : G.IsPath u W v) : G.IsWalk u W v
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx => exact .nil hx
  | cons hl _ _ ih => exact .cons hl ih

name: Graph.IsPath.left_mem
statement: theorem IsPath.left_mem (h : G.IsPath u W v) : u ∈ V(G)
proof: := h.isWalk.left_mem

name: Graph.IsPath.right_mem
statement: theorem IsPath.right_mem (h : G.IsPath u W v) : v ∈ V(G)
proof: := h.isWalk.right_mem

name: Graph.IsPath.edge_mem
statement: theorem IsPath.edge_mem (h : G.IsPath u W v) (he : e ∈ W) : e ∈ E(G)
proof: := h.isWalk.edge_mem he

name: Graph.IsPath.single
statement: theorem IsPath.single (hl : G.IsLink e u v) (huv : u ≠ v) : G.IsPath u [e] v
proof:
:=
  .cons hl (.nil hl.right_mem) (by simpa using huv)

name: Graph.IsPath.cons_ne
statement: theorem IsPath.cons_ne (hW : G.IsPath w W v) (hfresh : u ∉ G.walkVertices w W) : u ≠ w
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  exact hfresh mem_walkVertices_self

name: Graph.IsPath.not_isLoopAt
statement: theorem IsPath.not_isLoopAt (h : G.IsPath u W v) (he : e ∈ W) (x : α) : ¬ G.IsLoopAt e x
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => simp at he
  | @cons u w v f W hl hW hfresh ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
    · intro hloop
      
      rcases hl.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hloop with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
        exact IsPath.cons_ne hW hfresh rfl
    · exact ih he

name: Graph.IsPath.nodup
statement: theorem IsPath.nodup (h : G.IsPath u W v) : W.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact List.nodup_nil
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW hfresh ih =>
    refine List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨fun he ↦ hfresh ?_, ih⟩
    exact mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered ⟨e, he, hl.inc_left⟩

name: Graph.IsPath.mono
statement: theorem IsPath.mono (hHG : H ≤ G) (h : H.IsPath u W v) : G.IsPath u W v
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx => exact .nil (hHG.vertexSet_mono hx)
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW hfresh ih =>
    refine .cons (hl.mono hHG) ih fun hmem ↦ hfresh ?_
    
    rcases mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hmem with rfl | ⟨f, hf, hinc⟩
    · exact mem_walkVertices_self
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hinc
      exact mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered
        ⟨f, hf, ((hHG.isLink_iff (hW.isWalk.edge_mem hf)).2 hy).inc_left⟩

name: Graph.IsPath.target_mem_walkVertices
statement: theorem IsPath.target_mem_walkVertices (h : G.IsPath u W v) : v ∈ G.walkVertices u W
proof:
:=
  h.isWalk.target_mem_walkVertices

name: Graph.IsPath.extend_at_target
statement:
theorem IsPath.extend_at_target (h : G.IsPath u P w) (hl : G.IsLink e w v)
    (hv : v ∉ G.walkVertices u P) : G.IsPath u (P ++ [e]) v
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx =>
    rw [walkVertices_nil] at hv
    exact List.nil_append _ ▸ IsPath.single hl (Ne.symm hv)
  | @cons u w₀ w f P₀ hl₀ hP₀ hfresh ih =>
    have hv₀ : v ∉ G.walkVertices w₀ P₀ := fun hmem ↦ hv (mem_walkVertices_cons_of_mem hl₀ hmem)
    refine List.cons_append .. ▸ .cons hl₀ (ih hl hv₀) fun hmem ↦ ?_
    
    
    rcases mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hmem with rfl | hcov
    · exact hfresh mem_walkVertices_self
    rw [coveredVertices_append] at hcov
    rcases hcov with hcov | ⟨f', hf', hinc⟩
    · exact hfresh (mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered hcov)
    · obtain rfl : f' = e := by simpa using hf'
      rcases hinc.eq_or_eq_of_isLink hl with rfl | rfl
      · exact hfresh hP₀.target_mem_walkVertices
      · exact hv mem_walkVertices_self

name: Graph.IsPath.reverse
statement: theorem IsPath.reverse (h : G.IsPath u W v) : G.IsPath v W.reverse u
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx => simpa using IsPath.nil hx
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW hfresh ih =>
    rw [List.reverse_cons]
    refine ih.extend_at_target hl.symm fun hmem ↦ hfresh ?_
    
    rw [walkVertices_reverse] at hmem
    rcases mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hmem with rfl | hcov
    · exact hW.target_mem_walkVertices
    · exact mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered hcov

name: Graph.IsPath.from_visited
statement:
theorem IsPath.from_visited (h : G.IsPath u W v) (hx : x ∈ G.walkVertices u W) :
    ∃ T, G.IsPath x T v ∧ T ⊆ W
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx' =>
    rw [walkVertices_nil] at hx
    obtain rfl := hx
    exact ⟨[], .nil hx', List.nil_subset _⟩
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW hfresh ih =>
    rcases mem_walkVertices_cons hl hx with rfl | hx'
    · exact ⟨e :: W, .cons hl hW hfresh, List.Subset.refl _⟩
    · obtain ⟨T, hT, hTW⟩ := ih hx'
      exact ⟨T, hT, List.Subset.trans hTW (List.subset_cons_self _ _)⟩

name: Graph.IsPath.split
statement:
theorem IsPath.split (h : G.IsPath u W v) (hx : x ∈ G.walkVertices u W) :
    ∃ W₁ W₂, W = W₁ ++ W₂ ∧ G.IsPath u W₁ x ∧ G.IsPath x W₂ v ∧
      (x = u ∨ u ∉ G.walkVertices x W₂)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx' =>
    rw [walkVertices_nil] at hx
    obtain rfl := hx
    exact ⟨[], [], rfl, .nil hx', .nil hx', Or.inl rfl⟩
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW hfresh ih =>
    rcases mem_walkVertices_cons hl hx with rfl | hx'
    · exact ⟨[], e :: W, rfl, .nil hl.left_mem, .cons hl hW hfresh, Or.inl rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨W₁, W₂, rfl, h₁, h₂, -⟩ := ih hx'
    have hsub₁ : W₁ ⊆ W₁ ++ W₂ := List.subset_append_left _ _
    have hsub₂ : W₂ ⊆ W₁ ++ W₂ := List.subset_append_right _ _
    refine ⟨e :: W₁, W₂, rfl, .cons hl h₁ fun hmem ↦ hfresh (walkVertices_mono hsub₁ hmem),
      h₂, Or.inr fun hmem ↦ hfresh ?_⟩
    
    rcases mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hmem with rfl | hcov
    · exact hx'
    · exact mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered (coveredVertices_mono hsub₂ hcov)

name: Graph.IsWalk.contains_path
statement: theorem IsWalk.contains_path (h : G.IsWalk u W v) : ∃ P, G.IsPath u P v ∧ P ⊆ W
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx => exact ⟨[], .nil hx, List.Subset.refl _⟩
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW ih =>
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPW⟩ := ih
    by_cases hu : u ∈ G.walkVertices w P
    · 
      obtain ⟨T, hT, hTP⟩ := hP.from_visited hu
      exact ⟨T, hT, List.Subset.trans (List.Subset.trans hTP hPW) (List.subset_cons_self _ _)⟩
    · exact ⟨e :: P, .cons hl hP hu, List.cons_subset_cons _ hPW⟩

name: Graph.Reaches.left_mem
statement: theorem Reaches.left_mem (h : G.Reaches u v) : u ∈ V(G)
proof: := h.choose_spec.left_mem

name: Graph.Reaches.right_mem
statement: theorem Reaches.right_mem (h : G.Reaches u v) : v ∈ V(G)
proof: := h.choose_spec.right_mem

name: Graph.Reaches.refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem Reaches.refl (hu : u ∈ V(G)) : G.Reaches u u

name: Graph.Reaches.symm
statement: theorem Reaches.symm (h : G.Reaches u v) : G.Reaches v u
proof:
:=
  let ⟨W, hW⟩ := h; ⟨W.reverse, hW.reverse⟩

name: Graph.Reaches.trans
statement: theorem Reaches.trans (h₁ : G.Reaches u v) (h₂ : G.Reaches v w) : G.Reaches u w
proof:
:=
  let ⟨W₁, hW₁⟩ := h₁; let ⟨W₂, hW₂⟩ := h₂; ⟨W₁ ++ W₂, hW₁.append hW₂⟩

name: Graph.reaches_comm
statement: theorem reaches_comm : G.Reaches u v ↔ G.Reaches v u
proof: := ⟨Reaches.symm, Reaches.symm⟩

name: Graph.Reaches.of_isLink
statement: theorem Reaches.of_isLink (hl : G.IsLink e u v) : G.Reaches u v
proof: := ⟨[e], .single hl⟩

name: Graph.Reaches.of_adj
statement: theorem Reaches.of_adj (h : G.Adj u v) : G.Reaches u v
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hl⟩ := h; .of_isLink hl

name: Graph.Reaches.exists_isPath
statement: theorem Reaches.exists_isPath (h : G.Reaches u v) : ∃ P, G.IsPath u P v
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hW⟩ := h; let ⟨P, hP, _⟩ := hW.contains_path; ⟨P, hP⟩

name: Graph.Reaches.mono
statement: theorem Reaches.mono (hHG : H ≤ G) (h : H.Reaches u v) : G.Reaches u v
proof:
:=
  let ⟨W, hW⟩ := h; ⟨W, hW.mono hHG⟩

name: Graph.Connected.nonempty
statement: theorem Connected.nonempty (h : G.Connected) : V(G).Nonempty

name: Graph.Connected.reaches
statement: theorem Connected.reaches (h : G.Connected) (hu : u ∈ V(G)) (hv : v ∈ V(G)) : G.Reaches u v
proof:
:=
  h.2 hu hv

name: Graph.Connected.of_hub
statement: theorem Connected.of_hub (hu : u ∈ V(G)) (h : ∀ v ∈ V(G), G.Reaches u v) : G.Connected
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, fun _ hx _ hy ↦ ((h _ hx).symm).trans (h _ hy)⟩

name: Graph.Connected.exists_isPath
statement:
theorem Connected.exists_isPath (h : G.Connected) (hu : u ∈ V(G)) (hv : v ∈ V(G)) :
    ∃ P, G.IsPath u P v
proof:
:=
  (h.reaches hu hv).exists_isPath

name: Graph.coveredVertices_mono_of_le
statement: theorem coveredVertices_mono_of_le (hHG : H ≤ G) : H.coveredVertices W ⊆ G.coveredVertices W
proof:
:=
  fun _ ⟨f, hf, y, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨f, hf, y, hy.mono hHG⟩

name: Graph.walkVertices_mono_of_le
statement: theorem walkVertices_mono_of_le (hHG : H ≤ G) : H.walkVertices u W ⊆ G.walkVertices u W
proof:
:=
  Set.insert_subset_insert (coveredVertices_mono_of_le hHG)

name: Graph.IsPath.anti
statement:
theorem IsPath.anti (hHG : H ≤ G) (h : G.IsPath u W v) (hu : u ∈ V(H))
    (hE : ∀ e ∈ W, e ∈ E(H)) : H.IsPath u W v
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil hu
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW hfresh ih =>
    have he : e ∈ E(H) := hE e List.mem_cons_self
    have hl' : H.IsLink e u w := (hHG.isLink_iff he).2 hl
    exact .cons hl' (ih hl'.right_mem fun f hf ↦ hE f (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hf))
      fun hmem ↦ hfresh (walkVertices_mono_of_le hHG hmem)

name: Graph.mem_edgeSet_deleteEdges_iff
statement:
theorem mem_edgeSet_deleteEdges_iff {F : Set β} {f : β} :
    f ∈ E(G.deleteEdges F) ↔ f ∈ E(G) ∧ f ∉ F
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Graph.IsWalk.deleteEdges
statement:
theorem IsWalk.deleteEdges {F : Set β} (h : G.IsWalk u W v) (hW : ∀ f ∈ W, f ∉ F) :
    (G.deleteEdges F).IsWalk u W v
proof:
:=
  h.anti deleteEdges_le (by simpa using h.left_mem)
    fun f hf ↦ mem_edgeSet_deleteEdges_iff.2 ⟨h.edge_mem hf, hW f hf⟩

name: Graph.SameLinks.refl
statement: @[refl] theorem refl (G : Graph α β) : SameLinks G G
proof: := ⟨rfl, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl⟩

name: Graph.SameLinks.symm
statement: theorem symm (h : SameLinks G H) : SameLinks H G
proof: := ⟨h.1.symm, fun x y => (h.2 x y).symm⟩

name: Graph.SameLinks.vertexSet
statement: theorem vertexSet (h : SameLinks G H) : V(G) = V(H)

name: Graph.SameLinks.deleteVerts
statement:
theorem deleteVerts (h : SameLinks G H) (X : Set α) :
    SameLinks (G.deleteVerts X) (H.deleteVerts X)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [vertexSet_deleteVerts, vertexSet_deleteVerts, h.1], fun x y => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    rw [deleteVerts_isLink _ _] at he
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (h.2 x y).1 ⟨e, he.1⟩
    exact ⟨f, (deleteVerts_isLink _ _).2 ⟨hf, he.2.1, he.2.2⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    rw [deleteVerts_isLink _ _] at he
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (h.2 x y).2 ⟨e, he.1⟩
    exact ⟨f, (deleteVerts_isLink _ _).2 ⟨hf, he.2.1, he.2.2⟩⟩

name: Graph.Reaches.sameLinks
statement: theorem Reaches.sameLinks (h : SameLinks G H) (hr : G.Reaches u v) : H.Reaches u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := hr
  induction hW with
  | nil hz => exact Reaches.refl (h.1 ▸ hz)
  | @cons p w q g R hl _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (h.2 p w).1 ⟨g, hl⟩
    exact (Reaches.of_isLink hf).trans ih

name: Graph.Connected.sameLinks
statement: theorem Connected.sameLinks (h : SameLinks G H) (hG : G.Connected) : H.Connected
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hG.nonempty
  exact Connected.of_hub (h.1 ▸ hz) fun w hw =>
    (hG.reaches hz (h.1 ▸ hw : w ∈ V(G))).sameLinks h

name: Graph.HasThreeVertices.sameLinks
statement:
theorem HasThreeVertices.sameLinks (h : SameLinks G H) (hG : G.HasThreeVertices) :
    H.HasThreeVertices
proof: := hG.mono (le_of_eq h.1)

name: Graph.IsTwoConnected.sameLinks
statement:
theorem IsTwoConnected.sameLinks (h : SameLinks G H) (hG : G.IsTwoConnected) :
    H.IsTwoConnected where
  hasThreeVertices
proof:
:= hG.hasThreeVertices.sameLinks h
  connected := hG.connected.sameLinks h
  deleteVerts_connected := fun z _ =>
    (hG.deleteVerts_connected' z).sameLinks (h.deleteVerts {z})

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_eq_pieceListGraph
statement:
theorem overlayGraph_eq_pieceListGraph (pieces : List Piece) (points : List Plane) :
    overlayGraph pieces points = pieceListGraph (overlayPieces pieces points)
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.orientPiece_link_iff
statement:
theorem orientPiece_link_iff (P : Piece) (x y : Plane) :
    ((x = (orientPiece P).1 ∧ y = (orientPiece P).2) ∨
        (x = (orientPiece P).2 ∧ y = (orientPiece P).1)) ↔
      ((x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2) ∨ (x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Precedes P.1 P.2
  · rw [orientPiece_of_precedes h]
  · rw [orientPiece_of_not_precedes h]; exact or_comm

name: Schoenflies.sameLinks_overlayGraph
statement:
theorem sameLinks_overlayGraph (pieces : List Piece) (points : List Plane) :
    Graph.SameLinks (pieceListGraph (subdivide pieces points)) (overlayGraph pieces points)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · ext v
    simp only [pieceListGraph_vertexSet, overlayGraph_vertexSet, endSet, mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨P, hP, hv⟩
      exact ⟨orientPiece P, mem_overlayPieces.2 ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩, (orientPiece_ends P v).2 hv⟩
    · rintro ⟨P, hP, hv⟩
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ := mem_overlayPieces.1 hP
      exact ⟨Q, hQ, (orientPiece_ends Q v).1 hv⟩
  · intro x y
    simp only [pieceListGraph_isLink, overlayGraph_isLink]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨P, hP, hxy⟩
      exact ⟨orientPiece P, mem_overlayPieces.2 ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩,
        (orientPiece_link_iff P x y).2 hxy⟩
    · rintro ⟨P, hP, hxy⟩
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ := mem_overlayPieces.1 hP
      exact ⟨Q, hQ, (orientPiece_link_iff Q x y).1 hxy⟩

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_isTwoConnected
proof:
:=
  h.sameLinks (sameLinks_overlayGraph pieces points)

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_isTwoConnected_of_cleanCut
statement:
theorem overlayGraph_isTwoConnected_of_cleanCut {pieces : List Piece} {points : List Plane}
    (hnd : ∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) (hclean : ∀ q ∈ points, CleanCut pieces q)
    (h : (pieceListGraph pieces).IsTwoConnected) :
    (overlayGraph pieces points).IsTwoConnected
proof:
:=
  overlayGraph_isTwoConnected (pieceListGraph_subdivide_isTwoConnected points pieces hnd hclean h)

name: Schoenflies.splitAllAt_append
statement:
theorem splitAllAt_append (q : Plane) (l l' : List Piece) :
    splitAllAt q (l ++ l') = splitAllAt q l ++ splitAllAt q l'
proof:
:= by
  simp [splitAllAt, List.flatMap_append]

name: Schoenflies.subdivide_append
statement:
theorem subdivide_append (points : List Plane) : ∀ l l' : List Piece,
    subdivide (l ++ l') points = subdivide l points ++ subdivide l' points
proof:
:= by
  induction points with
  | nil => intro l l'; rfl
  | cons q qs ih => intro l l'; rw [subdivide_cons, splitAllAt_append, ih, subdivide_cons,
      subdivide_cons]

name: Schoenflies.endSet_subset_append_left
statement: theorem endSet_subset_append_left {l l' : List Piece} : endSet l ⊆ endSet (l ++ l')
proof:
:= by
  rintro v ⟨P, hP, hv⟩
  exact ⟨P, List.mem_append_left _ hP, hv⟩

name: Schoenflies.mem_endSet_subdivide_of_mem_cover
proof:
:= by
  rw [← subdivide_cover pieces points] at hx
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hxP⟩ := mem_cover_iff.1 hx
  refine ⟨P, hP, ?_⟩
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  exact subdivide_avoids points hnd x hxp P hP
    (mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right (Ne.symm hcon.1) (Ne.symm hcon.2) hxP)

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_append_isTwoConnected
statement:
theorem overlayGraph_append_isTwoConnected {l l' : List Piece} {points : List Plane}
    (hnd : ∀ P ∈ l, P.Nondeg) (hnd' : ∀ P ∈ l', P.Nondeg)
    (hl : (pieceListGraph (subdivide l points)).IsTwoConnected)
    (hl' : (pieceListGraph (subdivide l' points)).IsTwoConnected)
    {a b : Plane} (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : a ∈ points) (hb : b ∈ points)
    (hal : a ∈ cover l) (hbl : b ∈ cover l) (hal' : a ∈ cover l') (hbl' : b ∈ cover l') :
    (overlayGraph (l ++ l') points).IsTwoConnected
proof:
:= by
  refine overlayGraph_isTwoConnected ?_
  rw [subdivide_append, ← pieceListGraph_union]
  exact hl.union (pieceListGraph_compatible _ _) hl' hab
    (mem_endSet_subdivide_of_mem_cover hnd ha hal)
    (mem_endSet_subdivide_of_mem_cover hnd' ha hal')
    (mem_endSet_subdivide_of_mem_cover hnd hb hbl)
    (mem_endSet_subdivide_of_mem_cover hnd' hb hbl')

name: Schoenflies.exists_crosscut
statement:
theorem exists_crosscut (hab : a ≠ b) (hFopen : IsOpen F) (hFbdd : Bornology.IsBounded F)
    (hy : y ∈ Plane.line a b ∩ F) :
    ∃ q₀ q₁ : Plane, q₀ ≠ q₁ ∧ q₀ ∈ frontier F ∧ q₁ ∈ frontier F ∧
      openSegment ℝ q₀ q₁ ⊆ F ∧ y ∈ openSegment ℝ q₀ q₁ ∧
      ∀ S : Set Plane, IsPreconnected S → S ⊆ Plane.line a b ∩ F → y ∈ S →
        S ⊆ openSegment ℝ q₀ q₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q₀, q₁, hne, -, -, hcomp, -, h0, h1⟩ :=
    Plane.exists_openSegment_eq_connectedComponentIn hab hFopen hFbdd hy
  refine ⟨q₀, q₁, hne, h0, h1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hcomp]
    exact fun z hz => (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ hz).2
  · rw [← hcomp]
    exact mem_connectedComponentIn hy
  · intro S hS hSsub hyS
    rw [← hcomp]
    exact hS.subset_connectedComponentIn hyS hSsub

name: Schoenflies.frontier_face_subset_pointSet
statement:
theorem frontier_face_subset_pointSet {β : Type*} {G : Graph Plane β} [G.Finite]
    {drawing : β → ℝ → Plane} (h : Graph.IsDrawing G drawing) (base : Plane) :
    frontier (Graph.face G drawing base) ⊆ Graph.pointSet G drawing
proof:
:=
  Plane.frontier_connectedComponentIn_compl_subset h.isClosed_pointSet base

name: Schoenflies.isPathGraph_single
statement:
theorem isPathGraph_single {q₀ q₁ : Plane} (hne : q₀ ≠ q₁) :
    (pieceListGraph [(q₀, q₁)]).IsPathGraph q₀ [(q₀, q₁)] q₁ where
  isPath
proof:
:= .single (pieceListGraph_isLink_self (by simp)) hne
  edgeSet_eq := rfl
  vertexSet_eq := by
    have hmem : ((q₀, q₁) : Piece) ∈ [((q₀, q₁) : Piece)] := List.mem_singleton_self _
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨P, hP, hx⟩
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hP
      subst hP
      simp only [Graph.walkVertices, mem_insert_iff, Graph.coveredVertices, mem_setOf_eq]
      rcases hx with h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr ⟨(q₀, q₁), hmem, pieceListGraph_inc hmem (Or.inr h)⟩
    · intro hx
      simp only [Graph.walkVertices, mem_insert_iff, Graph.coveredVertices, mem_setOf_eq] at hx
      rcases hx with h | ⟨e, he, hinc⟩
      · exact ⟨(q₀, q₁), hmem, Or.inl h⟩
      · rw [List.mem_singleton] at he
        subst he
        obtain ⟨-, hx'⟩ := pieceListGraph_inc_iff.1 hinc
        exact ⟨(q₀, q₁), hmem, hx'⟩

name: Schoenflies.pieceListGraph_append_crosscut
statement:
theorem pieceListGraph_append_crosscut {l : List Piece} {q₀ q₁ : Plane}
    (hl : (pieceListGraph l).IsTwoConnected) (hne : q₀ ≠ q₁)
    (h0 : q₀ ∈ endSet l) (h1 : q₁ ∈ endSet l) :
    (pieceListGraph (l ++ [(q₀, q₁)])).IsTwoConnected
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pieceListGraph_union]
  exact hl.ear (pieceListGraph_compatible _ _) (isPathGraph_single hne) hne h0 h1

name: Schoenflies.isConnected_union_joins
statement:
theorem isConnected_union_joins {A : Set Plane} {r₀ : Plane} (hr₀ : r₀ ∈ A)
    {reps : List Plane} {T : Plane → Set Plane}
    (hTconn : ∀ r ∈ reps, IsPreconnected (T r))
    (hThub : ∀ r ∈ reps, r₀ ∈ T r) (hTrep : ∀ r ∈ reps, r ∈ T r)
    (hcover : ∀ z ∈ A, ∃ r ∈ reps, ∃ S : Set Plane,
      S ⊆ A ∧ IsPreconnected S ∧ z ∈ S ∧ r ∈ S) :
    IsConnected (A ∪ ⋃ r ∈ reps, T r)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : r₀ ∈ A ∪ ⋃ r ∈ reps, T r := Or.inl hr₀
  refine ⟨⟨r₀, hmem⟩, isPreconnected_of_forall r₀ ?_⟩
  rintro z (hz | hz)
  · 
    obtain ⟨r, hr, S, hSA, hSconn, hzS, hrS⟩ := hcover z hz
    refine ⟨S ∪ T r, ?_, Or.inr (hThub r hr), Or.inl hzS,
      hSconn.union' ⟨r, hrS, hTrep r hr⟩ (hTconn r hr)⟩
    exact union_subset (hSA.trans subset_union_left)
      (fun w hw => Or.inr (mem_biUnion hr hw))
  · 
    simp only [mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hz
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hzT⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨T r, fun w hw => Or.inr (mem_biUnion hr hw), hThub r hr, hzT, hTconn r hr⟩

statement:

name: Schoenflies.attachGraph_isTwoConnected
statement:
theorem attachGraph_isTwoConnected {l l' : List Piece} {extra : List Plane}
    (hnd : ∀ P ∈ l, P.Nondeg) (hnd' : ∀ P ∈ l', P.Nondeg)
    (hl : (pieceListGraph (subdivide l (attachPoints (l ++ l') extra))).IsTwoConnected)
    (hl' : (pieceListGraph (subdivide l' (attachPoints (l ++ l') extra))).IsTwoConnected)
    {a b : Plane} (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : a ∈ extra) (hb : b ∈ extra)
    (hal : a ∈ cover l) (hbl : b ∈ cover l) (hal' : a ∈ cover l') (hbl' : b ∈ cover l') :
    (attachGraph (l ++ l') extra).IsTwoConnected
proof:
:=
  overlayGraph_append_isTwoConnected hnd hnd' hl hl' hab
    (mem_attachPoints_of_mem ha) (mem_attachPoints_of_mem hb) hal hbl hal' hbl'

name: Schoenflies.isConnected_cover_diff_of_joins
statement:
theorem isConnected_cover_diff_of_joins {l : List Piece} {C : Set Plane} {r₀ : Plane}
    {reps : List Plane} {J : Plane → List Piece} (hr₀ : r₀ ∈ cover l \ C)
    (hJconn : ∀ r ∈ reps, IsPreconnected (cover (J r)))
    (hJhub : ∀ r ∈ reps, r₀ ∈ cover (J r)) (hJrep : ∀ r ∈ reps, r ∈ cover (J r))
    (hJC : ∀ r ∈ reps, ∀ z ∈ cover (J r), z ∉ C)
    (hcov : ∀ z ∈ cover l \ C, ∃ r ∈ reps, ∃ S : Set Plane,
      S ⊆ cover l \ C ∧ IsPreconnected S ∧ z ∈ S ∧ r ∈ S) :
    IsConnected (cover (l ++ reps.flatMap J) \ C)
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : cover (l ++ reps.flatMap J) \ C = (cover l \ C) ∪ ⋃ r ∈ reps, cover (J r) := by
    rw [cover_append, cover_flatMap']
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, mem_union, mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hz | ⟨r, hr, hz⟩, hzC⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hz, hzC⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨r, hr, hz⟩
    · rintro (⟨hz, hzC⟩ | ⟨r, hr, hz⟩)
      · exact ⟨Or.inl hz, hzC⟩
      · exact ⟨Or.inr ⟨r, hr, hz⟩, hJC r hr z hz⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact isConnected_union_joins hr₀ hJconn hJhub hJrep hcov

name: Schoenflies.localGridEdges_nondeg
statement:
theorem localGridEdges_nondeg {p : Plane} {s : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∀ P ∈ localGridEdges p s k, P.Nondeg
proof:
:= fun _ hP =>
  gridEdges_nondeg ((localGridX_strictMono hs hk).strictMonoOn _)
    ((localGridY_strictMono hs hk).strictMonoOn _) hk hk hP

name: Schoenflies.localGrid_subset_attachGraph_pointSet
statement:
theorem localGrid_subset_attachGraph_pointSet {p : Plane} {s : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (l : List Piece)
    (extra : List Plane) :
    cover (localGridEdges p s k) ⊆
      Graph.pointSet (attachGraph (l ++ localGridEdges p s k) extra) segmentDrawing
proof:
:= by
  rw [attachGraph_pointSet, cover_append]
  exact subset_union_right

name: Schoenflies.attachGraph_localGridCell_diam
statement:
theorem attachGraph_localGridCell_diam {p : Plane} {s ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i j : ℕ)
    {x y : Plane} (hx : x ∈ localGridCell p s (localGridCount s ε) i j)
    (hy : y ∈ localGridCell p s (localGridCount s ε) i j) : dist x y < ε
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_le_of_mem_localGridCell hx hy) (localGridCount_spec hε)

name: Schoenflies.seg_subset_crosscut
statement:
theorem seg_subset_crosscut {q₀ q₁ : Plane} {J : Piece}
    (hswallow : ∀ S : Set Plane, IsPreconnected S → S ⊆ Plane.line a b ∩ F → y ∈ S →
      S ⊆ openSegment ℝ q₀ q₁)
    (hJline : J.interior ⊆ Plane.line a b ∩ F) (hy : y ∈ J.interior) :
    J.seg ⊆ segment ℝ q₀ q₁
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : J.interior ⊆ openSegment ℝ q₀ q₁ :=
    hswallow _ (convex_openSegment _ _).isPreconnected hJline hy
  calc J.seg = closure J.interior := (closure_openSegment _ _).symm
    _ ⊆ closure (openSegment ℝ q₀ q₁) := closure_mono h1
    _ = segment ℝ q₀ q₁ := closure_openSegment _ _

name: Schoenflies.mem_cover_append_crosscut
statement:
theorem mem_cover_append_crosscut {l : List Piece} {q₀ q₁ z : Plane}
    (hz : z ∈ segment ℝ q₀ q₁) : z ∈ cover (l ++ [(q₀, q₁)])
proof:
:= by
  rw [cover_append]
  exact Or.inr (mem_cover_iff.2 ⟨(q₀, q₁), List.mem_singleton_self _, hz⟩)

name: Schoenflies.left_mem_cover
statement: theorem left_mem_cover {l : List Piece} {P : Piece} (hP : P ∈ l) : P.1 ∈ cover l
proof:
:=
  mem_cover_iff.2 ⟨P, hP, left_mem_segment ℝ _ _⟩

name: Schoenflies.right_mem_cover
statement: theorem right_mem_cover {l : List Piece} {P : Piece} (hP : P ∈ l) : P.2 ∈ cover l
proof:
:=
  mem_cover_iff.2 ⟨P, hP, right_mem_segment ℝ _ _⟩

name: Schoenflies.two_common_of_crosscut
statement:
theorem two_common_of_crosscut {l l' : List Piece} {q₀ q₁ : Plane} {J : Piece}
    (hJ : J ∈ l') (hJnd : J.Nondeg)
    (hswallow : ∀ S : Set Plane, IsPreconnected S → S ⊆ Plane.line a b ∩ F → y ∈ S →
      S ⊆ openSegment ℝ q₀ q₁)
    (hJline : J.interior ⊆ Plane.line a b ∩ F) (hy : y ∈ J.interior) :
    J.1 ≠ J.2 ∧ J.1 ∈ cover (l ++ [(q₀, q₁)]) ∧ J.2 ∈ cover (l ++ [(q₀, q₁)]) ∧
      J.1 ∈ cover l' ∧ J.2 ∈ cover l'
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := seg_subset_crosscut hswallow hJline hy
  exact ⟨hJnd, mem_cover_append_crosscut (hsub (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)),
    mem_cover_append_crosscut (hsub (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _)),
    left_mem_cover hJ, right_mem_cover hJ⟩

name: Schoenflies.cover_swap
statement:
theorem cover_swap (l₁ l₂ l₃ : List Piece) :
    cover ((l₁ ++ l₂) ++ l₃) = cover ((l₁ ++ l₃) ++ l₂)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cover_append]
  ac_rfl

name: Schoenflies.gridAttachPieces_nondeg
statement:
theorem gridAttachPieces_nondeg (hs : 0 < s)
    (hg : ∀ P ∈ gsegs, P.Nondeg) (hj : ∀ P ∈ reps.flatMap Jarc, P.Nondeg) :
    ∀ P ∈ gridAttachPieces gsegs reps Jarc p s ε, P.Nondeg
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hP with hP' | hP'
  · rcases List.mem_append.1 hP' with hP'' | hP''
    exacts [hg P hP'', hj P hP'']
  · exact localGridEdges_nondeg hs (one_le_localGridCount s ε) P hP'

name: Schoenflies.gridAttachGraph_isDrawing
statement:
theorem gridAttachGraph_isDrawing (hs : 0 < s)
    (hg : ∀ P ∈ gsegs, P.Nondeg) (hj : ∀ P ∈ reps.flatMap Jarc, P.Nondeg) :
    Graph.IsDrawing (gridAttachGraph gsegs reps Jarc p s ε extra) segmentDrawing
proof:
:=
  attachGraph_isDrawing (gridAttachPieces_nondeg hs hg hj) extra

name: Schoenflies.gridAttachGraph_pointSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem gridAttachGraph_pointSet :
    Graph.pointSet (gridAttachGraph gsegs reps Jarc p s ε extra) segmentDrawing =
      cover (gridAttachPieces gsegs reps Jarc p s ε)
proof: := attachGraph_pointSet _ _

name: Schoenflies.localGrid_subset_gridAttachGraph
statement:
theorem localGrid_subset_gridAttachGraph :
    cover (localGridEdges p s (localGridCount s ε)) ⊆
      Graph.pointSet (gridAttachGraph gsegs reps Jarc p s ε extra) segmentDrawing
proof:
:= by
  rw [gridAttachGraph_pointSet, gridAttachPieces, cover_append]
  exact subset_union_right

name: Schoenflies.gridAttachGraph_isTwoConnected
statement:
theorem gridAttachGraph_isTwoConnected (hs : 0 < s)
    (hg : ∀ P ∈ gsegs, P.Nondeg) (hj : ∀ P ∈ reps.flatMap Jarc, P.Nondeg)
    (hΓ : (pieceListGraph (subdivide (gsegs ++ reps.flatMap Jarc)
      (attachPoints (gridAttachPieces gsegs reps Jarc p s ε) extra))).IsTwoConnected)
    (hK : (pieceListGraph (subdivide (localGridEdges p s (localGridCount s ε))
      (attachPoints (gridAttachPieces gsegs reps Jarc p s ε) extra))).IsTwoConnected)
    {a b : Plane} (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : a ∈ extra) (hb : b ∈ extra)
    (haΓ : a ∈ cover (gsegs ++ reps.flatMap Jarc))
    (hbΓ : b ∈ cover (gsegs ++ reps.flatMap Jarc))
    (haK : a ∈ cover (localGridEdges p s (localGridCount s ε)))
    (hbK : b ∈ cover (localGridEdges p s (localGridCount s ε))) :
    (gridAttachGraph gsegs reps Jarc p s ε extra).IsTwoConnected
proof:
:= by
  refine attachGraph_isTwoConnected (fun P hP => ?_)
    (localGridEdges_nondeg hs (one_le_localGridCount s ε)) hΓ hK hab ha hb haΓ hbΓ haK hbK
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hP with hP' | hP'
  exacts [hg P hP', hj P hP']

name: Schoenflies.gridAttachGraph_isConnected_diff
statement:
theorem gridAttachGraph_isConnected_diff
    (hr₀ : r₀ ∈ cover (gsegs ++ localGridEdges p s (localGridCount s ε)) \ C)
    (hJconn : ∀ r ∈ reps, IsPreconnected (cover (Jarc r)))
    (hJhub : ∀ r ∈ reps, r₀ ∈ cover (Jarc r)) (hJrep : ∀ r ∈ reps, r ∈ cover (Jarc r))
    (hJC : ∀ r ∈ reps, ∀ z ∈ cover (Jarc r), z ∉ C)
    (hcov : ∀ z ∈ cover (gsegs ++ localGridEdges p s (localGridCount s ε)) \ C,
      ∃ r ∈ reps, ∃ S : Set Plane, S ⊆ cover (gsegs ++ localGridEdges p s (localGridCount s ε)) \ C
        ∧ IsPreconnected S ∧ z ∈ S ∧ r ∈ S) :
    IsConnected
      (Graph.pointSet (gridAttachGraph gsegs reps Jarc p s ε extra) segmentDrawing \ C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gridAttachGraph_pointSet, gridAttachPieces, cover_swap]
  exact isConnected_cover_diff_of_joins hr₀ hJconn hJhub hJrep hJC hcov

name: Schoenflies.IsArcBetween.closure_diff
statement:
theorem IsArcBetween.closure_diff {A : Set Plane} {p q : Plane} (h : IsArcBetween A p q) :
    closure (A \ {p, q}) = A
proof:
:= by
  refine Subset.antisymm (h.isArc.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.2 sdiff_subset) fun z hz => ?_
  by_cases hzp : z = p
  · exact hzp ▸ h.left_mem_closure_diff
  by_cases hzq : z = q
  · exact hzq ▸ h.right_mem_closure_diff
  exact subset_closure ⟨hz, by rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp_all⟩

statement: theorem mem_cellNames_of_vert (i : Fin 6) : (InitialCell.vert i) ∈ cellNames
proof:
:=
  Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: Schoenflies.mem_cellNames_of_edge
statement: theorem mem_cellNames_of_edge (i : Fin 6) : (InitialCell.edge i) ∈ cellNames

:=

name: Schoenflies.mem_cellNames_chord

name: Schoenflies.mem_cells_of_mem_faceCells
statement:
theorem mem_cells_of_mem_faceCells {k : Bool} {c : InitialCell} (h : c ∈ faceCells k) :
    c ∈ initialStructure.cells
proof:
:= by
  cases k <;>
    · rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      all_goals
        first
          | exact mem_cells_initialStructure_of_vert _
          | exact mem_cells_initialStructure_of_edge _
          | exact mem_cells_initialStructure_of_chord

proof:
:= by
  cases l <;> simp [faceCells]

name: Schoenflies.initSub_iff_vert
statement:
theorem initSub_iff_vert {i : Fin 6} {c : InitialCell} :
    initSub c (.vert i) ↔ c = .vert i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by subst h; exact initSub_refl (mem_cellNames_of_vert i)⟩
  rcases h with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨k, hk, -⟩
  · exact h
  · exact absurd h (by simp [InitialCell.edges])
  · exact absurd hk (by simp)

name: Schoenflies.initSub_iff_edge
statement:
theorem initSub_iff_edge {i : Fin 6} {c : InitialCell} :
    initSub c (.edge i) ↔ c = .edge i ∨ c = .vert i ∨ c = .vert (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨-, h | h⟩ | ⟨k, hk, -⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
    · exact absurd hk (by simp)
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact initSub_refl (mem_cellNames_of_edge i)
    · exact (initSub_ends (InitialCell.edge_mem_edges i)).1
    · exact (initSub_ends (InitialCell.edge_mem_edges i)).2

name: Schoenflies.initSub_iff_chord
statement:
theorem initSub_iff_chord {c : InitialCell} :
    initSub c .chord ↔ c = .chord ∨ c = .vert 1 ∨ c = .vert 4
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨-, h | h⟩ | ⟨k, hk, -⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
    · exact absurd hk (by simp)
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact initSub_refl mem_cellNames_chord
    · exact (initSub_ends InitialCell.chord_mem_edges).1
    · exact (initSub_ends InitialCell.chord_mem_edges).2

name: Schoenflies.initSub_iff_face
statement:
theorem initSub_iff_face {k : Bool} {c : InitialCell} :
    initSub c (.face k) ↔ c = .face k ∨ c ∈ faceCells k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨l, hl, hmem⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact absurd h (by simp [InitialCell.edges])
    · cases hl; exact Or.inr hmem
  · rintro (rfl | h)
    · exact initSub_refl (mem_cellNames_of_face k)
    · exact initSub_face h

name: Schoenflies.combInvariants_initialStructure
statement:
theorem combInvariants_initialStructure : initialStructure.CombInvariants where
  sub_mem_left
proof:
:= by
    rintro c d (⟨rfl, hc⟩ | ⟨hd, rfl | rfl⟩ | ⟨k, rfl, hmem⟩)
    · exact hc
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (InitialCell.ends_mem_vertices hd).1)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (InitialCell.ends_mem_vertices hd).2)
    · exact mem_cells_of_mem_faceCells hmem
  sub_mem_right := by
    rintro c d (⟨-, hd⟩ | ⟨hd, -⟩ | ⟨k, rfl, -⟩)
    · exact hd
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hd)
    · exact mem_cells_initialStructure_of_face k
  sub_refl := fun {_} hc => initSub_refl hc
  sub_isLink := by
    rintro f a b ⟨hf, ⟨rfl, -⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩⟩
    exacts [(initSub_ends hf).1, (initSub_ends hf).2]
  face_maximal := by
    rintro F τ ⟨k, rfl⟩ h
    rcases h with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨he, hends⟩ | ⟨l, rfl, hmem⟩
    · exact h.symm
    · 
      rcases he with ⟨j, rfl⟩ | rfl <;> simp [InitialCell.ends] at hends
    · exact absurd hmem face_notMem_faceCells
  nonboundary_edge := by
    rintro F ⟨k, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨.chord, InitialCell.chord_mem_edges, by simp [InitialCell.outerEdges], ?_⟩
    exact initSub_face (by cases k <;> simp [faceCells])
  mem_face := by
    rintro c hc
    
    cases c with
    | aux n => exact absurd hc (aux_notMem_cells n)
    | vert i =>
      refine ⟨.face (![true, false, false, false, true, true] i), ⟨_, rfl⟩, initSub_face ?_⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp [faceCells]
    | edge i =>
      refine ⟨.face (![true, false, false, false, true, true] i), ⟨_, rfl⟩, initSub_face ?_⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp [faceCells]
    | chord => exact ⟨.face false, ⟨_, rfl⟩, initSub_face (by simp [faceCells])⟩
    | face k => exact ⟨.face k, ⟨k, rfl⟩, initSub_refl (mem_cellNames_of_face k)⟩
  outerEdge_unique := outerEdgeUniqueFace_initialStructure

name: Schoenflies.HexData.cellSet_vert
statement: @[simp] theorem cellSet_vert (i : Fin 6) : H.cellSet (.vert i) = {H.pos i}
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.HexData.cellSet_edge
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellSet_edge (i : Fin 6) :
    H.cellSet (.edge i) = H.outer i '' I \ {H.pos i, H.pos (i + 1)}
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.HexData.cellSet_chord
statement: @[simp] theorem cellSet_chord : H.cellSet .chord = H.chordSet \ {H.pos 1, H.pos 4}
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.HexData.cellSet_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellSet_face (k : Bool) :
    H.cellSet (.face k) = inside (H.arcOf k ∪ H.chordSet)
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.HexData.cellSet_edge_subset
statement: theorem cellSet_edge_subset (i : Fin 6) : H.cellSet (.edge i) ⊆ H.outer i '' I
proof: := sdiff_subset

name: Schoenflies.HexData.cellSet_edge_subset_outerArcs
statement: theorem cellSet_edge_subset_outerArcs (i : Fin 6) : H.cellSet (.edge i) ⊆ H.outerArcs
proof:
:=
  (H.cellSet_edge_subset i).trans (Set.subset_iUnion (fun i : Fin 6 => H.outer i '' I) i)

name: Schoenflies.HexData.cellSet_chord_subset
statement: theorem cellSet_chord_subset : H.cellSet .chord ⊆ H.chordSet
proof: := sdiff_subset

name: Schoenflies.HexData.pos_mem_outerArcs
statement: theorem pos_mem_outerArcs (i : Fin 6) : H.pos i ∈ H.outerArcs
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, H.pos_mem_outer i⟩

name: Schoenflies.HexData.nonempty_cellSet_edge
statement: theorem nonempty_cellSet_edge (i : Fin 6) : (H.cellSet (.edge i)).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  (H.isArcBetween_outer i).nonempty_diff

name: Schoenflies.HexData.nonempty_cellSet_chord
statement: theorem nonempty_cellSet_chord : (H.cellSet .chord).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  H.isArcBetween_chordSet.nonempty_diff

name: Schoenflies.HexData.closure_cellSet_edge
statement:
theorem closure_cellSet_edge (i : Fin 6) :
    closure (H.cellSet (.edge i)) = H.outer i '' I
proof:
:=
  (H.isArcBetween_outer i).closure_diff

name: Schoenflies.HexData.closure_cellSet_chord
statement: theorem closure_cellSet_chord : closure (H.cellSet .chord) = H.chordSet
proof:
:=
  H.isArcBetween_chordSet.closure_diff

name: Schoenflies.HexData.pos_notMem_cellSet_edge
statement: theorem pos_notMem_cellSet_edge (k i : Fin 6) : H.pos k ∉ H.cellSet (.edge i)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hz, hne⟩
  rcases H.mem_outer_iff hz with rfl | rfl
  exacts [hne (Or.inl rfl), hne (Or.inr rfl)]

name: Schoenflies.HexData.pos_notMem_cellSet_chord
statement: theorem pos_notMem_cellSet_chord (k : Fin 6) : H.pos k ∉ H.cellSet .chord
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hz, hne⟩
  rcases H.mem_chord_iff hz with rfl | rfl
  exacts [hne (Or.inl rfl), hne (Or.inr rfl)]

name: Schoenflies.HexData.disjoint_cellSet_edge
statement:
theorem disjoint_cellSet_edge {i j : Fin 6} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (H.cellSet (.edge i)) (H.cellSet (.edge j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro z ⟨hzi, hne⟩ ⟨hzj, -⟩
  exact hne (H.outer_meet i j hij ⟨hzi, hzj⟩).1

name: Schoenflies.HexData.disjoint_cellSet_edge_chord
statement:
theorem disjoint_cellSet_edge_chord (i : Fin 6) :
    Disjoint (H.cellSet (.edge i)) (H.cellSet .chord)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro z ⟨hzi, -⟩ ⟨hzc, hne⟩
  exact hne (H.chord_meet i ⟨hzc, hzi⟩)

name: Schoenflies.HexData.mem_cellSet_edge_or
statement:
theorem mem_cellSet_edge_or {i : Fin 6} {z : Plane} (hz : z ∈ H.outer i '' I) :
    z ∈ H.cellSet (.edge i) ∨ z = H.pos i ∨ z = H.pos (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : z ∈ ({H.pos i, H.pos (i + 1)} : Set Plane)
  · rcases h with h | h
    exacts [Or.inr (Or.inl h), Or.inr (Or.inr h)]
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hz, h⟩

name: Schoenflies.HexData.mem_cellSet_chord_or
statement:
theorem mem_cellSet_chord_or {z : Plane} (hz : z ∈ H.chordSet) :
    z ∈ H.cellSet .chord ∨ z = H.pos 1 ∨ z = H.pos 4
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : z ∈ ({H.pos 1, H.pos 4} : Set Plane)
  · rcases h with h | h
    exacts [Or.inr (Or.inl h), Or.inr (Or.inr h)]
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hz, h⟩

name: Schoenflies.HexData.iUnion_cellSet
statement:
theorem iUnion_cellSet (H : HexData) :
    (⋃ c : InitialCell, H.cellSet c) =
      (H.outerArcs ∪ H.chordSet) ∪ (H.cellSet (.face false) ∪ H.cellSet (.face true))
proof:
:= by
  refine Subset.antisymm (Set.iUnion_subset fun c => ?_) fun z hz => ?_
  · cases c with
    | vert i =>
      rintro z rfl
      exact Or.inl (Or.inl (H.pos_mem_outerArcs i))
    | edge i => exact fun z hz => Or.inl (Or.inl (H.cellSet_edge_subset_outerArcs i hz))
    | chord => exact fun z hz => Or.inl (Or.inr (H.cellSet_chord_subset hz))
    | aux n => exact Set.empty_subset _
    | face k =>
      cases k
      exacts [fun z hz => Or.inr (Or.inl hz), fun z hz => Or.inr (Or.inr hz)]
  · rcases hz with (hz | hz) | (hz | hz)
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hz
      rcases H.mem_cellSet_edge_or hi with h | rfl | rfl
      exacts [Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨.edge i, h⟩, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨.vert i, rfl⟩,
        Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨.vert (i + 1), rfl⟩]
    · rcases H.mem_cellSet_chord_or hz with h | rfl | rfl
      exacts [Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨.chord, h⟩, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨.vert 1, rfl⟩,
        Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨.vert 4, rfl⟩]
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨.face false, hz⟩
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨.face true, hz⟩

name: Schoenflies.HexData.biUnion_of_three_edges
statement:
theorem biUnion_of_three_edges (H : HexData) (F : Set InitialCell) {i j l : Fin 6}
    (hij : i + 1 = j) (hjl : j + 1 = l)
    (hmem : ∀ c ∈ F, c = .vert i ∨ c = .vert j ∨ c = .vert l ∨ c = .vert (l + 1) ∨
      c = .edge i ∨ c = .edge j ∨ c = .edge l ∨ c = .chord)
    (hvi : InitialCell.vert i ∈ F) (hvj : InitialCell.vert j ∈ F)
    (hvl : InitialCell.vert l ∈ F) (hvl1 : InitialCell.vert (l + 1) ∈ F)
    (hei : InitialCell.edge i ∈ F) (hej : InitialCell.edge j ∈ F)
    (hel : InitialCell.edge l ∈ F) (hch : InitialCell.chord ∈ F)
    (hv1 : InitialCell.vert 1 ∈ F) (hv4 : InitialCell.vert 4 ∈ F) :
    (⋃ c ∈ F, H.cellSet c)
      = (H.outer i '' I ∪ (H.outer j '' I ∪ H.outer l '' I)) ∪ H.chordSet
proof:
:= by
  refine Subset.antisymm (Set.iUnion₂_subset fun c hc => ?_) fun z hz => ?_
  · rcases hmem c hc with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rintro z rfl; exact Or.inl (Or.inl (H.pos_mem_outer i))
    · rintro z rfl; exact Or.inl (Or.inl (H.pos_mem_outer_of_succ hij))
    · rintro z rfl; exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl (H.pos_mem_outer_of_succ hjl)))
    · rintro z rfl; exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inr (H.pos_succ_mem_outer l)))
    · exact fun z hz => Or.inl (Or.inl (H.cellSet_edge_subset i hz))
    · exact fun z hz => Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl (H.cellSet_edge_subset j hz)))
    · exact fun z hz => Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inr (H.cellSet_edge_subset l hz)))
    · exact fun z hz => Or.inr (H.cellSet_chord_subset hz)
  · rcases hz with (hz | hz | hz) | hz
    · rcases H.mem_cellSet_edge_or hz with h | rfl | rfl
      exacts [Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, hei, h⟩, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, hvi, rfl⟩,
        Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨InitialCell.vert (i + 1), by rw [hij]; exact hvj, rfl⟩]
    · rcases H.mem_cellSet_edge_or hz with h | rfl | rfl
      exacts [Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, hej, h⟩, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, hvj, rfl⟩,
        Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨InitialCell.vert (j + 1), by rw [hjl]; exact hvl, rfl⟩]
    · rcases H.mem_cellSet_edge_or hz with h | rfl | rfl
      exacts [Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, hel, h⟩, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, hvl, rfl⟩,
        Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, hvl1, rfl⟩]
    · rcases H.mem_cellSet_chord_or hz with h | rfl | rfl
      exacts [Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, hch, h⟩, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, hv1, rfl⟩,
        Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, hv4, rfl⟩]

name: Schoenflies.HexData.biUnion_faceCells
statement:
theorem biUnion_faceCells (H : HexData) (k : Bool) :
    (⋃ c ∈ faceCells k, H.cellSet c) = H.arcOf k ∪ H.chordSet
proof:
:= by
  cases k
  · rw [HexData.arcOf_false]
    refine H.biUnion_of_three_edges _ (i := 1) (j := 2) (l := 3) (by decide) (by decide)
      (fun c hc => ?_) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [faceCells, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hc
      rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide
    all_goals (simp only [faceCells, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; decide)
  · rw [HexData.arcOf_true]
    refine H.biUnion_of_three_edges _ (i := 4) (j := 5) (l := 0) (by decide) (by decide)
      (fun c hc => ?_) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [faceCells, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hc
      rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide
    all_goals (simp only [faceCells, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; decide)

name: Schoenflies.HexData.isCellDecomposition
statement:
theorem isCellDecomposition (H : HexData)
    (hcross : IsCrosscut H.outerArcs H.chordSet (H.pos 1) (H.pos 4))
    (hcut : IsCutPair H.outerArcs (H.pos 1) (H.pos 4) (H.arcOf false) (H.arcOf true))
    (hcollars : HasArcCollars (inside H.outerArcs) H.chordSet) :
    H.realization.IsCellDecomposition (H.outerArcs ∪ inside H.outerArcs)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hsplit, hdisj12, hdisj1P, hdisj2P, -, -, hne1, hne2, hcl1, hcl2⟩ :=
    crosscut_cell_partition forall_isSeparating_of_isJordanCurve hcross hcut hcollars
  
  have hface : ∀ k : Bool, H.cellSet (.face k) ⊆ inside H.outerArcs := by
    intro k z hz
    rw [hsplit]
    cases k
    exacts [Or.inl (Or.inl hz), Or.inl (Or.inr hz)]
  have hfaceOuter : ∀ k : Bool, Disjoint (H.cellSet (.face k)) H.outerArcs := by
    intro k
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    exact fun z hz hzo => (hface k hz).1 hzo
  have hfaceChord : ∀ k : Bool, Disjoint (H.cellSet (.face k)) (H.cellSet .chord) := by
    intro k; cases k; exacts [hdisj1P, hdisj2P]
  have hfaceNe : ∀ k : Bool, (H.cellSet (.face k)).Nonempty := by
    intro k; cases k; exacts [hne1, hne2]
  have hfaceCl : ∀ k : Bool,
      closure (H.cellSet (.face k)) = H.cellSet (.face k) ∪ (H.arcOf k ∪ H.chordSet) := by
    intro k; cases k; exacts [hcl1, hcl2]
  
  have hvertEdge : ∀ k i : Fin 6, Disjoint (H.cellSet (.vert k)) (H.cellSet (.edge i)) := by
    intro k i
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro z rfl h
    exact H.pos_notMem_cellSet_edge k i h
  have hvertChord : ∀ k : Fin 6, Disjoint (H.cellSet (.vert k)) (H.cellSet .chord) := by
    intro k
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro z rfl h
    exact H.pos_notMem_cellSet_chord k h
  have hvertFace : ∀ (k : Fin 6) (l : Bool),
      Disjoint (H.cellSet (.vert k)) (H.cellSet (.face l)) := by
    intro k l
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro z rfl h
    exact (hface l h).1 (H.pos_mem_outerArcs k)
  have hedgeFace : ∀ (i : Fin 6) (l : Bool),
      Disjoint (H.cellSet (.edge i)) (H.cellSet (.face l)) :=
    fun i l => (hfaceOuter l).symm.mono_left (H.cellSet_edge_subset_outerArcs i)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rintro c hc
    cases c with
    | aux n => exact absurd hc (aux_notMem_cells n)
    | vert i => exact ⟨H.pos i, rfl⟩
    | edge i => exact H.nonempty_cellSet_edge i
    | chord => exact H.nonempty_cellSet_chord
    | face k => exact hfaceNe k
  · 
    rintro c d hc hd hcd
    cases c with
    | aux n => exact absurd hc (aux_notMem_cells n)
    | vert k =>
      cases d with
      | aux n => exact absurd hd (aux_notMem_cells n)
      | vert m =>
        rw [Set.disjoint_left]
        rintro z rfl h
        exact hcd (congrArg InitialCell.vert (H.injective_pos h))
      | edge i => exact hvertEdge k i
      | chord => exact hvertChord k
      | face l => exact hvertFace k l
    | edge i =>
      cases d with
      | aux n => exact absurd hd (aux_notMem_cells n)
      | vert m => exact (hvertEdge m i).symm
      | edge j => exact H.disjoint_cellSet_edge fun h => hcd (congrArg InitialCell.edge h)
      | chord => exact H.disjoint_cellSet_edge_chord i
      | face l => exact hedgeFace i l
    | chord =>
      cases d with
      | aux n => exact absurd hd (aux_notMem_cells n)
      | vert m => exact (hvertChord m).symm
      | edge j => exact (H.disjoint_cellSet_edge_chord j).symm
      | chord => exact absurd rfl hcd
      | face l => exact (hfaceChord l).symm
    | face k =>
      cases d with
      | aux n => exact absurd hd (aux_notMem_cells n)
      | vert m => exact (hvertFace m k).symm
      | edge j => exact (hedgeFace j k).symm
      | chord => exact hfaceChord k
      | face l =>
        cases k <;> cases l
        exacts [absurd rfl hcd, hdisj12, hdisj12.symm, absurd rfl hcd]
  · 
    have hall : (⋃ c ∈ initialStructure.cells, H.realization.cell c)
        = ⋃ c : InitialCell, H.cellSet c := by
      refine Subset.antisymm (Set.iUnion₂_subset fun c _ => Set.subset_iUnion _ c)
        (Set.iUnion_subset fun c => ?_)
      match c with
      | .vert i => exact Set.subset_biUnion_of_mem (mem_cells_initialStructure_of_vert i)
      | .edge i => exact Set.subset_biUnion_of_mem (mem_cells_initialStructure_of_edge i)
      | .chord => exact Set.subset_biUnion_of_mem mem_cells_initialStructure_of_chord
      | .face k => exact Set.subset_biUnion_of_mem (mem_cells_initialStructure_of_face k)
      | .aux n => exact Set.empty_subset _
    rw [hall, H.iUnion_cellSet]
    refine Subset.antisymm (Set.union_subset (Set.union_subset Set.subset_union_left ?_) ?_) ?_
    · intro z hz
      rcases H.mem_cellSet_chord_or hz with h | rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inr (by rw [hsplit]; exact Or.inr h)
      · exact Or.inl (H.pos_mem_outerArcs 1)
      · exact Or.inl (H.pos_mem_outerArcs 4)
    · rintro z (hz | hz)
      exacts [Or.inr (hface false hz), Or.inr (hface true hz)]
    · rintro z (hz | hz)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hz)
      · rw [hsplit] at hz
        rcases hz with (hz | hz) | hz
        exacts [Or.inr (Or.inl hz), Or.inr (Or.inr hz),
          Or.inl (Or.inr (H.cellSet_chord_subset hz))]
  · 
    rintro τ hτ
    have hidx : {c | c ∈ initialStructure.cells ∧ initialStructure.sub c τ}
        = {c | initSub c τ} := by
      ext c
      exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨combInvariants_initialStructure.sub_mem_left h, h⟩⟩
    rw [hidx]
    cases τ with
    | aux n => exact absurd hτ (aux_notMem_cells n)
    | vert i =>
      have hset : {c | initSub c (.vert i)} = ({InitialCell.vert i} : Set InitialCell) := by
        ext c; exact initSub_iff_vert
      rw [hset, Set.biUnion_singleton]
      exact closure_singleton
    | edge i =>
      have hset : {c | initSub c (.edge i)}
          = ({InitialCell.edge i, .vert i, .vert (i + 1)} : Set InitialCell) := by
        ext c; exact initSub_iff_edge
      rw [hset]
      change closure (H.cellSet (.edge i)) = _
      rw [H.closure_cellSet_edge i]
      refine Subset.antisymm (fun z hz => ?_) ?_
      · rcases H.mem_cellSet_edge_or hz with h | rfl | rfl
        exacts [Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, Or.inl rfl, h⟩,
          Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), rfl⟩,
          Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, Or.inr (Or.inr rfl), rfl⟩]
      · refine Set.iUnion₂_subset fun c hc => ?_
        rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact H.cellSet_edge_subset i
        · rintro z rfl; exact H.pos_mem_outer i
        · rintro z rfl; exact H.pos_succ_mem_outer i
    | chord =>
      have hset : {c | initSub c .chord}
          = ({InitialCell.chord, .vert 1, .vert 4} : Set InitialCell) := by
        ext c; exact initSub_iff_chord
      rw [hset]
      change closure (H.cellSet .chord) = _
      rw [H.closure_cellSet_chord]
      refine Subset.antisymm (fun z hz => ?_) ?_
      · rcases H.mem_cellSet_chord_or hz with h | rfl | rfl
        exacts [Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, Or.inl rfl, h⟩,
          Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), rfl⟩,
          Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨_, Or.inr (Or.inr rfl), rfl⟩]
      · refine Set.iUnion₂_subset fun c hc => ?_
        rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact H.cellSet_chord_subset
        · rintro z rfl
          exact ⟨0, zero_mem_I, H.chord_zero⟩
        · rintro z rfl
          exact ⟨1, one_mem_I, H.chord_one⟩
    | face k =>
      have hset : {c | initSub c (.face k)} = insert (InitialCell.face k) (faceCells k) := by
        ext c; exact initSub_iff_face
      rw [hset, Set.biUnion_insert]
      change closure (H.cellSet (.face k))
        = H.cellSet (.face k) ∪ ⋃ x ∈ faceCells k, H.cellSet x
      rw [H.biUnion_faceCells k]
      exact hfaceCl k

name: Schoenflies.HexData.isOpen_cellSet_face
statement:
theorem isOpen_cellSet_face (H : HexData)
    (hcross : IsCrosscut H.outerArcs H.chordSet (H.pos 1) (H.pos 4))
    (hcut : IsCutPair H.outerArcs (H.pos 1) (H.pos 4) (H.arcOf false) (H.arcOf true))
    (hcollars : HasArcCollars (inside H.outerArcs) H.chordSet) (k : Bool) :
    IsOpen (H.cellSet (.face k))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hopen1, hopen2, -⟩ :=
    crosscut_cell_partition forall_isSeparating_of_isJordanCurve hcross hcut hcollars
  cases k
  exacts [hopen1, hopen2]

name: Schoenflies.HexData.isFaceJordan
statement:
theorem isFaceJordan (H : HexData)
    (hcross : IsCrosscut H.outerArcs H.chordSet (H.pos 1) (H.pos 4))
    (hcut : IsCutPair H.outerArcs (H.pos 1) (H.pos 4) (H.arcOf false) (H.arcOf true)) :
    H.realization.IsFaceJordan where
  isJordanCurve
proof:
:= by
    intro F hF
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hF
    cases k
    · change IsJordanCurve (frontier (H.cellSet (.face false)))
      rw [H.cellSet_face,
        (jordan_curve_theorem (hcross.isJordanCurve_union hcut)).frontier_inside]
      exact hcross.isJordanCurve_union hcut
    · change IsJordanCurve (frontier (H.cellSet (.face true)))
      rw [H.cellSet_face,
        (jordan_curve_theorem (hcross.isJordanCurve_union hcut.symm)).frontier_inside]
      exact hcross.isJordanCurve_union hcut.symm
  cell_eq_inside := by
    intro F hF
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hF
    cases k
    · change inside (H.arcOf false ∪ H.chordSet) =
        inside (frontier (inside (H.arcOf false ∪ H.chordSet)))
      rw [(jordan_curve_theorem (hcross.isJordanCurve_union hcut)).frontier_inside]
    · change inside (H.arcOf true ∪ H.chordSet) =
        inside (frontier (inside (H.arcOf true ∪ H.chordSet)))
      rw [(jordan_curve_theorem (hcross.isJordanCurve_union hcut.symm)).frontier_inside]

name: Schoenflies.HexData.isWeaklyAdmissible
statement:
theorem isWeaklyAdmissible (H : HexData)
    (hcross : IsCrosscut H.outerArcs H.chordSet (H.pos 1) (H.pos 4)) :
    H.realization.IsWeaklyAdmissible H.outerArcs (H.outerArcs ∪ inside H.outerArcs) where
  isTwoConnected
proof:
:= H.isTwoConnected_graph
  outerSet_eq := H.outerSet_realization
  isPolygonal := by
    rintro e he hne
    
    rcases (he : e ∈ InitialCell.edges) with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | rfl
    · exact absurd (Set.mem_range_self i) hne
    · exact hcross.polygonal
  cell_subset := by
    rintro e he hne
    rcases (he : e ∈ InitialCell.edges) with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | rfl
    · exact absurd (Set.mem_range_self i) hne
    · intro z hz
      exact ⟨Or.inr (hcross.sdiff_subset hz), (hcross.sdiff_subset hz).1⟩
  skeletonSet_subset := by
    rw [H.skeletonSet_realization]
    refine Set.union_subset Set.subset_union_left fun z hz => ?_
    rcases H.mem_cellSet_chord_or hz with h | rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inr (hcross.sdiff_subset h)
    · exact Or.inl (H.pos_mem_outerArcs 1)
    · exact Or.inl (H.pos_mem_outerArcs 4)

name: Schoenflies.modelCurve_union_inside
statement: theorem modelCurve_union_inside : modelCurve ∪ inside modelCurve = Plane.closedSquare 0 1

  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_union, mem_openSquare_zero_one, mem_closedSquare_zero_one]

    · exact le_of_eq (h : Plane.supNorm x = 1)
    · exact h.le
  · intro h
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h with h' | h'
    · exact Or.inr h'
    · exact Or.inl h'

proof:

    (.cons (initOuter_isLink_edge 4).symm
      (.cons (initOuter_isLink_edge 3).symm
        (.cons (initOuter_isLink_edge 2).symm
          (Graph.IsPath.single (initOuter_isLink_edge 1).symm (by simp)) ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_
  all_goals
    simp [Graph.walkVertices, Graph.coveredVertices,
      initOuter_inc_iff, InitialCell.outerEdges, InitialCell.ends]

  · ext c
    change c ∈ InitialCell.outerEdges ↔
      c ∈ [InitialCell.edge 0, .edge 5, .edge 4, .edge 3, .edge 2, .edge 1]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩

    · intro hc

name: Schoenflies.IsSetHomeoOn.image_isRelOpen
statement:
theorem image_isRelOpen (h : IsSetHomeoOn u w X Y) {U V : Set Plane} (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hU : U = V ∩ X) : ∃ W : Set Plane, IsOpen W ∧ u '' U = W ∩ Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hWopen, hW⟩ := (_root_.continuousOn_iff'.1 h.continuousOn_inv) V hV
  refine ⟨W, hWopen, ?_⟩
  rw [hU, ← hW]
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxV, hxX⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨by rwa [mem_preimage, h.leftInvOn hxX], h.mapsTo hxX⟩
  · rintro ⟨hyw, hyY⟩
    exact ⟨w y, ⟨hyw, h.mapsTo_inv hyY⟩, h.rightInvOn hyY⟩

name: Schoenflies.exists_isSetHomeoOn_modelCurve
statement:
theorem exists_isSetHomeoOn_modelCurve {C : Set Plane} (hC : IsJordanCurve C) :
    ∃ u w : Plane → Plane, IsSetHomeoOn u w C modelCurve
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨h⟩ := hC.homeomorph_modelCurve
  refine ⟨fun p => if hp : p ∈ C then (h ⟨p, hp⟩ : Plane) else 0,
    fun q => if hq : q ∈ modelCurve then (h.symm ⟨q, hq⟩ : Plane) else 0, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
    have : (C.restrict fun p => if hp : p ∈ C then (h ⟨p, hp⟩ : Plane) else 0) =
        fun p : ↥C => (h p : Plane) := by
      funext p; simp [Set.restrict, p.2]
    rw [this]
    exact continuous_subtype_val.comp h.continuous
  · rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
    have : (modelCurve.restrict fun q => if hq : q ∈ modelCurve then (h.symm ⟨q, hq⟩ : Plane)
        else 0) = fun q : ↥modelCurve => (h.symm q : Plane) := by
      funext q; simp [Set.restrict, q.2]
    rw [this]
    exact continuous_subtype_val.comp h.symm.continuous
  · intro p hp; simp only [dif_pos hp]; exact (h ⟨p, hp⟩).2
  · intro q hq; simp only [dif_pos hq]; exact (h.symm ⟨q, hq⟩).2
  · intro p hp
    have hmem : (h ⟨p, hp⟩ : Plane) ∈ modelCurve := (h ⟨p, hp⟩).2
    simp only [dif_pos hp, dif_pos hmem]
    have : (⟨(h ⟨p, hp⟩ : Plane), hmem⟩ : ↥modelCurve) = h ⟨p, hp⟩ := rfl
    rw [this, h.symm_apply_apply]
  · intro q hq
    have hmem : (h.symm ⟨q, hq⟩ : Plane) ∈ C := (h.symm ⟨q, hq⟩).2
    simp only [dif_pos hq, dif_pos hmem]
    have : (⟨(h.symm ⟨q, hq⟩ : Plane), hmem⟩ : ↥C) = h.symm ⟨q, hq⟩ := rfl
    rw [this, h.apply_symm_apply]

theorem outerEdgeUniqueFace_initialStructure :
    CellStructure.OuterEdgeUniqueFace initialStructure
proof:
:= by
  rintro e ⟨i, rfl⟩
  
  have hsub : ∀ k : Bool, initSub (InitialCell.edge i) (InitialCell.face k) ↔
      InitialCell.edge i ∈ faceCells k := by
    intro k
    refine ⟨?_, fun h => initSub_face h⟩
    rintro (h | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨l, hl, hmem⟩)
    · exact absurd h (by simp)
    · exact absurd h (by simp [InitialCell.edges])
    · cases hl; exact hmem
  refine ⟨.face (![true, false, false, false, true, true] i), ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [initialStructure_sub, hsub]
    fin_cases i <;> simp [faceCells]
  · rintro T ⟨⟨k, rfl⟩, hT⟩
    rw [initialStructure_sub, hsub] at hT
    have : k = ![true, false, false, false, true, true] i := by
      fin_cases i <;> cases k <;> simp_all [faceCells]
    rw [this]

theorem isDrawing : Graph.IsDrawing (initSkel.map H.point) H.draw where
  edge_param
proof:
