name: Schoenflies.localGrid_outer_cycle
statement:
theorem localGrid_outer_cycle (hs : 0 < s) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (localGrid p s k).IsCycleThrough
        (gridBoundaryLast (localGridX p s k) (localGridY p s k) k k)
        (gridBoundaryPt (localGridX p s k) (localGridY p s k) k k 0)
        (gridBoundaryPt (localGridX p s k) (localGridY p s k) k k (2 * k + 2 * k - 1))
        (gridBoundaryDetour (localGridX p s k) (localGridY p s k) k k) ∧
      Graph.edgesCover segmentDrawing
          (gridBoundaryLast (localGridX p s k) (localGridY p s k) k k ::
            gridBoundaryDetour (localGridX p s k) (localGridY p s k) k k)
        = (segment ℝ (Plane.mk (p 0 - s) (p 1 - s)) (Plane.mk (p 0 + s) (p 1 - s)) ∪
            segment ℝ (Plane.mk (p 0 + s) (p 1 - s)) (Plane.mk (p 0 + s) (p 1 + s))) ∪
          (segment ℝ (Plane.mk (p 0 - s) (p 1 + s)) (Plane.mk (p 0 + s) (p 1 + s)) ∪
            segment ℝ (Plane.mk (p 0 - s) (p 1 - s)) (Plane.mk (p 0 - s) (p 1 + s)))
proof:
:= by
  have hxmono : ∀ i, i < k → localGridX p s k i ≤ localGridX p s k (i + 1) :=
    fun i _ => (localGridX_strictMono hs hk).monotone (Nat.le_succ i)
  have hymono : ∀ j, j < k → localGridY p s k j ≤ localGridY p s k (j + 1) :=
    fun j _ => (localGridY_strictMono hs hk).monotone (Nat.le_succ j)
  refine ⟨gridGraph_isCycleThrough_boundary hk hk
    (((localGridX_strictMono hs hk).strictMonoOn _).injOn)
    (((localGridY_strictMono hs hk).strictMonoOn _).injOn), ?_⟩
  rw [edgesCover_gridBoundary hk hk hxmono hymono]
  simp only [gridPt, localGridX_zero, localGridY_zero, localGridX_last hk, localGridY_last hk]

name: Schoenflies.dist_le_of_supNorm_bounds
statement:
theorem dist_le_of_supNorm_bounds {x y : Plane} {c : ℝ} (h0 : |x 0 - y 0| ≤ c)
    (h1 : |x 1 - y 1| ≤ c) : dist x y ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * c
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.2 two_pos
  refine le_trans (dist_le_sqrt_two_mul_supNorm x y) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hsq.le)
  simp only [Plane.supNorm, Plane.sub_apply]
  exact max_le h0 h1

name: Schoenflies.dist_lt_of_supNorm_bounds
statement:
theorem dist_lt_of_supNorm_bounds {x y : Plane} {c : ℝ} (h0 : |x 0 - y 0| < c)
    (h1 : |x 1 - y 1| < c) : dist x y < Real.sqrt 2 * c
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.2 two_pos
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_le_sqrt_two_mul_supNorm x y) (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ?_ hsq)
  simp only [Plane.supNorm, Plane.sub_apply]
  exact max_lt h0 h1

name: Schoenflies.dist_le_of_mem_localGridCell
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : localGridX p s k (i + 1) - localGridX p s k i = 2 * s / k := by
    simp only [localGridX, uniformCoord]; push_cast; ring
  have hstep' : localGridY p s k (j + 1) - localGridY p s k j = 2 * s / k := by
    simp only [localGridY, uniformCoord]; push_cast; ring
  refine dist_le_of_supNorm_bounds ?_ ?_
  · rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> [linarith [hx.1.1, hy.1.2]; linarith [hx.1.2, hy.1.1]]
  · rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> [linarith [hx.2.1, hy.2.2]; linarith [hx.2.2, hy.2.1]]

name: Schoenflies.mem_cover_of_coord_eq
statement:
theorem mem_cover_of_coord_eq (hs : 0 < s) (hk : 1 ≤ k) {z : Plane} {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ k)
    (hz : z ∈ Plane.closedSquare p s) (hz0 : z 0 = localGridX p s k i) :
    z ∈ cover (localGridEdges p s k)
proof:
:= by
  have hymono : ∀ j, j < k → localGridY p s k j ≤ localGridY p s k (j + 1) :=
    fun j _ => (localGridY_strictMono hs hk).monotone (Nat.le_succ j)
  have hbounds := Plane.closedSquare_eq_inter p s ▸ hz
  obtain ⟨-, h3, h4⟩ : _ ∧ (p 1 - s ≤ z 1) ∧ (z 1 ≤ p 1 + s) := hbounds
  have hmem : z ∈ segment ℝ (gridPt (localGridX p s k) (localGridY p s k) i 0)
      (gridPt (localGridX p s k) (localGridY p s k) i k) := by
    refine mem_segment_vert.2 ⟨hz0, ?_⟩
    rw [segment_eq_Icc ((localGridY_strictMono hs hk).monotone (Nat.zero_le k))]
    rw [localGridY_zero, localGridY_last hk]
    exact ⟨h3, h4⟩
  rw [← iUnion_gridVEdge_seg hk hymono i] at hmem
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_Iio, exists_prop] at hmem
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hzj⟩ := hmem
  exact mem_cover_iff.2 ⟨_, gridVEdge_mem_gridEdges hi hj hk, hzj⟩

name: Schoenflies.mem_cover_of_coord_eq'
statement:
theorem mem_cover_of_coord_eq' (hs : 0 < s) (hk : 1 ≤ k) {z : Plane} {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k)
    (hz : z ∈ Plane.closedSquare p s) (hz1 : z 1 = localGridY p s k j) :
    z ∈ cover (localGridEdges p s k)
proof:
:= by
  have hxmono : ∀ i, i < k → localGridX p s k i ≤ localGridX p s k (i + 1) :=
    fun i _ => (localGridX_strictMono hs hk).monotone (Nat.le_succ i)
  have hbounds := Plane.closedSquare_eq_inter p s ▸ hz
  obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, -⟩ : ((p 0 - s ≤ z 0) ∧ (z 0 ≤ p 0 + s)) ∧ _ := hbounds
  have hmem : z ∈ segment ℝ (gridPt (localGridX p s k) (localGridY p s k) 0 j)
      (gridPt (localGridX p s k) (localGridY p s k) k j) := by
    refine mem_segment_horiz.2 ⟨hz1, ?_⟩
    rw [segment_eq_Icc ((localGridX_strictMono hs hk).monotone (Nat.zero_le k))]
    rw [localGridX_zero, localGridX_last hk]
    exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rw [← iUnion_gridHEdge_seg hk hxmono j] at hmem
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_Iio, exists_prop] at hmem
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hzi⟩ := hmem
  exact mem_cover_iff.2 ⟨_, gridHEdge_mem_gridEdges hi hj hk, hzi⟩

name: Schoenflies.dist_lt_of_avoiding_localGrid
proof:
:= by
  have hstep := localGrid_step_pos hs hk
  have hcoord : ∀ (m : Fin 2) (a : ℝ), (∀ i ≤ k, uniformCoord a (2 * s / k) i ∉
      ((fun z : Plane => z m) '' F)) →
      (∀ z ∈ F, a ≤ z m ∧ z m ≤ a + k * (2 * s / k)) →
      |x m - y m| < 2 * s / k := by
    intro m a havd hbd
    refine abs_sub_lt_of_avoiding hstep (hF.image _ (Plane.continuous_coord m).continuousOn)
      ?_ havd ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_Icc.2 (hbd z hz)
  have hbdX : ∀ z ∈ F, (p 0 - s) ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ (p 0 - s) + k * (2 * s / k) := by
    intro z hz
    have hbounds := Plane.closedSquare_eq_inter p s ▸ hFW hz
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, -⟩ : ((p 0 - s ≤ z 0) ∧ (z 0 ≤ p 0 + s)) ∧ _ := hbounds
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    have := localGridX_last (p := p) (s := s) hk
    simp only [localGridX, uniformCoord] at this
    linarith
  have hbdY : ∀ z ∈ F, (p 1 - s) ≤ z 1 ∧ z 1 ≤ (p 1 - s) + k * (2 * s / k) := by
    intro z hz
    have hbounds := Plane.closedSquare_eq_inter p s ▸ hFW hz
    obtain ⟨-, h3, h4⟩ : _ ∧ (p 1 - s ≤ z 1) ∧ (z 1 ≤ p 1 + s) := hbounds
    refine ⟨h3, ?_⟩
    have := localGridY_last (p := p) (s := s) hk
    simp only [localGridY, uniformCoord] at this
    linarith
  refine dist_lt_of_supNorm_bounds (hcoord 0 (p 0 - s) ?_ hbdX) (hcoord 1 (p 1 - s) ?_ hbdY)
  · rintro i hi ⟨z, hz, hzeq⟩
    exact havoid z hz (mem_cover_of_coord_eq hs hk hi (hFW hz)
      (by simpa [localGridX] using hzeq))
  · rintro j hj ⟨z, hz, hzeq⟩
    exact havoid z hz (mem_cover_of_coord_eq' hs hk hj (hFW hz)
      (by simpa [localGridY] using hzeq))

name: Schoenflies.one_le_localGridCount
statement: theorem one_le_localGridCount (s ε : ℝ) : 1 ≤ localGridCount s ε
proof: := le_max_left _ _

name: Schoenflies.localGridCount_spec
statement:
theorem localGridCount_spec (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Real.sqrt 2 * (2 * s / (localGridCount s ε : ℕ)) < ε
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (localGridCount s ε : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast one_le_localGridCount s ε
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < (localGridCount s ε : ℕ) := by linarith
  have h1 : 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * s / ε < ((localGridCount s ε : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    calc 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * s / ε ≤ (⌈2 * Real.sqrt 2 * s / ε⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      _ < (⌈2 * Real.sqrt 2 * s / ε⌉₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
      _ ≤ ((localGridCount s ε : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast le_max_right 1 (⌈2 * Real.sqrt 2 * s / ε⌉₊ + 1)
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ hε] at h1
  rw [mul_div_assoc', div_lt_iff₀ hN0]
  linarith

name: Schoenflies.localGrid_fine
statement:
theorem localGrid_fine (hs : 0 < s) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (localGrid p s (localGridCount s ε)).IsTwoConnected ∧
      Graph.IsDrawing (localGrid p s (localGridCount s ε)) segmentDrawing ∧
      ∀ i j : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ localGridCell p s (localGridCount s ε) i j,
        ∀ y ∈ localGridCell p s (localGridCount s ε) i j, dist x y < ε
proof:
:= by
  have hk := one_le_localGridCount s ε
  refine ⟨localGrid_isTwoConnected hs hk, localGrid_isDrawing hs hk, fun i j x hx y hy => ?_⟩
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_le_of_mem_localGridCell hx hy) (localGridCount_spec hε)

name: Schoenflies.poly_reverse
statement:
theorem poly_reverse : ∀ vs : List Plane, poly vs.reverse = poly vs
  | [] => by simp
  | [v] => by simp
  | u :: v :: tl => by
    rw [List.reverse_cons, poly_concat (by simp) u, poly_reverse (v :: tl),
      List.getLast_reverse (by simp), List.head_cons, poly_cons_cons, segment_symm]
    exact union_comm _ _

                                               

                                                                

                                                                                                 
                                                                  
def PolyConnIn (S : Set Plane) (x y : Plane) : Prop
proof:
:=
  ∃ vs : List Plane, ∃ h : vs ≠ [], poly vs ⊆ S ∧ vs.head h = x ∧ vs.getLast h = y

name: Schoenflies.PolyConnIn.refl
statement: theorem PolyConnIn.refl (hx : x ∈ S) : PolyConnIn S x x
proof:
:=
  ⟨[x], by simp, by simpa using hx, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyConnIn.left_mem
statement: theorem PolyConnIn.left_mem (h : PolyConnIn S x y) : x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vs, hne, hsub, hhead, -⟩ := h
  exact hhead ▸ hsub (head_mem_poly hne)

name: Schoenflies.PolyConnIn.right_mem
statement: theorem PolyConnIn.right_mem (h : PolyConnIn S x y) : y ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vs, hne, hsub, -, hlast⟩ := h
  exact hlast ▸ hsub (getLast_mem_poly hne)

name: Schoenflies.PolyConnIn.mono
statement: theorem PolyConnIn.mono (h : PolyConnIn S x y) (hST : S ⊆ T) : PolyConnIn T x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vs, hne, hsub, hhead, hlast⟩ := h
  exact ⟨vs, hne, hsub.trans hST, hhead, hlast⟩

name: Schoenflies.PolyConnIn.trans
statement:
theorem PolyConnIn.trans (hxy : PolyConnIn S x y) (hyz : PolyConnIn S y z) :
    PolyConnIn S x z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vs, hv, hvS, hvh, hvl⟩ := hxy
  obtain ⟨ws, hw, hwS, hwh, hwl⟩ := hyz
  obtain ⟨w, rest, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hw
  simp only [List.head_cons] at hwh
  subst hwh
  refine ⟨vs ++ w :: rest, by simp, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [poly_append hv w rest hvl]; exact union_subset hvS hwS
  · rw [List.head_append_of_ne_nil hv]; exact hvh
  · rw [List.getLast_append_of_ne_nil _ (List.cons_ne_nil w rest)]; exact hwl

name: Schoenflies.PolyConnIn.symm
statement: theorem PolyConnIn.symm (h : PolyConnIn S x y) : PolyConnIn S y x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vs, hv, hvS, hvh, hvl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨vs.reverse, by simpa using hv, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [poly_reverse]; exact hvS
  · rw [List.head_reverse]; exact hvl
  · rw [List.getLast_reverse]; exact hvh

name: Schoenflies.polyConnIn_of_convex
statement:
theorem polyConnIn_of_convex {C : Set Plane} (hC : Convex ℝ C) (hCS : C ⊆ S)
    (hx : x ∈ C) (hy : y ∈ C) : PolyConnIn S x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨[x, y], by simp, by
    rw [poly_cons_cons, poly_singleton]
    exact union_subset ((hC.segment_subset hx hy).trans hCS)
      (singleton_subset_iff.2 (hCS hy)), rfl, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.polyConnIn_union_of_convex
statement:
theorem polyConnIn_union_of_convex {C D : Set Plane} (hC : Convex ℝ C) (hD : Convex ℝ D)
    (hmeet : (C ∩ D).Nonempty) (hx : x ∈ C ∪ D) (hy : y ∈ C ∪ D) : PolyConnIn (C ∪ D) x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hwC, hwD⟩ := hmeet
  have hxw : PolyConnIn (C ∪ D) x w := by
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact polyConnIn_of_convex hC subset_union_left hx hwC
    · exact polyConnIn_of_convex hD subset_union_right hx hwD
  have hwy : PolyConnIn (C ∪ D) w y := by
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · exact polyConnIn_of_convex hC subset_union_left hwC hy
    · exact polyConnIn_of_convex hD subset_union_right hwD hy
  exact hxw.trans hwy

name: Schoenflies.isLocallyPolyConnAt_of_convex
statement:
theorem isLocallyPolyConnAt_of_convex {U : Set Plane} {p : Plane} (hU : IsOpen U) (hpU : p ∈ U)
    (hUS : U ⊆ S) (hconv : Convex ℝ U) : IsLocallyPolyConnAt S p
proof:
:=
  ⟨U, hU, hpU, fun _ hx _ hy => polyConnIn_of_convex hconv hUS hx.1 hy.1⟩

name: Schoenflies.isLocallyPolyConnAt_of_star
statement:
theorem isLocallyPolyConnAt_of_star {U : Set Plane} {p : Plane} {ι : Type*} {C : ι → Set Plane}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hpU : p ∈ U) (hcover : U ∩ S ⊆ ⋃ i, C i) (hsub : ∀ i, C i ⊆ S)
    (hconv : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (C i)) (hstar : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ C i, p ∈ C i) :
    IsLocallyPolyConnAt S p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨U, hU, hpU, fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 (hcover hx)
  obtain ⟨j, hyj⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 (hcover hy)
  exact (polyConnIn_of_convex (hconv i) (hsub i) hxi (hstar i x hxi)).trans
    (polyConnIn_of_convex (hconv j) (hsub j) (hstar j y hyj) hyj)

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_openSquare_iff
statement:
theorem mem_openSquare_iff (c : Plane) (r : ℝ) (x : Plane) :
    x ∈ openSquare c r ↔ ∀ i, |x i - c i| < r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [openSquare, mem_setOf_eq, supDist, supNorm, sub_apply, max_lt_iff,
    Fin.forall_fin_two]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_openSquare_self
statement: theorem mem_openSquare_self {p : Plane} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : p ∈ openSquare p s
proof:
:= by
  simpa [openSquare] using hs

name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare_mono
statement: theorem openSquare_mono {p : Plane} {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) : openSquare p s ⊆ openSquare p t
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hx h

name: Schoenflies.Plane.convex_sideHalfPlane
statement:
theorem convex_sideHalfPlane (c : Plane) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) (b : Bool) :
    Convex ℝ (sideHalfPlane c r i b)
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · exact convex_coord_le i _
  · exact convex_coord_ge i _

name: Schoenflies.Plane.sideHalfPlane_subset_compl
statement:
theorem sideHalfPlane_subset_compl (c : Plane) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) (b : Bool) :
    sideHalfPlane c r i b ⊆ (openSquare c r)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hmem
  have hlt := (mem_openSquare_iff c r x).1 hmem i
  rw [abs_lt] at hlt
  cases b
  · exact absurd (show x i ≤ c i - r from hx) (by linarith [hlt.1])
  · exact absurd (show c i + r ≤ x i from hx) (by linarith [hlt.2])

name: Schoenflies.Plane.compl_openSquare_subset_iUnion
statement:
theorem compl_openSquare_subset_iUnion (c : Plane) (r : ℝ) :
    (openSquare c r)ᶜ ⊆ ⋃ ib : Fin 2 × Bool, sideHalfPlane c r ib.1 ib.2
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_compl_iff, mem_openSquare_iff] at hx
  push Not at hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
  rcases le_abs.1 hi with h | h
  · exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨(i, true), show c i + r ≤ x i by linarith⟩
  · exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨(i, false), show x i ≤ c i - r by linarith⟩

name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare_disjoint_sideHalfPlane
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hmem
  have hlt := (mem_openSquare_iff p s x).1 hx i
  rw [abs_lt] at hlt
  cases b
  · exact absurd (show x i ≤ c i - r from hmem) (by
      simp only [sideGap, cond_false] at hs; linarith [hlt.1])
  · exact absurd (show c i + r ≤ x i from hmem) (by
      simp only [sideGap, cond_true] at hs; linarith [hlt.2])

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_sideHalfPlane_of_sideGap_nonpos
statement:
theorem mem_sideHalfPlane_of_sideGap_nonpos {c : Plane} {r : ℝ} {p : Plane} {i : Fin 2}
    {b : Bool} (h : sideGap c r p i b ≤ 0) : p ∈ sideHalfPlane c r i b
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · simp only [sideGap, cond_false] at h
    exact show p i ≤ c i - r by linarith
  · simp only [sideGap, cond_true] at h
    exact show c i + r ≤ p i by linarith

name: Schoenflies.Plane.convex_openSquare_inter_sideHalfPlane
statement:
theorem convex_openSquare_inter_sideHalfPlane (p : Plane) (s : ℝ) (c : Plane) (r : ℝ)
    (i : Fin 2) (b : Bool) : Convex ℝ (openSquare p s ∩ sideHalfPlane c r i b)
proof:
:=
  (convex_openSquare p s).inter (convex_sideHalfPlane c r i b)

name: Schoenflies.exists_pos_le_of_pos
statement:
theorem exists_pos_le_of_pos {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (d : ι → ℝ) :
    ∃ s > 0, ∀ i, 0 < d i → s ≤ d i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hle⟩ :=
    exists_pos_le_of_finite (S := {i : ι | 0 < d i}) (Set.toFinite _) (f := d) fun _ hi => hi
  exact ⟨s, hs, fun i hi => hle i hi⟩

name: Schoenflies.Plane.exists_radius_sides
statement:
theorem Plane.exists_radius_sides (c : Plane) (r : ℝ) (p : Plane) :
    ∃ s > 0, ∀ ib : Fin 2 × Bool,
      ∀ z ∈ openSquare p s ∩ sideHalfPlane c r ib.1 ib.2,
        p ∈ openSquare p s ∩ sideHalfPlane c r ib.1 ib.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hle⟩ := exists_pos_le_of_pos fun ib : Fin 2 × Bool => sideGap c r p ib.1 ib.2
  refine ⟨s, hs, fun ib z hz => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    exact mem_openSquare_self hs
  · 
    
    by_contra hp
    exact openSquare_disjoint_sideHalfPlane
      (hle ib (lt_of_not_ge fun hcon => hp (mem_sideHalfPlane_of_sideGap_nonpos hcon))) z hz.1 hz.2

name: Schoenflies.isLocallyPolyConnAt_compl_openSquare
statement:
theorem isLocallyPolyConnAt_compl_openSquare (c : Plane) (r : ℝ) (p : Plane) :
    IsLocallyPolyConnAt (openSquare c r)ᶜ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hstar⟩ := Plane.exists_radius_sides c r p
  refine isLocallyPolyConnAt_of_star (C := fun ib : Fin 2 × Bool =>
      openSquare p s ∩ sideHalfPlane c r ib.1 ib.2)
    (isOpen_openSquare p s) (mem_openSquare_self hs) ?_ ?_ ?_ hstar
  · rintro x ⟨hxU, hxM⟩
    obtain ⟨ib, hib⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 (compl_openSquare_subset_iUnion c r hxM)
    exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨ib, hxU, hib⟩
  · exact fun ib => inter_subset_right.trans (sideHalfPlane_subset_compl c r ib.1 ib.2)
  · exact fun ib => convex_openSquare_inter_sideHalfPlane p s c r ib.1 ib.2

name: Schoenflies.isLocallyPolyConn_compl_biUnion
statement:
theorem isLocallyPolyConn_compl_biUnion {A : Set Plane} (hA : A.Finite) (ρ : Plane → ℝ)
    (hdisj : ∀ c ∈ A, ∀ c' ∈ A, c ≠ c' →
      Disjoint (closedSquare c (ρ c)) (closedSquare c' (ρ c'))) :
    IsLocallyPolyConn ((⋃ c ∈ A, openSquare c (ρ c))ᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  intro p _
  
  have room : ∀ c : Plane, ρ c < supDist p c → ∀ s ≤ supDist p c - ρ c,
      ∀ x ∈ openSquare p s, x ∉ openSquare c (ρ c) := by
    intro c _ s hs x hx hmem
    have h₁ : supDist x p < s := hx
    have h₂ : supDist x c < ρ c := hmem
    have := supDist_triangle p x c
    rw [supDist_comm p x] at this
    linarith
  by_cases hnear : ∃ c₀ ∈ A, p ∈ closedSquare c₀ (ρ c₀)
  · 
    obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀A, hpc₀⟩ := hnear
    have hfar : ∀ c ∈ A \ {c₀}, 0 < supDist p c - ρ c := by
      rintro c ⟨hcA, hcne⟩
      have : p ∉ closedSquare c (ρ c) :=
        Set.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj c₀ hc₀A c hcA fun h => hcne (h ▸ rfl)) hpc₀
      simp only [closedSquare, mem_setOf_eq, not_le] at this
      linarith
    obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁, hs₁le⟩ := exists_pos_le_of_finite (hA.sdiff (t := {c₀}))
      (f := fun c => supDist p c - ρ c) hfar
    obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂, hstar⟩ := Plane.exists_radius_sides c₀ (ρ c₀) p
    set s := min s₁ s₂ with hsdef
    have hs : 0 < s := lt_min hs₁ hs₂
    have hpU : p ∈ openSquare p s := mem_openSquare_self hs
    
    have hloc : openSquare p s ∩ (⋃ c ∈ A, openSquare c (ρ c))ᶜ
        ⊆ openSquare p s ∩ (openSquare c₀ (ρ c₀))ᶜ := by
      rintro x ⟨hxU, hxM⟩
      exact ⟨hxU, fun hcon => hxM (mem_biUnion hc₀A hcon)⟩
    have hback : ∀ x ∈ openSquare p s, x ∉ openSquare c₀ (ρ c₀) →
        x ∈ (⋃ c ∈ A, openSquare c (ρ c))ᶜ := by
      intro x hxU hx₀ hcon
      obtain ⟨c, hcA, hxc⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 hcon
      rcases eq_or_ne c c₀ with rfl | hcne
      · exact hx₀ hxc
      · exact room c (by linarith [hfar c ⟨hcA, hcne⟩]) s
          (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (hs₁le c ⟨hcA, hcne⟩)) x hxU hxc
    refine isLocallyPolyConnAt_of_star (C := fun ib : Fin 2 × Bool =>
        openSquare p s ∩ sideHalfPlane c₀ (ρ c₀) ib.1 ib.2)
      (isOpen_openSquare p s) hpU ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rintro x hx
      obtain ⟨hxU, hx₀⟩ := hloc hx
      obtain ⟨ib, hib⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 (compl_openSquare_subset_iUnion c₀ (ρ c₀) hx₀)
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨ib, hxU, hib⟩
    · rintro ib x ⟨hxU, hxH⟩
      exact hback x hxU (sideHalfPlane_subset_compl c₀ (ρ c₀) ib.1 ib.2 hxH)
    · exact fun ib => convex_openSquare_inter_sideHalfPlane p s c₀ (ρ c₀) ib.1 ib.2
    · 
      rintro ib z ⟨hzU, hzH⟩
      refine ⟨hpU, ?_⟩
      have : z ∈ openSquare p s₂ ∩ sideHalfPlane c₀ (ρ c₀) ib.1 ib.2 :=
        ⟨openSquare_mono (min_le_right s₁ s₂) hzU, hzH⟩
      exact (hstar ib z this).2
  · 
    push Not at hnear
    have hfar : ∀ c ∈ A, 0 < supDist p c - ρ c := by
      intro c hcA
      have := hnear c hcA
      simp only [closedSquare, mem_setOf_eq, not_le] at this
      linarith
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsle⟩ := exists_pos_le_of_finite hA (f := fun c => supDist p c - ρ c) hfar
    refine isLocallyPolyConnAt_of_convex (isOpen_openSquare p s)
      (mem_openSquare_self hs) ?_ (convex_openSquare p s)
    intro x hx hcon
    obtain ⟨c, hcA, hxc⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 hcon
    exact room c (by linarith [hfar c hcA]) s (hsle c hcA) x hx hxc

name: Schoenflies.continuousOn_invFunOn_image'
statement:
theorem continuousOn_invFunOn_image' {f : ℝ → Plane} {s : Set ℝ} (hs : IsCompact s)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f s) (hinj : InjOn f s) :
    ContinuousOn (Function.invFunOn f s) (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuousOn_iff_isClosed]
  intro F hF
  refine ⟨f '' (F ∩ s), (hs.inter_left hF).image_of_continuousOn (hf.mono inter_subset_right)
    |>.isClosed, ?_⟩
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hy, x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_preimage, hinj.leftInvOn_invFunOn hx] at hy
    exact ⟨⟨x, ⟨hy, hx⟩, rfl⟩, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, -⟩
    exact ⟨by rw [mem_preimage, hinj.leftInvOn_invFunOn hxs]; exact hxF,
      ⟨x, hxs, rfl⟩⟩

name: Schoenflies.IsArcBetween.eq_of_subset_arc
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hfc, hfi, rfl, -, -⟩ := hC
  let inv : Plane → ℝ := Function.invFunOn f I
  have hinv : ContinuousOn inv (f '' I) :=
    continuousOn_invFunOn_image' isCompact_I hfc hfi
  have hmaps : MapsTo inv (f '' I) I := by
    rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    change Function.invFunOn f I (f t) ∈ I
    rw [hfi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht]
    exact ht
  have image_inv (K : Set Plane) (hK : K ⊆ f '' I) : f '' (inv '' K) = K := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, hxK, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hK hxK
      simpa [inv, hfi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht] using hxK
    · intro x hxK
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hK hxK
      exact ⟨inv (f t), ⟨f t, hxK, rfl⟩, by simp [inv, hfi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht]⟩
  have image_is_interval (K : Set Plane) (hKarc : IsArcBetween K p q)
      (hK : K ⊆ f '' I) :
      inv '' K = uIcc (inv p) (inv q) := by
    obtain ⟨g, hgc, hgi, hgim, hg0, hg1⟩ := hKarc
    let k : ℝ → ℝ := inv ∘ g
    have hgmap : MapsTo g I (f '' I) := fun t ht => hK (hgim ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem g ht)
    have hkc : ContinuousOn k I := hinv.comp hgc hgmap
    have hki : InjOn k I := by
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      apply hgi hx hy
      have hleft : ∀ z ∈ K, f (inv z) = z := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hK hz
        simp [inv, hfi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht]
      rw [← hleft (g x) (hgim ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem g hx),
        ← hleft (g y) (hgim ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem g hy)]
      exact congrArg f (show inv (g x) = inv (g y) from hxy)
    have hkimage : k '' I = uIcc (k 0) (k 1) := by
      rcases hkc.strictMonoOn_of_injOn_Icc' zero_le_one hki with hmono | hanti
      · rw [hkc.image_Icc_of_monotoneOn zero_le_one hmono.monotoneOn,
          uIcc_of_le (hmono.monotoneOn zero_mem_I one_mem_I zero_le_one)]
      · rw [hkc.image_Icc_of_antitoneOn zero_le_one hanti.antitoneOn,
          uIcc_of_ge (hanti.antitoneOn zero_mem_I one_mem_I zero_le_one)]
    calc
      inv '' K = k '' I := by rw [← hgim, Set.image_image]; rfl
      _ = uIcc (k 0) (k 1) := hkimage
      _ = uIcc (inv p) (inv q) := by simp [k, Function.comp_def, hg0, hg1]
  have hAi := image_is_interval A hA hAC
  have hBi := image_is_interval B hB hBC
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ f '' (inv '' A) := by
      rw [image_inv A hAC]
      exact hx
    rw [hAi, ← hBi, image_inv B hBC] at hx'
    exact hx'
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ f '' (inv '' B) := by
      rw [image_inv B hBC]
      exact hx
    rw [hBi, ← hAi, image_inv A hAC] at hx'
    exact hx'

name: Schoenflies.IsArcBetween.isPolygonal_of_subset_arc
proof:
:= by
  have hpq : p ≠ q := by
    obtain ⟨f, -, hi, -, h0, h1⟩ := hA
    intro hpq'
    exact zero_ne_one (hi zero_mem_I one_mem_I (by simpa [h0, h1] using hpq'))
  obtain ⟨vs, hvs, -, -, hsub, hvsArc⟩ :=
    exists_simple_poly_of_isPolygonal hpoly hC.isArc.isConnected.isPreconnected hpq
      (hAC hA.left_mem) (hAC hA.right_mem)
  have heq := hA.eq_of_subset_arc hvsArc hC hAC hsub
  exact ⟨vs, heq⟩

name: Schoenflies.ArcHomeo.injOn
statement: theorem injOn (h : ArcHomeo A B a b c d) : InjOn h.toFun A
proof: := h.leftInvOn.injOn

name: Schoenflies.ArcHomeo.mapsTo
statement: theorem mapsTo (h : ArcHomeo A B a b c d) : MapsTo h.toFun A B
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hx' : h.toFun x ∈ h.toFun '' A := Set.mem_image_of_mem h.toFun hx
  simpa only [h.image_eq] using hx'

name: Schoenflies.ArcHomeo.mapsTo_invFun
statement: theorem mapsTo_invFun (h : ArcHomeo A B a b c d) : MapsTo h.invFun B A
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rw [← h.image_eq] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
  rw [h.leftInvOn hx]
  exact hx

name: Schoenflies.exists_arcHomeo
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hfc, hfi, hfim, hf0, hf1⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨g, hgc, hgi, hgim, hg0, hg1⟩ := hB
  let fi : Plane → ℝ := Function.invFunOn f I
  let gi : Plane → ℝ := Function.invFunOn g I
  let toFun : Plane → Plane := g ∘ fi
  let invFun : Plane → Plane := f ∘ gi
  have hfiC : ContinuousOn fi A := by
    rw [← hfim]
    exact continuousOn_invFunOn_image' isCompact_I hfc hfi
  have hgiC : ContinuousOn gi B := by
    rw [← hgim]
    exact continuousOn_invFunOn_image' isCompact_I hgc hgi
  have hfiMap : MapsTo fi A I := by
    rw [← hfim]
    rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    change Function.invFunOn f I (f t) ∈ I
    rw [hfi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht]
    exact ht
  have hgiMap : MapsTo gi B I := by
    rw [← hgim]
    rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    change Function.invFunOn g I (g t) ∈ I
    rw [hgi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht]
    exact ht
  refine ⟨{
    toFun := toFun
    invFun := invFun
    continuousOn_toFun := hgc.comp hfiC hfiMap
    continuousOn_invFun := hfc.comp hgiC hgiMap
    leftInvOn := ?_
    rightInvOn := ?_
    image_eq := ?_
    map_left := ?_
    map_right := ?_
  }⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hfim ▸ hx
    simp [toFun, invFun, fi, gi, hfi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht,
      hgi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht]
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hgim ▸ hy
    simp [toFun, invFun, fi, gi, hgi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht,
      hfi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht]
  · apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact hgim ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem g (hfiMap hx)
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hgim ▸ hy
      refine ⟨f t, hfim ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem f ht, ?_⟩
      simp [toFun, fi, hfi.leftInvOn_invFunOn ht]
  · rw [← hf0, ← hg0]
    simp [toFun, fi, hfi.leftInvOn_invFunOn zero_mem_I]
  · rw [← hf1, ← hg1]
    simp [toFun, fi, hfi.leftInvOn_invFunOn one_mem_I]

name: Graph.edgeArc_mapDrawing
statement:
theorem edgeArc_mapDrawing (m : Schoenflies.ArcHomeo A B a b c d) (e : β) :
    edgeArc (mapDrawing m drawing) e = m.toFun '' edgeArc drawing e
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc, edgeArc, ← Set.image_comp]
  rfl

name: Graph.pointSet_map_mapDrawing
statement:
theorem pointSet_map_mapDrawing (m : Schoenflies.ArcHomeo A B a b c d) :
    pointSet (G.map m.toFun) (mapDrawing m drawing) = m.toFun '' pointSet G drawing
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointSet, pointSet, Graph.vertexSet_map, Graph.edgeSet_map, Set.image_union,
    Set.image_iUnion₂]
  congr 1
  exact Set.iUnion₂_congr fun e _ => edgeArc_mapDrawing m e

name: Graph.IsDrawing.map_arcHomeo
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.map_arcHomeo (h : IsDrawing G drawing)
    (m : Schoenflies.ArcHomeo A B a b c d)
    (hpoint : pointSet G drawing = A) :
    IsDrawing (G.map m.toFun) (mapDrawing m drawing) where
  edge_param
proof:
:= by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨hc, hi, hl⟩ := h.edge_param he
    have hedge : edgeArc drawing e ⊆ A := hpoint ▸ edgeArc_subset_pointSet he
    refine ⟨m.continuousOn_toFun.comp hc (fun t ht => hedge ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro s hs t ht hst
      exact hi hs ht (m.injOn (hedge ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩) (hedge ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩) hst)
    · exact hl.map m.toFun
  vertex_mem_edgeArc := by
    intro e x y v hlink hv hz
    rcases hlink with ⟨x', y', hxy, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [Graph.vertexSet_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨v', hv', rfl⟩ := hv
    rw [edgeArc_mapDrawing] at hz
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hmz⟩ := hz
    have hvA : v' ∈ A := hpoint ▸ vertexSet_subset_pointSet hv'
    have hzA : z ∈ A := hpoint ▸ edgeArc_subset_pointSet hxy.edge_mem hz
    have hvz : v' = z := m.injOn hvA hzA hmz.symm
    rcases h.vertex_mem_edgeArc hxy hv' (hvz ▸ hz) with rfl | rfl
    exacts [Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl]
  edge_inter := by
    intro e f he hf hef p hpe hpf
    rw [Graph.edgeSet_map] at he hf
    rw [edgeArc_mapDrawing] at hpe hpf
    obtain ⟨x, hxe, hxp⟩ := hpe
    obtain ⟨y, hyf, hyp⟩ := hpf
    have hxA : x ∈ A := hpoint ▸ edgeArc_subset_pointSet he hxe
    have hyA : y ∈ A := hpoint ▸ edgeArc_subset_pointSet hf hyf
    have hxy : x = y := m.injOn hxA hyA (hxp.trans hyp.symm)
    subst y
    obtain ⟨hxV, hie, hif⟩ := h.edge_inter he hf hef hxe hyf
    subst p
    exact ⟨by rw [Graph.vertexSet_map]; exact ⟨x, hxV, rfl⟩,
      hie.map m.toFun, hif.map m.toFun⟩

name: Graph.pointSet_congr
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointSet, pointSet]
  exact congrArg _ (Set.iUnion₂_congr fun e he => h he)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.pos_mem_skeletonSet
statement:
theorem Realization.pos_mem_skeletonSet (R : S.Realization) {v : γ} (hv : v ∈ V(S.skel)) :
    R.pos v ∈ R.skeletonSet
proof:
:=
  Graph.vertexSet_subset_pointSet (by rw [Realization.vertexSet_graph]; exact ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.skeletonSet_realize
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : (d.realize R earPos earDraw hE).skeletonSet =
      Graph.pointSet (R.graph.union (d.earGraph earPos)) (d.splitDrawing R earDraw) := by
    rw [← hE.splitGraph_eq]
    rfl
  rw [hstep, Graph.pointSet_union]
  congr 1
  · exact Graph.pointSet_congr fun e he =>
      edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_skel (by rwa [Realization.edgeSet_graph] at he)
  · exact Graph.pointSet_congr fun e he =>
      edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_ear (by rwa [d.edgeSet_earGraph] at he)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.skeletonSet_subset_realize
proof:
:=
  (skeletonSet_realize hE).symm ▸ Set.subset_union_left

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.isClosed_earSet
statement:
theorem isClosed_earSet {R : S.Realization} {earPos : γ → Plane} {earDraw : γ → ℝ → Plane}
    (hE : d.EarCrosscut R earPos earDraw) : IsClosed (d.earSet earPos earDraw)
proof:
:=
  hE.isArcBetween_earSet.isArc.isCompact.isClosed

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarHomeo.image_earSet
statement:
theorem image_earSet :
    m.toFun '' d.earSet earPos₁ earDraw₁ = d.earSet earPos₂ earDraw₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [earSet, earSet, Graph.pointSet, Graph.pointSet, Set.image_union, Set.image_iUnion₂]
  congr 1
  · rw [d.vertexSet_earGraph, d.vertexSet_earGraph, ← Set.image_comp]
    exact Set.image_congr fun z hz => m.earPos_apply hz
  · rw [d.edgeSet_earGraph, d.edgeSet_earGraph]
    exact Set.iUnion₂_congr fun f hf => m.edgeArc_image hf

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarHomeo.injOn
statement: theorem injOn : InjOn m.toFun (d.earSet earPos₁ earDraw₁)
proof: := m.leftInvOn.injOn

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarHomeo.mapsTo
statement:
theorem mapsTo :
    MapsTo m.toFun (d.earSet earPos₁ earDraw₁) (d.earSet earPos₂ earDraw₂)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => m.image_earSet ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarHomeo.mapsTo_invFun
statement:
theorem mapsTo_invFun :
    MapsTo m.invFun (d.earSet earPos₂ earDraw₂) (d.earSet earPos₁ earDraw₁)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rw [← m.image_earSet] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
  rw [m.leftInvOn hx]
  exact hx

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarHomeo.symm_toFun
statement: @[simp] theorem symm_toFun : m.symm.toFun = m.invFun
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarHomeo.symm_invFun
statement: @[simp] theorem symm_invFun : m.symm.invFun = m.toFun
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarHomeo.toFun_pos_source
statement:
theorem toFun_pos_source (hE₁ : d.EarCrosscut R₁ earPos₁ earDraw₁)
    (hE₂ : d.EarCrosscut R₂ earPos₂ earDraw₂) :
    m.toFun (R₁.pos d.source) = R₂.pos d.source
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hE₁.pos_source, m.earPos_apply d.source_mem_ear, hE₂.pos_source]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarHomeo.toFun_pos_target
statement:
theorem toFun_pos_target (hE₁ : d.EarCrosscut R₁ earPos₁ earDraw₁)
    (hE₂ : d.EarCrosscut R₂ earPos₂ earDraw₂) :
    m.toFun (R₁.pos d.target) = R₂.pos d.target
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hE₁.pos_target, m.earPos_apply d.target_mem_ear, hE₂.pos_target]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarHomeo.invFun_pos_source
statement:
theorem invFun_pos_source (hE₁ : d.EarCrosscut R₁ earPos₁ earDraw₁)
    (hE₂ : d.EarCrosscut R₂ earPos₂ earDraw₂) :
    m.invFun (R₂.pos d.source) = R₁.pos d.source
proof:
:= by
  rw [← m.toFun_pos_source hE₁ hE₂, m.leftInvOn hE₁.pos_source_mem_earSet]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarHomeo.invFun_pos_target
statement:
theorem invFun_pos_target (hE₁ : d.EarCrosscut R₁ earPos₁ earDraw₁)
    (hE₂ : d.EarCrosscut R₂ earPos₂ earDraw₂) :
    m.invFun (R₂.pos d.target) = R₁.pos d.target
proof:
:= by
  rw [← m.toFun_pos_target hE₁ hE₂, m.leftInvOn hE₁.pos_target_mem_earSet]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitMap_of_mem_skeletonSet
statement:
theorem splitMap_of_mem_skeletonSet {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ R₁.skeletonSet) :
    splitMap g m x = g.toFun x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [splitMap, if_pos hx]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitMap_eqOn_skeletonSet
statement: theorem splitMap_eqOn_skeletonSet : EqOn (splitMap g m) g.toFun R₁.skeletonSet
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => splitMap_of_mem_skeletonSet hx

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitInvMap_of_mem_skeletonSet
statement:
theorem splitInvMap_of_mem_skeletonSet {y : Plane} (hy : y ∈ R₂.skeletonSet) :
    splitInvMap g m y = g.invFun y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [splitInvMap, if_pos hy]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitInvMap_of_notMem_skeletonSet
statement:
theorem splitInvMap_of_notMem_skeletonSet {y : Plane} (hy : y ∉ R₂.skeletonSet) :
    splitInvMap g m y = m.invFun y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [splitInvMap, if_neg hy]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitMap_of_mem_earSet
statement:
theorem splitMap_of_mem_earSet {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ d.earSet earPos₁ earDraw₁) :
    splitMap g m x = m.toFun x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs : x ∈ R₁.skeletonSet
  · rw [splitMap, if_pos hs]
    have hends := hE₁.earSet_inter_skeletonSet ⟨hx, hs⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hends
    rcases hends with rfl | rfl
    · rw [g.pos_apply d.source_mem_skel, m.toFun_pos_source hE₁ hE₂]
    · rw [g.pos_apply d.target_mem_skel, m.toFun_pos_target hE₁ hE₂]
  · rw [splitMap, if_neg hs]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitMap_eqOn_earSet
statement: theorem splitMap_eqOn_earSet : EqOn (splitMap g m) m.toFun (d.earSet earPos₁ earDraw₁)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => splitMap_of_mem_earSet hE₁ hE₂ hx

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitInvMap_eqOn_earSet
statement:
theorem splitInvMap_eqOn_earSet :
    EqOn (splitInvMap g m) m.invFun (d.earSet earPos₂ earDraw₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y hy
  by_cases hs : y ∈ R₂.skeletonSet
  · rw [splitInvMap, if_pos hs]
    have hends := hE₂.earSet_inter_skeletonSet ⟨hy, hs⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hends
    rcases hends with rfl | rfl
    · have h : g.invFun (R₂.pos d.source) = R₁.pos d.source := g.symm.pos_apply d.source_mem_skel
      rw [h, m.invFun_pos_source hE₁ hE₂]
    · have h : g.invFun (R₂.pos d.target) = R₁.pos d.target := g.symm.pos_apply d.target_mem_skel
      rw [h, m.invFun_pos_target hE₁ hE₂]
  · rw [splitInvMap, if_neg hs]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.toFun_notMem_skeletonSet
statement:
theorem toFun_notMem_skeletonSet {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ d.earSet earPos₁ earDraw₁)
    (hs : x ∉ R₁.skeletonSet) : m.toFun x ∉ R₂.skeletonSet
proof:
:= by
  intro hcon
  have hends := hE₂.earSet_inter_skeletonSet ⟨m.mapsTo hx, hcon⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hends
  rcases hends with heq | heq
  · rw [← m.toFun_pos_source hE₁ hE₂] at heq
    exact hs (m.injOn hx hE₁.pos_source_mem_earSet heq ▸ R₁.pos_mem_skeletonSet d.source_mem_skel)
  · rw [← m.toFun_pos_target hE₁ hE₂] at heq
    exact hs (m.injOn hx hE₁.pos_target_mem_earSet heq ▸ R₁.pos_mem_skeletonSet d.target_mem_skel)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.invFun_notMem_skeletonSet
statement:
theorem invFun_notMem_skeletonSet {y : Plane} (hy : y ∈ d.earSet earPos₂ earDraw₂)
    (hs : y ∉ R₂.skeletonSet) : m.invFun y ∉ R₁.skeletonSet
proof:
:= by
  intro hcon
  have hx : m.invFun y ∈ d.earSet earPos₁ earDraw₁ := m.mapsTo_invFun hy
  have hends := hE₁.earSet_inter_skeletonSet ⟨hx, hcon⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hends
  have hback : m.toFun (m.invFun y) = y := m.rightInvOn hy
  rcases hends with heq | heq
  · rw [heq, m.toFun_pos_source hE₁ hE₂] at hback
    exact hs (hback ▸ R₂.pos_mem_skeletonSet d.source_mem_skel)
  · rw [heq, m.toFun_pos_target hE₁ hE₂] at hback
    exact hs (hback ▸ R₂.pos_mem_skeletonSet d.target_mem_skel)

name: Schoenflies.mem_segment_horiz
statement:
theorem mem_segment_horiz {u v c : ℝ} {x : Plane} :
    x ∈ segment ℝ (Plane.mk u c) (Plane.mk v c) ↔ x 1 = c ∧ x 0 ∈ segment ℝ u v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, p, q, hp, hq, hpq, ?_⟩
    · rw [Plane.smul_add_apply, Plane.mk_one, Plane.mk_one]
      linear_combination c * hpq
    · rw [Plane.smul_add_apply, Plane.mk_zero, Plane.mk_zero]
      simp [smul_eq_mul]
  · rintro ⟨hx1, p, q, hp, hq, hpq, hx0⟩
    refine ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, ?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · change (p • Plane.mk u c + q • Plane.mk v c) 0 = x 0
      rw [Plane.smul_add_apply, Plane.mk_zero, Plane.mk_zero, ← hx0]
      simp [smul_eq_mul]
    · change (p • Plane.mk u c + q • Plane.mk v c) 1 = x 1
      rw [Plane.smul_add_apply, Plane.mk_one, Plane.mk_one, hx1]
      linear_combination c * hpq

name: Schoenflies.mem_segment_vert
statement:
theorem mem_segment_vert {c u v : ℝ} {x : Plane} :
    x ∈ segment ℝ (Plane.mk c u) (Plane.mk c v) ↔ x 0 = c ∧ x 1 ∈ segment ℝ u v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, p, q, hp, hq, hpq, ?_⟩
    · rw [Plane.smul_add_apply, Plane.mk_zero, Plane.mk_zero]
      linear_combination c * hpq
    · rw [Plane.smul_add_apply, Plane.mk_one, Plane.mk_one]
      simp [smul_eq_mul]
  · rintro ⟨hx0, p, q, hp, hq, hpq, hx1⟩
    refine ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, ?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · change (p • Plane.mk c u + q • Plane.mk c v) 0 = x 0
      rw [Plane.smul_add_apply, Plane.mk_zero, Plane.mk_zero, hx0]
      linear_combination c * hpq
    · change (p • Plane.mk c u + q • Plane.mk c v) 1 = x 1
      rw [Plane.smul_add_apply, Plane.mk_one, Plane.mk_one, ← hx1]
      simp [smul_eq_mul]

name: Schoenflies.segment_one_neg_one
statement: theorem segment_one_neg_one : segment ℝ (1 : ℝ) (-1) = Icc (-1) 1
proof:

name: Schoenflies.mem_sideTop

proof:
:= by
  rw [sideTop, cornerNE, cornerNW, mem_segment_horiz, segment_one_neg_one]
  simp [abs_le, and_comm]

name: Schoenflies.mem_sideLeft
statement: theorem mem_sideLeft {x : Plane} : x ∈ sideLeft ↔ x 0 = -1 ∧ |x 1| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sideLeft, cornerNW, cornerSW, mem_segment_vert, segment_one_neg_one]
  simp [abs_le]

name: Schoenflies.mem_sideBottom
statement: theorem mem_sideBottom {x : Plane} : x ∈ sideBottom ↔ x 1 = -1 ∧ |x 0| ≤ 1

name: Schoenflies.mem_sideRight
statement: theorem mem_sideRight {x : Plane} : x ∈ sideRight ↔ x 0 = 1 ∧ |x 1| ≤ 1

name: Schoenflies.modelCurve_eq_sides
statement:
theorem modelCurve_eq_sides :
    modelCurve = (sideTop ∪ sideLeft) ∪ (sideBottom ∪ sideRight)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [modelCurve, mem_setOf_eq, mem_union, mem_sideTop, mem_sideLeft, mem_sideBottom,
    mem_sideRight, Plane.supNorm]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 : |x 0| ≤ 1 := h ▸ le_max_left _ _
    have h1 : |x 1| ≤ 1 := h ▸ le_max_right _ _
    rcases max_choice |x 0| |x 1| with hm | hm
    · 
      have hx : |x 0| = 1 := hm ▸ h
      rcases (abs_eq (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1)).mp hx with h' | h'
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h', h1⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨h', h1⟩)
    · have hx : |x 1| = 1 := hm ▸ h
      rcases (abs_eq (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1)).mp hx with h' | h'
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨h', h0⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h', h0⟩)
  · rintro ((⟨h1, h0⟩ | ⟨h0, h1⟩) | (⟨h1, h0⟩ | ⟨h0, h1⟩))
    · rw [show |x 1| = 1 by rw [h1]; norm_num]
      exact max_eq_right h0
    · rw [show |x 0| = 1 by rw [h0]; norm_num]
      exact max_eq_left h1
    · rw [show |x 1| = 1 by rw [h1]; norm_num]
      exact max_eq_right h0
    · rw [show |x 0| = 1 by rw [h0]; norm_num]
      exact max_eq_left h1

name: Schoenflies.cornerNE_ne_cornerNW
statement: theorem cornerNE_ne_cornerNW : cornerNE ≠ cornerNW
proof:

name: Schoenflies.sideTop_meet_sideLeft
statement: theorem sideTop_meet_sideLeft : ∀ z ∈ sideTop, z ∈ sideLeft → z = cornerNW
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz hz'
  rw [mem_sideTop] at hz
  rw [mem_sideLeft] at hz'
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [cornerNW] using hz'.1
  · simpa [cornerNW] using hz.1

name: Schoenflies.sideBottom_meet_sideRight
statement: theorem sideBottom_meet_sideRight : ∀ z ∈ sideBottom, z ∈ sideRight → z = cornerSE
proof:
:= by

  rw [mem_sideBottom] at hz

  ext i

  · simpa [cornerSE] using hz.1

name: Schoenflies.isArcBetween_upperSides
statement: theorem isArcBetween_upperSides : IsArcBetween (sideTop ∪ sideLeft) cornerNE cornerSW
proof:
:=
  isArcBetween_sideTop.concatenate isArcBetween_sideLeft sideTop_meet_sideLeft

name: Schoenflies.isArcBetween_lowerSides
statement: theorem isArcBetween_lowerSides : IsArcBetween (sideBottom ∪ sideRight) cornerSW cornerNE
proof:
:=
  isArcBetween_sideBottom.concatenate isArcBetween_sideRight sideBottom_meet_sideRight

name: Schoenflies.upperSides_meet_lowerSides
statement:
theorem upperSides_meet_lowerSides :
    ∀ z ∈ sideTop ∪ sideLeft, z ∈ sideBottom ∪ sideRight → z = cornerNE ∨ z = cornerSW
proof:
:= by
  rintro z (hz | hz) (hz' | hz')
  · 
    rw [mem_sideTop] at hz
    rw [mem_sideBottom] at hz'
    rw [hz.1] at hz'
    norm_num at hz'
  · 
    rw [mem_sideTop] at hz
    rw [mem_sideRight] at hz'
    refine Or.inl ?_
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [cornerNE] using hz'.1
    · simpa [cornerNE] using hz.1
  · 
    rw [mem_sideLeft] at hz
    rw [mem_sideBottom] at hz'
    refine Or.inr ?_
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [cornerSW] using hz.1
    · simpa [cornerSW] using hz'.1
  · 
    rw [mem_sideLeft] at hz
    rw [mem_sideRight] at hz'
    rw [hz.1] at hz'
    norm_num at hz'

statement: theorem smul_coord (a : ℝ) (x : Plane) (i : Fin 2) : (a • x) i = a * x i

name: Schoenflies.mem_closedSquare_zero_one
statement:
theorem mem_closedSquare_zero_one {x : Plane} :
    x ∈ Plane.closedSquare 0 1 ↔ Plane.supNorm x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Plane.closedSquare]

name: Schoenflies.mem_openSquare_zero_one

statement: theorem modelCurve_subset_closedSquare : modelCurve ⊆ Plane.closedSquare 0 1

  fun _ hx => mem_closedSquare_zero_one.mpr (le_of_eq hx)

name: Schoenflies.notMem_interior_closedSquare
statement:
theorem notMem_interior_closedSquare {x : Plane} (hx : Plane.supNorm x = 1) :
    x ∉ interior (Plane.closedSquare 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds, Metric.mem_nhds_iff] at hmem
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := hmem
  have hx' : max |x 0| |x 1| = 1 := hx
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx
    simp [Plane.supNorm] at hx
  have hnx : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx0
  set δ : ℝ := ε / (2 * ‖x‖) with hδdef
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε (by linarith)
  
  have hdist : dist ((1 + δ) • x) x < ε := by
    have hsub : (1 + δ) • x - x = δ • x := by module
    have hmul : δ * ‖x‖ = ε / 2 := by
      rw [hδdef]; field_simp
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ, hmul]
    linarith
  have hin : Plane.supNorm ((1 + δ) • x) ≤ 1 :=
    mem_closedSquare_zero_one.mp (hball (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hdist))
  
  have hgrown : 1 + δ ≤ Plane.supNorm ((1 + δ) • x) := by
    rcases max_choice |x 0| |x 1| with hm | hm
    · have h0 : |x 0| = 1 := by rw [← hm]; exact hx'
      calc 1 + δ = |(1 + δ) * x 0| := by
            rw [abs_mul, h0, abs_of_pos (by linarith), mul_one]
        _ = |((1 + δ) • x) 0| := by rw [smul_coord]
        _ ≤ Plane.supNorm ((1 + δ) • x) := Plane.abs_zero_le_supNorm _
    · have h1 : |x 1| = 1 := by rw [← hm]; exact hx'
      calc 1 + δ = |(1 + δ) * x 1| := by
            rw [abs_mul, h1, abs_of_pos (by linarith), mul_one]
        _ = |((1 + δ) • x) 1| := by rw [smul_coord]
        _ ≤ Plane.supNorm ((1 + δ) • x) := Plane.abs_one_le_supNorm _
  linarith

name: Schoenflies.interior_closedSquare_zero_one
statement:
theorem interior_closedSquare_zero_one :
    interior (Plane.closedSquare 0 1) = Plane.openSquare 0 1
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) ?_
  · rw [mem_openSquare_zero_one]
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (mem_closedSquare_zero_one.mp (interior_subset hx)) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd hx (notMem_interior_closedSquare h)
  · exact (Plane.isOpen_openSquare 0 1).subset_interior_iff.mpr fun x hx =>
      mem_closedSquare_zero_one.mpr (mem_openSquare_zero_one.mp hx).le

name: Schoenflies.modelCurve_eq_frontier
statement: theorem modelCurve_eq_frontier : modelCurve = frontier (Plane.closedSquare 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(Plane.isClosed_closedSquare 0 1).frontier_eq, interior_closedSquare_zero_one]
  ext x
  simp only [modelCurve, mem_setOf_eq, mem_sdiff, mem_closedSquare_zero_one,
    mem_openSquare_zero_one, not_lt]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.le, h.ge⟩, fun h => le_antisymm h.1 h.2⟩

name: Schoenflies.IsLoop.param_eq_or
statement:
theorem param_eq_or (hf : IsLoop f) {s t : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ I) (ht : t ∈ I) (h : f s = f t) :
    s = t ∨ (s = 0 ∧ t = 1) ∨ (s = 1 ∧ t = 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs1 : s = 1 <;> by_cases ht1 : t = 1
  · exact Or.inl (hs1.trans ht1.symm)
  · 
    subst hs1
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) = t :=
      hf.injOn ⟨le_rfl, zero_lt_one⟩ ⟨ht.1, lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 ht1⟩ (hf.closes.trans h)
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, h0.symm⟩)
  · subst ht1
    have h0 : s = 0 :=
      hf.injOn ⟨hs.1, lt_of_le_of_ne hs.2 hs1⟩ ⟨le_rfl, zero_lt_one⟩ (h.trans hf.closes.symm)
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h0, rfl⟩)
  · exact Or.inl
      (hf.injOn ⟨hs.1, lt_of_le_of_ne hs.2 hs1⟩ ⟨ht.1, lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 ht1⟩ h)

name: Schoenflies.IsLoop.eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_eq (hf : IsLoop f) (hg : IsLoop g) {s t : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ I) (ht : t ∈ I)
    (h : f s = f t) : g s = g t
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf.param_eq_or hs ht h with rfl | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · rfl
  · exact hg.closes
  · exact hg.closes.symm

name: Schoenflies.IsLoop.exists_homeomorph
statement:
theorem exists_homeomorph (hf : IsLoop f) (hg : IsLoop g) :
    ∃ h : ↥(f '' I) ≃ₜ ↥(g '' I),
      ∀ (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ I), (h ⟨f t, mem_image_of_mem f ht⟩ : Plane) = g t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥I := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp isCompact_I
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥(f '' I) :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_I.image_of_continuousOn hf.continuousOn)
  
  set q : ↥I → ↥(f '' I) := fun t => ⟨f t, mem_image_of_mem f t.2⟩ with hq
  set q' : ↥I → ↥(g '' I) := fun t => ⟨g t, mem_image_of_mem g t.2⟩ with hq'
  have hqc : Continuous q := (hf.continuousOn.restrict).subtype_mk _
  have hq'c : Continuous q' := (hg.continuousOn.restrict).subtype_mk _
  have hqs : Function.Surjective q := by
    rintro ⟨z, t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, rfl⟩
  have hq's : Function.Surjective q' := by
    rintro ⟨z, t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, rfl⟩
  have hquot : IsQuotientMap q := (hqc.isClosedMap).isQuotientMap hqc hqs
  
  set F : ↥(f '' I) → ↥(g '' I) := fun a => q' (Classical.choose (hqs a)) with hF
  have hFq : ∀ t : ↥I, F (q t) = q' t := by
    intro t
    have hchoice := Classical.choose_spec (hqs (q t))
    exact Subtype.ext
      (hf.eq_of_eq hg (Classical.choose (hqs (q t))).2 t.2 (congrArg Subtype.val hchoice))
  have hFc : Continuous F := by
    refine hquot.continuous_iff.mpr ?_
    have : F ∘ q = q' := funext hFq
    rw [this]
    exact hq'c
  have hFinj : Function.Injective F := by
    intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hqs a
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hqs b
    rw [hFq, hFq] at hab
    exact Subtype.ext (hg.eq_of_eq hf s.2 t.2 (congrArg Subtype.val hab))
  have hFsurj : Function.Surjective F := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hq's b
    exact ⟨q t, hFq t⟩
  refine ⟨Continuous.homeoOfEquivCompactToT2 (f := Equiv.ofBijective F ⟨hFinj, hFsurj⟩) hFc,
    fun t ht => ?_⟩
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (hFq ⟨t, ht⟩)

name: Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve.homeomorph
statement:
theorem homeomorph {C D : Set Plane} (hC : IsJordanCurve C) (hD : IsJordanCurve D) :
    Nonempty (↥C ≃ₜ ↥D)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hC
  obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := hD
  obtain ⟨h, -⟩ := hf.exists_homeomorph hg
  exact ⟨h⟩

name: Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve.homeomorph_modelCurve
statement:
theorem homeomorph_modelCurve {C : Set Plane} (hC : IsJordanCurve C) :
    Nonempty (↥C ≃ₜ ↥modelCurve)
proof:
:=
  hC.homeomorph isJordanCurve_modelCurve

name: Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve.modelCurve_homeomorph
statement:
theorem modelCurve_homeomorph {C : Set Plane} (hC : IsJordanCurve C) :
    Nonempty (↥modelCurve ≃ₜ ↥C)
proof:
:=
  isJordanCurve_modelCurve.homeomorph hC

name: Graph.chainUnion_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chainUnion_zero (Γ : ℕ → Graph α β) (i : ℕ) : chainUnion Γ i 0 = Γ i
proof: := rfl

name: Graph.chainUnion_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chainUnion_succ (Γ : ℕ → Graph α β) (i m : ℕ) :
    chainUnion Γ i (m + 1) = (chainUnion Γ i m).union (Γ (i + m + 1))
proof: := rfl

name: Graph.chainUnion_one
statement:
theorem chainUnion_one (Γ : ℕ → Graph α β) (i : ℕ) :
    chainUnion Γ i 1 = (Γ i).union (Γ (i + 1))
proof: := rfl

name: Graph.mem_vertexSet_chainUnion
statement:
theorem mem_vertexSet_chainUnion {x : α} :
    x ∈ V(chainUnion Γ i m) ↔ ∃ p, i ≤ p ∧ p ≤ i + m ∧ x ∈ V(Γ p)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun h => ⟨i, le_rfl, by omega, h⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨p, hp, hp', hx⟩
    obtain rfl : p = i := by omega
    exact hx
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [chainUnion_succ, vertexSet_union, Set.mem_union, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨p, hp, hp', hx⟩ | hx)
      · exact ⟨p, hp, by omega, hx⟩
      · exact ⟨i + m + 1, by omega, by omega, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, hp, hp', hx⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p (i + m + 1) with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨p, hp, by omega, hx⟩
      · obtain rfl : p = i + m + 1 := by omega
        exact Or.inr hx

name: Graph.mem_edgeSet_chainUnion
statement:
theorem mem_edgeSet_chainUnion {e : β} :
    e ∈ E(chainUnion Γ i m) ↔ ∃ p, i ≤ p ∧ p ≤ i + m ∧ e ∈ E(Γ p)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun h => ⟨i, le_rfl, by omega, h⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨p, hp, hp', he⟩
    obtain rfl : p = i := by omega
    exact he
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [chainUnion_succ, edgeSet_union, Set.mem_union, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨p, hp, hp', he⟩ | he)
      · exact ⟨p, hp, by omega, he⟩
      · exact ⟨i + m + 1, by omega, by omega, he⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, hp, hp', he⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p (i + m + 1) with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨p, hp, by omega, he⟩
      · obtain rfl : p = i + m + 1 := by omega
        exact Or.inr he

name: Graph.chainUnion_le
statement: theorem chainUnion_le (h : ∀ p, i ≤ p → p ≤ i + m → Γ p ≤ G) : chainUnion Γ i m ≤ G
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact h i le_rfl le_rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    exact union_le (ih fun p hp hp' => h p hp (by omega)) (h (i + m + 1) (by omega) le_rfl)

name: Graph.le_chainUnion
statement:
theorem le_chainUnion (hle : ∀ q, i ≤ q → q ≤ i + m → Γ q ≤ G) (hp : i ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ i + m) :
    Γ p ≤ chainUnion Γ i m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    obtain rfl : p = i := by omega
    exact le_rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p (i + m + 1) with h | h
    · exact (ih (fun q hq hq' => hle q hq (by omega)) (by omega)).trans (left_le_union _ _)
    · obtain rfl : p = i + m + 1 := by omega
      have hcompat : (chainUnion Γ i m).Compatible (Γ (i + m + 1)) :=
        Compatible.of_le_le (chainUnion_le fun q hq hq' => hle q hq (by omega))
          (hle _ (by omega) le_rfl)
      exact hcompat.right_le_union

name: Graph.chainUnion_finite
statement:
theorem chainUnion_finite (h : ∀ p, i ≤ p → p ≤ i + m → (Γ p).Finite) :
    (chainUnion Γ i m).Finite
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact h i le_rfl le_rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    have h1 := ih fun p hp hp' => h p hp (by omega)
    have h2 := h (i + m + 1) (by omega) le_rfl
    exact { finite_vertexSet := by
              rw [chainUnion_succ, vertexSet_union]
              exact h1.finite_vertexSet.union h2.finite_vertexSet
            finite_edgeSet := by
              rw [chainUnion_succ, edgeSet_union]
              exact h1.finite_edgeSet.union h2.finite_edgeSet }

name: Graph.chainUnion_isTwoConnected
statement:
theorem chainUnion_isTwoConnected (hle : ∀ q, i ≤ q → q ≤ i + m → Γ q ≤ G)
    (htc : ∀ q, i ≤ q → q ≤ i + m → (Γ q).IsTwoConnected)
    (hmeet : ∀ q, i ≤ q → q < i + m → ∃ a b : α, a ≠ b ∧ a ∈ V(Γ q) ∧ a ∈ V(Γ (q + 1)) ∧
      b ∈ V(Γ q) ∧ b ∈ V(Γ (q + 1))) :
    (chainUnion Γ i m).IsTwoConnected
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact htc i le_rfl le_rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    have hle' : ∀ q, i ≤ q → q ≤ i + m → Γ q ≤ G := fun q hq hq' => hle q hq (by omega)
    have hih := ih hle' (fun q hq hq' => htc q hq (by omega))
      (fun q hq hq' => hmeet q hq (by omega))
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, haq, haq', hbq, hbq'⟩ := hmeet (i + m) (by omega) (by omega)
    have hsub : Γ (i + m) ≤ chainUnion Γ i m := le_chainUnion hle' (by omega) le_rfl
    have hcompat : (chainUnion Γ i m).Compatible (Γ (i + m + 1)) :=
      Compatible.of_le_le (chainUnion_le hle') (hle _ (by omega) le_rfl)
    exact hih.union hcompat (htc _ (by omega) le_rfl) hab (hsub.vertexSet_mono haq) haq'
      (hsub.vertexSet_mono hbq) hbq'

name: Graph.IsCycleThrough.mem_edgeSet_cons
statement:
theorem IsCycleThrough.mem_edgeSet_cons {e g : β} {u v : α} {D : List β}
    (h : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D) (hg : g ∈ e :: D) : g ∈ E(G)
proof:
:= by
  rcases List.mem_cons.1 hg with rfl | hg
  · exact h.isLink.edge_mem
  · exact h.isPath.edge_mem hg

name: Graph.IsCycleThrough.anti
statement:
theorem IsCycleThrough.anti {e : β} {u v : α} {D : List β} (h : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D)
    (hKG : K ≤ G) (hE : ∀ g ∈ e :: D, g ∈ E(K)) : K.IsCycleThrough e u v D
proof:
:= by
  have he : e ∈ E(K) := hE e List.mem_cons_self
  have hl : K.IsLink e u v := (hKG.isLink_iff he).2 h.isLink
  exact ⟨hl, h.isPath.anti hKG hl.left_mem fun g hg => hE g (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hg),
    h.notMem⟩

name: Graph.IsCycleThrough.mono
statement:
theorem IsCycleThrough.mono {e : β} {u v : α} {D : List β} (h : K.IsCycleThrough e u v D)
    (hKG : K ≤ G) : G.IsCycleThrough e u v D
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.isLink.mono hKG, h.isPath.mono hKG, h.notMem⟩

name: Graph.exists_spliced_cycles
statement:
theorem exists_spliced_cycles {H F : Graph α β} {e : β} {u v a b : α} {D R D₁ D₂ : List β}
    (hcyc : H.IsCycleThrough e u v D) (hcc : IsCycleCrosscut H F e u v D a b R D₁ D₂) :
    ∃ (e₁ e₂ : β) (u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂ : α) (T₁ T₂ : List β),
      H.IsCycleThrough e₁ u₁ v₁ T₁ ∧ H.IsCycleThrough e₂ u₂ v₂ T₂ ∧
        (e₁ :: T₁).Perm (D₁ ++ R) ∧ (e₂ :: T₂).Perm (D₂ ++ R)
proof:
:= by
  have hBle : H.cycleGraph u e D ≤ H := hcyc.cycleGraph_le
  have haB : a ∈ V(H.cycleGraph u e D) := by
    rw [hcyc.cycleGraph_vertexSet]; exact hcc.mem_left
  
  have harc : ∀ {W : List β}, (∀ g ∈ W, g ∈ D₁ ++ D₂) →
      ∀ g ∈ W, g ∈ E(H.cycleGraph u e D) := by
    intro W hW g hg
    rw [hcyc.cycleGraph_edgeSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, List.mem_append]
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 (hcc.split.mem_iff.1 (hW g hg)) with rfl | h
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_singleton_self _)
    · exact Or.inl h
  have hnew : ∀ g ∈ R, g ∉ E(H.cycleGraph u e D) := by
    intro g hg hmem
    rw [hcyc.cycleGraph_edgeSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hmem
    exact hcc.edges_new g hg hmem
  have hint : ∀ y ∈ H.walkVertices a R, y ≠ a → y ≠ b → y ∉ V(H.cycleGraph u e D) := by
    intro y hy hya hyb
    rw [hcyc.cycleGraph_vertexSet]
    exact hcc.interior y hy hya hyb
  have hHle : (H.cycleGraph u e D).union (H.pathGraphOf a R) ≤ H :=
    union_le hBle (pathGraphOf_le hcc.isPath.isWalk)
  
  obtain ⟨f₁, x₁, y₁, T₁, hc₁, hp₁⟩ :=
    exists_spliced_cycle hBle
      (hcc.arc₁.anti hBle haB (harc fun g hg => List.mem_append_left _ hg))
      hcc.isPath hcc.ne hnew hint
  
  obtain ⟨f₂, x₂, y₂, T₂, hc₂, hp₂⟩ :=
    exists_spliced_cycle hBle
      (hcc.arc₂.reverse.anti hBle haB
        (harc fun g hg => List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_reverse.1 hg)))
      hcc.isPath hcc.ne hnew hint
  exact ⟨f₁, f₂, x₁, y₁, x₂, y₂, T₁, T₂, hc₁.mono hHle, hc₂.mono hHle, hp₁,
    hp₂.trans ((List.reverse_perm D₂).append_right R)⟩

name: Graph.mem_edgesOutside
statement:
theorem mem_edgesOutside {H : Graph α β} {W : List β} {g : β} :
    g ∈ edgesOutside H W ↔ g ∈ W ∧ g ∉ E(H)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Graph.finite_edgesOutside
statement: theorem finite_edgesOutside (H : Graph α β) (W : List β) : (edgesOutside H W).Finite
proof:
:=
  (W.finite_toSet).subset fun _ hg => hg.1

name: Graph.edgesOutside_append
statement:
theorem edgesOutside_append (H : Graph α β) (W₁ W₂ : List β) :
    edgesOutside H (W₁ ++ W₂) = edgesOutside H W₁ ∪ edgesOutside H W₂
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [mem_edgesOutside, List.mem_append, Set.mem_union]
  tauto

name: Graph.edgesOutside_perm
statement:
theorem edgesOutside_perm {H : Graph α β} {W₁ W₂ : List β} (hp : W₁.Perm W₂) :
    edgesOutside H W₁ = edgesOutside H W₂
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [mem_edgesOutside, hp.mem_iff]

name: Graph.edgesOutside_eq_empty
statement:
theorem edgesOutside_eq_empty {H : Graph α β} {W : List β} (h : ∀ g ∈ W, g ∈ E(H)) :
    edgesOutside H W = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [mem_edgesOutside, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_not]
  exact h g

name: Graph.edgesOutside_splice_lt
statement:
theorem edgesOutside_splice_lt {H : Graph α β} {W W' D₁ D₂ R : List β} (hnodup : W.Nodup)
    (hperm : W.Perm (D₁ ++ D₂)) (hperm' : W'.Perm (D₁ ++ R)) (hR : ∀ g ∈ R, g ∈ E(H))
    (hD₂ : ∃ g ∈ D₂, g ∉ E(H)) :
    (edgesOutside H W').ncard < (edgesOutside H W).ncard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgD₂, hgH⟩ := hD₂
  have hdisj : List.Disjoint D₁ D₂ :=
    List.disjoint_of_nodup_append ((List.Perm.nodup_iff hperm).1 hnodup)
  have hW' : edgesOutside H W' = edgesOutside H D₁ := by
    rw [edgesOutside_perm hperm', edgesOutside_append, edgesOutside_eq_empty hR,
      Set.union_empty]
  have hW : edgesOutside H W = edgesOutside H D₁ ∪ edgesOutside H D₂ := by
    rw [edgesOutside_perm hperm, edgesOutside_append]
  have hsub : edgesOutside H W' ⊆ edgesOutside H W := by
    rw [hW', hW]; exact Set.subset_union_left
  refine Set.ncard_lt_ncard ((Set.ssubset_iff_of_subset hsub).2 ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩)
    (finite_edgesOutside H W)
  · rw [hW]; exact Or.inr ⟨hgD₂, hgH⟩
  · rw [hW']
    exact fun hg' => hdisj hg'.1 hgD₂

name: Graph.Encloses.mono
statement: theorem Encloses.mono (hHK : H ≤ K) (h : Encloses H drawing x) : Encloses K drawing x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, u, v, D, hc, hin⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, u, v, D, ⟨hc.isLink.mono hHK, hc.isPath.mono hHK, hc.notMem⟩, hin⟩

name: Graph.isBounded_face_of_encloses
statement:
theorem isBounded_face_of_encloses (hx : x ∈ exterior H drawing)
    (henc : Encloses H drawing x) : Bornology.IsBounded (face H drawing x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, u, v, D, hcyc, hin⟩ := henc
  have hsub : edgesCover drawing (e :: D) ⊆ pointSet H drawing :=
    edgesCover_subset_pointSet fun g hg => hcyc.mem_edgeSet_cons hg
  
  
  have h1 : face H drawing x ⊆ connectedComponentIn (edgesCover drawing (e :: D))ᶜ x :=
    IsPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
      (mem_face hx) fun w hw hw' => (face_subset_exterior _ _ _ hw) (hsub hw')
  exact (mem_inside_iff.1 hin).2.subset h1

name: Graph.encloses_of_isBounded_face
statement:
theorem encloses_of_isBounded_face [H.Finite] (hd : IsDrawing H drawing)
    (hpoly : ∀ g ∈ E(H), IsPolygonal (edgeArc drawing g)) (h2 : H.IsTwoConnected)
    (hx : x ∈ exterior H drawing) (hb : Bornology.IsBounded (face H drawing x)) :
    Encloses H drawing x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, u, v, D, hfc⟩ := face_cycles' hd hpoly h2 x hx
  exact ⟨e, u, v, D, hfc.isCycle, hfc.eq_inside_of_isBounded' hb ▸ mem_face hx⟩

name: Graph.exists_cycle_edgesOutside_lt
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_edgesOutside_lt {H F : Graph Plane β} {e : β} {u v : Plane} {D : List β}
    (hcyc : H.IsCycleThrough e u v D) {D₁ D₂ R : List β} (hperm : (e :: D).Perm (D₁ ++ D₂))
    (hR : ∀ g ∈ R, g ∈ E(F)) (h₁ : ∃ g ∈ D₁, g ∉ E(F)) (h₂ : ∃ g ∈ D₂, g ∉ E(F))
    {e₁ e₂ : β} {u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂ : Plane} {T₁ T₂ : List β}
    (hZ₁ : H.IsCycleThrough e₁ u₁ v₁ T₁) (hZ₂ : H.IsCycleThrough e₂ u₂ v₂ T₂)
    (hp₁ : (e₁ :: T₁).Perm (D₁ ++ R)) (hp₂ : (e₂ :: T₂).Perm (D₂ ++ R))
    (hone : x ∈ inside (edgesCover drawing (e₁ :: T₁)) ∨
      x ∈ inside (edgesCover drawing (e₂ :: T₂))) :
    ∃ (e' : β) (u' v' : Plane) (D' : List β), H.IsCycleThrough e' u' v' D' ∧
      x ∈ inside (edgesCover drawing (e' :: D')) ∧
      (edgesOutside F (e' :: D')).ncard < (edgesOutside F (e :: D)).ncard
proof:
:= by
  
  have hnodup : (e :: D).Nodup := List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨hcyc.notMem, hcyc.isPath.nodup⟩
  rcases hone with hx | hx
  · exact ⟨e₁, u₁, v₁, T₁, hZ₁, hx, edgesOutside_splice_lt hnodup hperm hp₁ hR h₂⟩
  · exact ⟨e₂, u₂, v₂, T₂, hZ₂, hx,
      edgesOutside_splice_lt hnodup (hperm.trans List.perm_append_comm) hp₂ hR h₁⟩

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.block_le
statement: theorem block_le (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hm : i + m ≤ n) : chainUnion Γ i m ≤ G
proof:
:=
  chainUnion_le fun p _ hp' => h.le_ambient p (by omega)

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.le_block
statement:
theorem le_block (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hm : i + m ≤ n) (hp : i ≤ p)
    (hp' : p ≤ i + m) : Γ p ≤ chainUnion Γ i m
proof:
:=
  le_chainUnion (G := G) (fun q _ hq' => h.le_ambient q (by omega)) hp hp'

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.block_finite
statement:
theorem block_finite (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hm : i + m ≤ n) :
    (chainUnion Γ i m).Finite
proof:
:=
  chainUnion_finite fun p _ hp' => h.finite p (by omega)

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.block_isDrawing
statement:
theorem block_isDrawing (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hm : i + m ≤ n) :
    IsDrawing (chainUnion Γ i m) drawing
proof:
:=
  h.isDrawing.mono (h.block_le hm)

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.block_polygonal
statement:
theorem block_polygonal (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hm : i + m ≤ n) :
    ∀ g ∈ E(chainUnion Γ i m), IsPolygonal (edgeArc drawing g)
proof:
:=
  fun g hg => h.polygonal g ((h.block_le hm).edgeSet_mono hg)

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.block_isTwoConnected
statement:
theorem block_isTwoConnected (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hm : i + m ≤ n) :
    (chainUnion Γ i m).IsTwoConnected
proof:
:=
  chainUnion_isTwoConnected (G := G) (fun q _ hq' => h.le_ambient q (by omega))
    (fun q _ hq' => h.twoConnected q (by omega)) fun q _ hq' => h.meet q (by omega)

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.mem_pointSet_block
statement:
theorem mem_pointSet_block {z : Plane} (hz : z ∈ pointSet (chainUnion Γ i m) drawing) :
    ∃ p, i ≤ p ∧ p ≤ i + m ∧ z ∈ pointSet (Γ p) drawing
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact ⟨i, le_rfl, le_rfl, hz⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [chainUnion_succ, pointSet_union, Set.mem_union] at hz
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hp', hzp⟩ := ih hz
      exact ⟨p, hp, by omega, hzp⟩
    · exact ⟨i + m + 1, by omega, by omega, hz⟩

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.disjoint_block_far
statement:
theorem disjoint_block_far (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hm : i + m + 2 ≤ n) :
    Disjoint (pointSet (chainUnion Γ i m) drawing) (pointSet (Γ (i + m + 2)) drawing)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro z hz hz'
  obtain ⟨q, -, hq', hzq⟩ := mem_pointSet_block hz
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (h.disjoint q (i + m + 2) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) hzq hz'

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.disjoint_vertexSet
statement:
theorem disjoint_vertexSet (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) {q : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ n) (hq : q ≤ n)
    (hpq : p + 1 < q) : Disjoint V(Γ p) V(Γ q)
proof:
:=
  (h.disjoint p q hp hq hpq).mono vertexSet_subset_pointSet vertexSet_subset_pointSet

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.disjoint_edgeSet
statement:
theorem disjoint_edgeSet (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) {q : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ n) (hq : q ≤ n)
    (hpq : p + 1 < q) : Disjoint E(Γ p) E(Γ q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro g hgp hgq
  have hmem : drawing g 0 ∈ edgeArc drawing g := ⟨0, unitInterval.zero_mem, rfl⟩
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (h.disjoint p q hp hq hpq)
    (edgeArc_subset_pointSet hgp hmem) (edgeArc_subset_pointSet hgq hmem)

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.not_encloses_pair
statement:
theorem not_encloses_pair (hout : OuterOnPairs Γ drawing n x) (hp : p + 1 ≤ n) :
    ¬ Encloses (chainUnion Γ p 1) drawing x
proof:
:= fun henc =>
  (hout p hp).2 (isBounded_face_of_encloses (hout p hp).1 henc)

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.not_encloses_single
statement:
theorem not_encloses_single (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hout : OuterOnPairs Γ drawing n x)
    (hp : p ≤ n) : ¬ Encloses (Γ p) drawing x
proof:
:= by
  intro henc
  have hn : 2 ≤ n := h.two_le
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p n with hlt | hge
  · exact not_encloses_pair hout (by omega)
      (henc.mono (h.le_block (i := p) (m := 1) (by omega) le_rfl (by omega)))
  · 
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, n = q + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain rfl : p = q + 1 := by omega
    exact not_encloses_pair hout (by omega)
      (henc.mono (h.le_block (i := q) (m := 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)))

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.not_encloses
statement:
theorem not_encloses (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hout : OuterOnPairs Γ drawing n x)
    (hdesc : Descent Γ drawing n x) :
    ∀ m i, i + m ≤ n → ¬ Encloses (chainUnion Γ i m) drawing x
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    match m with
    | 0 => exact fun i him => h.not_encloses_single hout (by omega)
    | 1 => exact fun i him => not_encloses_pair hout (by omega)
    | (m + 2) =>
      intro i him henc
      
      
      have inner : ∀ c (e : β) (u v : Plane) (D : List β),
          (chainUnion Γ i (m + 2)).IsCycleThrough e u v D →
          x ∈ inside (edgesCover drawing (e :: D)) →
          (edgesOutside (Γ (i + m + 1)) (e :: D)).ncard < c → False := by
        intro c
        induction c with
        | zero => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ _ hlt => absurd hlt (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
        | succ c ihc =>
          intro e u v D hcyc hin hlt
          
          have hmem : ∀ g ∈ e :: D, ∃ q, i ≤ q ∧ q ≤ i + (m + 2) ∧ g ∈ E(Γ q) := fun g hg =>
            mem_edgeSet_chainUnion.1 (hcyc.mem_edgeSet_cons hg)
          
          
          have hA : ∃ g ∈ e :: D, g ∈ E(Γ (i + m + 2)) ∧ g ∉ E(Γ (i + m + 1)) := by
            by_contra hcon
            push Not at hcon
            have hE : ∀ g ∈ e :: D, g ∈ E(chainUnion Γ i (m + 1)) := by
              intro g hg
              obtain ⟨q, hq, hq', hgq⟩ := hmem g hg
              rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q (i + m + 2) with hlt' | hge'
              · exact mem_edgeSet_chainUnion.2 ⟨q, hq, by omega, hgq⟩
              · obtain rfl : q = i + m + 2 := by omega
                exact mem_edgeSet_chainUnion.2
                  ⟨i + m + 1, by omega, by omega, hcon g hg hgq⟩
            exact ih (m + 1) (by omega) i (by omega)
              ⟨e, u, v, D, hcyc.anti (left_le_union _ _) hE, hin⟩
          
          
          have hB : ∃ g ∈ e :: D, g ∈ E(chainUnion Γ i m) ∧ g ∉ E(Γ (i + m + 1)) := by
            by_contra hcon
            push Not at hcon
            have hpair : chainUnion Γ (i + m + 1) 1 ≤ chainUnion Γ i (m + 2) :=
              chainUnion_le fun q hq hq' =>
                h.le_block him (by omega) (by omega)
            have hE : ∀ g ∈ e :: D, g ∈ E(chainUnion Γ (i + m + 1) 1) := by
              intro g hg
              obtain ⟨q, hq, hq', hgq⟩ := hmem g hg
              rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q (i + m + 1) with hlt' | hge'
              · exact mem_edgeSet_chainUnion.2 ⟨i + m + 1, by omega, by omega,
                  hcon g hg (mem_edgeSet_chainUnion.2 ⟨q, hq, by omega, hgq⟩)⟩
              · exact mem_edgeSet_chainUnion.2 ⟨q, by omega, by omega, hgq⟩
            exact ih 1 (by omega) (i + m + 1) (by omega)
              ⟨e, u, v, D, hcyc.anti hpair hE, hin⟩
          
          obtain ⟨e', u', v', D', hcyc', hin', hlt'⟩ := hdesc i m him e u v D hcyc hin hA hB
          exact ihc e' u' v' D' hcyc' hin' (by omega)
      obtain ⟨e, u, v, D, hcyc, hin⟩ := henc
      exact inner _ e u v D hcyc hin (Nat.lt_succ_self _)

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.mem_exterior_chain
statement:
theorem mem_exterior_chain (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hout : OuterOnPairs Γ drawing n x) :
    x ∈ exterior (chainUnion Γ 0 n) drawing
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  have hn : 2 ≤ n := h.two_le
  obtain ⟨p, -, hp, hxp⟩ := mem_pointSet_block hx
  
  have key : ∀ q, q + 1 ≤ n → x ∉ pointSet (Γ q) drawing ∧ x ∉ pointSet (Γ (q + 1)) drawing := by
    intro q hq
    have := (hout q hq).1
    rw [exterior, chainUnion_one, Set.mem_compl_iff, pointSet_union] at this
    exact ⟨fun hc => this (Or.inl hc), fun hc => this (Or.inr hc)⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p n with hlt | hge
  · exact (key p (by omega)).1 hxp
  · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, n = q + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain rfl : p = q + 1 := by omega
    exact (key q (by omega)).2 hxp

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.outer_chain
statement:
theorem outer_chain (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hout : OuterOnPairs Γ drawing n x)
    (hdesc : Descent Γ drawing n x) :
    x ∈ exterior (chainUnion Γ 0 n) drawing ∧
      ¬ Bornology.IsBounded (face (chainUnion Γ 0 n) drawing x)
proof:
:= by
  have hext := h.mem_exterior_chain hout
  refine ⟨hext, fun hb => ?_⟩
  haveI : (chainUnion Γ 0 n).Finite := h.block_finite (i := 0) (m := n) (by omega)
  exact h.not_encloses hout hdesc n 0 (by omega)
    (encloses_of_isBounded_face (h.block_isDrawing (by omega)) (h.block_polygonal (by omega))
      (h.block_isTwoConnected (by omega)) hext hb)

name: Graph.IsPlaneChain.outer_chain'
statement:
theorem outer_chain' (h : IsPlaneChain Γ drawing G n) (hout : OuterOnPairs Γ drawing n x) :
    x ∈ exterior (chainUnion Γ 0 n) drawing ∧
      ¬ Bornology.IsBounded (face (chainUnion Γ 0 n) drawing x)
proof:
:=
  h.outer_chain_of_crosscutExists hout h.crosscutExists

name: Schoenflies.splitAt_subset
statement:
theorem splitAt_subset (p : Plane) (P : Piece) :
    ∀ Q ∈ splitAt p P, Q.seg ⊆ P.seg ∧ Q.interior ⊆ P.interior
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold splitAt
  split_ifs with h
  · have hp : p ∈ P.seg := openSegment_subset_segment ℝ _ _ h
    intro Q hQ
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hQ with rfl | hQ
    · exact ⟨(convex_segment P.1 P.2).segment_subset (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _) hp,
        openSegment_left_subset h⟩
    · rcases List.mem_singleton.1 hQ with rfl
      exact ⟨(convex_segment P.1 P.2).segment_subset hp (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _),
        openSegment_right_subset h⟩
  · intro Q hQ
    rcases List.mem_singleton.1 hQ with rfl
    exact ⟨subset_rfl, subset_rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.splitAllAt_subset
statement:
theorem splitAllAt_subset (p : Plane) (pieces : List Piece) :
    ∀ Q ∈ splitAllAt p pieces, ∃ P ∈ pieces, Q.seg ⊆ P.seg ∧ Q.interior ⊆ P.interior
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hQP⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 hQ
  exact ⟨P, hP, splitAt_subset p P Q hQP⟩

name: Schoenflies.subdivide_subset
statement:
theorem subdivide_subset (pieces : List Piece) (points : List Plane) :
    ∀ Q ∈ subdivide pieces points, ∃ P ∈ pieces, Q.seg ⊆ P.seg ∧ Q.interior ⊆ P.interior
proof:
:= by
  induction points generalizing pieces with
  | nil => exact fun Q hQ => ⟨Q, hQ, subset_rfl, subset_rfl⟩
  | cons p ps ih =>
    intro Q hQ
    obtain ⟨R, hR, hQR, hQR'⟩ := ih (pieces := splitAllAt p pieces) Q hQ
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hRP, hRP'⟩ := splitAllAt_subset p pieces R hR
    exact ⟨P, hP, hQR.trans hRP, hQR'.trans hRP'⟩

name: Schoenflies.splitAt_ends
statement:
theorem splitAt_ends (p : Plane) (P : Piece) :
    ∀ Q ∈ splitAt p P, ∀ z, (z = Q.1 ∨ z = Q.2) → z = p ∨ (z = P.1 ∨ z = P.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold splitAt
  split_ifs with h
  · intro Q hQ z hz
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hQ with rfl | hQ
    · rcases hz with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
      · exact Or.inl rfl
    · rcases List.mem_singleton.1 hQ with rfl
      rcases hz with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
  · intro Q hQ z hz
    rcases List.mem_singleton.1 hQ with rfl
    exact Or.inr hz

name: Schoenflies.splitAllAt_ends
statement:
theorem splitAllAt_ends (p : Plane) (pieces : List Piece) :
    ∀ Q ∈ splitAllAt p pieces, ∀ z, (z = Q.1 ∨ z = Q.2) →
      z = p ∨ ∃ P ∈ pieces, (z = P.1 ∨ z = P.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ z hz
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hQP⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 hQ
  rcases splitAt_ends p P Q hQP z hz with h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨P, hP, h⟩

name: Schoenflies.subdivide_ends
statement:
theorem subdivide_ends (pieces : List Piece) (points : List Plane) :
    ∀ Q ∈ subdivide pieces points, ∀ z, (z = Q.1 ∨ z = Q.2) →
      z ∈ points ∨ ∃ P ∈ pieces, (z = P.1 ∨ z = P.2)
proof:
:= by
  induction points generalizing pieces with
  | nil => exact fun Q hQ z hz => Or.inr ⟨Q, hQ, hz⟩
  | cons p ps ih =>
    intro Q hQ z hz
    rcases ih (pieces := splitAllAt p pieces) Q hQ z hz with h | ⟨R, hR, hzR⟩
    · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
    · rcases splitAllAt_ends p pieces R hR z hzR with rfl | ⟨P, hP, hzP⟩
      · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨P, hP, hzP⟩

name: Schoenflies.meetOf_comm
statement: theorem meetOf_comm (P Q : Piece) : meetOf P Q = meetOf Q P
proof: := inter_comm _ _

name: Schoenflies.subdivide_ends_are_cuts
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ z hz
  rcases subdivide_ends pieces points Q hQ z hz with h' | ⟨P, hP, hzP⟩
  · exact h'
  · exact h P hP z hzP

name: Schoenflies.exists_meet_points
statement:
theorem exists_meet_points (P : Piece) (others : List Piece) :
    ∃ points : List Plane, ∀ Q ∈ others, (meetOf P Q).Nonempty →
      ∃ u v, meetOf P Q = segment ℝ u v ∧ u ∈ points ∧ v ∈ points
proof:
:= by
  induction others with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], by simp⟩
  | cons R rs ih =>
    obtain ⟨tailPoints, htail⟩ := ih
    by_cases hR : (meetOf P R).Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := segment_inter_segment P.1 P.2 R.1 R.2 hR
      refine ⟨u :: v :: tailPoints, fun Q hQ hne => ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hQ with rfl | hQ
      · exact ⟨u, v, huv, by simp, by simp⟩
      · obtain ⟨s, t, hst, hs, ht⟩ := htail Q hQ hne
        exact ⟨s, t, hst, by simp [hs], by simp [ht]⟩
    · refine ⟨tailPoints, fun Q hQ hne => ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hQ with rfl | hQ
      · exact absurd hne hR
      · exact htail Q hQ hne

name: Schoenflies.exists_cut_points
statement:
theorem exists_cut_points (pieces : List Piece) :
    ∃ points : List Plane, EndsAreCut pieces points ∧ MeetsAreCut pieces points
proof:
:= by
  induction pieces with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], by simp [EndsAreCut], by simp [MeetsAreCut]⟩
  | cons R rs ih =>
    obtain ⟨tailPoints, hEnds, hMeets⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨meetPoints, hHead⟩ := exists_meet_points R rs
    refine ⟨R.1 :: R.2 :: (meetPoints ++ tailPoints), fun P hP z hz => ?_,
      fun P hP Q hQ hPQ hne => ?_⟩
    · 
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hP with rfl | hPt
      · rcases hz with rfl | rfl <;> simp
      · have := hEnds P hPt z hz
        simp [this]
    · 
      
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hP with hPh | hPt
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hQ with hQh | hQt
        · exact absurd (hPh.trans hQh.symm) hPQ
        · subst hPh
          obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hu, hv⟩ := hHead Q hQt hne
          exact ⟨u, v, huv, by simp [hu], by simp [hv]⟩
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hQ with hQh | hQt
        · subst hQh
          have hne' : (meetOf Q P).Nonempty := by rwa [meetOf_comm]
          obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hu, hv⟩ := hHead P hPt hne'
          exact ⟨u, v, by rw [meetOf_comm]; exact huv, by simp [hu], by simp [hv]⟩
        · obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hu, hv⟩ := hMeets P hPt Q hQt hPQ hne
          exact ⟨u, v, huv, by simp [hu], by simp [hv]⟩

name: Schoenflies.subdivide_common_segment
statement:
theorem subdivide_common_segment {pieces : List Piece} {points : List Plane}
    (hnd : ∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) (hMeets : MeetsAreCut pieces points)
    {P Q : Piece} (hP : P ∈ subdivide pieces points) (hQ : Q ∈ subdivide pieces points)
    {x : Plane} (hxP : x ∈ P.interior) (hxQ : x ∈ Q.interior) :
    ∃ A : Piece, A.Nondeg ∧ P.seg ⊆ A.seg ∧ Q.seg ⊆ A.seg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hPseg, hPint⟩ := subdivide_subset pieces points P hP
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hQseg, hQint⟩ := subdivide_subset pieces points Q hQ
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst hpq
    exact ⟨p, hnd p hp, hPseg, hQseg⟩
  
  have hxp : x ∈ p.seg := openSegment_subset_segment ℝ _ _ (hPint hxP)
  have hxq : x ∈ q.seg := openSegment_subset_segment ℝ _ _ (hQint hxQ)
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hu, hv⟩ := hMeets p hp q hq hpq ⟨x, hxp, hxq⟩
  have hux : u ∉ P.interior := subdivide_avoids points hnd u hu P hP
  have hvx : v ∉ P.interior := subdivide_avoids points hnd v hv P hP
  have huy : u ∉ Q.interior := subdivide_avoids points hnd u hu Q hQ
  have hvy : v ∉ Q.interior := subdivide_avoids points hnd v hv Q hQ
  
  have hxuv : x ∈ segment ℝ u v := huv ▸ ⟨hxp, hxq⟩
  have hxu : u ≠ x := fun h => hux (h ▸ hxP)
  have hxv : v ≠ x := fun h => hvx (h ▸ hxP)
  have hxopen : x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v := mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right hxu hxv hxuv
  have huvne : u ≠ v := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [openSegment_same, mem_singleton_iff] at hxopen
    exact hxu hxopen.symm
  
  
  have hsubp : segment ℝ u v ⊆ p.seg := huv ▸ inter_subset_left
  have hsubq : segment ℝ u v ⊆ q.seg := huv ▸ inter_subset_right
  refine ⟨(u, v), huvne, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact segment_inside_of_ends_outside (hnd p hp)
      (hPseg (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)) (hPseg (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      (hsubp (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)) (hsubp (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      hxP hxopen hux hvx
  · exact segment_inside_of_ends_outside (hnd q hq)
      (hQseg (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)) (hQseg (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      (hsubq (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)) (hsubq (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      hxQ hxopen huy hvy

name: Schoenflies.subdivide_separated
statement:
theorem subdivide_separated {pieces : List Piece} {points : List Plane}
    (hnd : ∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) (hEnds : EndsAreCut pieces points)
    (hMeets : MeetsAreCut pieces points)
    {P Q : Piece} (hP : P ∈ subdivide pieces points) (hQ : Q ∈ subdivide pieces points)
    {x : Plane} (hxP : x ∈ P.interior) (hxQ : x ∈ Q.interior) :
    P = Q ∨ P = (Q.2, Q.1)
proof:
:= by
  
  have cut : ∀ R ∈ subdivide pieces points, ∀ z, (z = R.1 ∨ z = R.2) → z ∈ points :=
    subdivide_ends_are_cuts hEnds
  have h₁ : Q.1 ∉ P.interior :=
    subdivide_avoids points hnd _ (cut Q hQ _ (Or.inl rfl)) P hP
  have h₂ : Q.2 ∉ P.interior :=
    subdivide_avoids points hnd _ (cut Q hQ _ (Or.inr rfl)) P hP
  have h₃ : P.1 ∉ Q.interior :=
    subdivide_avoids points hnd _ (cut P hP _ (Or.inl rfl)) Q hQ
  have h₄ : P.2 ∉ Q.interior :=
    subdivide_avoids points hnd _ (cut P hP _ (Or.inr rfl)) Q hQ
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hPA, hQA⟩ := subdivide_common_segment hnd hMeets hP hQ hxP hxQ
  rcases same_ends_of_meeting_interiors hA
      (hPA (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)) (hPA (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      (hQA (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)) (hQA (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      hxP hxQ h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ with ⟨e₁, e₂⟩ | ⟨e₁, e₂⟩
