  · exact Or.inl (Prod.ext e₁ e₂)
  · exact Or.inr (Prod.ext e₁ e₂)

name: Schoenflies.IsPlaneSubdivisionExtension.trans
statement:
theorem trans (hGH : IsPlaneSubdivisionExtension G Gdraw H Hdraw)
    (hHK : IsPlaneSubdivisionExtension H Hdraw K Kdraw) :
    IsPlaneSubdivisionExtension G Gdraw K Kdraw where
  finite
proof:
:= hHK.finite
  oldIsDrawing := hGH.oldIsDrawing
  isDrawing := hHK.isDrawing
  vertexSet_subset := hGH.vertexSet_subset.trans hHK.vertexSet_subset
  pointSet_subset := hGH.pointSet_subset.trans hHK.pointSet_subset
  edge_subset := by
    intro e he f hf hmeet
    obtain ⟨z, hzf, hze, hznotK⟩ := hmeet
    have hzH : z ∈ Graph.pointSet H Hdraw :=
      hGH.pointSet_subset (Graph.edgeArc_subset_pointSet he hze)
    rcases hzH with hzHV | hzHE
    · exact (hznotK (hHK.vertexSet_subset hzHV)).elim
    · obtain ⟨g, hg, hzg⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hzHE
      have hznotH : z ∉ V(H) := fun hzV => hznotK (hHK.vertexSet_subset hzV)
      exact (hHK.edge_subset hg hf ⟨z, hzf, hzg, hznotK⟩).trans
        (hGH.edge_subset he hg ⟨z, hzg, hze, hznotH⟩)

name: Schoenflies.mem_currentOverlayPieces
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_currentOverlayPieces {pieces : List Piece} {extra : List Plane} {R : Piece} :
    R ∈ currentOverlayPieces pieces extra ↔ R ∈ E(attachGraph pieces extra)
proof:
:= by
  rw [currentOverlayPieces, Finset.mem_toList, Graph.mem_edgeFinset]

name: Schoenflies.currentOverlayPieces_nondeg
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  have hRedge : R ∈ E(attachGraph pieces extra) := mem_currentOverlayPieces.1 hR
  change R ∈ overlayPieces pieces (attachPoints pieces extra) at hRedge
  exact overlayPieces_nondeg _ hpieces R hRedge

name: Schoenflies.cover_currentOverlayPieces
statement:
theorem cover_currentOverlayPieces (pieces : List Piece) (extra : List Plane) :
    cover (currentOverlayPieces pieces extra) =
      Graph.pointSet (attachGraph pieces extra) segmentDrawing
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨R, hR, hxR⟩ := mem_cover_iff.1 hx
    exact Graph.edgeArc_subset_pointSet (mem_currentOverlayPieces.1 hR) (by
      rwa [edgeArc_segmentDrawing])
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with hxV | hxE
    · change x ∈ V(overlayGraph pieces (attachPoints pieces extra)) at hxV
      obtain ⟨R, hR, hxR⟩ := hxV
      apply mem_cover_iff.2
      refine ⟨R, mem_currentOverlayPieces.2 hR, ?_⟩
      rcases hxR with rfl | rfl
      · exact left_mem_segment ℝ _ _
      · exact right_mem_segment ℝ _ _
    · obtain ⟨R, hR, hxR⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hxE
      exact mem_cover_iff.2 ⟨R, mem_currentOverlayPieces.2 hR, by
        rwa [edgeArc_segmentDrawing] at hxR⟩

name: Schoenflies.extendOverlay_pointSet
statement:
theorem extendOverlay_pointSet
    (pieces : List Piece) (extra : List Plane) (joins : List Piece) :
    Graph.pointSet (extendOverlay pieces extra joins) segmentDrawing =
      Graph.pointSet (attachGraph pieces extra) segmentDrawing ∪ cover joins
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendOverlay, attachGraph_pointSet, extendedOverlayPieces, cover_append,
    cover_currentOverlayPieces]

name: Schoenflies.extendOverlay_isDrawing
statement:
theorem extendOverlay_isDrawing
    {pieces : List Piece} {extra : List Plane} {joins : List Piece}
    (hpieces : ∀ R ∈ pieces, R.Nondeg) (hjoins : ∀ R ∈ joins, R.Nondeg) :
    Graph.IsDrawing (extendOverlay pieces extra joins) segmentDrawing
proof:
:= by
  apply attachGraph_isDrawing
  intro R hR
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hR with hR | hR
  · exact currentOverlayPieces_nondeg hpieces R hR
  · exact hjoins R hR

name: Schoenflies.attachGraphVertices_subset_extendOverlay
statement:
theorem attachGraphVertices_subset_extendOverlay
    {pieces : List Piece} {extra : List Plane} {joins : List Piece}
    (hpieces : ∀ R ∈ pieces, R.Nondeg) (hjoins : ∀ R ∈ joins, R.Nondeg) :
    V(attachGraph pieces extra) ⊆ V(extendOverlay pieces extra joins)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change x ∈ V(overlayGraph (extendedOverlayPieces pieces extra joins)
    (attachPoints (extendedOverlayPieces pieces extra joins)
      (attachGraph pieces extra).vertexFinset.toList))
  apply overlayGraph_mem_vertexSet_of_mem_cover
  · intro R hR
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hR with hR | hR
    · exact currentOverlayPieces_nondeg hpieces R hR
    · exact hjoins R hR
  · apply mem_attachPoints_of_mem
    rw [Finset.mem_toList, Graph.mem_vertexFinset]
    exact hx
  · rw [extendedOverlayPieces, cover_append, cover_currentOverlayPieces]
    exact Or.inl (Graph.vertexSet_subset_pointSet hx)

name: Schoenflies.extendOverlay_edge_subset
statement:
theorem extendOverlay_edge_subset
    {pieces : List Piece} {extra : List Plane} {joins : List Piece}
    (hpieces : ∀ R ∈ pieces, R.Nondeg) (hjoins : ∀ R ∈ joins, R.Nondeg) :
    ∀ {A : Piece}, A ∈ E(attachGraph pieces extra) → ∀ {R : Piece},
      R ∈ E(extendOverlay pieces extra joins) →
      (Graph.edgeArc segmentDrawing R ∩
        (Graph.edgeArc segmentDrawing A \ V(extendOverlay pieces extra joins))).Nonempty →
      Graph.edgeArc segmentDrawing R ⊆ Graph.edgeArc segmentDrawing A
proof:
:= by
  intro A hA R hR hmeet
  obtain ⟨z, hzR, hzA, hznot⟩ := hmeet
  obtain ⟨R', hR', hzR', hR'A⟩ :=
    exists_overlayPiece_mem_subset
      (points := attachPoints (extendedOverlayPieces pieces extra joins)
        (attachGraph pieces extra).vertexFinset.toList)
      (P₀ := A)
      (List.mem_append_left joins (mem_currentOverlayPieces.2 hA))
      (by rwa [edgeArc_segmentDrawing] at hzA)
  have hzR'Arc : z ∈ Graph.edgeArc segmentDrawing R' := by
    rwa [edgeArc_segmentDrawing]
  have hRR' : R = R' :=
    (extendOverlay_isDrawing hpieces hjoins).unique_edge_at
      hR hR' hznot hzR hzR'Arc
  rw [hRR', edgeArc_segmentDrawing, edgeArc_segmentDrawing]
  exact hR'A

name: Schoenflies.extendOverlay_edge_source
statement:
theorem extendOverlay_edge_source
    {pieces : List Piece} {extra : List Plane} {joins : List Piece}
    {R : Piece} (hR : R ∈ E(extendOverlay pieces extra joins)) :
    (∃ A ∈ E(attachGraph pieces extra), R.seg ⊆ A.seg) ∨
      ∃ A ∈ joins, R.seg ⊆ A.seg
proof:
:= by
  change R ∈ overlayPieces (extendedOverlayPieces pieces extra joins)
    (attachPoints (extendedOverlayPieces pieces extra joins)
      (attachGraph pieces extra).vertexFinset.toList) at hR
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀, rfl⟩ := mem_overlayPieces.1 hR
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hsub, -⟩ := subdivide_subset _ _ R₀ hR₀
  rw [orientPiece_seg]
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hA with hA | hA
  · exact Or.inl ⟨A, mem_currentOverlayPieces.1 hA, hsub⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨A, hA, hsub⟩

name: Schoenflies.attachGraph_isPlaneSubdivisionExtension_extendOverlay
statement:
theorem attachGraph_isPlaneSubdivisionExtension_extendOverlay
    {pieces : List Piece} {extra : List Plane} {joins : List Piece}
    (hpieces : ∀ R ∈ pieces, R.Nondeg) (hjoins : ∀ R ∈ joins, R.Nondeg) :
    IsPlaneSubdivisionExtension (attachGraph pieces extra) segmentDrawing
      (extendOverlay pieces extra joins) segmentDrawing where
  finite
proof:
:= inferInstance
  oldIsDrawing := attachGraph_isDrawing hpieces extra
  isDrawing := extendOverlay_isDrawing hpieces hjoins
  vertexSet_subset := attachGraphVertices_subset_extendOverlay hpieces hjoins
  pointSet_subset := by
    rw [extendOverlay_pointSet]
    exact subset_union_left
  edge_subset := by
    intro A hA R hR hmeet
    exact extendOverlay_edge_subset hpieces hjoins hA hR hmeet

name: Schoenflies.attachGraphTrace_isTwoConnected_extendOverlay
statement:
theorem attachGraphTrace_isTwoConnected_extendOverlay
    {pieces : List Piece} {extra : List Plane} {joins : List Piece}
    (hpieces : ∀ R ∈ pieces, R.Nondeg) (hjoins : ∀ R ∈ joins, R.Nondeg)
    (htwo : (attachGraph pieces extra).IsTwoConnected) :
    (Graph.traceGraph (extendOverlay pieces extra joins) segmentDrawing
      (Graph.pointSet (attachGraph pieces extra) segmentDrawing)).IsTwoConnected
proof:
:=
  (attachGraph_isPlaneSubdivisionExtension_extendOverlay hpieces hjoins).trace_isTwoConnected
    htwo

name: Schoenflies.precedes_total
statement: theorem precedes_total (p q : Plane) : Precedes p q ∨ Precedes q p
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (p 0) (q 0) with h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
  · rcases le_total (p 1) (q 1) with h' | h'
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨h, h'⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h.symm, h'⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)

name: Schoenflies.eq_of_precedes_of_precedes
statement:
theorem eq_of_precedes_of_precedes {p q : Plane} (h : Precedes p q) (h' : Precedes q p) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : p 0 = q 0 ∧ p 1 = q 1 := by
    rcases h with h | ⟨ha, hb⟩ <;> rcases h' with h' | ⟨ha', hb'⟩
    · exact absurd h (asymm h')
    · exact absurd h (by rw [ha']; exact lt_irrefl _)
    · exact absurd h' (by rw [ha]; exact lt_irrefl _)
    · exact ⟨ha, le_antisymm hb hb'⟩
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact key.1
  · exact key.2

name: Schoenflies.orientPiece_of_precedes
statement: theorem orientPiece_of_precedes {P : Piece} (h : Precedes P.1 P.2) : orientPiece P = P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact if_pos h

name: Schoenflies.orientPiece_of_not_precedes
statement:
theorem orientPiece_of_not_precedes {P : Piece} (h : ¬ Precedes P.1 P.2) :
    orientPiece P = (P.2, P.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact if_neg h

name: Schoenflies.orientPiece_seg
statement: @[simp] theorem orientPiece_seg (P : Piece) : (orientPiece P).seg = P.seg
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Precedes P.1 P.2
  · rw [orientPiece_of_precedes h]
  · rw [orientPiece_of_not_precedes h]; exact segment_symm ℝ _ _

name: Schoenflies.orientPiece_interior
statement: @[simp] theorem orientPiece_interior (P : Piece) : (orientPiece P).interior = P.interior
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Precedes P.1 P.2
  · rw [orientPiece_of_precedes h]
  · rw [orientPiece_of_not_precedes h]; exact openSegment_symm ℝ _ _

name: Schoenflies.orientPiece_ends
statement:
theorem orientPiece_ends (P : Piece) (z : Plane) :
    (z = (orientPiece P).1 ∨ z = (orientPiece P).2) ↔ (z = P.1 ∨ z = P.2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Precedes P.1 P.2
  · rw [orientPiece_of_precedes h]
  · rw [orientPiece_of_not_precedes h]; exact or_comm

name: Schoenflies.orientPiece_nondeg
statement: theorem orientPiece_nondeg {P : Piece} (h : P.Nondeg) : (orientPiece P).Nondeg
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : Precedes P.1 P.2
  · rw [orientPiece_of_precedes hp]; exact h
  · rw [orientPiece_of_not_precedes hp]; exact fun e => h e.symm

name: Schoenflies.precedes_orientPiece
statement: theorem precedes_orientPiece (P : Piece) : Precedes (orientPiece P).1 (orientPiece P).2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Precedes P.1 P.2
  · rw [orientPiece_of_precedes h]; exact h
  · rw [orientPiece_of_not_precedes h]
    exact (precedes_total P.1 P.2).resolve_left h

name: Schoenflies.orientPiece_idem
statement: @[simp] theorem orientPiece_idem (P : Piece) : orientPiece (orientPiece P) = orientPiece P
proof:
:=
  orientPiece_of_precedes (precedes_orientPiece P)

name: Schoenflies.orientPiece_swap
statement: @[simp] theorem orientPiece_swap (P : Piece) : orientPiece (P.2, P.1) = orientPiece P
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Precedes P.1 P.2
  · rw [orientPiece_of_precedes h]
    by_cases h' : Precedes P.2 P.1
    · 
      
      have he : P.1 = P.2 := eq_of_precedes_of_precedes h h'
      rw [orientPiece_of_precedes (P := (P.2, P.1)) h']
      exact Prod.ext he.symm he
    · rw [orientPiece_of_not_precedes (P := (P.2, P.1)) h']
  · rw [orientPiece_of_not_precedes h,
      orientPiece_of_precedes (P := (P.2, P.1)) ((precedes_total P.1 P.2).resolve_left h)]

name: Schoenflies.cover_eq_of_mem_iff
statement:
theorem cover_eq_of_mem_iff {l₁ l₂ : List Piece} (h : ∀ P, P ∈ l₁ ↔ P ∈ l₂) :
    cover l₁ = cover l₂
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [cover, mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨P, hP, hx⟩ => ⟨P, (h P).1 hP, hx⟩, fun ⟨P, hP, hx⟩ => ⟨P, (h P).2 hP, hx⟩⟩

name: Schoenflies.cover_map_orientPiece
statement: theorem cover_map_orientPiece (l : List Piece) : cover (l.map orientPiece) = cover l
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [cover, mem_iUnion, exists_prop, List.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩, hx⟩
    exact ⟨Q, hQ, by rwa [orientPiece_seg] at hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, hx⟩
    exact ⟨orientPiece Q, ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩, by rwa [orientPiece_seg]⟩

name: Schoenflies.mem_overlayPieces
statement:
theorem mem_overlayPieces {pieces : List Piece} {points : List Plane} {P : Piece} :
    P ∈ overlayPieces pieces points ↔ ∃ Q ∈ subdivide pieces points, orientPiece Q = P
proof:
:= by
  rw [overlayPieces, List.mem_dedup, List.mem_map]

name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_nodup
statement:
theorem overlayPieces_nodup (pieces : List Piece) (points : List Plane) :
    (overlayPieces pieces points).Nodup
proof:
:=
  List.nodup_dedup _

name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_cover
statement:
theorem overlayPieces_cover (pieces : List Piece) (points : List Plane) :
    cover (overlayPieces pieces points) = cover pieces
proof:
:= by
  rw [overlayPieces,
    cover_eq_of_mem_iff (l₂ := (subdivide pieces points).map orientPiece) fun _ => List.mem_dedup,
    cover_map_orientPiece, subdivide_cover]

name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_nondeg
statement:
theorem overlayPieces_nondeg {pieces : List Piece} (points : List Plane)
    (hnd : ∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) : ∀ P ∈ overlayPieces pieces points, P.Nondeg
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ := mem_overlayPieces.1 hP
  exact orientPiece_nondeg (subdivide_ne points hnd Q hQ)

name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_ends_cut
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP z hz
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ := mem_overlayPieces.1 hP
  exact subdivide_ends_are_cuts hEnds Q hQ z ((orientPiece_ends Q z).1 hz)

name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_avoids
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp P hP
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ := mem_overlayPieces.1 hP
  rw [orientPiece_interior]
  exact subdivide_avoids points hnd p hp Q hQ

name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_disjoint_interiors
proof:
:= by
  intro hxQ
  obtain ⟨P', hP', rfl⟩ := mem_overlayPieces.1 hP
  obtain ⟨Q', hQ', rfl⟩ := mem_overlayPieces.1 hQ
  rw [orientPiece_interior] at hxP hxQ
  rcases subdivide_separated hnd hEnds hMeets hP' hQ' hxP hxQ with h | h
  · exact hPQ (by rw [h])
  · exact hPQ (by rw [h, orientPiece_swap])

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_vertexSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem overlayGraph_vertexSet :
    V(overlayGraph pieces points) = endSet (overlayPieces pieces points)
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_mem_edgeSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem overlayGraph_mem_edgeSet :
    P ∈ E(overlayGraph pieces points) ↔ P ∈ overlayPieces pieces points
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_isLink
statement:
@[simp] theorem overlayGraph_isLink :
    (overlayGraph pieces points).IsLink P x y ↔
      P ∈ overlayPieces pieces points ∧ ((x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2) ∨ (x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1))
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_mem_vertexSet
statement:
theorem overlayGraph_mem_vertexSet :
    v ∈ V(overlayGraph pieces points) ↔ ∃ P ∈ overlayPieces pieces points, v = P.1 ∨ v = P.2
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_inc
statement:
theorem overlayGraph_inc (hP : P ∈ overlayPieces pieces points) (h : v = P.1 ∨ v = P.2) :
    (overlayGraph pieces points).Inc P v
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨P.2, hP, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨P.1, hP, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

name: Schoenflies.edgeArc_segmentDrawing
statement:
@[simp] theorem edgeArc_segmentDrawing (P : Piece) :
    Graph.edgeArc segmentDrawing P = P.seg
proof:
:=
  (segment_eq_image_lineMap ℝ P.1 P.2).symm

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_isDrawing
statement:
theorem overlayGraph_isDrawing (pieces : List Piece) (points : List Plane)
    (hnd : ∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) (hEnds : EndsAreCut pieces points)
    (hMeets : MeetsAreCut pieces points) :
    Graph.IsDrawing (overlayGraph pieces points) segmentDrawing
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro P hP
    have hne : P.Nondeg := overlayPieces_nondeg points hnd P (by simpa using hP)
    refine ⟨AffineMap.lineMap_continuous.continuousOn, injOn_lineMap hne, ?_⟩
    have h0 : segmentDrawing P 0 = P.1 := by simp [segmentDrawing]
    have h1 : segmentDrawing P 1 = P.2 := by simp [segmentDrawing]
    rw [h0, h1]
    exact ⟨by simpa using hP, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  · 
    
    rintro P a b w ⟨hP, h⟩ hw hwarc
    rw [edgeArc_segmentDrawing] at hwarc
    obtain ⟨R, hR, hwR⟩ := hw
    have hwint : w ∉ P.interior :=
      overlayPieces_avoids hnd w (overlayPieces_ends_cut hEnds R hR w hwR) P hP
    have hend : w = P.1 ∨ w = P.2 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      exact hwint (mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right (Ne.symm hcon.1) (Ne.symm hcon.2) hwarc)
    rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact hend
    · exact hend.symm
  · 
    
    
    rintro P Q hP hQ hPQ p hpP hpQ
    rw [overlayGraph_mem_edgeSet] at hP hQ
    rw [edgeArc_segmentDrawing] at hpP hpQ
    have key : ∀ A B : Piece, A ∈ overlayPieces pieces points →
        B ∈ overlayPieces pieces points → A ≠ B → p ∈ A.seg → p ∈ B.seg →
        (p = A.1 ∨ p = A.2) := by
      intro A B hA hB hAB hpA hpB
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      have hintA : p ∈ A.interior :=
        mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right (Ne.symm hcon.1) (Ne.symm hcon.2) hpA
      by_cases hendB : p = B.1 ∨ p = B.2
      · exact overlayPieces_avoids hnd p (overlayPieces_ends_cut hEnds B hB p hendB) A hA hintA
      · push Not at hendB
        have hintB : p ∈ B.interior :=
          mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right (Ne.symm hendB.1) (Ne.symm hendB.2) hpB
        exact overlayPieces_disjoint_interiors hnd hEnds hMeets hA hB hAB hintA hintB
    have hendP := key P Q hP hQ hPQ hpP hpQ
    have hendQ := key Q P hQ hP (Ne.symm hPQ) hpQ hpP
    exact ⟨⟨P, hP, hendP⟩, overlayGraph_inc hP hendP, overlayGraph_inc hQ hendQ⟩

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_pointSet
statement:
theorem overlayGraph_pointSet (pieces : List Piece) (points : List Plane) :
    Graph.pointSet (overlayGraph pieces points) segmentDrawing = cover pieces
proof:
:= by
  rw [← overlayPieces_cover pieces points]
  ext z
  simp only [Graph.pointSet, mem_union, mem_iUnion, exists_prop, overlayGraph_vertexSet,
    endSet, mem_setOf_eq, overlayGraph_mem_edgeSet, edgeArc_segmentDrawing, cover]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨P, hP, hzP⟩ | ⟨P, hP, hzP⟩)
    · refine ⟨P, hP, ?_⟩
      rcases hzP with rfl | rfl
      · exact left_mem_segment ℝ _ _
      · exact right_mem_segment ℝ _ _
    · exact ⟨P, hP, hzP⟩
  · rintro ⟨P, hP, hzP⟩
    exact Or.inr ⟨P, hP, hzP⟩

name: Schoenflies.finite_endSet
statement: theorem finite_endSet (edges : List Piece) : (endSet edges).Finite
proof:
:= by
  
  have : endSet edges ⊆ (fun P : Piece => P.1) '' {P | P ∈ edges}
      ∪ (fun P : Piece => P.2) '' {P | P ∈ edges} := by
    rintro v ⟨P, hP, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩
  exact Set.Finite.subset
    ((edges.finite_toSet.image _).union (edges.finite_toSet.image _)) this

name: Schoenflies.polygonal_overlay
statement:
theorem polygonal_overlay (pieces : List Piece) (hnd : ∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) :
    ∃ G : Graph Plane Piece, Graph.Finite G ∧ Graph.IsDrawing G segmentDrawing ∧
      Graph.pointSet G segmentDrawing = cover pieces
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨points, hEnds, hMeets⟩ := exists_cut_points pieces
  exact ⟨overlayGraph pieces points, overlayGraph_finite pieces points,
    overlayGraph_isDrawing pieces points hnd hEnds hMeets,
    overlayGraph_pointSet pieces points⟩

name: Schoenflies.hgt_eq
statement: theorem hgt_eq (u z : Plane) : hgt u z = u 0 * z 1 - u 1 * z 0
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.fwd_eq
statement: theorem fwd_eq (u z : Plane) : fwd u z = z 0 * u 0 + z 1 * u 1
proof: := Plane.inner_eq z u

name: Schoenflies.Plane.add_apply
statement: theorem add_apply (x y : Plane) (i : Fin 2) : (x + y) i = x i + y i
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.Plane.smul_apply
statement: theorem smul_apply (r : ℝ) (x : Plane) (i : Fin 2) : (r • x) i = r * x i
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.hgt_lin
statement:
theorem hgt_lin (u a b : Plane) (t : ℝ) :
    hgt u (a + t • (b - a)) = hgt u a + t * (hgt u b - hgt u a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hgt_eq, Plane.add_apply, Plane.smul_apply, Plane.sub_apply]; ring

name: Schoenflies.fwd_lin
statement:
theorem fwd_lin (u a b : Plane) (t : ℝ) :
    fwd u (a + t • (b - a)) = fwd u a + t * (fwd u b - fwd u a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fwd_eq, Plane.add_apply, Plane.smul_apply, Plane.sub_apply]; ring

name: Schoenflies.hgt_sub
statement: theorem hgt_sub (u x y : Plane) : hgt u (x - y) = hgt u x - hgt u y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hgt_eq, Plane.sub_apply]; ring

name: Schoenflies.fwd_sub
statement: theorem fwd_sub (u x y : Plane) : fwd u (x - y) = fwd u x - fwd u y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fwd_eq, Plane.sub_apply]; ring

name: Schoenflies.hgt_add_smul
statement:
theorem hgt_add_smul (u v x : Plane) (t : ℝ) :
    hgt u (x + t • v) = hgt u x + t * hgt u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hgt_eq, Plane.add_apply, Plane.smul_apply]; ring

name: Schoenflies.fwd_add_smul
statement:
theorem fwd_add_smul (u v x : Plane) (t : ℝ) :
    fwd u (x + t • v) = fwd u x + t * fwd u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fwd_eq, Plane.add_apply, Plane.smul_apply]; ring

name: Schoenflies.hgt_eq_fwd_perp
statement: theorem hgt_eq_fwd_perp (u z : Plane) : hgt u z = fwd (Plane.perp u) z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hgt_eq, fwd_eq, Plane.perp_zero, Plane.perp_one]; ring

name: Schoenflies.norm_sq_one
statement: theorem norm_sq_one : u 0 ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Plane.norm_sq_eq, hu, one_pow]

name: Schoenflies.hgt_self
statement: @[simp] theorem hgt_self : hgt u u = 0
proof: := by simp only [hgt_eq]; ring

name: Schoenflies.fwd_self
statement: theorem fwd_self : fwd u u = 1
proof: := by rw [fwd_eq, ← norm_sq_one hu]; ring

name: Schoenflies.hgt_perp
statement: theorem hgt_perp : hgt u (Plane.perp u) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [hgt_eq, ← norm_sq_one hu]; simp only [Plane.perp_zero, Plane.perp_one]; ring

name: Schoenflies.fwd_perp
statement: theorem fwd_perp : fwd u (Plane.perp u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fwd_eq, Plane.perp_zero, Plane.perp_one]; ring

name: Schoenflies.decomp
statement: theorem decomp (v : Plane) : v = fwd u v • u + hgt u v • Plane.perp u
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := norm_sq_one hu
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Plane.add_apply, Plane.smul_apply, Plane.perp_zero,
      Plane.perp_one, hgt_eq, fwd_eq]
  · linear_combination (-(v 0)) * h1
  · linear_combination (-(v 1)) * h1

name: Schoenflies.eq_of_coords
statement: theorem eq_of_coords (h1 : fwd u z = fwd u w) (h2 : hgt u z = hgt u w) : z = w
proof:
:= by
  have hz := decomp hu z
  have hw := decomp hu w
  rw [h1, h2] at hz
  exact hz.trans hw.symm

name: Schoenflies.abs_fwd_le_norm
statement: theorem abs_fwd_le_norm (v : Plane) : |fwd u v| ≤ ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_real_inner_le_norm v u
  rw [hu, mul_one] at h
  exact h

name: Schoenflies.abs_hgt_le_norm
statement: theorem abs_hgt_le_norm (v : Plane) : |hgt u v| ≤ ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Plane.IsDirection (Plane.perp u) := by
    rw [Plane.IsDirection, Plane.norm_perp]; exact hu
  rw [hgt_eq_fwd_perp]
  exact abs_fwd_le_norm hp v

name: Schoenflies.hgt_meet
statement: theorem hgt_meet (h : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b) (t : ℝ) : hgt u (meet u a b t) = t
proof:
:= by
  have hne : hgt u b - hgt u a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm h)
  rw [meet, hgt_lin]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Schoenflies.fwd_meet
statement:
theorem fwd_meet (u a b : Plane) (t : ℝ) :
    fwd u (meet u a b t) =
      fwd u a + ((t - hgt u a) / (hgt u b - hgt u a)) * (fwd u b - fwd u a)
proof:
:=
  fwd_lin u a b _

name: Schoenflies.meet_mem_segment
statement:
theorem meet_mem_segment (h : hgt u a < hgt u b) (h1 : hgt u a ≤ t) (h2 : t ≤ hgt u b) :
    meet u a b t ∈ segment ℝ a b
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (0:ℝ) < hgt u b - hgt u a := by linarith
  rw [segment_eq_image' ℝ a b]
  exact ⟨_, ⟨div_nonneg (by linarith) hne.le, (div_le_one hne).2 (by linarith)⟩, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.eq_meet
statement:
theorem eq_meet (h : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b) (hz : z ∈ segment ℝ a b) :
    z = meet u a b (hgt u z)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : hgt u b - hgt u a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm h)
  rw [segment_eq_image' ℝ a b] at hz
  obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := hz
  have : (hgt u (a + r • (b - a)) - hgt u a) / (hgt u b - hgt u a) = r := by
    rw [hgt_lin]; field_simp; ring
  rw [meet, this]

name: Schoenflies.meet_swap
statement: theorem meet_swap (h : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b) (t : ℝ) : meet u b a t = meet u a b t
proof:
:= by
  have hne : hgt u b - hgt u a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm h)
  have h2 : (t - hgt u b) / (hgt u a - hgt u b)
      = 1 - (t - hgt u a) / (hgt u b - hgt u a) := by field_simp; ring
  rw [meet, meet, h2, sub_smul, one_smul, smul_sub, smul_sub]
  abel

name: Schoenflies.crosses_swap
statement:
theorem crosses_swap (h : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b) (q : Plane) :
    Crosses u (b, a) q ↔ Crosses u (a, b) q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Crosses, meet_swap h, min_comm (hgt u b) (hgt u a), max_comm (hgt u b) (hgt u a)]

name: Schoenflies.crossings_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem crossings_nil (u q : Plane) : crossings u [] q = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.crossings_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem crossings_cons (u : Plane) (P : Piece) (L : List Piece) (q : Plane) :
    crossings u (P :: L) q = (if Crosses u P q then 1 else 0) + crossings u L q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [crossings]

name: Schoenflies.crossings_append
statement:
theorem crossings_append (u : Plane) (L₁ L₂ : List Piece) (q : Plane) :
    crossings u (L₁ ++ L₂) q = crossings u L₁ q + crossings u L₂ q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [crossings, List.sum_append]

name: Schoenflies.parity_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem parity_nil (u q : Plane) : parity u [] q = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.parity_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem parity_cons (u : Plane) (P : Piece) (L : List Piece) (q : Plane) :
    parity u (P :: L) q = mark u P q + parity u L q
proof:
:= by
  simp [parity]

name: Schoenflies.parity_append
statement:
theorem parity_append (u : Plane) (L₁ L₂ : List Piece) (q : Plane) :
    parity u (L₁ ++ L₂) q = parity u L₁ q + parity u L₂ q
proof:
:= by
  simp [parity, List.sum_append]

name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_crossings
statement:
theorem parity_eq_crossings (u : Plane) (L : List Piece) (q : Plane) :
    parity u L q = (crossings u L q : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons P L ih =>
    rw [parity_cons, ih, crossings_cons, Nat.cast_add, mark]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: Schoenflies.nondeg_of_hgt_ne
statement: theorem nondeg_of_hgt_ne {P : Piece} (h : hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) : P.Nondeg
proof:
:= by
  intro hEq
  exact h (by rw [hEq])

name: Schoenflies.hgt_lt_of_mem_openSegment
statement:
theorem hgt_lt_of_mem_openSegment (hab : hgt u a < hgt u b) (hc : c ∈ openSegment ℝ a b) :
    hgt u a < hgt u c ∧ hgt u c < hgt u b
proof:
:= by
  rw [openSegment_eq_image' ℝ a b] at hc
  obtain ⟨r, ⟨hr0, hr1⟩, rfl⟩ := hc
  rw [hgt_lin]
  constructor
  · nlinarith
  · nlinarith

name: Schoenflies.hgt_ne_of_mem_openSegment
statement:
theorem hgt_ne_of_mem_openSegment (hab : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b) (hc : c ∈ openSegment ℝ a b) :
    hgt u a ≠ hgt u c ∧ hgt u c ≠ hgt u b
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with h | h
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hgt_lt_of_mem_openSegment h hc
    exact ⟨ne_of_lt h1, ne_of_lt h2⟩
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hgt_lt_of_mem_openSegment h (by rwa [openSegment_symm] at hc)
    exact ⟨ne_of_gt h2, ne_of_gt h1⟩

name: Schoenflies.splitAt_hgt_ne
statement:
theorem splitAt_hgt_ne {P : Piece} (hP : hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) (c : Plane) :
    ∀ Q ∈ splitAt c P, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := P
  unfold splitAt
  split_ifs with hcc
  · simp only [Piece.interior] at hcc
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hgt_ne_of_mem_openSegment hP hcc
    intro Q hQ
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hQ with rfl | hQ
    · exact h1
    · rcases List.mem_singleton.1 hQ with rfl
      exact h2
  · intro Q hQ
    rcases List.mem_singleton.1 hQ with rfl
    exact hP

name: Schoenflies.splitAllAt_hgt_ne
statement:
theorem splitAllAt_hgt_ne (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) (c : Plane) :
    ∀ Q ∈ splitAllAt c L, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hQP⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 hQ
  exact splitAt_hgt_ne (hL P hP) c Q hQP

name: Schoenflies.subdivide_hgt_ne
statement:
theorem subdivide_hgt_ne (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) (points : List Plane) :
    ∀ Q ∈ subdivide L points, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2
proof:
:= by
  induction points generalizing L with
  | nil => exact hL
  | cons c cs ih => exact ih (splitAllAt_hgt_ne hL c)

name: Schoenflies.eq_meet_of_smul
statement:
theorem eq_meet_of_smul (hab : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b) (r : ℝ) (hz : z = a + r • (b - a)) :
    z = meet u a b (hgt u z)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : hgt u b - hgt u a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hab)
  have hr : (hgt u z - hgt u a) / (hgt u b - hgt u a) = r := by
    rw [hz, hgt_lin]; field_simp; ring
  rw [meet, hr, hz]

name: Schoenflies.meet_left_eq
statement:
theorem meet_left_eq (hab : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b) (hac : hgt u a ≠ hgt u c)
    {r : ℝ} (hc : c = a + r • (b - a)) (t : ℝ) : meet u a c t = meet u a b t
proof:
:= by
  have hca : c - a = r • (b - a) := by rw [hc]; abel
  have hz : meet u a c t = a + (((t - hgt u a) / (hgt u c - hgt u a)) * r) • (b - a) := by
    rw [meet, hca, smul_smul]
  rw [eq_meet_of_smul hab _ hz, hgt_meet hac]

name: Schoenflies.meet_right_eq
statement:
theorem meet_right_eq (hab : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b) (hcb : hgt u c ≠ hgt u b)
    {r : ℝ} (hc : c = a + r • (b - a)) (t : ℝ) : meet u c b t = meet u a b t
proof:
:= by
  have hbc : b - c = (1 - r) • (b - a) := by rw [hc, sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
  have key : ∀ k : ℝ, c + k • (b - c) = a + (r + k * (1 - r)) • (b - a) := by
    intro k
    rw [hbc, smul_smul, hc, add_smul]
    abel
  have hz : meet u c b t = a + (r + ((t - hgt u c) / (hgt u b - hgt u c)) * (1 - r)) • (b - a) := by
    rw [meet]; exact key _
  rw [eq_meet_of_smul hab _ hz, hgt_meet hcb]

name: Schoenflies.crossings_split_aux
statement:
private theorem crossings_split_aux (hab : hgt u a < hgt u b) (hc : c ∈ openSegment ℝ a b)
    (q : Plane) :
    (if Crosses u (a, c) q then 1 else 0) + (if Crosses u (c, b) q then 1 else 0)
      = (if Crosses u (a, b) q then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hac, hcb⟩ := hgt_lt_of_mem_openSegment hab hc
  obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ := (openSegment_eq_image' ℝ a b).subset hc
  
  have hm1 : meet u a c (hgt u q) = meet u a b (hgt u q) :=
    meet_left_eq (ne_of_lt hab) (ne_of_lt hac) hr.symm _
  have hm2 : meet u c b (hgt u q) = meet u a b (hgt u q) :=
    meet_right_eq (ne_of_lt hab) (ne_of_lt hcb) hr.symm _
  simp only [Crosses, hm1, hm2, min_eq_left hab.le, max_eq_right hab.le,
    min_eq_left hac.le, max_eq_right hac.le, min_eq_left hcb.le, max_eq_right hcb.le]
  by_cases hD : fwd u q < fwd u (meet u a b (hgt u q))
  · by_cases h1 : hgt u a ≤ hgt u q
    · by_cases h2 : hgt u q < hgt u c
      · rw [if_pos ⟨h1, h2, hD⟩, if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith),
          if_pos ⟨h1, by linarith, hD⟩]
      · push Not at h2
        by_cases h3 : hgt u q < hgt u b
        · rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith), if_pos ⟨h2, h3, hD⟩,
            if_pos ⟨h1, h3, hD⟩]
        · rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith), if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith),
            if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith)]
    · push Not at h1
      rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith), if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith),
        if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith)]
  · rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD g), if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD g),
      if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD g)]

name: Schoenflies.crossings_split
statement:
private theorem crossings_split (hab : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b) (hc : c ∈ openSegment ℝ a b)
    (q : Plane) :
    (if Crosses u (a, c) q then 1 else 0) + (if Crosses u (c, b) q then 1 else 0)
      = (if Crosses u (a, b) q then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hac, hcb⟩ := hgt_ne_of_mem_openSegment hab hc
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with h | h
  · exact crossings_split_aux h hc q
  · have hc' : c ∈ openSegment ℝ b a := by rwa [openSegment_symm]
    have key := crossings_split_aux h hc' q
    simp only [crosses_swap hcb, crosses_swap hac, crosses_swap hab] at key
    rw [add_comm]
    exact key

name: Schoenflies.crossings_splitAt
statement:
theorem crossings_splitAt {P : Piece} (hP : hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) (c q : Plane) :
    crossings u (splitAt c P) q = crossings u [P] q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := P
  unfold splitAt
  split_ifs with hcc
  · simp only [Piece.interior] at hcc
    simp only [crossings_cons, crossings_nil, add_zero]
    exact crossings_split hP hcc q
  · rfl

name: Schoenflies.crossings_splitAllAt
statement:
theorem crossings_splitAllAt (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) (c q : Plane) :
    crossings u (splitAllAt c L) q = crossings u L q
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons P L ih =>
    have hP : hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2 := hL P (by simp)
    have hL' : ∀ Q ∈ L, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2 := fun Q hQ => hL Q (by simp [hQ])
    rw [splitAllAt, List.flatMap_cons, crossings_append, ← splitAllAt, ih hL',
      crossings_splitAt hP c q, crossings_cons, crossings_cons, crossings_nil, add_zero]

name: Schoenflies.crossings_subdivide
statement:
theorem crossings_subdivide (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) (points : List Plane)
    (q : Plane) : crossings u (subdivide L points) q = crossings u L q
proof:
:= by
  induction points generalizing L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
    rw [subdivide_cons, ih (splitAllAt_hgt_ne hL c), crossings_splitAllAt hL c q]

name: Schoenflies.parity_subdivide
statement:
theorem parity_subdivide (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) (points : List Plane)
    (q : Plane) : parity u (subdivide L points) q = parity u L q
proof:
:= by
  rw [parity_eq_crossings, parity_eq_crossings, crossings_subdivide hL]

name: Schoenflies.sum_map_add
statement:
theorem sum_map_add {α : Type*} (l : List α) (F G : α → ZMod 2) :
    (l.map (fun x => F x + G x)).sum = (l.map F).sum + (l.map G).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x l ih => simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih]; ring

name: Schoenflies.sum_map_flatMap
statement:
theorem sum_map_flatMap {α β : Type*} (l : List α) (g : α → List β) (F : β → ZMod 2) :
    ((l.flatMap g).map F).sum = (l.map (fun x => ((g x).map F).sum)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x l ih => simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_append, List.sum_append, ih,
      List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]

name: Schoenflies.add_self_zmod_two
statement: theorem add_self_zmod_two (x : ZMod 2) : x + x = 0
proof:
:= by
  revert x; decide

name: Schoenflies.isClosedChain_nil
statement: theorem isClosedChain_nil : IsClosedChain []
proof: := fun _ => by simp

name: Schoenflies.isClosedChain_edgesOf
statement: theorem isClosedChain_edgesOf (vs : List Plane) : IsClosedChain (edgesOf vs)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  have h1 : (edgesOf vs).map Prod.fst = vs :=
    List.map_fst_zip (by simp)
  have h2 : (edgesOf vs).map Prod.snd = vs.rotate 1 :=
    List.map_snd_zip (by simp)
  have e1 : ((edgesOf vs).map (fun P => f P.1)).sum = (vs.map f).sum := by
    calc ((edgesOf vs).map (fun P => f P.1)).sum
        = (((edgesOf vs).map Prod.fst).map f).sum := by rw [List.map_map]; rfl
      _ = (vs.map f).sum := by rw [h1]
  have e2 : ((edgesOf vs).map (fun P => f P.2)).sum = ((vs.rotate 1).map f).sum := by
    calc ((edgesOf vs).map (fun P => f P.2)).sum
        = (((edgesOf vs).map Prod.snd).map f).sum := by rw [List.map_map]; rfl
      _ = ((vs.rotate 1).map f).sum := by rw [h2]
  have e3 : ((vs.rotate 1).map f).sum = (vs.map f).sum :=
    List.Perm.sum_eq (List.Perm.map f (vs.rotate_perm 1))
  rw [sum_map_add, e1, e2, e3]
  exact add_self_zmod_two _

name: Schoenflies.isClosedChain_splitAllAt
statement:
theorem isClosedChain_splitAllAt (h : IsClosedChain L) (c : Plane) :
    IsClosedChain (splitAllAt c L)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro f
  have step : ∀ P : Piece, (((splitAt c P).map (fun Q => f Q.1 + f Q.2)).sum) = f P.1 + f P.2 := by
    intro P
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := P
    unfold splitAt
    split_ifs
    · simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
      linear_combination add_self_zmod_two (f c)
    · simp
  rw [splitAllAt, sum_map_flatMap, List.map_congr_left (fun P _ => step P)]
  exact h f

name: Schoenflies.isClosedChain_subdivide
statement:
theorem isClosedChain_subdivide (h : IsClosedChain L) (points : List Plane) :
    IsClosedChain (subdivide L points)
proof:
:= by
  induction points generalizing L with
  | nil => exact h
  | cons c cs ih => exact ih (isClosedChain_splitAllAt h c)

name: Schoenflies.mem_cover
statement: theorem mem_cover {P : Piece} (hP : P ∈ L) (hz : z ∈ P.seg) : z ∈ cover L
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_biUnion hP hz

name: Schoenflies.isCompact_cover
statement: theorem isCompact_cover (L : List Piece) : IsCompact (cover L)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rw [cover_nil]; exact isCompact_empty
  | cons P L ih => rw [cover_cons]; exact (isCompact_segment P.1 P.2).union ih

name: Schoenflies.isClosed_cover
statement: theorem isClosed_cover (L : List Piece) : IsClosed (cover L)
proof: := (isCompact_cover L).isClosed

name: Schoenflies.meet_mem_seg
statement:
theorem meet_mem_seg {P : Piece} (h : hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2)
    (h1 : min (hgt u P.1) (hgt u P.2) ≤ t) (h2 : t ≤ max (hgt u P.1) (hgt u P.2)) :
    meet u P.1 P.2 t ∈ P.seg
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with hlt | hlt
  · rw [min_eq_left hlt.le] at h1
    rw [max_eq_right hlt.le] at h2
    exact meet_mem_segment hlt h1 h2
  · rw [min_eq_right hlt.le] at h1
    rw [max_eq_left hlt.le] at h2
    have hmem := meet_mem_segment hlt h1 h2
    rwa [meet_swap h, segment_symm] at hmem

name: Schoenflies.hgt_along
statement: theorem hgt_along (q : Plane) (s : ℝ) : hgt u (q + s • u) = hgt u q
proof:
:= by
  rw [hgt_add_smul, hgt_self]; ring

name: Schoenflies.fwd_along
statement: theorem fwd_along (q : Plane) (s : ℝ) : fwd u (q + s • u) = fwd u q + s
proof:
:= by
  rw [fwd_add_smul, fwd_self hu]; ring

name: Schoenflies.hgt_across
statement: theorem hgt_across (q : Plane) (s : ℝ) : hgt u (q + s • Plane.perp u) = hgt u q + s
proof:
:= by
  rw [hgt_add_smul, hgt_perp hu]; ring

name: Schoenflies.fwd_across
statement: theorem fwd_across (q : Plane) (s : ℝ) : fwd u (q + s • Plane.perp u) = fwd u q
proof:
:= by
  rw [fwd_add_smul, fwd_perp]; ring

name: Schoenflies.mem_segment_along
statement:
theorem mem_segment_along {q y : Plane} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (h1 : hgt u y = hgt u q)
    (h2 : fwd u q ≤ fwd u y) (h3 : fwd u y ≤ fwd u q + s) :
    y ∈ segment ℝ q (q + s • u)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs with rfl | hspos
  · have hy : y = q := eq_of_coords hu (by linarith) h1
    rw [hy, zero_smul, add_zero]
    exact left_mem_segment ℝ q q
  · rw [segment_eq_image' ℝ q (q + s • u)]
    refine ⟨(fwd u y - fwd u q) / s,
      ⟨div_nonneg (by linarith) hs, (div_le_one hspos).2 (by linarith)⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only []
    have hsub : q + s • u - q = s • u := by abel
    rw [hsub, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hspos)]
    exact eq_of_coords hu (by rw [fwd_add_smul, fwd_self hu]; ring)
      (by rw [hgt_add_smul, hgt_self, h1]; ring)

name: Schoenflies.mem_segment_across
statement:
theorem mem_segment_across {q y : Plane} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (h1 : fwd u y = fwd u q)
    (h2 : hgt u q ≤ hgt u y) (h3 : hgt u y ≤ hgt u q + s) :
    y ∈ segment ℝ q (q + s • Plane.perp u)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs with rfl | hspos
  · have hy : y = q := eq_of_coords hu h1 (by linarith)
    rw [hy, zero_smul, add_zero]
    exact left_mem_segment ℝ q q
  · rw [segment_eq_image' ℝ q (q + s • Plane.perp u)]
    refine ⟨(hgt u y - hgt u q) / s,
      ⟨div_nonneg (by linarith) hs, (div_le_one hspos).2 (by linarith)⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only []
    have hsub : q + s • Plane.perp u - q = s • Plane.perp u := by abel
    rw [hsub, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hspos)]
    exact eq_of_coords hu (by rw [fwd_add_smul, fwd_perp, h1]; ring)
      (by rw [hgt_add_smul, hgt_perp hu]; ring)

name: Schoenflies.side_const
statement:
theorem side_const {lo hi ξ : ℝ}
    (hmiss : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ a b, fwd u y = ξ → lo ≤ hgt u y → hgt u y ≤ hi → False)
    (hz : z ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hw : w ∈ segment ℝ a b)
    (hzl : lo ≤ hgt u z) (hzh : hgt u z ≤ hi) (hwl : lo ≤ hgt u w) (hwh : hgt u w ≤ hi) :
    (ξ < fwd u z ↔ ξ < fwd u w)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ z w : Plane, z ∈ segment ℝ a b → w ∈ segment ℝ a b →
      lo ≤ hgt u z → hgt u z ≤ hi → lo ≤ hgt u w → hgt u w ≤ hi →
      ξ < fwd u z → ξ < fwd u w := by
    intro z w hz hw hzl hzh hwl hwh hlt
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hpos : 0 < fwd u z - fwd u w := by linarith
    set r := (fwd u z - ξ) / (fwd u z - fwd u w) with hr
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg (by linarith) hpos.le
    have hr1 : r ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hpos).2 (by linarith)
    have hy : z + r • (w - z) ∈ segment ℝ a b :=
      (convex_segment a b).segment_subset hz hw
        (by rw [segment_eq_image' ℝ z w]; exact ⟨r, ⟨hr0, hr1⟩, rfl⟩)
    refine hmiss _ hy ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [fwd_lin, hr]; field_simp; ring
    · rw [hgt_lin]
      linarith [mul_nonneg hr0 (sub_nonneg.2 hwl), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hr1) (sub_nonneg.2 hzl)]
    · rw [hgt_lin]
      linarith [mul_nonneg hr0 (sub_nonneg.2 hwh), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hr1) (sub_nonneg.2 hzh)]
  exact ⟨fun h => key z w hz hw hzl hzh hwl hwh h, fun h => key w z hw hz hwl hwh hzl hzh h⟩

name: Schoenflies.parity_move_along
proof:
:= by
  refine congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left ?_)
  intro P hP
  have hPne := hL P hP
  have hiff : Crosses u P (q + s • u) ↔ Crosses u P q := by
    simp only [Crosses, hgt_along, fwd_along hu]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      exact ⟨h1, h2, by linarith⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_⟩
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      exact hmiss _ (mem_segment_along hu hs (hgt_meet hPne _) h3.le hcon)
        (mem_cover hP (meet_mem_seg hPne h1 h2.le))
  simp only [mark, hiff]

name: Schoenflies.mark_swap
statement: theorem mark_swap (h : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b) (q : Plane) : mark u (b, a) q = mark u (a, b) q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mark, crosses_swap h]

name: Schoenflies.mark_step
statement:
private theorem mark_step {q : Plane} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hab : hgt u a < hgt u b)
    (hmiss : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ a b, fwd u y = fwd u q → hgt u q ≤ hgt u y →
      hgt u y ≤ hgt u q + s → False) :
    mark u (a, b) q + mark u (a, b) (q + s • Plane.perp u)
      = fmark u q s a + fmark u q s b
proof:
:= by
  have hne : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b := ne_of_lt hab
  have hha : ∀ t : ℝ, hgt u (meet u a b t) = t := fun t => hgt_meet hne t
  have hma : ∀ t : ℝ, hgt u a ≤ t → t ≤ hgt u b → meet u a b t ∈ segment ℝ a b :=
    fun t h1 h2 => meet_mem_segment hab h1 h2
  have haseg : a ∈ segment ℝ a b := left_mem_segment ℝ a b
  have hbseg : b ∈ segment ℝ a b := right_mem_segment ℝ a b
  have hside : ∀ z, z ∈ segment ℝ a b → ∀ w, w ∈ segment ℝ a b →
      hgt u q ≤ hgt u z → hgt u z ≤ hgt u q + s →
      hgt u q ≤ hgt u w → hgt u w ≤ hgt u q + s →
      (fwd u q < fwd u z ↔ fwd u q < fwd u w) :=
    fun z hz w hw h1 h2 h3 h4 => side_const hmiss hz hw h1 h2 h3 h4
  simp only [mark, fmark, Crosses, min_eq_left hab.le, max_eq_right hab.le,
    hgt_across hu, fwd_across]
  rcases le_or_gt (hgt u a) (hgt u q) with hA | hA
  · rcases lt_or_ge (hgt u q + s) (hgt u b) with hB | hB
    · 
      have e := hside (meet u a b (hgt u q)) (hma _ hA (by linarith))
        (meet u a b (hgt u q + s)) (hma _ (by linarith) hB.le)
        (hha _).ge (by rw [hha]; linarith) (by rw [hha]; linarith) (hha _).le
      by_cases hD : fwd u q < fwd u (meet u a b (hgt u q))
      · rw [if_pos ⟨hA, by linarith, hD⟩, if_pos ⟨by linarith, hB, e.1 hD⟩,
          if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith), if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith)]
        decide
      · rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD g),
          if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD (e.2 g)),
          if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith), if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith)]
    · rcases lt_or_ge (hgt u q) (hgt u b) with hB2 | hB2
      · 
        have e := hside (meet u a b (hgt u q)) (hma _ hA hB2.le) b hbseg
          (hha _).ge (by rw [hha]; linarith) (by linarith) hB
        by_cases hD : fwd u q < fwd u (meet u a b (hgt u q))
        · rw [if_pos ⟨hA, hB2, hD⟩, if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith),
            if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith), if_pos ⟨hB2, hB, e.1 hD⟩]
          decide
        · rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD g),
            if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith),
            if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith),
            if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD (e.2 g))]
      · 
        rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith), if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith),
          if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith), if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith)]
  · rcases le_or_gt (hgt u a) (hgt u q + s) with hA2 | hA2
    · rcases lt_or_ge (hgt u q + s) (hgt u b) with hB | hB
      · 
        have e := hside (meet u a b (hgt u q + s)) (hma _ hA2 hB.le) a haseg
          (by rw [hha]; linarith) (hha _).le (by linarith) hA2
        by_cases hD : fwd u q < fwd u a
        · rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith), if_pos ⟨hA2, hB, e.2 hD⟩,
            if_pos ⟨hA, hA2, hD⟩, if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith)]
          decide
        · rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith),
            if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD (e.1 g)),
            if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD g),
            if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith)]
      · 
        have e := hside a haseg b hbseg (by linarith) hA2 (by linarith) hB
        by_cases hD : fwd u q < fwd u a
        · rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith), if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith),
            if_pos ⟨hA, hA2, hD⟩, if_pos ⟨by linarith, hB, e.1 hD⟩]
          decide
        · rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith), if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith),
            if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD g),
            if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩; exact hD (e.2 g))]
    · 
      rw [if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith), if_neg (by rintro ⟨g, -, -⟩; linarith),
        if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith), if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, g, -⟩; linarith)]

name: Schoenflies.parity_move_across
statement:
theorem parity_move_across (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) (hC : IsClosedChain L)
    {q : Plane} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hmiss : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ q (q + s • Plane.perp u), y ∉ cover L) :
    parity u L (q + s • Plane.perp u) = parity u L q
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ P ∈ L, mark u P q + mark u P (q + s • Plane.perp u)
      = fmark u q s P.1 + fmark u q s P.2 := by
    intro P hP
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := P
    have hne := hL (a, b) hP
    have hmiss' : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ a b, fwd u y = fwd u q → hgt u q ≤ hgt u y →
        hgt u y ≤ hgt u q + s → False := fun y hy h1 h2 h3 =>
      hmiss y (mem_segment_across hu hs h1 h2 h3) (mem_cover hP hy)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
    · exact mark_step hu hs h hmiss'
    · have hmiss'' : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ b a, fwd u y = fwd u q → hgt u q ≤ hgt u y →
          hgt u y ≤ hgt u q + s → False := by
        intro y hy
        exact hmiss' y (by rwa [segment_symm] at hy)
      have hstep := mark_step hu hs h hmiss''
      rw [mark_swap hne, mark_swap hne] at hstep
      rw [hstep]
      exact add_comm _ _
  have hzero : parity u L q + parity u L (q + s • Plane.perp u) = 0 := by
    rw [parity, parity, ← sum_map_add, List.map_congr_left key]
    exact hC (fun v => fmark u q s v)
  have harith : ∀ x y : ZMod 2, x + y = 0 → y = x := by decide
  exact harith _ _ hzero

name: Schoenflies.parity_move_along'
statement:
theorem parity_move_along' (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) {q q' : Plane} (s : ℝ)
    (hq' : q' = q + s • u) (hmiss : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ q q', y ∉ cover L) :
    parity u L q' = parity u L q
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 s with hs | hs
  · subst hq'; exact parity_move_along hu hL hs hmiss
  · have hq : q = q' + (-s) • u := by rw [hq', neg_smul, add_neg_cancel_right]
    have hmiss' : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ q' (q' + (-s) • u), y ∉ cover L := by
      intro y hy
      rw [← hq] at hy
      exact hmiss y (by rwa [segment_symm] at hy)
    have hmove := parity_move_along hu hL (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ -s) hmiss'
    rw [← hq] at hmove
    exact hmove.symm

name: Schoenflies.parity_move_across'
statement:
theorem parity_move_across' (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) (hC : IsClosedChain L)
    {q q' : Plane} (s : ℝ) (hq' : q' = q + s • Plane.perp u)
    (hmiss : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ q q', y ∉ cover L) :
    parity u L q' = parity u L q
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 s with hs | hs
  · subst hq'; exact parity_move_across hu hL hC hs hmiss
  · have hq : q = q' + (-s) • Plane.perp u := by rw [hq', neg_smul, add_neg_cancel_right]
    have hmiss' : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ q' (q' + (-s) • Plane.perp u), y ∉ cover L := by
      intro y hy
      rw [← hq] at hy
      exact hmiss y (by rwa [segment_symm] at hy)
    have hmove := parity_move_across hu hL hC (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ -s) hmiss'
    rw [← hq] at hmove
    exact hmove.symm

name: Schoenflies.exists_ball_avoiding
statement:
theorem exists_ball_avoiding {z : Plane} (h : z ∉ cover L) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ y ∈ ball z ε, y ∉ cover L
proof:
:= by
  have hopen := (isClosed_cover L).isOpen_compl
  rw [Metric.isOpen_iff] at hopen
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsub⟩ := hopen z h
  exact ⟨ε, hε, fun y hy => hsub hy⟩

name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_of_mem_ball
statement:
theorem parity_eq_of_mem_ball (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) (hC : IsClosedChain L)
    {q q' : Plane} {ε : ℝ} (hq' : q' ∈ ball q ε) (hmiss : ∀ y ∈ ball q ε, y ∉ cover L) :
    parity u L q' = parity u L q
proof:
:= by
  have hεpos : 0 < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt dist_nonneg (mem_ball.1 hq')
  have hqb : q ∈ ball q ε := mem_ball_self hεpos
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Plane, w = q + (fwd u (q' - q)) • u := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hwball : w ∈ ball q ε := by
    have hsub : q + (fwd u (q' - q)) • u - q = (fwd u (q' - q)) • u := by abel
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hw, hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hu, mul_one]
    calc |fwd u (q' - q)| ≤ ‖q' - q‖ := abs_fwd_le_norm hu _
      _ = dist q' q := (dist_eq_norm q' q).symm
      _ < ε := mem_ball.1 hq'
  have hq'w : q' = w + (hgt u (q' - q)) • Plane.perp u := by
    have hd := decomp hu (q' - q)
    rw [hw, add_assoc, ← hd]
    abel
  have h1 : parity u L w = parity u L q :=
    parity_move_along' hu hL _ hw
      (fun y hy => hmiss y ((convex_ball q ε).segment_subset hqb hwball hy))
  have h2 : parity u L q' = parity u L w :=
    parity_move_across' hu hL hC _ hq'w
      (fun y hy => hmiss y ((convex_ball q ε).segment_subset hwball hq' hy))
  rw [h2, h1]

name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_of_isPreconnected
statement:
theorem parity_eq_of_isPreconnected (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2)
    (hC : IsClosedChain L) {S : Set Plane} (hS : IsPreconnected S)
    (hSC : ∀ z ∈ S, z ∉ cover L) {x y : Plane} (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) :
    parity u L x = parity u L y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hopen : ∀ c : ZMod 2, IsOpen {z : Plane | z ∉ cover L ∧ parity u L z = c} := by
    intro c
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
    rintro z ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := exists_ball_avoiding hz1
    exact ⟨ε, hε, fun t ht => ⟨hball t ht,
      by rw [parity_eq_of_mem_ball hu hL hC ht hball, hz2]⟩⟩
  have htwo : ∀ e : ZMod 2, e = parity u L x ∨ e = parity u L y := by
    revert hne
    generalize parity u L x = c
    generalize parity u L y = d
    revert c d
    decide
  obtain ⟨z, -, hzA, hzB⟩ :=
    hS _ _ (hopen (parity u L x)) (hopen (parity u L y))
      (fun t ht => (htwo (parity u L t)).imp (fun h => ⟨hSC t ht, h⟩) (fun h => ⟨hSC t ht, h⟩))
      ⟨x, hx, hSC x hx, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy, hSC y hy, rfl⟩
  exact hne (hzA.2 ▸ hzB.2)

name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_of_mem_connectedComponentIn
statement:
theorem parity_eq_of_mem_connectedComponentIn (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2)
    (hC : IsClosedChain L) {x y : Plane} (hx : x ∉ cover L)
    (hy : y ∈ connectedComponentIn (cover L)ᶜ x) : parity u L y = parity u L x
proof:
:=
  parity_eq_of_isPreconnected hu hL hC isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
    (fun _ ht => connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ ht) hy (mem_connectedComponentIn hx)

name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem parity_eq_zero_of_lt (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) {q : Plane}
    (h : ∀ z ∈ cover L, fwd u z < fwd u q) : parity u L q = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine List.sum_eq_zero ?_
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
  refine if_neg ?_
  rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  exact absurd (h _ (mem_cover hP (meet_mem_seg (hL P hP) h1 h2.le))) (not_lt.2 h3.le)

name: Schoenflies.parity_flip
statement:
theorem parity_flip {L₁ L₂ : List Piece} {a b p : Plane}
    (hL : ∀ P ∈ L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2)
    (hp : p ∈ openSegment ℝ a b) (h1 : p ∉ cover L₁) (h2 : p ∉ cover L₂) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < δ →
      p - t • u ∉ cover (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) ∧
      p + t • u ∉ cover (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) ∧
      parity u (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) (p - t • u)
        = parity u (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) (p + t • u) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hab : hgt u a ≠ hgt u b := hL (a, b) (by simp)
  have hpK : p ∉ cover (L₁ ++ L₂) := by
    rw [cover_append]
    rintro (h | h)
    · exact h1 h
    · exact h2 h
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := exists_ball_avoiding hpK
  refine ⟨ε, hε, fun t ht htε => ?_⟩
  
  have hneg : p - t • u = p + (-t) • u := by rw [neg_smul]; abel
  have hgm : hgt u (p - t • u) = hgt u p := by rw [hneg, hgt_along]
  have hgp : hgt u (p + t • u) = hgt u p := hgt_along p t
  have hfm : fwd u (p - t • u) = fwd u p - t := by rw [hneg, fwd_along hu]; ring
  have hfp : fwd u (p + t • u) = fwd u p + t := fwd_along hu p t
  have hdist : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < ε → p + r • u ∈ ball p ε := by
    intro r hr
    have hsub : p + r • u - p = r • u := by abel
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hu, mul_one]
    exact hr
  have habsm : |(-t)| < ε := by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos ht]; exact htε
  have habsp : |t| < ε := by rw [abs_of_pos ht]; exact htε
  
  have hpseg : p ∈ segment ℝ a b := openSegment_subset_segment ℝ a b hp
  have hmeetp : meet u a b (hgt u p) = p := (eq_meet hab hpseg).symm
  have hnotseg : ∀ r : ℝ, r ≠ 0 → p + r • u ∉ segment ℝ a b := by
    intro r hr hmem
    have heq : p + r • u = p := by
      rw [eq_meet hab hmem, hgt_along, hmeetp]
    have hf : fwd u (p + r • u) = fwd u p + r := fwd_along hu p r
    rw [heq] at hf
    exact hr (by linarith)
  have hcov : ∀ r : ℝ, r ≠ 0 → |r| < ε → p + r • u ∉ cover (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) := by
    intro r hr hrε hmem
    rw [cover_append, cover_cons] at hmem
    rcases hmem with h | h | h
    · exact hball _ (hdist r hrε) (by rw [cover_append]; exact Or.inl h)
    · exact hnotseg r hr h
    · exact hball _ (hdist r hrε) (by rw [cover_append]; exact Or.inr h)
  
  have hfar : ∀ P ∈ L₁ ++ L₂, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2 →
      min (hgt u P.1) (hgt u P.2) ≤ hgt u p → hgt u p ≤ max (hgt u P.1) (hgt u P.2) →
      ε ≤ |fwd u (meet u P.1 P.2 (hgt u p)) - fwd u p| := by
    intro P hP hPne g1 g2
    have hmcov : meet u P.1 P.2 (hgt u p) ∈ cover (L₁ ++ L₂) :=
      mem_cover hP (meet_mem_seg hPne g1 g2)
    have hmnb : ¬ (dist (meet u P.1 P.2 (hgt u p)) p < ε) := fun h =>
      hball _ (mem_ball.2 h) hmcov
    push Not at hmnb
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hmnb
    have hh : hgt u (meet u P.1 P.2 (hgt u p) - p) = 0 := by
      rw [hgt_sub, hgt_meet hPne]; ring
    have hd := decomp hu (meet u P.1 P.2 (hgt u p) - p)
    rw [hh, zero_smul, add_zero] at hd
    have hnorm : ‖meet u P.1 P.2 (hgt u p) - p‖
        = |fwd u (meet u P.1 P.2 (hgt u p) - p)| := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hd]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hu, mul_one]
    rw [hnorm, fwd_sub] at hmnb
    exact hmnb
  have hother : ∀ P ∈ L₁ ++ L₂, mark u P (p - t • u) + mark u P (p + t • u) = 0 := by
    intro P hP
    have hPne : hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2 := by
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hP with h | h
      · exact hL P (by simp [h])
      · exact hL P (by simp [h])
    have hiff : Crosses u P (p - t • u) ↔ Crosses u P (p + t • u) := by
      simp only [Crosses, hgm, hgp, hfm, hfp]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩
        refine ⟨g1, g2, ?_⟩
        rcases le_abs.1 (hfar P hP hPne g1 g2.le) with hcase | hcase
        · linarith
        · linarith
      · rintro ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩
        exact ⟨g1, g2, by linarith⟩
    simp only [mark, hiff]
    exact add_self_zmod_two _
  
  have hbtw : min (hgt u a) (hgt u b) < hgt u p ∧ hgt u p < max (hgt u a) (hgt u b) := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with h | h
    · obtain ⟨g1, g2⟩ := hgt_lt_of_mem_openSegment h hp
      rw [min_eq_left h.le, max_eq_right h.le]
      exact ⟨g1, g2⟩
    · obtain ⟨g1, g2⟩ := hgt_lt_of_mem_openSegment h (by rwa [openSegment_symm] at hp)
      rw [min_eq_right h.le, max_eq_left h.le]
      exact ⟨g1, g2⟩
  have hedge : mark u (a, b) (p - t • u) + mark u (a, b) (p + t • u) = 1 := by
    have hm1 : Crosses u (a, b) (p - t • u) := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hgm]; exact hbtw.1.le
      · rw [hgm]; exact hbtw.2
      · rw [hgm, hfm, hmeetp]; linarith
    have hm2 : ¬ Crosses u (a, b) (p + t • u) := by
      rintro ⟨-, -, g⟩
      rw [hgp, hfp, hmeetp] at g
      linarith
    rw [mark, mark, if_pos hm1, if_neg hm2, add_zero]
  refine ⟨by rw [hneg]; exact hcov (-t) (by linarith) habsm, hcov t (ne_of_gt ht) habsp, ?_⟩
  have hz1 : (L₁.map (fun P => mark u P (p - t • u) + mark u P (p + t • u))).sum = 0 := by
    refine List.sum_eq_zero ?_
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
    exact hother P (List.mem_append_left _ hP)
  have hz2 : (L₂.map (fun P => mark u P (p - t • u) + mark u P (p + t • u))).sum = 0 := by
    refine List.sum_eq_zero ?_
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
    exact hother P (List.mem_append_right _ hP)
  have hsum : parity u (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) (p - t • u)
      + parity u (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) (p + t • u) = 1 := by
    rw [parity, parity, ← sum_map_add, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_append,
      List.sum_cons, hz1, hz2, hedge]
    ring
  have harith : ∀ x y : ZMod 2, x + y = 1 → x = y + 1 := by decide
  exact harith _ _ hsum

name: Schoenflies.exists_direction_hgt_ne
statement:
theorem exists_direction_hgt_ne (L : List Piece) (hnd : ∀ P ∈ L, P.Nondeg) :
    ∃ u : Plane, Plane.IsDirection u ∧ ∀ P ∈ L, hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hdet⟩ :=
    Plane.exists_isDirection_det_ne_zero (L.finite_toSet.image (fun P : Piece => P.2 - P.1))
  refine ⟨u, hu, fun P hP heq => ?_⟩
  have hne : P.2 - P.1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 fun h => hnd P hP h.symm
  have hzero : hgt u (P.2 - P.1) = 0 := by rw [hgt_sub, heq]; ring
  exact hdet _ ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ hne hzero

name: Schoenflies.not_crosses_of_level
statement:
theorem not_crosses_of_level {c d : Plane} (h : hgt u c = hgt u d) (q : Plane) :
    ¬ Crosses u (c, d) q
proof:
:= by
  intro hcr
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := hcr
  have e1 : ((c, d) : Piece).1 = c := rfl
  have e2 : ((c, d) : Piece).2 = d := rfl
  rw [e1, e2, h, min_self] at h1
  rw [e1, e2, h, max_self] at h2
  linarith

name: Schoenflies.mark_swap'
statement: theorem mark_swap' (u : Plane) (P : Piece) (q : Plane) : mark u (P.2, P.1) q = mark u P q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := P
  by_cases h : hgt u a = hgt u b
  · rw [mark, mark, if_neg (not_crosses_of_level h.symm q), if_neg (not_crosses_of_level h q)]
  · exact mark_swap h q

name: Schoenflies.parity_perm
statement: theorem parity_perm (h : L₁.Perm L₂) (u q : Plane) : parity u L₁ q = parity u L₂ q
proof:
:=
  (h.map fun P => mark u P q).sum_eq

name: Schoenflies.cover_perm
statement: theorem cover_perm (h : L₁.Perm L₂) : cover L₁ = cover L₂
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [cover, mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨P, hP, hz⟩ => ⟨P, h.mem_iff.1 hP, hz⟩, fun ⟨P, hP, hz⟩ => ⟨P, h.mem_iff.2 hP, hz⟩⟩

name: Schoenflies.orientPiece_eq_or
statement: theorem orientPiece_eq_or (P : Piece) : orientPiece P = P ∨ orientPiece P = (P.2, P.1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Precedes P.1 P.2
  · exact Or.inl (orientPiece_of_precedes h)
  · exact Or.inr (orientPiece_of_not_precedes h)

name: Schoenflies.mark_orientPiece
statement:
theorem mark_orientPiece (u : Plane) (P : Piece) (q : Plane) :
    mark u (orientPiece P) q = mark u P q
proof:
:= by
  rcases orientPiece_eq_or P with h | h
  · rw [h]
  · rw [h, mark_swap']

name: Schoenflies.parity_map_orientPiece
statement:
theorem parity_map_orientPiece (u : Plane) (L : List Piece) (q : Plane) :
    parity u (L.map orientPiece) q = parity u L q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [parity, List.map_map]
  exact congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left fun P _ => mark_orientPiece u P q)

name: Schoenflies.hgt_ne_orientPiece
statement:
theorem hgt_ne_orientPiece {P : Piece} (h : hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2) :
    hgt u (orientPiece P).1 ≠ hgt u (orientPiece P).2
proof:
:= by
  rcases orientPiece_eq_or P with e | e
  · rw [e]; exact h
  · rw [e]; exact fun hh => h hh.symm

name: Schoenflies.hgt_ne_of_orientPiece
statement:
theorem hgt_ne_of_orientPiece {P : Piece} (h : hgt u (orientPiece P).1 ≠ hgt u (orientPiece P).2) :
    hgt u P.1 ≠ hgt u P.2
proof:
:= by
  rcases orientPiece_eq_or P with e | e
  · rw [e] at h; exact h
  · rw [e] at h; exact fun hh => h hh.symm

name: Schoenflies.chainSum_map_orientPiece
statement:
theorem chainSum_map_orientPiece (f : Plane → ZMod 2) (L : List Piece) :
    ((L.map orientPiece).map fun P => f P.1 + f P.2).sum
      = (L.map fun P => f P.1 + f P.2).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.map_map]
  refine congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left fun P _ => ?_)
  rcases orientPiece_eq_or P with e | e
  · rw [Function.comp_apply, e]
  · rw [Function.comp_apply, e]; exact add_comm _ _

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.refl
statement: @[refl] theorem SameEdges.refl (L : List Piece) : SameEdges L L
proof: := List.Perm.refl _

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.symm
statement: theorem SameEdges.symm (h : SameEdges L₁ L₂) : SameEdges L₂ L₁
proof: := List.Perm.symm h

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.trans
statement: theorem SameEdges.trans (h₁ : SameEdges L₁ L₂) (h₂ : SameEdges L₂ L₃) : SameEdges L₁ L₃
proof:
:=
  List.Perm.trans h₁ h₂

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.of_perm
statement: theorem SameEdges.of_perm (h : L₁.Perm L₂) : SameEdges L₁ L₂
proof: := h.map _

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.append
statement:
theorem SameEdges.append {L₁' L₂' : List Piece} (h₁ : SameEdges L₁ L₁') (h₂ : SameEdges L₂ L₂') :
    SameEdges (L₁ ++ L₂) (L₁' ++ L₂')
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [SameEdges, List.map_append] using List.Perm.append h₁ h₂

name: Schoenflies.sameEdges_reverse
statement: theorem sameEdges_reverse (L : List Piece) : SameEdges L.reverse L
proof:
:=
  SameEdges.of_perm (List.reverse_perm L)

name: Schoenflies.sameEdges_map_swap
statement: theorem sameEdges_map_swap (L : List Piece) : SameEdges (L.map fun P => (P.2, P.1)) L
proof:
:= by
  have : (L.map fun P => (P.2, P.1)).map orientPiece = L.map orientPiece := by
    rw [List.map_map]
    exact List.map_congr_left fun P _ => orientPiece_swap P
  rw [SameEdges, this]

name: Schoenflies.sameEdges_of_perm_reverse_swap
statement:
theorem sameEdges_of_perm_reverse_swap {L A K : List Piece}
    (h : L.Perm (A ++ (K.map fun P => (P.2, P.1)).reverse)) : SameEdges L (A ++ K)
proof:
:=
  (SameEdges.of_perm h).trans
    (SameEdges.append (SameEdges.refl A) ((sameEdges_reverse _).trans (sameEdges_map_swap K)))

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.parity_eq
statement:
theorem SameEdges.parity_eq (h : SameEdges L₁ L₂) (u q : Plane) :
    parity u L₁ q = parity u L₂ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← parity_map_orientPiece u L₁ q, ← parity_map_orientPiece u L₂ q]
  exact parity_perm h u q

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.cover_eq
statement: theorem SameEdges.cover_eq (h : SameEdges L₁ L₂) : cover L₁ = cover L₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cover_map_orientPiece L₁, ← cover_map_orientPiece L₂]
  exact cover_perm h

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.exists_mem
statement:
theorem SameEdges.exists_mem (h : SameEdges L₁ L₂) {Q : Piece} (hQ : Q ∈ L₁) :
    ∃ R ∈ L₂, orientPiece R = orientPiece Q
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : orientPiece Q ∈ L₂.map orientPiece :=
    h.mem_iff.1 (List.mem_map_of_mem (f := orientPiece) hQ)
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRQ⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hmem
  exact ⟨R, hR, hRQ⟩

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.hgt_ne
statement:
theorem SameEdges.hgt_ne (h : SameEdges L₁ L₂) (hL : ∀ Q ∈ L₂, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2) :
    ∀ Q ∈ L₁, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRQ⟩ := h.exists_mem hQ
  exact hgt_ne_of_orientPiece (hRQ ▸ hgt_ne_orientPiece (hL R hR))

name: Schoenflies.hgt_ne_append
statement:
theorem hgt_ne_append (h₁ : ∀ Q ∈ L₁, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2)
    (h₂ : ∀ Q ∈ L₂, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2) : ∀ Q ∈ L₁ ++ L₂, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hQ with h | h
  · exact h₁ Q h
  · exact h₂ Q h

name: Schoenflies.isChainFrom_self_iff
statement: theorem isChainFrom_self_iff : IsChainFrom L p p ↔ IsClosedChain L
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h f
  · rw [h f]; exact add_self_zmod_two _
  · rw [h f]; exact (add_self_zmod_two _).symm

name: Schoenflies.isChainFrom_nil
statement: theorem isChainFrom_nil (p : Plane) : IsChainFrom [] p p
proof:
:= fun f => by
  simp [(add_self_zmod_two (f p)).symm]

name: Schoenflies.IsChainFrom.append
statement:
theorem IsChainFrom.append (h₁ : IsChainFrom L₁ p q) (h₂ : IsChainFrom L₂ q r) :
    IsChainFrom (L₁ ++ L₂) p r
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  rw [List.map_append, List.sum_append, h₁ f, h₂ f]
  linear_combination add_self_zmod_two (f q)

name: Schoenflies.IsChainFrom.isClosedChain_append
statement:
theorem IsChainFrom.isClosedChain_append (h₁ : IsChainFrom L₁ p q) (h₂ : IsChainFrom L₂ p q) :
    IsClosedChain (L₁ ++ L₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  rw [List.map_append, List.sum_append, h₁ f, h₂ f]
  exact add_self_zmod_two _

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.isChainFrom
statement:
theorem SameEdges.isChainFrom (h : SameEdges L₁ L₂) (h₂ : IsChainFrom L₂ p q) :
    IsChainFrom L₁ p q
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  rw [← chainSum_map_orientPiece f L₁, (h.map fun P => f P.1 + f P.2).sum_eq,
    chainSum_map_orientPiece, h₂ f]

name: Schoenflies.SameEdges.isClosedChain
statement:
theorem SameEdges.isClosedChain (h : SameEdges L₁ L₂) (h₂ : IsClosedChain L₂) :
    IsClosedChain L₁
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  rw [← chainSum_map_orientPiece f L₁, (h.map fun P => f P.1 + f P.2).sum_eq,
    chainSum_map_orientPiece, h₂ f]

name: Schoenflies.pathPieces_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem pathPieces_nil : pathPieces [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.pathPieces_singleton
statement: @[simp] theorem pathPieces_singleton (v : Plane) : pathPieces [v] = []
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.pathPieces_cons_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathPieces_cons_cons (v w : Plane) (rest : List Plane) :
    pathPieces (v :: w :: rest) = (v, w) :: pathPieces (w :: rest)
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.isChainFrom_pathPieces
statement:
theorem isChainFrom_pathPieces (p : Plane) (mid : List Plane) (q : Plane) :
    IsChainFrom (pathPieces (p :: (mid ++ [q]))) p q
proof:
:= by
  induction mid generalizing p with
  | nil =>
    intro f
    simp
  | cons w ws ih =>
    intro f
    rw [List.cons_append, pathPieces_cons_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih w f]
    linear_combination add_self_zmod_two (f w)

name: Schoenflies.cover_pathPieces
statement:
theorem cover_pathPieces (p : Plane) (mid : List Plane) (q : Plane) :
    cover (pathPieces (p :: (mid ++ [q]))) = poly (p :: (mid ++ [q]))
proof:
:= by
  induction mid generalizing p with
  | nil =>
    rw [List.nil_append, pathPieces_cons_cons, pathPieces_singleton, cover_cons, cover_nil,
      poly_cons_cons, poly_singleton, union_empty]
    exact (union_eq_self_of_subset_right
      (singleton_subset_iff.2 (right_mem_segment ℝ p q))).symm
  | cons w ws ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append, pathPieces_cons_cons, cover_cons, ih w, poly_cons_cons]
    rfl

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.arcPieces_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem arcPieces_zero (C : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) :
    C.arcPieces a 0 = []
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.arcPieces_add
statement:
theorem arcPieces_add (C : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) (k l : ℕ) :
    C.arcPieces a (k + l) = C.arcPieces a k ++ C.arcPieces (a + k) l
proof:
:= by
  rw [arcPieces, arcPieces, arcPieces, List.range_add, List.map_append, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  refine List.map_congr_left fun t _ => ?_
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Nat.cast_add, ← add_assoc]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.arcPieces_full
statement: theorem arcPieces_full (C : ClosedPolygon m) : C.arcPieces 0 (m + 3) = C.pieces
proof:
:= by
  rw [arcPieces, pieces]
  exact List.map_congr_left fun t _ => by rw [zero_add]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.mem_pieces_of_mem_arcPieces
statement: theorem mem_pieces_of_mem_arcPieces {Q : Piece} (hQ : Q ∈ C.arcPieces a k) : Q ∈ C.pieces
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hQ
  exact C.mem_pieces _

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.arcPieces_nondeg
statement:
theorem arcPieces_nondeg (C : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ Q ∈ C.arcPieces a k, Q.Nondeg
proof:
:=
  fun _ hQ => C.pieces_nondeg _ (mem_pieces_of_mem_arcPieces hQ)

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.arcPieces_hgt_ne
statement:
theorem arcPieces_hgt_ne (hL : ∀ Q ∈ C.pieces, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2) :
    ∀ Q ∈ C.arcPieces a k, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2
proof:
:=
  fun _ hQ => hL _ (mem_pieces_of_mem_arcPieces hQ)

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.isChainFrom_arcPieces
statement:
theorem isChainFrom_arcPieces (C : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) (k : ℕ) :
    IsChainFrom (C.arcPieces a k) (C.vertex a) (C.vertex (a + k))
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  have hmap : ((C.arcPieces a k).map fun P => f P.1 + f P.2)
      = (List.range k).map fun j : ℕ =>
          f (C.vertex (a + (j : ZMod (m + 3))))
            + f (C.vertex (a + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)))) := by
    rw [arcPieces, List.map_map]
    refine List.map_congr_left fun t _ => ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, natCast_succ, ← add_assoc]
  have key := sum_range_boundary (fun i : ℕ => f (C.vertex (a + (i : ZMod (m + 3))))) k
  rw [hmap, key]
  simp

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.arcPieces_full_perm
statement:
theorem arcPieces_full_perm (C : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) :
    (C.arcPieces a (m + 3)).Perm C.pieces
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : a.val < m + 3 := ZMod.val_lt a
  have hcast : ((a.val : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) = a := ZMod.natCast_rightInverse a
  
  have hzero : a + ((m + 3 - a.val : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) = 0 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hlt.le, hcast]
    simp
  have hsplit1 : C.arcPieces a (m + 3)
      = C.arcPieces a (m + 3 - a.val) ++ C.arcPieces 0 a.val := by
    have h1 : (m + 3 - a.val) + a.val = m + 3 := by omega
    have h2 := arcPieces_add C a (m + 3 - a.val) a.val
    rwa [h1, hzero] at h2
  have hsplit2 : C.pieces = C.arcPieces 0 a.val ++ C.arcPieces a (m + 3 - a.val) := by
    have h1 : a.val + (m + 3 - a.val) = m + 3 := by omega
    have h2 := arcPieces_add C 0 a.val (m + 3 - a.val)
    rw [h1, arcPieces_full, zero_add, hcast] at h2
    exact h2
  rw [hsplit1, hsplit2]
  exact List.perm_append_comm

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.arcPieces_split_perm
statement:
theorem arcPieces_split_perm (C : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) (hk : k ≤ m + 3) :
    (C.arcPieces a k ++ C.arcPieces (a + k) (m + 3 - k)).Perm C.pieces
proof:
:= by
  rw [← arcPieces_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hk]
  exact arcPieces_full_perm C a

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.sameEdges_arcPieces_split
statement:
theorem sameEdges_arcPieces_split (C : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) (hk : k ≤ m + 3) :
    SameEdges C.pieces (C.arcPieces a k ++ C.arcPieces (a + k) (m + 3 - k))
proof:
:=
  SameEdges.of_perm (arcPieces_split_perm C a hk).symm

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.cover_arcPieces_union
statement:
theorem cover_arcPieces_union (C : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) (hk : k ≤ m + 3) :
    cover (C.arcPieces a k) ∪ cover (C.arcPieces (a + k) (m + 3 - k)) = C.carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cover_append, cover_perm (arcPieces_split_perm C a hk), cover_pieces]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.cover_arcPieces_subset
statement:
theorem cover_arcPieces_subset (C : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) (k : ℕ) :
    cover (C.arcPieces a k) ⊆ C.carrier
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hzR⟩ := exists_of_mem_cover hz
  rw [← cover_pieces]
  exact mem_cover (mem_pieces_of_mem_arcPieces hR) hzR

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.isClosedChain_arcPieces_append
proof:
:=
  (isChainFrom_arcPieces C a k).isClosedChain_append hK

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.arcPieces_append_hgt_ne
proof:
:=
  hgt_ne_append (arcPieces_hgt_ne hC) hK

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.carrier_eq_of_sameEdges
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cover_pieces, h.cover_eq, cover_append]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.notMem_carrier_of_sameEdges
proof:
:= by
  rw [carrier_eq_of_sameEdges h]
  rintro (hx | hx)
  · exact hxC (cover_arcPieces_subset C a k hx)
  · exact hxK hx

name: Schoenflies.parity_split
proof:
:= by
  rw [h₁.parity_eq u q, h₂.parity_eq u q, hC.parity_eq u q, parity_append, parity_append,
    parity_append]
  linear_combination add_self_zmod_two (parity u K q)

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.parity_splitting
statement:
theorem parity_splitting (C : ClosedPolygon m) (u : Plane) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) (hk : k ≤ m + 3)
    {K : List Piece} (h₁ : SameEdges L₁ (C.arcPieces a k ++ K))
    (h₂ : SameEdges L₂ (C.arcPieces (a + k) (m + 3 - k) ++ K)) (q : Plane) :
    parity u L₁ q + parity u L₂ q = parity u C.pieces q
proof:
:=
  parity_split u (sameEdges_arcPieces_split C a hk) h₁ h₂ q

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.parity_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem parity_eq_one_iff (C : ClosedPolygon m) {u : Plane} (hu : Plane.IsDirection u)
    (hL : ∀ Q ∈ C.pieces, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2) {x : Plane} (hx : x ∉ C.carrier) :
    parity u C.pieces x = 1 ↔ x ∈ inside C.carrier
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : x ∈ inside C.carrier ∪ outside C.carrier := by
    rw [inside_union_outside]; exact hx
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, C.parity_eq_one_of_mem_inside hu hL⟩
  rcases hmem with h' | h'
  · exact h'
  · rw [C.parity_eq_zero_of_mem_outside hu hL h'] at h
    exact absurd h (by decide)

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.crosscut_inside_exactly_one
statement:
theorem crosscut_inside_exactly_one {m₁ m₂ : ℕ} (C : ClosedPolygon m) (J₁ : ClosedPolygon m₁)
    (J₂ : ClosedPolygon m₂) {u : Plane} (hu : Plane.IsDirection u)
    (hC : ∀ Q ∈ C.pieces, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2) {K : List Piece}
    (hK : ∀ Q ∈ K, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2) (hk : k ≤ m + 3)
    (h₁ : SameEdges J₁.pieces (C.arcPieces a k ++ K))
    (h₂ : SameEdges J₂.pieces (C.arcPieces (a + k) (m + 3 - k) ++ K))
    {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ inside C.carrier) (hxK : x ∉ cover K) :
    x ∈ inside J₁.carrier ↔ x ∉ inside J₂.carrier
proof:
:= by
  have hJ₁ := h₁.hgt_ne (arcPieces_append_hgt_ne hC hK)
  have hJ₂ := h₂.hgt_ne (arcPieces_append_hgt_ne hC hK)
  have hsum := C.parity_splitting u a hk h₁ h₂ x
  rw [C.parity_eq_one_of_mem_inside hu hC hx] at hsum
  have harith : ∀ s t : ZMod 2, s + t = 1 → (s = 1 ↔ ¬ t = 1) := by decide
  rw [← J₁.parity_eq_one_iff hu hJ₁ (notMem_carrier_of_sameEdges h₁ hx.1 hxK),
    ← J₂.parity_eq_one_iff hu hJ₂ (notMem_carrier_of_sameEdges h₂ hx.1 hxK)]
  exact harith _ _ hsum

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.crosscut_outside_agree
statement:
theorem crosscut_outside_agree {m₁ m₂ : ℕ} (C : ClosedPolygon m) (J₁ : ClosedPolygon m₁)
    (J₂ : ClosedPolygon m₂) {u : Plane} (hu : Plane.IsDirection u)
    (hC : ∀ Q ∈ C.pieces, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2) {K : List Piece}
    (hK : ∀ Q ∈ K, hgt u Q.1 ≠ hgt u Q.2) (hk : k ≤ m + 3)
    (h₁ : SameEdges J₁.pieces (C.arcPieces a k ++ K))
    (h₂ : SameEdges J₂.pieces (C.arcPieces (a + k) (m + 3 - k) ++ K))
    {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ outside C.carrier) (hxK : x ∉ cover K) :
    x ∈ inside J₁.carrier ↔ x ∈ inside J₂.carrier
proof:
:= by
  have hJ₁ := h₁.hgt_ne (arcPieces_append_hgt_ne hC hK)
  have hJ₂ := h₂.hgt_ne (arcPieces_append_hgt_ne hC hK)
  have hsum := C.parity_splitting u a hk h₁ h₂ x
  rw [C.parity_eq_zero_of_mem_outside hu hC hx] at hsum
  have harith : ∀ s t : ZMod 2, s + t = 0 → (s = 1 ↔ t = 1) := by decide
  rw [← J₁.parity_eq_one_iff hu hJ₁ (notMem_carrier_of_sameEdges h₁ hx.1 hxK),
    ← J₂.parity_eq_one_iff hu hJ₂ (notMem_carrier_of_sameEdges h₂ hx.1 hxK)]
  exact harith _ _ hsum

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mk_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_zero (x y : ℝ) : mk x y 0 = x
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mk_one
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_one (x y : ℝ) : mk x y 1 = y
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.Plane.perp_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem perp_zero (u : Plane) : perp u 0 = -u 1
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.Plane.perp_one
statement: @[simp] theorem perp_one (u : Plane) : perp u 1 = u 0
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_self
statement: @[simp] theorem det_self (a : Plane) : det a a = 0
proof: := by simp [det]; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_comm
statement: theorem det_comm (a b : Plane) : det a b = -det b a
proof: := by simp [det]; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_smul_left
statement: @[simp] theorem det_smul_left (r : ℝ) (a b : Plane) : det (r • a) b = r * det a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [det]; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_smul_right
statement: @[simp] theorem det_smul_right (r : ℝ) (a b : Plane) : det a (r • b) = r * det a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [det]; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_add_left
statement: theorem det_add_left (a b c : Plane) : det (a + b) c = det a c + det b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [det]; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_add_right
statement: theorem det_add_right (a b c : Plane) : det a (b + c) = det a b + det a c
proof:
:= by
  simp [det]; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_perp_self
statement: @[simp] theorem det_perp_self (u : Plane) : det u (perp u) = ‖u‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  simp [det, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.inner_eq
statement: theorem inner_eq (u v : Plane) : inner ℝ u v = u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, mul_comm]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.perp_perp
statement: @[simp] theorem perp_perp (u : Plane) : perp (perp u) = -u
proof:
:= by
  ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp

name: Schoenflies.Plane.inner_perp_self
statement: @[simp] theorem inner_perp_self (u : Plane) : inner ℝ u (perp u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_eq]; simp; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_perp_right
statement: @[simp] theorem det_perp_right (u v : Plane) : det u (perp v) = inner ℝ u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_eq]; simp [det]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_perp_left
statement: @[simp] theorem det_perp_left (u v : Plane) : det (perp u) v = -inner ℝ u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_eq]; simp [det]; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_perp_perp
statement: @[simp] theorem det_perp_perp (u v : Plane) : det (perp u) (perp v) = det u v
proof:
:= by
  simp [det]; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.norm_perp
statement: @[simp] theorem norm_perp (u : Plane) : ‖perp u‖ = ‖u‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  congr 1
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, sq_abs]
  ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_eq_zero_iff_smul
statement:
theorem det_eq_zero_iff_smul (u v : Plane) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    det u v = 0 ↔ ∃ r : ℝ, v = r • u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    
    have hcoord : u 0 ≠ 0 ∨ u 1 ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hc
      push Not at hc
      exact hu (by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hc.1, hc.2])
    simp only [det, sub_eq_zero] at h
    rcases hcoord with h0 | h1
    · refine ⟨v 0 / u 0, ?_⟩
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp <;> field_simp; linarith
    · refine ⟨v 1 / u 1, ?_⟩
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp <;> field_simp; linarith
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    simp

name: Schoenflies.Plane.notMem_of_mem_segment_of_isMinOn
statement:
theorem notMem_of_mem_segment_of_isMinOn (haK : a ∈ K) (hxK : x ∉ K)
    (hmin : ∀ b ∈ K, dist x a ≤ dist x b) (hy : y ∈ segment ℝ x a) (hya : y ≠ a) :
    y ∉ K
proof:
:= by
  intro hyK
