      have hzC : z ∈ C := hAC hz.1
      rw [← hD] at hzC
      exact hzC.elim h1 h2
    
    have hends : ∀ D : Set Plane, p ∈ D → q ∈ D → A \ {p, q} ⊆ D → A ⊆ D := by
      intro D hpD' hqD' hsub' z hz
      by_cases hzpq : z ∈ ({p, q} : Set Plane)
      · rcases hzpq with rfl | rfl
        exacts [hpD', hqD']
      · exact hsub' ⟨hz, hzpq⟩
    by_cases hcase : ((A \ {p, q}) ∩ D₁ᶜ).Nonempty
    · refine Or.inr (hends D₂ hpD.2 hqD.2 fun z hz => ?_)
      by_contra hzD2
      exact hnone (hconn _ _ (hD1.isArc.isClosed).isOpen_compl (hD2.isArc.isClosed).isOpen_compl
        hsub hcase ⟨z, hz, hzD2⟩)
    · refine Or.inl (hends D₁ hpD.1 hqD.1 fun z hz => ?_)
      by_contra hzD1
      exact hcase ⟨z, hz, hzD1⟩
  
  have hthird : ∀ D : Set Plane, IsArcBetween D p q → ¬ D ⊆ ({p, q} : Set Plane) := by
    intro D hDar hsub
    obtain ⟨-, z, hz⟩ := hDar.preconnected_diff
    exact hz.2 (hsub hz.1)
  have hnotboth : ∀ D D' : Set Plane, D ∪ D' = C → D ∩ D' = {p, q} → IsArcBetween D' p q →
      A₁ ⊆ D → A₂ ⊆ D → False := by
    intro D D' hDD hDDi hD'ar h1 h2
    refine hthird D' hD'ar ?_
    rw [← hDDi]
    intro z hz
    have hzC : z ∈ C := by rw [← hDD]; exact Or.inr hz
    rw [← hA] at hzC
    exact hzC.elim (fun h => ⟨h1 h, hz⟩) fun h => ⟨h2 h, hz⟩
  
  have heq : ∀ X Y X' Y' : Set Plane, X ∪ Y = C → X' ∪ Y' = C → X' ∩ Y' = {p, q} →
      p ∈ X → q ∈ X → X ⊆ X' → Y ⊆ Y' → X = X' := by
    intro X Y X' Y' hXY hX'Y' hX'Y'i hpX hqX hXX hYY
    refine Set.Subset.antisymm hXX fun z hz => ?_
    have hzC : z ∈ C := by rw [← hX'Y']; exact Or.inl hz
    rw [← hXY] at hzC
    rcases hzC with h | h
    · exact h
    · have hzpq : z ∈ ({p, q} : Set Plane) := by rw [← hX'Y'i]; exact ⟨hz, hYY h⟩
      rcases hzpq with rfl | rfl
      exacts [hpX, hqX]
  have hAC₁ : A₁ ⊆ C := by rw [← hA]; exact Set.subset_union_left
  have hAC₂ : A₂ ⊆ C := by rw [← hA]; exact Set.subset_union_right
  rcases key A₁ hA1 hAC₁ with h1 | h1 <;> rcases key A₂ hA2 hAC₂ with h2 | h2
  · exact absurd (hnotboth D₁ D₂ hD hDi hD2 h1 h2) (by simp)
  · exact Or.inl ⟨heq A₁ A₂ D₁ D₂ hA hD hDi hpA.1 hqA.1 h1 h2,
      heq A₂ A₁ D₂ D₁ (by rw [Set.union_comm]; exact hA) (by rw [Set.union_comm]; exact hD)
        (by rw [Set.inter_comm]; exact hDi) hpA.2 hqA.2 h2 h1⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨heq A₁ A₂ D₂ D₁ hA (by rw [Set.union_comm]; exact hD)
      (by rw [Set.inter_comm]; exact hDi) hpA.1 hqA.1 h1 h2,
      heq A₂ A₁ D₁ D₂ (by rw [Set.union_comm]; exact hA) hD hDi hpA.2 hqA.2 h2 h1⟩
  · exact absurd (hnotboth D₂ D₁ (by rw [Set.union_comm]; exact hD)
      (by rw [Set.inter_comm]; exact hDi) hD1 h1 h2) (by simp)

name: Schoenflies.exists_closedPolygon_arcs
statement:
theorem exists_closedPolygon_arcs {C A₁ A₂ : Set Plane} (hJ : IsJordanCurve C)
    (hP : IsPolygonal C) {p q : Plane} (hp : IsCornerAt C p) (hq : IsCornerAt C q) (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hA1 : IsArcBetween A₁ p q) (hA2 : IsArcBetween A₂ p q) (hunion : A₁ ∪ A₂ = C)
    (hinter : A₁ ∩ A₂ = {p, q}) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (P : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) (k : ℕ), P.carrier = C ∧
      1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ m + 2 ∧ P.vertex a = p ∧ P.vertex (a + (k : ZMod (m + 3))) = q ∧
      ((P.arc a k = A₁ ∧ P.arc (a + (k : ZMod (m + 3))) (m + 3 - k) = A₂) ∨
        (P.arc a k = A₂ ∧ P.arc (a + (k : ZMod (m + 3))) (m + 3 - k) = A₁))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, P, a, k, hcar, hpa, hqa, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_closedPolygon_split hJ hP hp hq hpq
  refine ⟨m, P, a, k, hcar, hk1, hk2, hpa, hqa, ?_⟩
  have hD1 : IsArcBetween (P.arc a k) p q := by
    rw [← hpa, ← hqa]; exact P.isArcBetween_arc a hk1 hk2
  have hD2 : IsArcBetween (P.arc (a + (k : ZMod (m + 3))) (m + 3 - k)) p q := by
    have h := P.isArcBetween_arc (a + (k : ZMod (m + 3))) (k := m + 3 - k) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [zmod_add_sub_cancel (by omega) a] at h
    rw [← hpa, ← hqa]
    exact h.reverse
  have hDunion : P.arc a k ∪ P.arc (a + (k : ZMod (m + 3))) (m + 3 - k) = C := by
    rw [P.arc_union a (by omega), hcar]
  have hDinter : P.arc a k ∩ P.arc (a + (k : ZMod (m + 3))) (m + 3 - k) = {p, q} := by
    rw [P.arc_inter a hk1 hk2, hpa, hqa]
  rcases two_arcs_unique hunion hinter hDunion hDinter hA1 hA2 hD1 hD2 with ⟨e1, e2⟩ | ⟨e1, e2⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨e1.symm, e2.symm⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨e2.symm, e1.symm⟩

name: Schoenflies.exists_closedPolygon_arcs_ordered
statement:
theorem exists_closedPolygon_arcs_ordered {C A₁ A₂ : Set Plane} (hJ : IsJordanCurve C)
    (hP : IsPolygonal C) {p q : Plane} (hp : IsCornerAt C p) (hq : IsCornerAt C q) (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hA1 : IsArcBetween A₁ p q) (hA2 : IsArcBetween A₂ p q) (hunion : A₁ ∪ A₂ = C)
    (hinter : A₁ ∩ A₂ = {p, q}) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (P : ClosedPolygon m) (a : ZMod (m + 3)) (k : ℕ), P.carrier = C ∧
      1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ m + 2 ∧
      P.arc a k = A₁ ∧ P.arc (a + (k : ZMod (m + 3))) (m + 3 - k) = A₂ ∧
      ((P.vertex a = p ∧ P.vertex (a + (k : ZMod (m + 3))) = q) ∨
        (P.vertex a = q ∧ P.vertex (a + (k : ZMod (m + 3))) = p))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, P, a, k, hcar, hk1, hk2, hpa, hqa, hcase⟩ :=
    exists_closedPolygon_arcs hJ hP hp hq hpq hA1 hA2 hunion hinter
  rcases hcase with ⟨e1, e2⟩ | ⟨e1, e2⟩
  · exact ⟨m, P, a, k, hcar, hk1, hk2, e1, e2, Or.inl ⟨hpa, hqa⟩⟩
  · refine ⟨m, P, a + (k : ZMod (m + 3)), m + 3 - k, hcar, by omega, by omega, e2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [zmod_add_sub_cancel (by omega) a, show m + 3 - (m + 3 - k) = k by omega]
      exact e1
    · rw [zmod_add_sub_cancel (by omega) a]
      exact Or.inr ⟨hqa, hpa⟩

name: Graph.coveredVertices_map
statement:
theorem coveredVertices_map (f : α → α') :
    (G.map f).coveredVertices W = f '' G.coveredVertices W
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_coveredVertices_iff, map_inc, Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he, v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨v, ⟨e, he, hv⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, ⟨e, he, hv⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e, he, v, hv, rfl⟩

name: Graph.walkVertices_map
statement:
theorem walkVertices_map (f : α → α') (u : α) (W : List β) :
    (G.map f).walkVertices (f u) W = f '' G.walkVertices u W
proof:
:= by
  rw [walkVertices, walkVertices, coveredVertices_map, Set.image_insert_eq]

name: Graph.IsPath.map
statement: theorem IsPath.map (hf : InjOn f V(G)) (h : G.IsPath u W v) : (G.map f).IsPath (f u) W (f v)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil hx => exact .nil (by simpa using Set.mem_image_of_mem f hx)
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW hfresh ih =>
    refine .cons (hl.map f) ih ?_
    rw [walkVertices_map]
    rintro ⟨z, hz, hzf⟩
    have hzV : z ∈ V(G) := walkVertices_subset_vertexSet hW.isWalk.left_mem hz
    exact hfresh (hf hzV hl.left_mem hzf ▸ hz)

name: Graph.map_union
statement:
theorem map_union (G H : Graph α β) (f : α → α') :
    (G.union H).map f = (G.map f).union (H.map f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Graph.ext (by simp [Set.image_union]) fun e x y => ?_
  simp only [map_isLink, union_isLink, Relation.map_apply, edgeSet_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, hab | ⟨he, hab⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨a, b, hab, rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨he, a, b, hab, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨a, b, hab, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨he, a, b, hab, rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨a, b, Or.inl hab, rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨a, b, Or.inr ⟨he, hab⟩, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Graph.IsPathGraph.map
statement:
theorem IsPathGraph.map {P : Graph α β} (hf : InjOn f V(P)) (h : P.IsPathGraph u W v) :
    (P.map f).IsPathGraph (f u) W (f v) where
  isPath
proof:
:= h.isPath.map hf
  edgeSet_eq := by rw [edgeSet_map]; exact h.edgeSet_eq
  vertexSet_eq := by rw [vertexSet_map, walkVertices_map, h.vertexSet_eq]

name: Graph.walkPointSet_eq_pointSet
statement:
theorem walkPointSet_eq_pointSet {u v : Plane} {W : List β} (h : H.IsPathGraph u W v) :
    walkPointSet H drw u W = pointSet H drw
proof:
:= by
  rw [walkPointSet, pointSet, h.vertexSet_eq, h.edgeSet_eq]

name: Graph.walkPointSet_nil
statement: theorem walkPointSet_nil (u : Plane) : walkPointSet H drw u ([] : List β) = {u}
proof:
:= by
  rw [walkPointSet, walkVertices_nil]
  simp

name: Graph.walkPointSet_cons
proof:
:= by
  have hu : u ∈ edgeArc drw e := (hD.edge_isArcBetween hl).left_mem
  have hset : ({f | f ∈ e :: W} : Set β) = insert e {f | f ∈ W} := by
    ext f; simp [List.mem_cons]
  rw [walkPointSet, walkPointSet, walkVertices_cons hl, hset, Set.biUnion_insert]
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rintro z (hz | hz)
    · rcases hz with rfl | hz
      · exact Or.inl hu
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hz)
    · rcases hz with hz | hz
      · exact Or.inl hz
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hz)
  · rintro z (hz | hz | hz)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hz)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hz)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hz)

name: Graph.IsDrawing.isArcBetween_walkPointSet
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.isArcBetween_walkPointSet (hD : IsDrawing H drw) :
    ∀ {u v : Plane} {W : List β}, H.IsPath u W v → u ≠ v →
      IsArcBetween (walkPointSet H drw u W) u v
proof:
:= by
  intro u v W hp
  induction hp with
  | nil => exact fun h => absurd rfl h
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW hfresh ih =>
    intro _
    rw [walkPointSet_cons hD hl]
    have harc : IsArcBetween (edgeArc drw e) u w := hD.edge_isArcBetween hl
    by_cases hwv : w = v
    · subst hwv
      rw [hW.eq_nil_of_eq, walkPointSet_nil,
        Set.union_eq_self_of_subset_right (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 harc.right_mem)]
      exact harc
    · refine harc.concatenate (ih hwv) ?_
      intro z hz hz'
      
      have hzw : z ∈ H.walkVertices w W := by
        rcases hz' with hz' | hz'
        · exact hz'
        · obtain ⟨f, hf, hzf⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hz'
          have hfe : e ≠ f := by
            rintro rfl
            exact (List.nodup_cons.1 (IsPath.cons hl hW hfresh).nodup).1 hf
          exact mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered ⟨f, hf,
            (hD.edge_inter hl.edge_mem (hW.isWalk.edge_mem hf) hfe hz hzf).2.2⟩
      have hzV : z ∈ V(H) := walkVertices_subset_vertexSet hW.isWalk.left_mem hzw
      rcases hD.vertex_mem_edgeArc hl hzV hz with rfl | rfl
      · exact absurd hzw hfresh
      · rfl

name: Graph.IsDrawing.isArcBetween_pointSet
statement:
theorem IsDrawing.isArcBetween_pointSet (hD : IsDrawing H drw) {u v : Plane} {W : List β}
    (h : H.IsPathGraph u W v) (huv : u ≠ v) : IsArcBetween (pointSet H drw) u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← walkPointSet_eq_pointSet h]
  exact hD.isArcBetween_walkPointSet h.isPath huv

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.walkVertices_graph
statement:
theorem walkVertices_graph (u : γ) (W : List γ) :
    R.graph.walkVertices (R.pos u) W = R.pos '' S.skel.walkVertices u W
proof:
:=
  Graph.walkVertices_map _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.cellUnion_pathCells
statement:
theorem cellUnion_pathCells {u v : γ} {W : List γ} (h : S.skel.IsWalk u W v) :
    R.cellUnion (S.pathCells u W) = Graph.walkPointSet R.graph R.drawing (R.pos u) W
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : S.skel.walkVertices u W ⊆ V(S.skel) :=
    Graph.walkVertices_subset_vertexSet h.left_mem
  have hV : R.cellUnion (S.skel.walkVertices u W) = R.pos '' S.skel.walkVertices u W := by
    refine Set.Subset.antisymm (cellUnion_subset fun z hz => ?_) ?_
    · rw [R.cell_vertex (hsub hz)]
      exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact cell_subset_cellUnion hz (by rw [R.cell_vertex (hsub hz)]; rfl)
  rw [CellStructure.pathCells, cellUnion_union, hV, Graph.walkPointSet, R.walkVertices_graph]
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_
  · refine Set.union_subset (cellUnion_subset fun f hf => ?_) Set.subset_union_left
    obtain ⟨a, b, hl⟩ := Graph.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet (h.edge_mem hf)
    rw [R.cell_edge hl]
    exact fun x hx => Or.inr (Set.mem_biUnion hf hx.1)
  · refine Set.union_subset Set.subset_union_right (Set.iUnion₂_subset fun f hf x hx => ?_)
    obtain ⟨a, b, hl⟩ := Graph.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet (h.edge_mem hf)
    by_cases hxab : x ∈ ({R.pos a, R.pos b} : Set Plane)
    · simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hxab
      rcases hxab with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inr ⟨a, Graph.mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered ⟨f, hf, hl.inc_left⟩, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨b, Graph.mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered ⟨f, hf, hl.inc_right⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl (cell_subset_cellUnion hf (by rw [R.cell_edge hl]; exact ⟨hx, hxab⟩))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.skeletonSet_subset_cellUnion
statement:
theorem skeletonSet_subset_cellUnion :
    R.skeletonSet ⊆ R.cellUnion (V(S.skel) ∪ E(S.skel))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · rw [Realization.vertexSet_graph] at hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine cell_subset_cellUnion (Set.mem_union_left _ hz) ?_
    rw [R.cell_vertex hz]
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨f, hf, hxf⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hx
    rw [Realization.edgeSet_graph] at hf
    obtain ⟨a, b, hl⟩ := Graph.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet hf
    by_cases hxab : x ∈ ({R.pos a, R.pos b} : Set Plane)
    · simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hxab
      rcases hxab with rfl | rfl
      · refine cell_subset_cellUnion (Set.mem_union_left _ hl.left_mem) ?_
        rw [R.cell_vertex hl.left_mem]
        rfl
      · refine cell_subset_cellUnion (Set.mem_union_left _ hl.right_mem) ?_
        rw [R.cell_vertex hl.right_mem]
        rfl
    · refine cell_subset_cellUnion (Set.mem_union_right _ hf) ?_
      rw [R.cell_edge hl]
      exact ⟨hxf, hxab⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.disjoint_cell_skeletonSet
statement:
theorem disjoint_cell_skeletonSet {D : Set Plane} (hcd : R.IsCellDecomposition D) {F : γ}
    (hF : F ∈ S.faces) : Disjoint (R.cell F) R.skeletonSet
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.disjoint_right.2 fun x hx hxF => ?_
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hxσ⟩ := mem_cellUnion_iff.1 (R.skeletonSet_subset_cellUnion hx)
  have hne : F ≠ σ := by
    rintro rfl
    rcases hσ with hσ | hσ
    exacts [Set.disjoint_left.1 S.disjoint_faces_vertexSet hF hσ,
      Set.disjoint_left.1 S.disjoint_faces_edgeSet hF hσ]
  have hσc : σ ∈ S.cells := by
    rcases hσ with hσ | hσ
    exacts [S.mem_cells_of_mem_vertexSet hσ, S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet hσ]
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hcd.disjoint (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hF) hσc hne) hxF hxσ

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.source_mem_ear
statement: theorem source_mem_ear : d.source ∈ V(d.ear)
proof:
:=
  (d.vertexSet_inter ▸ (Set.mem_insert _ _ : d.source ∈ ({d.source, d.target} : Set γ))).1

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.target_mem_ear
statement: theorem target_mem_ear : d.target ∈ V(d.ear)
proof:
:=
  (d.vertexSet_inter ▸
    (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl : d.target ∈ ({d.source, d.target} : Set γ))).1

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.source_mem_cells₂
statement: theorem source_mem_cells₂ : d.source ∈ d.cells₂
proof:
:=
  Or.inr Graph.mem_walkVertices_self

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.target_mem_cells₂
statement: theorem target_mem_cells₂ : d.target ∈ d.cells₂
proof:
:=
  Or.inr d.isPath₂.isWalk.target_mem_walkVertices

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.subcells_face_diff
statement: theorem subcells_face_diff : S.subcells d.face \ {d.face} = d.cells₁ ∪ d.cells₂
proof:
:= by
  ext σ
  simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, CellStructure.mem_subcells_iff, Set.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨-, hsub⟩, hne⟩
    rcases d.sub_face.1 hsub with rfl | h
    · exact absurd rfl hne
    · exact h
  · intro h
    refine ⟨⟨?_, d.sub_face.2 (Or.inr h)⟩, ?_⟩
    · rcases h with h | h
      exacts [d.cells₁_subset h, d.cells₂_subset h]
    · rcases h with h | h
      exacts [d.cells₁_ne_face h, d.cells₂_ne_face h]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.vertexSet_earGraph
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexSet_earGraph (earPos : γ → Plane) :
    V(d.earGraph earPos) = earPos '' V(d.ear)
proof: := Graph.vertexSet_map _ _

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.edgeSet_earGraph
statement:
@[simp] theorem edgeSet_earGraph (earPos : γ → Plane) :
    E(d.earGraph earPos) = E(d.ear)
proof: := Graph.edgeSet_map _ _

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.source_ne_target_pos
statement: theorem source_ne_target_pos : R.pos d.source ≠ R.pos d.target
proof:
:= fun h =>
  d.source_ne_target (R.injOn_pos d.source_mem_skel d.target_mem_skel h)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.mem_earSet_of_mem_ear
statement: theorem mem_earSet_of_mem_ear {z : γ} (hz : z ∈ V(d.ear)) : earPos z ∈ d.earSet earPos earDraw
proof:
:=
  Graph.vertexSet_subset_pointSet (by rw [d.vertexSet_earGraph]; exact ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.edgeArc_subset_earSet
statement:
theorem edgeArc_subset_earSet {f : γ} (hf : f ∈ E(d.ear)) :
    Graph.edgeArc earDraw f ⊆ d.earSet earPos earDraw
proof:
:=
  Graph.edgeArc_subset_pointSet (by rw [d.edgeSet_earGraph]; exact hf)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.earPos_eq
statement: theorem earPos_eq {z : γ} (hz : z ∈ V(d.ear)) (hz' : z ∈ V(S.skel)) : earPos z = R.pos z
proof:
:= by
  have : z ∈ ({d.source, d.target} : Set γ) := d.vertexSet_inter ▸ ⟨hz, hz'⟩
  rcases this with rfl | rfl
  exacts [hE.pos_source, hE.pos_target]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.pos_source_mem_earSet
statement: theorem pos_source_mem_earSet : R.pos d.source ∈ d.earSet earPos earDraw
proof:
:=
  hE.pos_source ▸ mem_earSet_of_mem_ear d.source_mem_ear

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.pos_target_mem_earSet
statement: theorem pos_target_mem_earSet : R.pos d.target ∈ d.earSet earPos earDraw
proof:
:=
  hE.pos_target ▸ mem_earSet_of_mem_ear d.target_mem_ear

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.earPos_mem_cell_face
statement:
theorem earPos_mem_cell_face {z : γ} (hz : z ∈ V(d.ear)) (hs : z ≠ d.source)
    (ht : z ≠ d.target) : earPos z ∈ R.cell d.face
proof:
:= by
  refine hE.subset_face ⟨mem_earSet_of_mem_ear hz, ?_⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  rintro (h | h)
  · exact hs (hE.injOn hz d.source_mem_ear (h.trans hE.pos_source.symm))
  · exact ht (hE.injOn hz d.target_mem_ear (h.trans hE.pos_target.symm))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.earSet_inter_skeletonSet
statement:
theorem earSet_inter_skeletonSet :
    d.earSet earPos earDraw ∩ R.skeletonSet ⊆ {R.pos d.source, R.pos d.target}
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hx, hx'⟩
  by_contra hcon
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hE.disjoint_skeleton (hE.subset_face ⟨hx, hcon⟩) hx'

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.edgeArc_diff
proof:
:= by
  have hlm : (d.earGraph earPos).IsLink f (earPos a) (earPos b) := hl.map earPos
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.sdiff_subset_sdiff_right ?_) (fun x ⟨hx, hx'⟩ => ⟨hx, ?_⟩)
  · rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [⟨a, hl.left_mem, rfl⟩, ⟨b, hl.right_mem, rfl⟩]
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    have hwV : earPos w ∈ V(d.earGraph earPos) := by
      rw [d.vertexSet_earGraph]; exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact hx' (hE.isDrawing.vertex_mem_edgeArc hlm hwV hx)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitPos_of_mem_ear
statement: theorem splitPos_of_mem_ear {z : γ} (hz : z ∈ V(d.ear)) : d.splitPos R earPos z = earPos z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [splitPos, if_pos hz]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitPos_of_notMem_ear
statement: theorem splitPos_of_notMem_ear {z : γ} (hz : z ∉ V(d.ear)) : d.splitPos R earPos z = R.pos z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [splitPos, if_neg hz]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.splitPos_eq
statement:
theorem EarCrosscut.splitPos_eq (hE : d.EarCrosscut R earPos earDraw) {z : γ}
    (hz : z ∈ V(S.skel)) : d.splitPos R earPos z = R.pos z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz' : z ∈ V(d.ear)
  · rw [splitPos_of_mem_ear hz', hE.earPos_eq hz' hz]
  · rw [splitPos_of_notMem_ear hz']

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitDrawing_of_mem_ear
statement:
theorem splitDrawing_of_mem_ear {f : γ} (hf : f ∈ E(d.ear)) :
    d.splitDrawing R earDraw f = earDraw f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [splitDrawing, if_pos hf]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitDrawing_of_mem_skel
statement:
theorem splitDrawing_of_mem_skel {f : γ} (hf : f ∈ E(S.skel)) :
    d.splitDrawing R earDraw f = R.drawing f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [splitDrawing, if_neg (Set.disjoint_left.1 d.disjoint_edgeSet hf)]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitCell_face₁
statement:
theorem splitCell_face₁ : d.splitCell R earPos earDraw d.face₁ =
    inside (R.cellUnion d.cells₁ ∪ d.earSet earPos earDraw)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold splitCell
  rw [if_pos rfl]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitCell_face₂
statement:
theorem splitCell_face₂ : d.splitCell R earPos earDraw d.face₂ =
    inside (R.cellUnion d.cells₂ ∪ d.earSet earPos earDraw)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold splitCell
  rw [if_neg (Ne.symm d.face_ne), if_pos rfl]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitCell_of_mem_cells
statement:
theorem splitCell_of_mem_cells {σ : γ} (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells) :
    d.splitCell R earPos earDraw σ = R.cell σ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h₁ : σ ≠ d.face₁ := by rintro rfl; exact d.face₁_notMem hσ
  have h₂ : σ ≠ d.face₂ := by rintro rfl; exact d.face₂_notMem hσ
  have h₃ : ¬ (σ ∈ V(d.ear) ∧ σ ∉ V(S.skel)) := by
    rintro ⟨hv, hnv⟩
    rcases d.mem_cells_of_mem_ear_vertexSet hv hσ with rfl | rfl
    exacts [hnv d.source_mem_skel, hnv d.target_mem_skel]
  have h₄ : σ ∉ E(d.ear) := fun h => d.edge_fresh h hσ
  unfold splitCell
  rw [if_neg h₁, if_neg h₂, if_neg h₃, if_neg h₄]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.splitCell_earVertex
statement:
theorem EarCrosscut.splitCell_earVertex (hE : d.EarCrosscut R earPos earDraw) {z : γ}
    (hz : z ∈ V(d.ear)) : d.splitCell R earPos earDraw z = {earPos z}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hz' : z ∈ V(S.skel)
  · rw [splitCell_of_mem_cells (S.mem_cells_of_mem_vertexSet hz'), R.cell_vertex hz',
      hE.earPos_eq hz hz']
  · have h₁ : z ≠ d.face₁ := by rintro rfl; exact d.face₁_notMem_ear (Or.inl hz)
    have h₂ : z ≠ d.face₂ := by rintro rfl; exact d.face₂_notMem_ear (Or.inl hz)
    unfold splitCell
    rw [if_neg h₁, if_neg h₂, if_pos (show z ∈ V(d.ear) ∧ z ∉ V(S.skel) from ⟨hz, hz'⟩)]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.splitCell_earEdge
statement:
theorem splitCell_earEdge {f : γ} (hf : f ∈ E(d.ear)) :
    d.splitCell R earPos earDraw f = Graph.edgeArc earDraw f \ earPos '' V(d.ear)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h₁ : f ≠ d.face₁ := by rintro rfl; exact d.face₁_notMem_ear (Or.inr hf)
  have h₂ : f ≠ d.face₂ := by rintro rfl; exact d.face₂_notMem_ear (Or.inr hf)
  have h₃ : ¬ (f ∈ V(d.ear) ∧ f ∉ V(S.skel)) := fun h =>
    Set.disjoint_left.1 d.ear_disjoint h.1 hf
  unfold splitCell
  rw [if_neg h₁, if_neg h₂, if_neg h₃, if_pos hf]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_skel
statement:
theorem edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_skel {f : γ} (hf : f ∈ E(S.skel)) :
    Graph.edgeArc (d.splitDrawing R earDraw) f = Graph.edgeArc R.drawing f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Graph.edgeArc, Graph.edgeArc, splitDrawing_of_mem_skel hf]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_ear
statement:
theorem edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_ear {f : γ} (hf : f ∈ E(d.ear)) :
    Graph.edgeArc (d.splitDrawing R earDraw) f = Graph.edgeArc earDraw f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Graph.edgeArc, Graph.edgeArc, splitDrawing_of_mem_ear hf]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.splitGraph_eq
statement:
theorem splitGraph_eq :
    (S.splitFace d).skel.map (d.splitPos R earPos) = R.graph.union (d.earGraph earPos)
proof:
:= by
  change (S.skel.union d.ear).map (d.splitPos R earPos) = _
  rw [Graph.map_union]
  congr 1
  · exact Graph.map_eq_of_eqOn fun z hz => hE.splitPos_eq hz
  · exact Graph.map_eq_of_eqOn fun z hz => splitPos_of_mem_ear hz

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.isDrawing_split
statement:
theorem isDrawing_split :
    Graph.IsDrawing (R.graph.union (d.earGraph earPos)) (d.splitDrawing R earDraw)
proof:
:= by
  have hEskel : E(R.graph) = E(S.skel) := Realization.edgeSet_graph R
  have hcompat : R.graph.Compatible (d.earGraph earPos) :=
    Graph.Compatible.of_disjoint_edgeSet (by
      rw [hEskel, d.edgeSet_earGraph]; exact d.disjoint_edgeSet)
  have hle₁ : R.graph ≤ R.graph.union (d.earGraph earPos) := Graph.left_le_union _ _
  have hle₂ : d.earGraph earPos ≤ R.graph.union (d.earGraph earPos) := hcompat.right_le_union
  have hmeet := hE.earSet_inter_skeletonSet
  have hends : ∀ {x : Plane}, x ∈ ({R.pos d.source, R.pos d.target} : Set Plane) →
      x ∈ V(R.graph) ∧ x ∈ V(d.earGraph earPos) := by
    rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨by rw [Realization.vertexSet_graph]; exact ⟨_, d.source_mem_skel, rfl⟩,
        by rw [d.vertexSet_earGraph]; exact ⟨d.source, d.source_mem_ear, hE.pos_source⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨by rw [Realization.vertexSet_graph]; exact ⟨_, d.target_mem_skel, rfl⟩,
        by rw [d.vertexSet_earGraph]; exact ⟨d.target, d.target_mem_ear, hE.pos_target⟩⟩
  have hcross : ∀ {x : Plane}, x ∈ d.earSet earPos earDraw → x ∈ R.skeletonSet →
      x ∈ V(R.graph) ∧ x ∈ V(d.earGraph earPos) := fun hx hx' => hends (hmeet ⟨hx, hx'⟩)
  have hmix : ∀ {p : Plane} {e g : γ}, e ∈ E(S.skel) → g ∈ E(d.ear) →
      p ∈ Graph.edgeArc R.drawing e → p ∈ Graph.edgeArc earDraw g →
      p ∈ V(R.graph.union (d.earGraph earPos)) ∧
        (R.graph.union (d.earGraph earPos)).Inc e p ∧
        (R.graph.union (d.earGraph earPos)).Inc g p := by
    intro p e g he hg hpe hpg
    have hp1 : p ∈ R.skeletonSet :=
      Graph.edgeArc_subset_pointSet (by rwa [hEskel]) hpe
    have hp2 : p ∈ d.earSet earPos earDraw := edgeArc_subset_earSet hg hpg
    obtain ⟨hpV1, hpV2⟩ := hcross hp2 hp1
    obtain ⟨a, b, hlab⟩ := Graph.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet (show e ∈ E(R.graph) by rwa [hEskel])
    obtain ⟨c, c', hlcc⟩ := Graph.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet
      (show g ∈ E(d.earGraph earPos) by rwa [d.edgeSet_earGraph])
    have hInc1 : R.graph.Inc e p := by
      rcases R.isDrawing.vertex_mem_edgeArc hlab hpV1 hpe with rfl | rfl
      exacts [hlab.inc_left, hlab.inc_right]
    have hInc2 : (d.earGraph earPos).Inc g p := by
      rcases hE.isDrawing.vertex_mem_edgeArc hlcc hpV2 hpg with rfl | rfl
      exacts [hlcc.inc_left, hlcc.inc_right]
    exact ⟨Or.inl hpV1, hInc1.mono hle₁, hInc2.mono hle₂⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro e he
    rcases he with he | he
    · rw [hEskel] at he
      obtain ⟨hc, hi, hl⟩ := R.isDrawing.edge_param (by rwa [Graph.edgeSet_map])
      rw [splitDrawing_of_mem_skel he]
      exact ⟨hc, hi, Graph.union_isLink.2 (Or.inl hl)⟩
    · rw [d.edgeSet_earGraph] at he
      obtain ⟨hc, hi, hl⟩ := hE.isDrawing.edge_param (by rwa [d.edgeSet_earGraph])
      rw [splitDrawing_of_mem_ear he]
      exact ⟨hc, hi, Graph.union_isLink.2
        (Or.inr ⟨by rw [hEskel]; exact Set.disjoint_right.1 d.disjoint_edgeSet he, hl⟩)⟩
  · 
    intro e x y v hl hv hmem
    rcases Graph.union_isLink.1 hl with hl | ⟨-, hl⟩
    · have he : e ∈ E(S.skel) := by rw [← hEskel]; exact hl.edge_mem
      rw [edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_skel he] at hmem
      have hvg : v ∈ V(R.graph) := by
        rcases hv with hv | hv
        · exact hv
        · exact (hcross (Graph.vertexSet_subset_pointSet hv)
            (Graph.edgeArc_subset_pointSet (by rwa [hEskel]) hmem)).1
      exact R.isDrawing.vertex_mem_edgeArc hl hvg hmem
    · have he : e ∈ E(d.ear) := by rw [← d.edgeSet_earGraph]; exact hl.edge_mem
      rw [edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_ear he] at hmem
      have hvg : v ∈ V(d.earGraph earPos) := by
        rcases hv with hv | hv
        · exact (hcross (edgeArc_subset_earSet he hmem)
            (Graph.vertexSet_subset_pointSet hv)).2
        · exact hv
      exact hE.isDrawing.vertex_mem_edgeArc hl hvg hmem
  · 
    intro e f he hf hef p hpe hpf
    rcases he with he | he <;> rcases hf with hf | hf
    · rw [hEskel] at he hf
      rw [edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_skel he] at hpe
      rw [edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_skel hf] at hpf
      obtain ⟨hpV, hIe, hIf⟩ := R.isDrawing.edge_inter (by rwa [Graph.edgeSet_map])
        (by rwa [Graph.edgeSet_map]) hef hpe hpf
      exact ⟨Or.inl hpV, hIe.mono hle₁, hIf.mono hle₁⟩
    · rw [hEskel] at he
      rw [d.edgeSet_earGraph] at hf
      rw [edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_skel he] at hpe
      rw [edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_ear hf] at hpf
      exact hmix he hf hpe hpf
    · rw [d.edgeSet_earGraph] at he
      rw [hEskel] at hf
      rw [edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_ear he] at hpe
      rw [edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_skel hf] at hpf
      obtain ⟨hv, h1, h2⟩ := hmix hf he hpf hpe
      exact ⟨hv, h2, h1⟩
    · rw [d.edgeSet_earGraph] at he hf
      rw [edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_ear he] at hpe
      rw [edgeArc_splitDrawing_of_mem_ear hf] at hpf
      obtain ⟨hpV, hIe, hIf⟩ := hE.isDrawing.edge_inter (by rwa [d.edgeSet_earGraph])
        (by rwa [d.edgeSet_earGraph]) hef hpe hpf
      exact ⟨Or.inr hpV, hIe.mono hle₂, hIf.mono hle₂⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.frontier_cell_face
statement:
theorem frontier_cell_face {D : Set Plane} (hcd : R.IsCellDecomposition D)
    (hJ : R.IsFaceJordan) :
    frontier (R.cell d.face) = R.cellUnion d.cells₁ ∪ R.cellUnion d.cells₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hJ.faceBoundary_eq hcd d.face_mem, Realization.faceBoundary, d.subcells_face_diff,
    Realization.cellUnion_union]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.pos_source_mem_cellUnion_cells₁
statement: theorem pos_source_mem_cellUnion_cells₁ : R.pos d.source ∈ R.cellUnion d.cells₁
proof:
:=
  Realization.cell_subset_cellUnion d.source_mem_cells₁
    (by rw [R.cell_vertex d.source_mem_skel]; rfl)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.pos_source_mem_cellUnion_cells₂
statement: theorem pos_source_mem_cellUnion_cells₂ : R.pos d.source ∈ R.cellUnion d.cells₂
proof:
:=
  Realization.cell_subset_cellUnion d.source_mem_cells₂
    (by rw [R.cell_vertex d.source_mem_skel]; rfl)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.pos_target_mem_cellUnion_cells₁
statement: theorem pos_target_mem_cellUnion_cells₁ : R.pos d.target ∈ R.cellUnion d.cells₁
proof:
:=
  Realization.cell_subset_cellUnion d.target_mem_cells₁
    (by rw [R.cell_vertex d.target_mem_skel]; rfl)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.pos_target_mem_cellUnion_cells₂
statement: theorem pos_target_mem_cellUnion_cells₂ : R.pos d.target ∈ R.cellUnion d.cells₂
proof:
:=
  Realization.cell_subset_cellUnion d.target_mem_cells₂
    (by rw [R.cell_vertex d.target_mem_skel]; rfl)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.isArcBetween_cellUnion_cells₁
statement:
theorem isArcBetween_cellUnion_cells₁ :
    IsArcBetween (R.cellUnion d.cells₁) (R.pos d.source) (R.pos d.target)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cells₁, R.cellUnion_pathCells d.isPath₁.isWalk]
  exact R.isDrawing.isArcBetween_walkPointSet (d.isPath₁.map R.injOn_pos)
    (fun h => d.source_ne_target (R.injOn_pos d.source_mem_skel d.target_mem_skel h))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.isArcBetween_cellUnion_cells₂
statement:
theorem isArcBetween_cellUnion_cells₂ :
    IsArcBetween (R.cellUnion d.cells₂) (R.pos d.source) (R.pos d.target)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cells₂, R.cellUnion_pathCells d.isPath₂.isWalk]
  exact R.isDrawing.isArcBetween_walkPointSet (d.isPath₂.map R.injOn_pos)
    (fun h => d.source_ne_target (R.injOn_pos d.source_mem_skel d.target_mem_skel h))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.isCutPair_of_inter
statement:
theorem isCutPair_of_inter {D : Set Plane} (hcd : R.IsCellDecomposition D)
    (hJ : R.IsFaceJordan) :
    IsCutPair (frontier (R.cell d.face)) (R.pos d.source) (R.pos d.target)
      (R.cellUnion d.cells₁) (R.cellUnion d.cells₂) where
  fst
proof:
:= isArcBetween_cellUnion_cells₁
  snd := isArcBetween_cellUnion_cells₂
  union_eq := (frontier_cell_face hcd hJ).symm
  inter_eq := by
    refine Set.Subset.antisymm (fun x ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ => ?_) ?_
    · obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hxσ⟩ := Realization.mem_cellUnion_iff.1 hx₁
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hxτ⟩ := Realization.mem_cellUnion_iff.1 hx₂
      have hστ : σ = τ := by
        by_contra hne
        exact Set.disjoint_left.1
          (hcd.disjoint (d.cells₁_subset hσ) (d.cells₂_subset hτ) hne) hxσ hxτ
      subst hστ
      have hmem : σ ∈ ({d.source, d.target} : Set γ) := d.paths_meet ▸ ⟨hσ, hτ⟩
      rcases hmem with rfl | rfl
      · rw [R.cell_vertex d.source_mem_skel] at hxσ
        exact Or.inl hxσ
      · rw [R.cell_vertex d.target_mem_skel] at hxσ
        exact Or.inr hxσ
    · rintro x (rfl | rfl)
      exacts [⟨pos_source_mem_cellUnion_cells₁, pos_source_mem_cellUnion_cells₂⟩,
        ⟨pos_target_mem_cellUnion_cells₁, pos_target_mem_cellUnion_cells₂⟩]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.isPathGraph_earGraph
statement:
theorem isPathGraph_earGraph :
    (d.earGraph earPos).IsPathGraph (R.pos d.source) d.earWalk (R.pos d.target)
proof:
:= by
  have := d.isPathGraph.map hE.injOn
  rwa [hE.pos_source, hE.pos_target] at this

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.isArcBetween_earSet
statement:
theorem isArcBetween_earSet :
    IsArcBetween (d.earSet earPos earDraw) (R.pos d.source) (R.pos d.target)
proof:
:=
  hE.isDrawing.isArcBetween_pointSet hE.isPathGraph_earGraph source_ne_target_pos

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.isCrosscut_earSet
statement:
theorem isCrosscut_earSet {D : Set Plane} (hcd : R.IsCellDecomposition D)
    (hJ : R.IsFaceJordan) :
    IsCrosscut (frontier (R.cell d.face)) (d.earSet earPos earDraw)
      (R.pos d.source) (R.pos d.target) where
  curve
proof:
:= hJ.isJordanCurve d.face_mem
  arc := hE.isArcBetween_earSet
  polygonal := hE.polygonal
  left_mem := (frontier_cell_face hcd hJ) ▸ Or.inl pos_source_mem_cellUnion_cells₁
  right_mem := (frontier_cell_face hcd hJ) ▸ Or.inl pos_target_mem_cellUnion_cells₁
  sdiff_subset := by
    rw [← hJ.cell_eq_inside d.face_mem]
    exact hE.subset_face

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.EarCrosscut.closure_edgeArc_diff
statement:
theorem closure_edgeArc_diff {f a b : γ} (hl : d.ear.IsLink f a b) :
    closure (Graph.edgeArc earDraw f \ {earPos a, earPos b}) = Graph.edgeArc earDraw f
proof:
:= by
  have harc : IsArcBetween (Graph.edgeArc earDraw f) (earPos a) (earPos b) :=
    hE.isDrawing.edge_isArcBetween (hl.map earPos)
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (closure_minimal Set.sdiff_subset harc.isArc.isCompact.isClosed) ?_
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxab : x ∈ ({earPos a, earPos b} : Set Plane)
  · rcases hxab with rfl | rfl
    exacts [harc.left_mem_closure_diff, harc.right_mem_closure_diff]
  · exact subset_closure ⟨hx, hxab⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.realize_pos
statement: @[simp] theorem realize_pos : (realize R d earPos earDraw hE).pos = d.splitPos R earPos
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.realize_drawing
statement:
@[simp] theorem realize_drawing :
    (realize R d earPos earDraw hE).drawing = d.splitDrawing R earDraw
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.realize_cell
statement:
@[simp] theorem realize_cell :
    (realize R d earPos earDraw hE).cell = d.splitCell R earPos earDraw
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.cellUnion_earCells
statement:
theorem cellUnion_earCells :
    (realize R d earPos earDraw hE).cellUnion d.earCells = d.earSet earPos earDraw
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (Realization.cellUnion_subset fun σ hσ => ?_) ?_
  · have hσ' : σ ∈ V(d.ear) ∪ E(d.ear) := hσ
    rcases hσ' with hσ' | hσ'
    · rw [realize_cell, hE.splitCell_earVertex hσ']
      exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (EarCrosscut.mem_earSet_of_mem_ear hσ')
    · rw [realize_cell, splitCell_earEdge hσ']
      exact Set.Subset.trans Set.sdiff_subset (EarCrosscut.edgeArc_subset_earSet hσ')
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ V(d.earGraph earPos) ∪
        ⋃ e ∈ E(d.earGraph earPos), Graph.edgeArc earDraw e := hx
    by_cases hxv : x ∈ earPos '' V(d.ear)
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hxv
      refine Realization.cell_subset_cellUnion (Set.mem_union_left _ hz) ?_
      rw [realize_cell, hE.splitCell_earVertex hz]
      rfl
    · rcases hx' with hx' | hx'
      · rw [d.vertexSet_earGraph] at hx'
        exact absurd hx' hxv
      · obtain ⟨f, hf, hxf⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hx'
        rw [d.edgeSet_earGraph] at hf
        refine Realization.cell_subset_cellUnion (Set.mem_union_right _ hf) ?_
        rw [realize_cell, splitCell_earEdge hf]
        exact ⟨hxf, hxv⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.cellUnion_earNewCells
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (Realization.cellUnion_subset fun σ hσ => ?_) ?_
  · have hσ' : σ ∈ (V(d.ear) \ {d.source, d.target}) ∪ E(d.ear) := hσ
    rcases hσ' with ⟨hσV, hσn⟩ | hσE
    · rw [realize_cell, hE.splitCell_earVertex hσV]
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hσn
      push Not at hσn
      refine Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨EarCrosscut.mem_earSet_of_mem_ear hσV, ?_⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      rintro (h | h)
      · exact hσn.1 (hE.injOn hσV d.source_mem_ear (h.trans hE.pos_source.symm))
      · exact hσn.2 (hE.injOn hσV d.target_mem_ear (h.trans hE.pos_target.symm))
    · rw [realize_cell, splitCell_earEdge hσE]
      rintro x ⟨hxa, hxv⟩
      refine ⟨EarCrosscut.edgeArc_subset_earSet hσE hxa, ?_⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact hxv ⟨d.source, d.source_mem_ear, hE.pos_source⟩
      · exact hxv ⟨d.target, d.target_mem_ear, hE.pos_target⟩
  · rintro x ⟨hx, hxn⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hxn
    push Not at hxn
    have hx' : x ∈ V(d.earGraph earPos) ∪
        ⋃ e ∈ E(d.earGraph earPos), Graph.edgeArc earDraw e := hx
    by_cases hxv : x ∈ earPos '' V(d.ear)
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hxv
      have hzs : z ≠ d.source := fun h => hxn.1 (by rw [h, hE.pos_source])
      have hzt : z ≠ d.target := fun h => hxn.2 (by rw [h, hE.pos_target])
      have hzmem : z ∈ V(d.ear) \ ({d.source, d.target} : Set γ) := by
        refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
        simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        push Not
        exact ⟨hzs, hzt⟩
      refine Realization.cell_subset_cellUnion (Set.mem_union_left _ hzmem) ?_
      rw [realize_cell, hE.splitCell_earVertex hz]
      rfl
    · rcases hx' with hx' | hx'
      · rw [d.vertexSet_earGraph] at hx'
        exact absurd hx' hxv
      · obtain ⟨f, hf, hxf⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hx'
        rw [d.edgeSet_earGraph] at hf
        refine Realization.cell_subset_cellUnion (Set.mem_union_right _ hf) ?_
        rw [realize_cell, splitCell_earEdge hf]
        exact ⟨hxf, hxv⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.isCrosscutSplit_realize
statement:
theorem isCrosscutSplit_realize {D : Set Plane} (hcd : R.IsCellDecomposition D)
    (hJ : R.IsFaceJordan) :
    d.IsCrosscutSplit R (realize R d earPos earDraw hE) where
  cell_eq
proof:
:= fun _ hσ _ => splitCell_of_mem_cells hσ
  isCrosscut := by
    rw [cellUnion_earCells]
    exact hE.isCrosscut_earSet hcd hJ
  isCutPair := isCutPair_of_inter hcd hJ
  cell_face₁ := by rw [realize_cell, splitCell_face₁, cellUnion_earCells]
  cell_face₂ := by rw [realize_cell, splitCell_face₂, cellUnion_earCells]
  cellUnion_earNewCells := by rw [cellUnion_earNewCells, cellUnion_earCells]
  earNonempty := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hσ' : σ ∈ (V(d.ear) \ {d.source, d.target}) ∪ E(d.ear) := hσ
    rcases hσ' with ⟨hσV, -⟩ | hσE
    · rw [realize_cell, hE.splitCell_earVertex hσV]
      exact ⟨earPos σ, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, b, hl⟩ := Graph.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet hσE
      rw [realize_cell, splitCell_earEdge hσE, hE.edgeArc_diff hl]
      exact (hE.isDrawing.edge_isArcBetween (hl.map earPos)).nonempty_diff
  earDisjoint := by
    intro σ τ hσ hτ hne
    have hσ' : σ ∈ (V(d.ear) \ {d.source, d.target}) ∪ E(d.ear) := hσ
    have hτ' : τ ∈ (V(d.ear) \ {d.source, d.target}) ∪ E(d.ear) := hτ
    rcases hσ' with ⟨hσV, -⟩ | hσE <;> rcases hτ' with ⟨hτV, -⟩ | hτE
    · rw [realize_cell, hE.splitCell_earVertex hσV, hE.splitCell_earVertex hτV]
      refine Set.disjoint_left.2 ?_
      rintro x rfl hx
      exact hne (hE.injOn hσV hτV (Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hx))
    · rw [realize_cell, hE.splitCell_earVertex hσV, splitCell_earEdge hτE]
      refine Set.disjoint_left.2 ?_
      rintro x rfl hx
      exact hx.2 ⟨σ, hσV, rfl⟩
    · rw [realize_cell, splitCell_earEdge hσE, hE.splitCell_earVertex hτV]
      refine Set.disjoint_right.2 ?_
      rintro x rfl hx
      exact hx.2 ⟨τ, hτV, rfl⟩
    · rw [realize_cell, splitCell_earEdge hσE, splitCell_earEdge hτE]
      refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hx hx' => hx.2 ?_
      have hmem := hE.isDrawing.edge_inter (by rwa [d.edgeSet_earGraph])
        (by rwa [d.edgeSet_earGraph]) hne hx.1 hx'.1
      rw [d.vertexSet_earGraph] at hmem
      exact hmem.1
  closure_earVertex := by
    intro z hz _ _
    rw [realize_cell, hE.splitCell_earVertex hz]
    exact closure_singleton
  closure_earEdge := by
    intro f a b hl
    have harc := hE.isDrawing.edge_isArcBetween (hl.map earPos)
    rw [realize_cell, splitCell_earEdge hl.edge_mem, hE.edgeArc_diff hl,
      hE.splitCell_earVertex hl.left_mem, hE.splitCell_earVertex hl.right_mem,
      hE.closure_edgeArc_diff hl]
    refine Set.Subset.antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) ?_
    · by_cases hxab : x ∈ ({earPos a, earPos b} : Set Plane)
      · rcases hxab with rfl | rfl
        exacts [Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)]
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, hxab⟩
    · rintro x (hx | hx | hx)
      · exact hx.1
      · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hx]
        exact harc.left_mem
      · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hx]
        exact harc.right_mem

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.isCellDecomposition_and_isFaceJordan_realize
statement:
theorem isCellDecomposition_and_isFaceJordan_realize (hS : S.CombInvariants) {D : Set Plane}
    (hcd : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hJ : R.IsFaceJordan) :
    (realize R d earPos earDraw hE).IsCellDecomposition D ∧
      (realize R d earPos earDraw hE).IsFaceJordan ∧
      (realize R d earPos earDraw hE).Refines R d.parent
proof:
:=
  (isCrosscutSplit_realize hE hcd hJ).isCellDecomposition_and_isFaceJordan hS hcd hJ

name: Schoenflies.uIcc_union_uIcc
statement: theorem uIcc_union_uIcc (h : t ∈ uIcc a b) : uIcc a t ∪ uIcc t b = uIcc a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hab
  · rw [uIcc_of_le hab] at h ⊢
    rw [uIcc_of_le h.1, uIcc_of_le h.2, Icc_union_Icc_eq_Icc h.1 h.2]
  · rw [uIcc_of_ge hab] at h ⊢
    rw [uIcc_of_ge h.2, uIcc_of_ge h.1, union_comm, Icc_union_Icc_eq_Icc h.1 h.2]

name: Schoenflies.uIcc_inter_uIcc
statement: theorem uIcc_inter_uIcc (h : t ∈ uIcc a b) : uIcc a t ∩ uIcc t b = {t}
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hab
  · rw [uIcc_of_le hab] at h
    rw [uIcc_of_le h.1, uIcc_of_le h.2, Icc_inter_Icc_eq_singleton h.1 h.2]
  · rw [uIcc_of_ge hab] at h
    rw [uIcc_of_ge h.2, uIcc_of_ge h.1, inter_comm, Icc_inter_Icc_eq_singleton h.1 h.2]

name: Schoenflies.right_notMem_uIcc_left
statement: theorem right_notMem_uIcc_left (h : t ∈ uIcc a b) (hb : b ≠ t) : b ∉ uIcc a t
proof:
:= fun hmem =>
  hb (by
    have : b ∈ uIcc a t ∩ uIcc t b := ⟨hmem, right_mem_uIcc⟩
    rwa [uIcc_inter_uIcc h, mem_singleton_iff] at this)

name: Schoenflies.left_notMem_uIcc_right
statement: theorem left_notMem_uIcc_right (h : t ∈ uIcc a b) (ha : a ≠ t) : a ∉ uIcc t b
proof:
:= fun hmem =>
  ha (by
    have : a ∈ uIcc a t ∩ uIcc t b := ⟨left_mem_uIcc, hmem⟩
    rwa [uIcc_inter_uIcc h, mem_singleton_iff] at this)

name: Schoenflies.uIcc_left_subset
statement: theorem uIcc_left_subset (h : t ∈ uIcc a b) : uIcc a t ⊆ uIcc a b
proof:
:=
  uIcc_subset_uIcc left_mem_uIcc h

name: Schoenflies.uIcc_right_subset
statement: theorem uIcc_right_subset (h : t ∈ uIcc a b) : uIcc t b ⊆ uIcc a b
proof:
:=
  uIcc_subset_uIcc h right_mem_uIcc

name: Schoenflies.subarc_image_union
statement:
theorem subarc_image_union (h : t ∈ uIcc a b) :
    subarc f a t '' I ∪ subarc f t b '' I = f '' uIcc a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [subarc_image, subarc_image, ← image_union, uIcc_union_uIcc h]

name: Schoenflies.subarc_image_inter
statement:
theorem subarc_image_inter (hi : InjOn f (uIcc a b)) (h : t ∈ uIcc a b) :
    subarc f a t '' I ∩ subarc f t b '' I = {f t}
proof:
:= by
  rw [subarc_image, subarc_image, ← hi.image_inter (uIcc_left_subset h) (uIcc_right_subset h),
    uIcc_inter_uIcc h, image_singleton]

name: Schoenflies.IsArcBetween.closure_diff_eq
statement:
theorem IsArcBetween.closure_diff_eq {A : Set Plane} {p q : Plane} (h : IsArcBetween A p q) :
    closure (A \ {p, q}) = A
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm (h.isArc.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.2 sdiff_subset) fun z hz => ?_
  by_cases hzp : z = p
  · exact hzp ▸ h.left_mem_closure_diff
  · by_cases hzq : z = q
    · exact hzq ▸ h.right_mem_closure_diff
    · exact subset_closure ⟨hz, by simp [hzp, hzq]⟩

name: Schoenflies.diff_pair_union_union
statement:
theorem diff_pair_union_union {A : Set Plane} {p q : Plane} (hp : p ∈ A) (hq : q ∈ A) :
    A \ {p, q} ∪ {q} ∪ {p} = A
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_union, mem_sdiff, mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff, not_or]
  constructor
  · rintro ((⟨h, -, -⟩ | rfl) | rfl)
    exacts [h, hq, hp]
  · intro h
    by_cases h₁ : z = p
    · exact Or.inr h₁
    · by_cases h₂ : z = q
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h₂)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨h, h₁, h₂⟩)

name: Schoenflies.uIcc_zero_one
statement: theorem uIcc_zero_one : uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 = I
proof: := uIcc_of_le zero_le_one

name: Schoenflies.firstHalf_apply
statement: theorem firstHalf_apply (s : ℝ) : firstHalf drawing e t s = drawing e (t * s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [firstHalf, subarc, reparam]
  congr 1
  ring

name: Schoenflies.secondHalf_apply
statement: theorem secondHalf_apply (s : ℝ) : secondHalf drawing e t s = drawing e (t + (1 - t) * s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [secondHalf, subarc, reparam]
  congr 1
  ring

name: Schoenflies.firstHalf_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem firstHalf_zero : firstHalf drawing e t 0 = drawing e 0
proof: := subarc_zero

name: Schoenflies.firstHalf_one
statement: @[simp] theorem firstHalf_one : firstHalf drawing e t 1 = drawing e t
proof: := subarc_one

name: Schoenflies.secondHalf_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem secondHalf_zero : secondHalf drawing e t 0 = drawing e t
proof: := subarc_zero

name: Schoenflies.secondHalf_one
statement: @[simp] theorem secondHalf_one : secondHalf drawing e t 1 = drawing e 1
proof: := subarc_one

name: Schoenflies.continuousOn_firstHalf
statement:
theorem continuousOn_firstHalf (hc : ContinuousOn (drawing e) I) (ht : t ∈ I) :
    ContinuousOn (firstHalf drawing e t) I
proof: := continuousOn_subarc hc zero_mem_I ht

name: Schoenflies.continuousOn_secondHalf
statement:
theorem continuousOn_secondHalf (hc : ContinuousOn (drawing e) I) (ht : t ∈ I) :
    ContinuousOn (secondHalf drawing e t) I
proof: := continuousOn_subarc hc ht one_mem_I

name: Schoenflies.injOn_firstHalf
statement:
theorem injOn_firstHalf (hi : InjOn (drawing e) I) (ht : t ∈ I) (h0 : t ≠ 0) :
    InjOn (firstHalf drawing e t) I
proof:
:=
  injOn_subarc (hi.mono (uIcc_subset_I zero_mem_I ht)) (Ne.symm h0)

name: Schoenflies.injOn_secondHalf
statement:
theorem injOn_secondHalf (hi : InjOn (drawing e) I) (ht : t ∈ I) (h1 : t ≠ 1) :
    InjOn (secondHalf drawing e t) I
proof:
:=
  injOn_subarc (hi.mono (uIcc_subset_I ht one_mem_I)) h1

name: Schoenflies.image_firstHalf
statement:
theorem image_firstHalf (ht : t ∈ I) :
    firstHalf drawing e t '' I = drawing e '' Icc 0 t
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstHalf, subarc_image, uIcc_of_le ht.1]

name: Schoenflies.image_secondHalf
statement:
theorem image_secondHalf (ht : t ∈ I) :
    secondHalf drawing e t '' I = drawing e '' Icc t 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondHalf, subarc_image, uIcc_of_le ht.2]

name: Schoenflies.firstHalf_union_secondHalf
statement:
theorem firstHalf_union_secondHalf (ht : t ∈ I) :
    firstHalf drawing e t '' I ∪ secondHalf drawing e t '' I = edgeArc drawing e
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstHalf, secondHalf, subarc_image_union (by rwa [uIcc_zero_one]), uIcc_zero_one, edgeArc]

name: Schoenflies.firstHalf_inter_secondHalf
statement:
theorem firstHalf_inter_secondHalf (hi : InjOn (drawing e) I) (ht : t ∈ I) :
    firstHalf drawing e t '' I ∩ secondHalf drawing e t '' I = {drawing e t}
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstHalf, secondHalf,
    subarc_image_inter (by rwa [uIcc_zero_one]) (by rwa [uIcc_zero_one])]

name: Schoenflies.isArcBetween_firstHalf
statement:
theorem isArcBetween_firstHalf (hc : ContinuousOn (drawing e) I) (hi : InjOn (drawing e) I)
    (ht : t ∈ I) (h0 : t ≠ 0) :
    IsArcBetween (firstHalf drawing e t '' I) (drawing e 0) (drawing e t)
proof:
:=
  ⟨firstHalf drawing e t, continuousOn_firstHalf hc ht, injOn_firstHalf hi ht h0, rfl,
    firstHalf_zero, firstHalf_one⟩

name: Schoenflies.isArcBetween_secondHalf
statement:
theorem isArcBetween_secondHalf (hc : ContinuousOn (drawing e) I) (hi : InjOn (drawing e) I)
    (ht : t ∈ I) (h1 : t ≠ 1) :
    IsArcBetween (secondHalf drawing e t '' I) (drawing e t) (drawing e 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨secondHalf drawing e t, continuousOn_secondHalf hc ht, injOn_secondHalf hi ht h1, rfl,
    secondHalf_zero, secondHalf_one⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edge_mem_edgeSet_graph
statement: theorem edge_mem_edgeSet_graph : d.edge ∈ E(R.graph)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Realization.edgeSet_graph]; exact d.edge_mem_edgeSet

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.continuousOn_drawing_edge
statement: theorem continuousOn_drawing_edge : ContinuousOn (R.drawing d.edge) I
proof:
:=
  (R.isDrawing.edge_param (d.edge_mem_edgeSet_graph R)).1

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.injOn_drawing_edge
statement: theorem injOn_drawing_edge : InjOn (R.drawing d.edge) I
proof:
:=
  (R.isDrawing.edge_param (d.edge_mem_edgeSet_graph R)).2.1

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.isLink_drawn_edge
statement: theorem isLink_drawn_edge : R.graph.IsLink d.edge (R.pos d.left) (R.pos d.right)
proof:
:=
  d.isLink.map R.pos

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.leftParam_eq_zero_or_one
statement: theorem leftParam_eq_zero_or_one : d.leftParam R = 0 ∨ d.leftParam R = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftParam
  split_ifs
  exacts [Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.drawing_params
statement:
theorem drawing_params :
    R.drawing d.edge (d.leftParam R) = R.pos d.left ∧
      R.drawing d.edge (d.rightParam R) = R.pos d.right
proof:
:= by
  have hd := R.isDrawing.edge_param (d.edge_mem_edgeSet_graph R)
  rcases (d.isLink_drawn_edge R).eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hd.2.2 with ⟨h0, h1⟩ | ⟨h0, h1⟩
  · have hL : d.leftParam R = 0 := if_pos h0.symm
    refine ⟨by rw [hL]; exact h0.symm, ?_⟩
    have hR : d.rightParam R = 1 := by rw [rightParam, hL]; ring
    rw [hR]; exact h1.symm
  · 
    
    have hne : ¬ (R.drawing d.edge 0 = R.pos d.left) := fun hcon =>
      zero_ne_one (hd.2.1 zero_mem_I one_mem_I (by rw [hcon, h0]))
    have hL : d.leftParam R = 1 := if_neg hne
    refine ⟨by rw [hL]; exact h0.symm, ?_⟩
    have hR : d.rightParam R = 0 := by rw [rightParam, hL]; ring
    rw [hR]; exact h1.symm

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.drawing_leftParam
statement: theorem drawing_leftParam : R.drawing d.edge (d.leftParam R) = R.pos d.left
proof:
:=
  (d.drawing_params R).1

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.drawing_rightParam
statement: theorem drawing_rightParam : R.drawing d.edge (d.rightParam R) = R.pos d.right
proof:
:=
  (d.drawing_params R).2

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.leftParam_mem_I
statement: theorem leftParam_mem_I : d.leftParam R ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rcases d.leftParam_eq_zero_or_one R with h | h <;> rw [h]
  exacts [zero_mem_I, one_mem_I]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.rightParam_mem_I
statement: theorem rightParam_mem_I : d.rightParam R ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rcases d.leftParam_eq_zero_or_one R with h | h
  · rw [rightParam, h, sub_zero]; exact one_mem_I
  · rw [rightParam, h, sub_self]; exact zero_mem_I

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.uIcc_params
statement: theorem uIcc_params : uIcc (d.leftParam R) (d.rightParam R) = I
proof:
:= by
  rcases d.leftParam_eq_zero_or_one R with h | h
  · rw [rightParam, h, sub_zero]; exact uIcc_zero_one
  · rw [rightParam, h, sub_self, uIcc_comm]; exact uIcc_zero_one

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.leftParam_ne
statement: theorem leftParam_ne (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) : d.leftParam R ≠ t
proof:
:= by
  rcases d.leftParam_eq_zero_or_one R with h | h <;> rw [h]
  exacts [ht.1.ne, ht.2.ne']

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.rightParam_ne
statement: theorem rightParam_ne (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) : d.rightParam R ≠ t
proof:
:= by
  rcases d.leftParam_eq_zero_or_one R with h | h
  · rw [rightParam, h, sub_zero]; exact ht.2.ne'
  · rw [rightParam, h, sub_self]; exact ht.1.ne

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.mem_uIcc_params
statement: theorem mem_uIcc_params (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) : t ∈ uIcc (d.leftParam R) (d.rightParam R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d.uIcc_params R]; exact Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.newPos_notMem_vertexSet
statement:
theorem newPos_notMem_vertexSet (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    R.drawing d.edge t ∉ V(R.graph)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have harc : R.drawing d.edge t ∈ edgeArc R.drawing d.edge :=
    ⟨t, Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht, rfl⟩
  have hinj := d.injOn_drawing_edge R
  rcases R.isDrawing.vertex_mem_edgeArc (d.isLink_drawn_edge R) hmem harc with h | h
  · exact d.leftParam_ne R ht
      (hinj (d.leftParam_mem_I R) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht) ((d.drawing_leftParam R).trans h.symm))
  · exact d.rightParam_ne R ht
      (hinj (d.rightParam_mem_I R) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)
        ((d.drawing_rightParam R).trans h.symm))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.newPos_ne_pos
statement:
theorem newPos_ne_pos (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) {v : γ} (hv : v ∈ V(S.skel)) :
    R.drawing d.edge t ≠ R.pos v
proof:
:= fun h =>
  d.newPos_notMem_vertexSet R ht (by rw [h, Realization.vertexSet_graph]; exact ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.newVertex_notMem_vertexSet
statement: theorem newVertex_notMem_vertexSet : d.newVertex ∉ V(S.skel)
proof:
:= fun h =>
  d.newVertex_notMem (S.mem_cells_of_mem_vertexSet h)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.ne_newVertex_of_mem_cells
statement: theorem ne_newVertex_of_mem_cells {z : γ} (hz : z ∈ S.cells) : z ≠ d.newVertex
proof:
:= fun h =>
  d.newVertex_notMem (h ▸ hz)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.ne_newEdge₁_of_mem_cells
statement: theorem ne_newEdge₁_of_mem_cells {z : γ} (hz : z ∈ S.cells) : z ≠ d.newEdge₁
proof:
:= fun h =>
  d.newEdge₁_notMem (h ▸ hz)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.ne_newEdge₂_of_mem_cells
statement: theorem ne_newEdge₂_of_mem_cells {z : γ} (hz : z ∈ S.cells) : z ≠ d.newEdge₂
proof:
:= fun h =>
  d.newEdge₂_notMem (h ▸ hz)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.newEdge₁_ne_edge
statement: theorem newEdge₁_ne_edge : d.newEdge₁ ≠ d.edge
proof:
:= fun h =>
  d.newEdge₁_notMem (h ▸ d.edge_mem_cells)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.newEdge₂_ne_edge
statement: theorem newEdge₂_ne_edge : d.newEdge₂ ≠ d.edge
proof:
:= fun h =>
  d.newEdge₂_notMem (h ▸ d.edge_mem_cells)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.isLink_newEdge₁
statement: theorem isLink_newEdge₁ : d.skeleton.IsLink d.newEdge₁ d.left d.newVertex
proof:
:=
  d.skeleton_isLink.2 (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.isLink_newEdge₂
statement: theorem isLink_newEdge₂ : d.skeleton.IsLink d.newEdge₂ d.newVertex d.right
proof:
:=
  d.skeleton_isLink.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.skeleton_isLink_of_old
statement:
theorem skeleton_isLink_of_old {f x y : γ} (hfe : f ≠ d.edge) (h : S.skel.IsLink f x y) :
    d.skeleton.IsLink f x y
proof:
:=
  d.skeleton_isLink.2 (Or.inl ⟨h, hfe,
    fun hc => d.newEdge₁_notMem_edgeSet (hc ▸ h.edge_mem),
    fun hc => d.newEdge₂_notMem_edgeSet (hc ▸ h.edge_mem)⟩)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.skeleton_isLink_old_iff
statement:
theorem skeleton_isLink_old_iff {f x y : γ} (hf : f ∈ E(S.skel)) (hfe : f ≠ d.edge) :
    d.skeleton.IsLink f x y ↔ S.skel.IsLink f x y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, d.skeleton_isLink_of_old hfe⟩
  rcases d.skeleton_isLink.1 h with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩
  · exact h
  · exact absurd hf d.newEdge₁_notMem_edgeSet
  · exact absurd hf d.newEdge₂_notMem_edgeSet

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizePos_newVertex
statement: @[simp] theorem realizePos_newVertex : d.realizePos R t d.newVertex = R.drawing d.edge t
proof:
:=
  if_pos rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizePos_of_ne
statement: theorem realizePos_of_ne {z : γ} (h : z ≠ d.newVertex) : d.realizePos R t z = R.pos z
proof: := if_neg h

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizePos_of_mem_cells
statement: theorem realizePos_of_mem_cells {z : γ} (h : z ∈ S.cells) : d.realizePos R t z = R.pos z
proof:
:=
  realizePos_of_ne (d.ne_newVertex_of_mem_cells h)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet
statement: theorem realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet {z : γ} (h : z ∈ V(S.skel)) : d.realizePos R t z = R.pos z
proof:
:=
  realizePos_of_mem_cells (S.mem_cells_of_mem_vertexSet h)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeDrawing_newEdge₁
statement:
@[simp] theorem realizeDrawing_newEdge₁ :
    d.realizeDrawing R t d.newEdge₁ = subarc (R.drawing d.edge) (d.leftParam R) t
proof: := if_pos rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeDrawing_newEdge₂
statement:
@[simp] theorem realizeDrawing_newEdge₂ :
    d.realizeDrawing R t d.newEdge₂ = subarc (R.drawing d.edge) t (d.rightParam R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeDrawing, if_neg d.newEdge_ne.symm, if_pos rfl]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeDrawing_of_ne
statement:
theorem realizeDrawing_of_ne {f : γ} (h₁ : f ≠ d.newEdge₁) (h₂ : f ≠ d.newEdge₂) :
    d.realizeDrawing R t f = R.drawing f
proof: := by rw [realizeDrawing, if_neg h₁, if_neg h₂]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeDrawing_of_mem_cells
statement:
theorem realizeDrawing_of_mem_cells {f : γ} (h : f ∈ S.cells) :
    d.realizeDrawing R t f = R.drawing f
proof:
:=
  realizeDrawing_of_ne (d.ne_newEdge₁_of_mem_cells h) (d.ne_newEdge₂_of_mem_cells h)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeCell_newVertex
statement: @[simp] theorem realizeCell_newVertex : d.realizeCell R t d.newVertex = {R.drawing d.edge t}
proof:
:=
  if_pos rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeCell_newEdge₁
statement:
@[simp] theorem realizeCell_newEdge₁ : d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₁ =
    R.drawing d.edge '' uIcc (d.leftParam R) t \ {R.pos d.left, R.drawing d.edge t}
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeCell, if_neg d.newVertex_ne₁.symm, if_pos rfl]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeCell_newEdge₂
statement:
@[simp] theorem realizeCell_newEdge₂ : d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₂ =
    R.drawing d.edge '' uIcc t (d.rightParam R) \ {R.drawing d.edge t, R.pos d.right}
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeCell, if_neg d.newVertex_ne₂.symm, if_neg d.newEdge_ne.symm, if_pos rfl]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeCell_of_mem_cells
statement: theorem realizeCell_of_mem_cells {c : γ} (h : c ∈ S.cells) : d.realizeCell R t c = R.cell c
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeCell, if_neg (d.ne_newVertex_of_mem_cells h), if_neg (d.ne_newEdge₁_of_mem_cells h),
    if_neg (d.ne_newEdge₂_of_mem_cells h)]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edgeArc_newEdge₁
statement:
theorem edgeArc_newEdge₁ : edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁ =
    R.drawing d.edge '' uIcc (d.leftParam R) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc, realizeDrawing_newEdge₁, subarc_image]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edgeArc_newEdge₂
statement:
theorem edgeArc_newEdge₂ : edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂ =
    R.drawing d.edge '' uIcc t (d.rightParam R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc, realizeDrawing_newEdge₂, subarc_image]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edgeArc_of_ne
statement:
theorem edgeArc_of_ne {f : γ} (h₁ : f ≠ d.newEdge₁) (h₂ : f ≠ d.newEdge₂) :
    edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) f = edgeArc R.drawing f
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc, edgeArc, realizeDrawing_of_ne h₁ h₂]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.cell_vertex_realize
statement:
theorem cell_vertex_realize ⦃v : γ⦄ (hv : v ∈ V(d.skeleton)) :
    d.realizeCell R t v = {d.realizePos R t v}
proof:
:= by
  rw [d.skeleton_vertexSet, mem_insert_iff] at hv
  rcases hv with rfl | hv
  · rw [realizeCell_newVertex, realizePos_newVertex]
  · rw [realizeCell_of_mem_cells (S.mem_cells_of_mem_vertexSet hv),
      realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hv, R.cell_vertex hv]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.cell_edge_realize
proof:
:= by
  rcases d.skeleton_isLink.1 hl with ⟨hlS, -, hg₁, hg₂⟩ | ⟨rfl, hs⟩ | ⟨rfl, hs⟩
  · rw [realizeCell_of_mem_cells (S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet hlS.edge_mem),
      edgeArc_of_ne hg₁ hg₂, realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hlS.left_mem,
      realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hlS.right_mem, R.cell_edge hlS]
  · rw [realizeCell_newEdge₁, edgeArc_newEdge₁]
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.1 hs with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet d.isLink.left_mem, realizePos_newVertex]
    · rw [realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet d.isLink.left_mem, realizePos_newVertex, pair_comm]
  · rw [realizeCell_newEdge₂, edgeArc_newEdge₂]
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.1 hs with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet d.isLink.right_mem, realizePos_newVertex]
    · rw [realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet d.isLink.right_mem, realizePos_newVertex, pair_comm]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.injOn_realizePos
statement: theorem injOn_realizePos : InjOn (d.realizePos R t) V(d.skeleton)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  rw [d.skeleton_vertexSet, mem_insert_iff] at hp hq
  rcases hp with rfl | hp
  · rcases hq with rfl | hq
    · rfl
    · rw [realizePos_newVertex, realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hq] at hpq
      exact absurd hpq (d.newPos_ne_pos R ht hq)
  · rcases hq with rfl | hq
    · rw [realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hp, realizePos_newVertex] at hpq
      exact absurd hpq.symm (d.newPos_ne_pos R ht hp)
    · rw [realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hp, realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hq] at hpq
      exact R.injOn_pos hp hq hpq

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edgeArc_newEdge₁_subset
statement:
theorem edgeArc_newEdge₁_subset :
    edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁ ⊆ edgeArc R.drawing d.edge
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₁, edgeArc]
  exact image_mono ((uIcc_left_subset (d.mem_uIcc_params R ht)).trans (d.uIcc_params R).subset)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edgeArc_newEdge₂_subset
statement:
theorem edgeArc_newEdge₂_subset :
    edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂ ⊆ edgeArc R.drawing d.edge
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₂, edgeArc]
  exact image_mono ((uIcc_right_subset (d.mem_uIcc_params R ht)).trans (d.uIcc_params R).subset)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edgeArc_new_union
statement:
theorem edgeArc_new_union : edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁ ∪
    edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂ = edgeArc R.drawing d.edge
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₁, edgeArc_newEdge₂, ← image_union,
    uIcc_union_uIcc (d.mem_uIcc_params R ht), d.uIcc_params R, edgeArc]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edgeArc_new_inter
statement:
theorem edgeArc_new_inter : edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁ ∩
    edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂ = {R.drawing d.edge t}
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₁, edgeArc_newEdge₂,
    ← (d.injOn_drawing_edge R).mono (d.uIcc_params R).subset |>.image_inter
      (uIcc_left_subset (d.mem_uIcc_params R ht)) (uIcc_right_subset (d.mem_uIcc_params R ht)),
    uIcc_inter_uIcc (d.mem_uIcc_params R ht), image_singleton]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.posLeft_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁
statement:
theorem posLeft_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁ :
    R.pos d.left ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₁, ← d.drawing_leftParam R]
  exact ⟨_, left_mem_uIcc, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.posRight_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂
statement:
theorem posRight_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂ :
    R.pos d.right ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₂, ← d.drawing_rightParam R]
  exact ⟨_, right_mem_uIcc, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.newPos_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁
statement:
theorem newPos_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁ :
    R.drawing d.edge t ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₁]; exact ⟨t, right_mem_uIcc, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.newPos_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂
statement:
theorem newPos_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂ :
    R.drawing d.edge t ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₂]; exact ⟨t, left_mem_uIcc, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.posRight_notMem_edgeArc_newEdge₁
statement:
theorem posRight_notMem_edgeArc_newEdge₁ :
    R.pos d.right ∉ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₁, ← d.drawing_rightParam R]
  rintro ⟨s, hs, hseq⟩
  have hsI : s ∈ I :=
    ((uIcc_left_subset (d.mem_uIcc_params R ht)).trans (d.uIcc_params R).subset) hs
  have : s = d.rightParam R := d.injOn_drawing_edge R hsI (d.rightParam_mem_I R) hseq
  exact right_notMem_uIcc_left (d.mem_uIcc_params R ht) (d.rightParam_ne R ht) (this ▸ hs)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.posLeft_notMem_edgeArc_newEdge₂
statement:
theorem posLeft_notMem_edgeArc_newEdge₂ :
    R.pos d.left ∉ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₂, ← d.drawing_leftParam R]
  rintro ⟨s, hs, hseq⟩
  have hsI : s ∈ I :=
    ((uIcc_right_subset (d.mem_uIcc_params R ht)).trans (d.uIcc_params R).subset) hs
  have : s = d.leftParam R := d.injOn_drawing_edge R hsI (d.leftParam_mem_I R) hseq
  exact left_notMem_uIcc_right (d.mem_uIcc_params R ht) (d.leftParam_ne R ht) (this ▸ hs)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.newPos_notMem_edgeArc_of_ne
statement:
theorem newPos_notMem_edgeArc_of_ne {f : γ} (hf : f ∈ E(S.skel)) (hfe : f ≠ d.edge) :
    R.drawing d.edge t ∉ edgeArc R.drawing f
proof:
:= fun hva =>
  d.newPos_notMem_vertexSet R ht
    (R.isDrawing.arcs_meet_at_vertex (d.edge_mem_edgeSet_graph R)
      (by rw [edgeSet_map]; exact hf) (Ne.symm hfe)
      ⟨t, Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht, rfl⟩ hva)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeGraph_edgeSet
statement: theorem realizeGraph_edgeSet : E(d.realizeGraph R t) = E(d.skeleton)
proof: := edgeSet_map _ _

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizePos_image_vertexSet
statement: theorem realizePos_image_vertexSet : d.realizePos R t '' V(S.skel) = R.pos '' V(S.skel)
proof:
:=
  image_congr fun _ hv => realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hv

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeGraph_vertexSet
statement:
theorem realizeGraph_vertexSet :
    V(d.realizeGraph R t) = insert (R.drawing d.edge t) V(R.graph)
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeGraph, vertexSet_map, d.skeleton_vertexSet, image_insert_eq, realizePos_newVertex,
    realizePos_image_vertexSet, Realization.vertexSet_graph]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.mem_realizeGraph_vertexSet_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_realizeGraph_vertexSet_of_mem {p : Plane} (hp : p ∈ V(R.graph)) :
    p ∈ V(d.realizeGraph R t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeGraph_vertexSet]; exact mem_insert_of_mem _ hp

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.mem_edgeSet_skel_of_ne
statement:
theorem mem_edgeSet_skel_of_ne {f : γ} (hf : f ∈ E(d.realizeGraph R t))
    (h₁ : f ≠ d.newEdge₁) (h₂ : f ≠ d.newEdge₂) : f ∈ E(S.skel) ∧ f ≠ d.edge
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeGraph_edgeSet, d.skeleton_edgeSet] at hf
  simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_sdiff, mem_singleton_iff] at hf
  rcases hf with rfl | rfl | h
  exacts [absurd rfl h₁, absurd rfl h₂, h]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeGraph_isLink_old
statement:
theorem realizeGraph_isLink_old {f : γ} {x y : Plane} (hf : f ∈ E(S.skel)) (hfe : f ≠ d.edge) :
    (d.realizeGraph R t).IsLink f x y ↔ R.graph.IsLink f x y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, q, hpq, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [d.skeleton_isLink_old_iff hf hfe] at hpq
    rw [realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hpq.left_mem, realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hpq.right_mem]
    exact hpq.map R.pos
  · rintro ⟨p, q, hpq, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p, q, d.skeleton_isLink_of_old hfe hpq,
      realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hpq.left_mem, realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet hpq.right_mem⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeGraph_inc_old
statement:
theorem realizeGraph_inc_old {f : γ} {p : Plane} (hf : f ∈ E(S.skel)) (hfe : f ≠ d.edge) :
    (d.realizeGraph R t).Inc f p ↔ R.graph.Inc f p
proof:
:=
  exists_congr fun _ => realizeGraph_isLink_old hf hfe

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₁
statement:
theorem realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₁ :
    (d.realizeGraph R t).IsLink d.newEdge₁ (R.pos d.left) (R.drawing d.edge t)
proof:
:= by
  have h := d.isLink_newEdge₁.map (d.realizePos R t)
  rwa [realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet d.isLink.left_mem, realizePos_newVertex] at h

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₂
statement:
theorem realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₂ :
    (d.realizeGraph R t).IsLink d.newEdge₂ (R.drawing d.edge t) (R.pos d.right)
proof:
:= by
  have h := d.isLink_newEdge₂.map (d.realizePos R t)
  rwa [realizePos_of_mem_vertexSet d.isLink.right_mem, realizePos_newVertex] at h

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁_vertex
statement:
theorem mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁_vertex {p : Plane} (hp : p ∈ V(d.realizeGraph R t))
    (hpa : p ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁) :
    p = R.pos d.left ∨ p = R.drawing d.edge t
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeGraph_vertexSet, mem_insert_iff] at hp
  rcases hp with rfl | hp
  · exact Or.inr rfl
  · rcases R.isDrawing.vertex_mem_edgeArc (d.isLink_drawn_edge R) hp
      (edgeArc_newEdge₁_subset ht hpa) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact absurd (h ▸ hpa) (posRight_notMem_edgeArc_newEdge₁ ht)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂_vertex
statement:
theorem mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂_vertex {p : Plane} (hp : p ∈ V(d.realizeGraph R t))
    (hpa : p ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂) :
    p = R.drawing d.edge t ∨ p = R.pos d.right
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeGraph_vertexSet, mem_insert_iff] at hp
  rcases hp with rfl | hp
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · rcases R.isDrawing.vertex_mem_edgeArc (d.isLink_drawn_edge R) hp
      (edgeArc_newEdge₂_subset ht hpa) with h | h
    · exact absurd (h ▸ hpa) (posLeft_notMem_edgeArc_newEdge₂ ht)
    · exact Or.inr h

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edge_inter_new_new
statement:
theorem edge_inter_new_new {p : Plane}
    (hp₁ : p ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁)
    (hp₂ : p ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂) :
    p ∈ V(d.realizeGraph R t) ∧ (d.realizeGraph R t).Inc d.newEdge₁ p ∧
      (d.realizeGraph R t).Inc d.newEdge₂ p
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : p ∈ ({R.drawing d.edge t} : Set Plane) := by
    rw [← edgeArc_new_inter ht]; exact ⟨hp₁, hp₂⟩
  rw [mem_singleton_iff] at hmem
  subst hmem
  exact ⟨by rw [realizeGraph_vertexSet]; exact mem_insert _ _,
    (realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₁).inc_right, (realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₂).inc_left⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edge_inter_newEdge₁_old
statement:
theorem edge_inter_newEdge₁_old {g : γ} (hg : g ∈ E(S.skel)) (hge : g ≠ d.edge) {p : Plane}
    (hp₁ : p ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁)
    (hpg : p ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) g) :
    p ∈ V(d.realizeGraph R t) ∧ (d.realizeGraph R t).Inc d.newEdge₁ p ∧
      (d.realizeGraph R t).Inc g p
proof:
:= by
  have hgc := S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet hg
  rw [edgeArc_of_ne (d.ne_newEdge₁_of_mem_cells hgc) (d.ne_newEdge₂_of_mem_cells hgc)] at hpg
  obtain ⟨hpV, -, hpgInc⟩ := R.isDrawing.edge_inter (d.edge_mem_edgeSet_graph R)
    (by rw [edgeSet_map]; exact hg) (Ne.symm hge)
    (edgeArc_newEdge₁_subset ht hp₁) hpg
  rcases mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁_vertex ht (mem_realizeGraph_vertexSet_of_mem hpV) hp₁ with
    h | h
  · subst h
    exact ⟨mem_realizeGraph_vertexSet_of_mem hpV, (realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₁).inc_left,
      (realizeGraph_inc_old hg hge).2 hpgInc⟩
  · exact absurd (h ▸ hpV) (d.newPos_notMem_vertexSet R ht)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edge_inter_newEdge₂_old
statement:
theorem edge_inter_newEdge₂_old {g : γ} (hg : g ∈ E(S.skel)) (hge : g ≠ d.edge) {p : Plane}
    (hp₂ : p ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂)
    (hpg : p ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) g) :
    p ∈ V(d.realizeGraph R t) ∧ (d.realizeGraph R t).Inc d.newEdge₂ p ∧
      (d.realizeGraph R t).Inc g p
proof:
:= by
  have hgc := S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet hg
  rw [edgeArc_of_ne (d.ne_newEdge₁_of_mem_cells hgc) (d.ne_newEdge₂_of_mem_cells hgc)] at hpg
  obtain ⟨hpV, -, hpgInc⟩ := R.isDrawing.edge_inter (d.edge_mem_edgeSet_graph R)
    (by rw [edgeSet_map]; exact hg) (Ne.symm hge)
    (edgeArc_newEdge₂_subset ht hp₂) hpg
  rcases mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂_vertex ht (mem_realizeGraph_vertexSet_of_mem hpV) hp₂ with
    h | h
  · exact absurd (h ▸ hpV) (d.newPos_notMem_vertexSet R ht)
  · subst h
    exact ⟨mem_realizeGraph_vertexSet_of_mem hpV,
      (realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₂).inc_right, (realizeGraph_inc_old hg hge).2 hpgInc⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.edge_inter_old_old
statement:
theorem edge_inter_old_old {f g : γ} (hf : f ∈ E(S.skel)) (hfe : f ≠ d.edge)
    (hg : g ∈ E(S.skel)) (hge : g ≠ d.edge) (hfg : f ≠ g) {p : Plane}
    (hpf : p ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) f) (hpg : p ∈ edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) g) :
    p ∈ V(d.realizeGraph R t) ∧ (d.realizeGraph R t).Inc f p ∧ (d.realizeGraph R t).Inc g p
proof:
:= by
  have hfc := S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet hf
  have hgc := S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet hg
  rw [edgeArc_of_ne (d.ne_newEdge₁_of_mem_cells hfc) (d.ne_newEdge₂_of_mem_cells hfc)] at hpf
  rw [edgeArc_of_ne (d.ne_newEdge₁_of_mem_cells hgc) (d.ne_newEdge₂_of_mem_cells hgc)] at hpg
  obtain ⟨hpV, h₁, h₂⟩ := R.isDrawing.edge_inter (by rw [edgeSet_map]; exact hf)
    (by rw [edgeSet_map]; exact hg) hfg hpf hpg
  exact ⟨mem_realizeGraph_vertexSet_of_mem hpV, (realizeGraph_inc_old hf hfe).2 h₁,
    (realizeGraph_inc_old hg hge).2 h₂⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.isDrawing_realize
statement:
theorem isDrawing_realize : IsDrawing (d.realizeGraph R t) (d.realizeDrawing R t) where
  edge_param
proof:
:= by
    intro f hf
    rw [realizeGraph_edgeSet, d.skeleton_edgeSet] at hf
    simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_sdiff, mem_singleton_iff] at hf
    rcases hf with rfl | rfl | ⟨hfS, hfe⟩
    · rw [realizeDrawing_newEdge₁]
      refine ⟨continuousOn_subarc (d.continuousOn_drawing_edge R) (d.leftParam_mem_I R)
          (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht),
        injOn_subarc ((d.injOn_drawing_edge R).mono
          (uIcc_subset_I (d.leftParam_mem_I R) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht))) (d.leftParam_ne R ht),
        ?_⟩
      rw [subarc_zero, subarc_one, d.drawing_leftParam R]
      exact realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₁
    · rw [realizeDrawing_newEdge₂]
      refine ⟨continuousOn_subarc (d.continuousOn_drawing_edge R) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)
          (d.rightParam_mem_I R),
        injOn_subarc ((d.injOn_drawing_edge R).mono
          (uIcc_subset_I (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht) (d.rightParam_mem_I R)))
          (Ne.symm (d.rightParam_ne R ht)), ?_⟩
      rw [subarc_zero, subarc_one, d.drawing_rightParam R]
      exact realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₂
    · have hfc := S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet hfS
      rw [realizeDrawing_of_mem_cells hfc]
      have hd := R.isDrawing.edge_param
        (show f ∈ E(R.graph) by rw [Realization.edgeSet_graph]; exact hfS)
      exact ⟨hd.1, hd.2.1, (realizeGraph_isLink_old hfS hfe).2 hd.2.2⟩
  vertex_mem_edgeArc := by
    intro f x y v hl hv hva
    by_cases hf₁ : f = d.newEdge₁
    · subst hf₁
      rcases hl.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq (realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₁) with
        ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁_vertex ht hv hva
      · exact (mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁_vertex ht hv hva).symm
    · by_cases hf₂ : f = d.newEdge₂
      · subst hf₂
        rcases hl.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq (realizeGraph_isLink_newEdge₂) with
          ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        · exact mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂_vertex ht hv hva
        · exact (mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂_vertex ht hv hva).symm
      · obtain ⟨hfS, hfe⟩ := mem_edgeSet_skel_of_ne hl.edge_mem hf₁ hf₂
        rw [edgeArc_of_ne hf₁ hf₂] at hva
        rw [realizeGraph_isLink_old hfS hfe] at hl
        rw [realizeGraph_vertexSet, mem_insert_iff] at hv
        rcases hv with rfl | hv
        · exact absurd hva (newPos_notMem_edgeArc_of_ne ht hfS hfe)
        · exact R.isDrawing.vertex_mem_edgeArc hl hv hva
  edge_inter := by
    intro f g hf hg hfg p hpf hpg
    by_cases hf₁ : f = d.newEdge₁
    · subst hf₁
      by_cases hg₂ : g = d.newEdge₂
      · subst hg₂
        exact edge_inter_new_new ht hpf hpg
      · obtain ⟨hgS, hge⟩ := mem_edgeSet_skel_of_ne hg (Ne.symm hfg) hg₂
        exact edge_inter_newEdge₁_old ht hgS hge hpf hpg
    · by_cases hf₂ : f = d.newEdge₂
      · subst hf₂
        by_cases hg₁ : g = d.newEdge₁
        · subst hg₁
          obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := edge_inter_new_new ht hpg hpf
          exact ⟨h₁, h₃, h₂⟩
        · obtain ⟨hgS, hge⟩ := mem_edgeSet_skel_of_ne hg hg₁ (Ne.symm hfg)
          exact edge_inter_newEdge₂_old ht hgS hge hpf hpg
      · obtain ⟨hfS, hfe⟩ := mem_edgeSet_skel_of_ne hf hf₁ hf₂
        by_cases hg₁ : g = d.newEdge₁
        · subst hg₁
          obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := edge_inter_newEdge₁_old ht hfS hfe hpg hpf
          exact ⟨h₁, h₃, h₂⟩
        · by_cases hg₂ : g = d.newEdge₂
          · subst hg₂
            obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := edge_inter_newEdge₂_old ht hfS hfe hpg hpf
            exact ⟨h₁, h₃, h₂⟩
          · obtain ⟨hgS, hge⟩ := mem_edgeSet_skel_of_ne hg hg₁ hg₂
            exact edge_inter_old_old hfS hfe hgS hge hfg hpf hpg

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.isArcBetween_newEdge₁
statement:
theorem isArcBetween_newEdge₁ : IsArcBetween (edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁)
    (R.pos d.left) (R.drawing d.edge t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeArc_newEdge₁, ← d.drawing_leftParam R]
  exact isArcBetween_subarc_of_injOn_I (d.continuousOn_drawing_edge R) (d.injOn_drawing_edge R)
    (d.leftParam_mem_I R) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht) (d.leftParam_ne R ht)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.isArcBetween_newEdge₂
statement:
theorem isArcBetween_newEdge₂ : IsArcBetween (edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂)
    (R.drawing d.edge t) (R.pos d.right)
proof:

  exact isArcBetween_subarc_of_injOn_I (d.continuousOn_drawing_edge R) (d.injOn_drawing_edge R)
    (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht) (d.rightParam_mem_I R) (Ne.symm (d.rightParam_ne R ht))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.closure_realizeCell_newEdge₁
statement:
theorem closure_realizeCell_newEdge₁ :
    closure (d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₁) = edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeCell_newEdge₁, ← edgeArc_newEdge₁]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.closure_realizeCell_newEdge₂
statement:
theorem closure_realizeCell_newEdge₂ :
    closure (d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₂) = edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) d.newEdge₂
