name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeCell_edge_eq
statement:
theorem realizeCell_edge_eq : R.cell d.edge = d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₁ ∪
    d.realizeCell R t d.newVertex ∪ d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.cell_edge d.isLink, realizeCell_newEdge₁, realizeCell_newVertex, realizeCell_newEdge₂,
    ← edgeArc_newEdge₁, ← edgeArc_newEdge₂, ← edgeArc_new_union ht]
  ext p
  simp only [mem_union, mem_sdiff, mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff, not_or]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp | hp, hL, hR⟩
    · by_cases hM : p = R.drawing d.edge t
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hM)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨hp, hL, hM⟩)
    · by_cases hM : p = R.drawing d.edge t
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hM)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hp, hM, hR⟩
  · rintro ((⟨hp, hL, hM⟩ | rfl) | ⟨hp, hM, hR⟩)
    · exact ⟨Or.inl hp, hL, fun h => posRight_notMem_edgeArc_newEdge₁ ht (h ▸ hp)⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inl newPos_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁, d.newPos_ne_pos R ht d.isLink.left_mem,
        d.newPos_ne_pos R ht d.isLink.right_mem⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inr hp, fun h => posLeft_notMem_edgeArc_newEdge₂ ht (h ▸ hp), hR⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.nonempty_realizeCell_newEdge₁
statement: theorem nonempty_realizeCell_newEdge₁ : (d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₁).Nonempty

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.disjoint_newEdge₁_newVertex
statement:
theorem disjoint_newEdge₁_newVertex :
    Disjoint (d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₁) (d.realizeCell R t d.newVertex)
proof:
:= by
  rw [realizeCell_newEdge₁, realizeCell_newVertex]
  exact disjoint_left.2 fun _ hp hq => hp.2 (Or.inr (mem_singleton_iff.1 hq))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.disjoint_newEdge₂_newVertex
statement:
theorem disjoint_newEdge₂_newVertex :
    Disjoint (d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₂) (d.realizeCell R t d.newVertex)
proof:
:= by

  exact disjoint_left.2 fun _ hp hq => hp.2 (Or.inl (mem_singleton_iff.1 hq))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.disjoint_newEdge₁_newEdge₂
statement:
theorem disjoint_newEdge₁_newEdge₂ :
    Disjoint (d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₁) (d.realizeCell R t d.newEdge₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_left.2 fun p hp hq => ?_
  rw [realizeCell_newEdge₁, ← edgeArc_newEdge₁] at hp
  rw [realizeCell_newEdge₂, ← edgeArc_newEdge₂] at hq
  have : p ∈ ({R.drawing d.edge t} : Set Plane) := by
    rw [← edgeArc_new_inter ht]; exact ⟨hp.1, hq.1⟩
  exact hp.2 (Or.inr (mem_singleton_iff.1 this))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.isRefinement_realize
statement:
theorem isRefinement_realize : d.IsRefinement R (d.realize R t ht) where
  cell_eq
proof:
:= fun _ hc _ => realizeCell_of_mem_cells hc
  cell_edge := realizeCell_edge_eq ht
  nonempty := by
    rintro c (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · rw [realize_cell, realizeCell_newVertex]
      exact ⟨R.drawing d.edge t, rfl⟩
    · exact nonempty_realizeCell_newEdge₁ ht
    · exact nonempty_realizeCell_newEdge₂ ht
  disjoint := by
    rintro c τ (rfl | rfl | rfl) (rfl | rfl | rfl) hne
    · exact absurd rfl hne
    · exact (disjoint_newEdge₁_newVertex (t := t)).symm
    · exact (disjoint_newEdge₂_newVertex (t := t)).symm
    · exact disjoint_newEdge₁_newVertex
    · exact absurd rfl hne
    · exact disjoint_newEdge₁_newEdge₂ ht
    · exact disjoint_newEdge₂_newVertex
    · exact (disjoint_newEdge₁_newEdge₂ ht).symm
    · exact absurd rfl hne
  closure_newVertex := by
    simp only [realize_cell]
    rw [realizeCell_newVertex, closure_singleton]
  closure_newEdge₁ := by
    simp only [realize_cell]
    rw [closure_realizeCell_newEdge₁ ht, realizeCell_newVertex,
      R.cell_vertex d.isLink.left_mem, realizeCell_newEdge₁, ← edgeArc_newEdge₁]
    exact (diff_pair_union_union posLeft_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁ newPos_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₁).symm
  closure_newEdge₂ := by
    simp only [realize_cell]
    rw [closure_realizeCell_newEdge₂ ht, realizeCell_newVertex,
      R.cell_vertex d.isLink.right_mem, realizeCell_newEdge₂, ← edgeArc_newEdge₂,
      pair_comm (R.drawing d.edge t) (R.pos d.right)]
    exact (diff_pair_union_union posRight_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂ newPos_mem_edgeArc_newEdge₂).symm

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realize_isCellDecomposition_and_isFaceJordan
statement:
theorem realize_isCellDecomposition_and_isFaceJordan (hS : S.CombInvariants) {D : Set Plane}
    (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hJ : R.IsFaceJordan) :
    (d.realize R t ht).IsCellDecomposition D ∧ (d.realize R t ht).IsFaceJordan ∧
      (d.realize R t ht).Refines R d.parent
proof:
:=
  (isRefinement_realize ht).isCellDecomposition_and_isFaceJordan hS h hJ

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.pointSet_realize
statement:
theorem pointSet_realize :
    pointSet (d.realizeGraph R t) (d.realizeDrawing R t) = pointSet R.graph R.drawing
proof:
:= by
  have hedge : (⋃ f ∈ E(R.graph), edgeArc R.drawing f) =
      edgeArc R.drawing d.edge ∪ ⋃ f ∈ E(S.skel) \ {d.edge}, edgeArc R.drawing f := by
    rw [← biUnion_insert, insert_sdiff_singleton,
      insert_eq_of_mem (show d.edge ∈ E(S.skel) from d.edge_mem_edgeSet), Realization.edgeSet_graph]
  have hnew : (⋃ f ∈ E(d.realizeGraph R t), edgeArc (d.realizeDrawing R t) f) =
      edgeArc R.drawing d.edge ∪ ⋃ f ∈ E(S.skel) \ {d.edge}, edgeArc R.drawing f := by
    rw [realizeGraph_edgeSet, d.skeleton_edgeSet, biUnion_insert, biUnion_insert,
      iUnion₂_congr (fun f (hf : f ∈ E(S.skel) \ {d.edge}) =>
        edgeArc_of_ne (d := d) (R := R) (t := t)
          (d.ne_newEdge₁_of_mem_cells (S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet hf.1))
          (d.ne_newEdge₂_of_mem_cells (S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet hf.1))),
      ← union_assoc, edgeArc_new_union ht]
  have hM : R.drawing d.edge t ∈ edgeArc R.drawing d.edge := ⟨t, Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht, rfl⟩
  rw [pointSet, pointSet, hnew, hedge, realizeGraph_vertexSet, insert_union,
    insert_eq_of_mem (mem_union_right _ (mem_union_left _ hM))]

statement: theorem skeletonSet_realize : (d.realize R t ht).skeletonSet = R.skeletonSet

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.arcMatch_edge
statement:
theorem arcMatch_edge : ArcMatch (R₁.drawing d.edge) (R₂.drawing d.edge) g.toFun where
  continuousOn_src
proof:
:= d.continuousOn_drawing_edge R₁
  injOn_src := d.injOn_drawing_edge R₁
  continuousOn_tgt := d.continuousOn_drawing_edge R₂
  injOn_tgt := d.injOn_drawing_edge R₂
  continuousOn_map := g.continuousOn_toFun.mono (d.edgeArc_subset_skeletonSet R₁)
  injOn_map := g.injOn.mono (d.edgeArc_subset_skeletonSet R₁)
  image_eq := g.edgeArc_image d.edge_mem_edgeSet

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.targetParam_leftParam

proof:

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.targetParam_ends
statement:
theorem targetParam_ends :
    (d.targetParam g 0 = 0 ∧ d.targetParam g 1 = 1) ∨
      (d.targetParam g 0 = 1 ∧ d.targetParam g 1 = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := d.targetParam_leftParam g
  have hR := d.targetParam_rightParam g
  rw [rightParam, rightParam] at hR
  rcases d.leftParam_eq_zero_or_one R₁ with h1 | h1 <;>
      rcases d.leftParam_eq_zero_or_one R₂ with h2 | h2 <;>
      simp only [h1, h2, sub_zero, sub_self] at hL hR
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hL, hR⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hL, hR⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hR, hL⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hR, hL⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.targetParam_mem_Ioo

:=
  (d.arcMatch_edge g).param_mem_Ioo_of_ends (d.targetParam_ends g) ht

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.image_edge_uIcc
statement:
theorem image_edge_uIcc {s u : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ I) (hu : u ∈ I) :
    g.toFun '' (R₁.drawing d.edge '' uIcc s u) =
      R₂.drawing d.edge '' uIcc (d.targetParam g s) (d.targetParam g u)
proof:
:=
  (d.arcMatch_edge g).image_image_uIcc hs hu

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeHomeo_toFun
statement:
@[simp] theorem realizeHomeo_toFun (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (d.realizeHomeo g ht).toFun = g.toFun
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeHomeo_invFun
statement:
@[simp] theorem realizeHomeo_invFun (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (d.realizeHomeo g ht).invFun = g.invFun
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.realizeHomeo_eqOn
statement:
theorem realizeHomeo_eqOn (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) {A : Set Plane} :
    EqOn (d.realizeHomeo g ht).toFun g.toFun A
proof: := fun _ _ => rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.finite_cells
statement: theorem finite_cells (S : CellStructure γ) : S.cells.Finite
proof:
:=
  (S.finite_vertexSet.union S.finite_edgeSet).union S.finite_faces

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.mem_star_iff
statement: theorem mem_star_iff : y ∈ R.star σ ↔ ∃ τ, S.sub σ τ ∧ y ∈ closure (R.cell τ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [star, Set.mem_iUnion, mem_supercells, exists_prop]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.closure_cell_subset_star
statement: theorem closure_cell_subset_star (h : S.sub σ τ) : closure (R.cell τ) ⊆ R.star σ
proof:
:= fun _ hz =>
  mem_star_iff.2 ⟨τ, h, hz⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.finite_supercells
statement: theorem finite_supercells (hS : S.CombInvariants) (σ : γ) : (S.supercells σ).Finite
proof:
:=
  S.finite_cells.subset fun _ hτ => hS.sub_mem_right hτ

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.isClosed_star
statement: theorem isClosed_star (hS : S.CombInvariants) : IsClosed (R.star σ)
proof:
:=
  (finite_supercells hS σ).isClosed_biUnion fun _ _ => isClosed_closure

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.carrier_spec
statement:
theorem carrier_spec [Nonempty γ] (R : S.Realization) (x : Plane)
    (h : ∃ σ, σ ∈ S.cells ∧ x ∈ R.cell σ) :
    R.carrier x ∈ S.cells ∧ x ∈ R.cell (R.carrier x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [carrier, dif_pos h]
  exact h.choose_spec

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.cell_subset_domain
statement: theorem cell_subset_domain (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells) : R.cell σ ⊆ D
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.iUnion_eq]
  exact Set.subset_biUnion_of_mem hσ

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.exists_cell
statement:
theorem exists_cell (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hx : x ∈ D) :
    ∃ σ, σ ∈ S.cells ∧ x ∈ R.cell σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.iUnion_eq] at hx
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hxσ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hx
  exact ⟨σ, hσ, hxσ⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.mem_cells_carrier
statement:
theorem mem_cells_carrier [Nonempty γ] (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hx : x ∈ D) :
    R.carrier x ∈ S.cells
proof: := (R.carrier_spec x (h.exists_cell hx)).1

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.mem_cell_carrier
statement:
theorem mem_cell_carrier [Nonempty γ] (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hx : x ∈ D) :
    x ∈ R.cell (R.carrier x)
proof: := (R.carrier_spec x (h.exists_cell hx)).2

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.carrier_eq
statement:
theorem carrier_eq [Nonempty γ] (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells)
    (hx : x ∈ R.cell σ) : R.carrier x = σ
proof:
:= by
  have hxD : x ∈ D := h.cell_subset_domain hσ hx
  by_contra hne
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (h.disjoint (h.mem_cells_carrier hxD) hσ hne)
    (h.mem_cell_carrier hxD) hx

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.mem_star_carrier
statement:
theorem mem_star_carrier [Nonempty γ] (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hx : x ∈ D) :
    x ∈ R.star (R.carrier x)
proof:
:=
  closure_cell_subset_star (h.sub_refl (h.mem_cells_carrier hx))
    (_root_.subset_closure (h.mem_cell_carrier hx))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.star_nonempty
statement: theorem star_nonempty (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells) : (R.star σ).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h.nonempty hσ
  exact ⟨z, closure_cell_subset_star (h.sub_refl hσ) (_root_.subset_closure hz)⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.star_subset_closure_domain
statement:
theorem star_subset_closure_domain (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hS : S.CombInvariants) :
    R.star σ ⊆ closure D
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hyτ⟩ := mem_star_iff.1 hy
  exact closure_mono (h.cell_subset_domain (hS.sub_mem_right hτ)) hyτ

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.isBounded_star
statement:
theorem isBounded_star (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hS : S.CombInvariants)
    (hD : IsBounded D) : IsBounded (R.star σ)
proof:
:=
  hD.closure.subset (h.star_subset_closure_domain hS)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.isCompact_star
statement:
theorem isCompact_star (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hS : S.CombInvariants)
    (hD : IsBounded D) : IsCompact (R.star σ)
proof:
:=
  Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded (isClosed_star hS) (h.isBounded_star hS hD)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.star_anti_of_sub
statement:
theorem star_anti_of_sub (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hS : S.CombInvariants)
    (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells) (hρ : ρ ∈ S.cells) (hsub : S.sub σ ρ) : R.star ρ ⊆ R.star σ
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hyτ⟩ := mem_star_iff.1 hy
  exact mem_star_iff.2 ⟨τ, h.sub_trans hσ hρ (hS.sub_mem_right hτ) hsub hτ, hyτ⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.Refines.refl
statement:
theorem refl (R : S.Realization) : R.Refines R id where
  parent_mem_cells
proof:
:= fun _ hσ => hσ
  parent_mem_faces := fun _ hF => hF
  sub_parent := fun _ _ h => h
  cell_subset := fun _ _ => subset_rfl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.Refines.trans
statement:
theorem trans (h' : R''.Refines R' par') (h : R'.Refines R par) : R''.Refines R (par ∘ par') where
  parent_mem_cells
proof:
:= fun _ hσ => h.parent_mem_cells (h'.parent_mem_cells hσ)
  parent_mem_faces := fun _ hF => h.parent_mem_faces (h'.parent_mem_faces hF)
  sub_parent := fun _ _ hst => h.sub_parent (h'.sub_parent hst)
  cell_subset := fun _ hσ => (h'.cell_subset hσ).trans (h.cell_subset (h'.parent_mem_cells hσ))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.Refines.closure_cell_subset
statement:
theorem closure_cell_subset (h : R'.Refines R par) {σ : γ} (hσ : σ ∈ S'.cells) :
    closure (R'.cell σ) ⊆ closure (R.cell (par σ))
proof:
:=
  closure_mono (h.cell_subset hσ)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.Refines.parent_carrier
statement:
theorem parent_carrier [Nonempty γ] (href : R'.Refines R par) (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D)
    (h' : R'.IsCellDecomposition D') {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ D') :
    par (R'.carrier x) = R.carrier x
proof:
:=
  (h.carrier_eq (href.parent_mem_cells (h'.mem_cells_carrier hx))
    (href.cell_subset (h'.mem_cells_carrier hx) (h'.mem_cell_carrier hx))).symm

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.Refines.star_subset
statement:
theorem star_subset (href : R'.Refines R par) (hS' : S'.CombInvariants) {σ : γ} :
    R'.star σ ⊆ R.star (par σ)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hyτ⟩ := mem_star_iff.1 hy
  exact closure_cell_subset_star (href.sub_parent hτ)
    (href.closure_cell_subset (hS'.sub_mem_right hτ) hyτ)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.Refines.star_carrier_subset
statement:
theorem star_carrier_subset [Nonempty γ] (href : R'.Refines R par) (hS' : S'.CombInvariants)
    (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (h' : R'.IsCellDecomposition D') {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ D') :
    R'.star (R'.carrier x) ⊆ R.star (R.carrier x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← href.parent_carrier h h' hx]
  exact href.star_subset hS'

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.Refines.carrier_congr
statement:
theorem carrier_congr [Nonempty γ] (h₁ : R₁'.Refines R₁ par) (h₂ : R₂'.Refines R₂ par)
    (hd₁ : R₁.IsCellDecomposition D₁) (hd₁' : R₁'.IsCellDecomposition D₁')
    (hd₂ : R₂.IsCellDecomposition D₂) (hd₂' : R₂'.IsCellDecomposition D₂')
    {x y : Plane} (hx : x ∈ D₁') (hy : y ∈ D₂')
    (hxy : R₁'.carrier x = R₂'.carrier y) : R₁.carrier x = R₂.carrier y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h₁.parent_carrier hd₁ hd₁' hx, ← h₂.parent_carrier hd₂ hd₂' hy, hxy]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.Refines.target_star_subset
statement:
theorem target_star_subset [Nonempty γ] (h₁ : R₁'.Refines R₁ par) (h₂ : R₂'.Refines R₂ par)
    (hS' : S'.CombInvariants) (hd₁ : R₁.IsCellDecomposition D₁)
    (hd₁' : R₁'.IsCellDecomposition D₁') {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ D₁') :
    R₂'.star (R₁'.carrier x) ⊆ R₂.star (R₁.carrier x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h₁.parent_carrier hd₁ hd₁' hx]
  exact h₂.star_subset hS'

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.star_inter_nonempty_of_star_inter_nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpσ, hpτ⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨α, hσα, hpα⟩ := mem_star_iff.1 hpσ
  obtain ⟨β, hτβ, hpβ⟩ := mem_star_iff.1 hpτ
  have hα : α ∈ S.cells := hS.sub_mem_right hσα
  have hβ : β ∈ S.cells := hS.sub_mem_right hτβ
  
  rw [h₁.closure_eq hα] at hpα
  obtain ⟨ρ, ⟨hρ, hρα⟩, hpρ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hpα
  have hρβ : S.sub ρ β := h₁.sub_of_mem hρ hβ hpρ hpβ
  
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h₂.nonempty hρ
  exact ⟨w, closure_cell_subset_star hσα (h₂.subset_closure hρ hα hρα hw),
    closure_cell_subset_star hτβ (h₂.subset_closure hρ hβ hρβ hw)⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.star_inter_nonempty_congr
proof:
:=
  ⟨star_inter_nonempty_of_star_inter_nonempty h₁ h₂ hS,
    star_inter_nonempty_of_star_inter_nonempty h₂ h₁ hS⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.star_eq_faces
statement:
theorem star_eq_faces (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hS : S.CombInvariants) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells) :
    R.star σ = ⋃ F ∈ {F | F ∈ S.faces ∧ S.sub σ F}, closure (R.cell F)
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (fun y hy => ?_) ?_
  · obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hyτ⟩ := mem_star_iff.1 hy
    have hτc : τ ∈ S.cells := hS.sub_mem_right hτ
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hτF⟩ := hS.mem_face hτc
    have hFc : F ∈ S.cells := S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hF
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨F, ⟨hF, h.sub_trans hσ hτc hFc hτ hτF⟩, ?_⟩
    exact closure_minimal (h.subset_closure hτc hFc hτF) isClosed_closure hyτ
  · exact Set.iUnion₂_subset fun _ hF => closure_cell_subset_star hF.2

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.mem_closure_face
statement:
theorem mem_closure_face (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) {F : γ} (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells)
    (hF : F ∈ S.faces) (hsub : S.sub σ F) (hx : x ∈ R.cell σ) : x ∈ closure (R.cell F)
proof:
:=
  h.subset_closure hσ (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hF) hsub hx

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.dist_le_of_mem_star
statement:
theorem dist_le_of_mem_star (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hS : S.CombInvariants)
    (hD : IsBounded D) (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells)
    (hdiam : ∀ ⦃F⦄, F ∈ S.faces → S.sub σ F → diam (closure (R.cell F)) ≤ η)
    (hx : x ∈ R.cell σ) (hy : y ∈ R.star σ) : dist x y ≤ η
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.star_eq_faces hS hσ] at hy
  obtain ⟨F, ⟨hF, hsub⟩, hyF⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hy
  have hbdd : IsBounded (closure (R.cell F)) :=
    (hD.subset (h.cell_subset_domain (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hF))).closure
  exact le_trans (dist_le_diam_of_mem hbdd (h.mem_closure_face hσ hF hsub hx) hyF) (hdiam hF hsub)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.diam_star_le
statement:
theorem diam_star_le (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hS : S.CombInvariants) (hD : IsBounded D)
    (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells)
    (hdiam : ∀ ⦃F⦄, F ∈ S.faces → S.sub σ F → diam (closure (R.cell F)) ≤ η) :
    diam (R.star σ) ≤ 2 * η
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h.nonempty hσ
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hσF⟩ := hS.mem_face hσ
  have hη : 0 ≤ η := le_trans diam_nonneg (hdiam hF hσF)
  refine diam_le_of_forall_dist_le (by linarith) fun y hy z hz => ?_
  have hxy : dist x y ≤ η := h.dist_le_of_mem_star hS hD hσ hdiam hx hy
  have hxz : dist x z ≤ η := h.dist_le_of_mem_star hS hD hσ hdiam hx hz
  calc dist y z ≤ dist y x + dist x z := dist_triangle y x z
    _ = dist x y + dist x z := by rw [dist_comm y x]
    _ ≤ 2 * η := by linarith

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.diam_star_lt
statement:
theorem diam_star_lt (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hS : S.CombInvariants) (hD : IsBounded D)
    (hσ : σ ∈ S.cells)
    (hdiam : ∀ ⦃F⦄, F ∈ S.faces → S.sub σ F → diam (closure (R.cell F)) < η) :
    diam (R.star σ) < 2 * η
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : {F | F ∈ S.faces ∧ S.sub σ F}.Finite := S.finite_faces.subset fun _ hF => hF.1
  have hne : {F | F ∈ S.faces ∧ S.sub σ F}.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hσF⟩ := hS.mem_face hσ
    exact ⟨F, hF, hσF⟩
  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image hfin.toFinset
    (fun F => diam (closure (R.cell F))) (hfin.toFinset_nonempty.2 hne)
  rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hF₀
  have hle : diam (R.star σ) ≤ 2 * diam (closure (R.cell F₀)) :=
    h.diam_star_le hS hD hσ fun F hF hsub =>
      hmax F (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hfin |>.2 ⟨hF, hsub⟩)
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle (by have := hdiam hF₀.1 hF₀.2; linarith)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.diam_star_carrier_lt
statement:
theorem diam_star_carrier_lt [Nonempty γ] (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hS : S.CombInvariants)
    (hD : IsBounded D) (hx : x ∈ D)
    (hdiam : ∀ ⦃F⦄, F ∈ S.faces → S.sub (R.carrier x) F → diam (closure (R.cell F)) < η) :
    diam (R.star (R.carrier x)) < 2 * η
proof:
:=
  h.diam_star_lt hS hD (h.mem_cells_carrier hx) hdiam

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.Refines.diam_cell_le
statement:
theorem diam_cell_le (href : R'.Refines R par) (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hD : IsBounded D)
    {F : γ} (hF : F ∈ S'.cells) :
    diam (closure (R'.cell F)) ≤ diam (closure (R.cell (par F)))
proof:
:=
  diam_mono (href.closure_cell_subset hF)
    ((hD.subset (h.cell_subset_domain (href.parent_mem_cells hF))).closure)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.Refines.diam_cell_le_of_forall
statement:
theorem diam_cell_le_of_forall (href : R'.Refines R par) (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D)
    (hD : IsBounded D) (hdiam : ∀ ⦃F⦄, F ∈ S.faces → diam (closure (R.cell F)) ≤ η)
    {F : γ} (hF : F ∈ S'.faces) : diam (closure (R'.cell F)) ≤ η
proof:
:=
  le_trans (href.diam_cell_le h hD (S'.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hF))
    (hdiam (href.parent_mem_faces hF))

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.isOpen_cellNbhd
statement: theorem isOpen_cellNbhd (R : S.Realization) (x : Plane) : IsOpen (R.cellNbhd x)
proof:
:=
  ((S.finite_cells.subset fun _ hτ => hτ.1).isClosed_biUnion
    fun _ _ => isClosed_closure).isOpen_compl

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.mem_cellNbhd_self
statement: theorem mem_cellNbhd_self (R : S.Realization) (x : Plane) : x ∈ R.cellNbhd x
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hxτ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hx
  exact hτ.2 hxτ

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.cellNbhd_mem_nhds
statement: theorem cellNbhd_mem_nhds (R : S.Realization) (x : Plane) : R.cellNbhd x ∈ nhds x
proof:
:=
  (isOpen_cellNbhd R x).mem_nhds (mem_cellNbhd_self R x)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.mem_closure_of_mem_cellNbhd
statement:
theorem mem_closure_of_mem_cellNbhd {R : S.Realization} {x z : Plane} {τ : γ} (hτ : τ ∈ S.cells)
    (hz : z ∈ R.cellNbhd x) (hzτ : z ∈ closure (R.cell τ)) : x ∈ closure (R.cell τ)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hx
  exact hz (Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨τ, ⟨hτ, hx⟩, hzτ⟩)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.sub_carrier_of_mem_cellNbhd
statement:
theorem sub_carrier_of_mem_cellNbhd [Nonempty γ] (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hx : x ∈ D)
    (hz : z ∈ R.cellNbhd x) (hzD : z ∈ D) : S.sub (R.carrier x) (R.carrier z)
proof:
:= by
  have hxclos : x ∈ closure (R.cell (R.carrier z)) :=
    mem_closure_of_mem_cellNbhd (h.mem_cells_carrier hzD) hz
      (_root_.subset_closure (h.mem_cell_carrier hzD))
  exact h.sub_of_mem (h.mem_cells_carrier hx) (h.mem_cells_carrier hzD)
    (h.mem_cell_carrier hx) hxclos

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.cell_neighborhood
statement:
theorem cell_neighborhood [Nonempty γ] (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (hS : S.CombInvariants)
    (hx : x ∈ D) (hz : z ∈ R.cellNbhd x) (hzD : z ∈ D) :
    S.sub (R.carrier x) (R.carrier z) ∧ R.star (R.carrier z) ⊆ R.star (R.carrier x)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := h.sub_carrier_of_mem_cellNbhd hx hz hzD
  exact ⟨hsub, h.star_anti_of_sub hS (h.mem_cells_carrier hx) (h.mem_cells_carrier hzD) hsub⟩

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.pos_pair_subset_edgeArc
statement:
theorem pos_pair_subset_edgeArc (R : S.Realization) {e a b : γ} (hl : S.skel.IsLink e a b) :
    ({R.pos a, R.pos b} : Set Plane) ⊆ Graph.edgeArc R.drawing e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hlink⟩ := R.isDrawing.edge_param (by rw [Graph.edgeSet_map]; exact hl.edge_mem)
  have h0 : R.drawing e 0 ∈ Graph.edgeArc R.drawing e := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ zero_mem_I
  have h1 : R.drawing e 1 ∈ Graph.edgeArc R.drawing e := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ one_mem_I
  have hpair : ({R.pos a, R.pos b} : Set Plane) = {R.drawing e 0, R.drawing e 1} := by
    rcases (hl.map R.pos).eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hlink with ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩
    · rw [ha, hb]
    · rw [ha, hb]; exact Set.pair_comm _ _
  rw [hpair]
  rintro z (rfl | rfl)
  exacts [h0, h1]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SkeletonHomeo.image_cell
statement:
theorem image_cell (g : SkeletonHomeo R₁ R₂) (hσ : σ ∈ V(S.skel) ∪ E(S.skel)) :
    g.toFun '' R₁.cell σ = R₂.cell σ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hσ with hv | he
  · rw [R₁.cell_vertex hv, R₂.cell_vertex hv, Set.image_singleton, g.pos_apply hv]
  · obtain ⟨a, b, hl⟩ := Graph.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet he
    have harc : Graph.edgeArc R₁.drawing σ ⊆ R₁.skeletonSet :=
      Graph.edgeArc_subset_pointSet (by rw [Realization.edgeSet_graph]; exact he)
    rw [R₁.cell_edge hl, R₂.cell_edge hl,
      (g.injOn.mono harc).image_sdiff_subset (R₁.pos_pair_subset_edgeArc hl),
      g.edgeArc_image he, Set.image_pair, g.pos_apply hl.left_mem, g.pos_apply hl.right_mem]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SkeletonHomeo.carrier_congr
statement:
theorem carrier_congr [Nonempty γ] (g : SkeletonHomeo R₁ R₂) (h₁ : R₁.IsCellDecomposition D₁)
    (h₂ : R₂.IsCellDecomposition D₂) (hσ : σ ∈ V(S.skel) ∪ E(S.skel)) (hx : x ∈ R₁.cell σ) :
    R₂.carrier (g.toFun x) = R₁.carrier x
proof:
:= by
  have hcells : σ ∈ S.cells := by
    rcases hσ with hv | he
    exacts [S.mem_cells_of_mem_vertexSet hv, S.mem_cells_of_mem_edgeSet he]
  have hgx : g.toFun x ∈ R₂.cell σ := by
    rw [← g.image_cell hσ]; exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx
  rw [h₁.carrier_eq hcells hx, h₂.carrier_eq hcells hgx]

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.refines_of_elementary
statement:
theorem refines_of_elementary (hc : c ∈ S.cells) (hcells : S'.cells = (S.cells \ {c}) ∪ N)
    (hfresh : ∀ ⦃σ⦄, σ ∈ N → σ ∉ S.cells) (hpar_new : ∀ ⦃σ⦄, σ ∈ N → par σ = c)
    (hpar_old : ∀ ⦃σ⦄, σ ∈ S.cells → par σ = σ)
    (hfaces : ∀ ⦃F⦄, F ∈ S'.faces → par F ∈ S.faces)
    (hsub : ∀ ⦃σ τ⦄, S'.sub σ τ → S.sub (par σ) (par τ))
    (hcell_eq : ∀ ⦃σ⦄, σ ∈ S.cells → σ ≠ c → R'.cell σ = R.cell σ)
    (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D) (h' : R'.IsCellDecomposition D) : R'.Refines R par where
  parent_mem_cells
proof:
:= by
    intro σ hσ
    rw [hcells] at hσ
    rcases hσ with ⟨hσc, -⟩ | hσN
    · rw [hpar_old hσc]; exact hσc
    · rw [hpar_new hσN]; exact hc
  parent_mem_faces := hfaces
  sub_parent := hsub
  cell_subset := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hσ' := hσ
    rw [hcells] at hσ'
    rcases hσ' with ⟨hσc, hσne⟩ | hσN
    · rw [hpar_old hσc, hcell_eq hσc hσne]
    · rw [hpar_new hσN]
      intro w hw
      
      
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hwρ⟩ := h.exists_cell (h'.cell_subset_domain hσ hw)
      by_cases hρc : ρ = c
      · exact hρc ▸ hwρ
      · have hρ' : ρ ∈ S'.cells := by rw [hcells]; exact Or.inl ⟨hρ, hρc⟩
        have hne : σ ≠ ρ := by rintro rfl; exact hfresh hσN hρ
        have hwρ' : w ∈ R'.cell ρ := by rw [hcell_eq hρ hρc]; exact hwρ
        exact absurd hwρ' (Set.disjoint_left.1 (h'.disjoint hσ hρ' hne) hw)

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.IsRefinement.refines
statement:
theorem IsRefinement.refines (hS : S.CombInvariants) {R : S.Realization}
    {R' : (S.subdivideEdge d).Realization} (href : d.IsRefinement R R') :
    R'.Refines R d.parent where
  parent_mem_cells
proof:
:= by
    intro σ hσ
    rw [subdivideEdge_cells] at hσ
    rcases hσ with ⟨hσc, -⟩ | hσN
    · rw [d.parent_of_mem_cells hσc]; exact hσc
    · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells hσN]; exact d.edge_mem_cells
  parent_mem_faces := by
    intro F hF
    rw [subdivideEdge_faces] at hF
    rw [d.parent_of_mem_cells (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hF)]
    exact hF
  sub_parent := fun _ _ h => d.sub_parent hS h
  cell_subset := by
    intro σ hσ
    rw [subdivideEdge_cells] at hσ
    rcases hσ with ⟨hσc, hσe⟩ | hσN
    · rw [d.parent_of_mem_cells hσc, href.cell_eq hσc hσe]
    · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells hσN]; exact href.cell_subset_edge hσN

name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.refines
statement:
theorem refines (hS : S.CombInvariants) {R : S.Realization}
    {R' : (S.splitFace d).Realization} {D : Set Plane} (h : R.IsCellDecomposition D)
    (h' : R'.IsCellDecomposition D)
    (hcell_eq : ∀ ⦃σ⦄, σ ∈ S.cells → σ ≠ d.face → R'.cell σ = R.cell σ) :
    R'.Refines R d.parent
proof:
:= by
  refine refines_of_elementary d.face_mem_cells (splitFace_cells d)
    (fun _ hσ => notMem_cells_of_mem_newCells hσ) (fun _ hσ => d.parent_of_mem_newCells hσ)
    (fun _ hσ => d.parent_of_mem_cells hσ) ?_ (fun _ _ h => d.sub_parent hS h) hcell_eq h h'
  intro F hF
  rw [splitFace_faces] at hF
  rcases hF with rfl | rfl | ⟨hFc, -⟩
  · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells d.face₁_mem_newCells]; exact d.face_mem
  · rw [d.parent_of_mem_newCells d.face₂_mem_newCells]; exact d.face_mem
  · rw [d.parent_of_mem_cells (S.mem_cells_of_mem_faces hFc)]; exact hFc

name: Schoenflies.segment_split
statement:
theorem segment_split (hp : p ∈ segment ℝ a b) :
    segment ℝ a b = segment ℝ a p ∪ segment ℝ p b
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ (union_subset
    ((convex_segment a b).segment_subset (left_mem_segment ℝ a b) hp)
    ((convex_segment a b).segment_subset hp (right_mem_segment ℝ a b)))
  obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hαβ, rfl⟩ := hp
  rintro x ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv, rfl⟩
  rcases le_or_gt v β with hvβ | hvβ
  · 
    left
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hβ with rfl | hβpos
    · have hv0 : v = 0 := le_antisymm hvβ hv
      have hu1 : u = 1 := by linarith
      subst hv0; subst hu1
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, one_smul]
      exact left_mem_segment ℝ a _
    · refine ⟨1 - v / β, v / β, by
        rw [sub_nonneg]
        exact div_le_one_of_le₀ hvβ hβpos.le, by positivity, by ring, ?_⟩
      have hβne : β ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hβpos
      have hvβ' : v / β * β = v := div_mul_cancel₀ v hβne
      have hcoef : (1 - v / β) + (v / β) * α = u := by
        have hα' : α = 1 - β := by linarith
        calc (1 - v / β) + (v / β) * α
            = (1 - v / β) + (v / β) * (1 - β) := by rw [hα']
          _ = 1 - v / β * β := by ring
          _ = 1 - v := by rw [hvβ']
          _ = u := by linarith
      rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← add_assoc, ← add_smul, hcoef, hvβ']
  · 
    right
    have hαpos : 0 < α := by linarith
    have hαne : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hαpos
    have huα : u ≤ α := by linarith
    refine ⟨u / α, 1 - u / α, by positivity, by
      rw [sub_nonneg]
      exact div_le_one_of_le₀ huα hαpos.le, by ring, ?_⟩
    have huα' : u / α * α = u := div_mul_cancel₀ u hαne
    have hcoef : (u / α) * β + (1 - u / α) = v := by
      have hβ' : β = 1 - α := by linarith
      calc (u / α) * β + (1 - u / α)
          = (u / α) * (1 - α) + (1 - u / α) := by rw [hβ']
        _ = 1 - u / α * α := by ring
        _ = 1 - u := by rw [huα']
        _ = v := by linarith
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, add_assoc, ← add_smul, hcoef, huα']

name: Schoenflies.openSegment_left_subset
statement:
theorem openSegment_left_subset (hp : p ∈ openSegment ℝ a b) :
    openSegment ℝ a p ⊆ openSegment ℝ a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hαβ, rfl⟩ := hp
  rintro x ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hst, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨s + t * α, t * β, by positivity, by positivity, by nlinarith, ?_⟩
  rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← add_assoc, ← add_smul]

name: Schoenflies.openSegment_right_subset
statement:
theorem openSegment_right_subset (hp : p ∈ openSegment ℝ a b) :
    openSegment ℝ p b ⊆ openSegment ℝ a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hαβ, rfl⟩ := hp
  rintro x ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hst, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨s * α, s * β + t, by positivity, by positivity, by nlinarith, ?_⟩
  rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, add_assoc, ← add_smul]

name: Schoenflies.segment_inter_segment
statement:
theorem segment_inter_segment (a b c d : Plane)
    (hne : (segment ℝ a b ∩ segment ℝ c d).Nonempty) :
    ∃ p q : Plane, segment ℝ a b ∩ segment ℝ c d = segment ℝ p q
proof:
:= by
  set S : Set Plane := segment ℝ a b ∩ segment ℝ c d with hSdef
  have hScompact : IsCompact S := (isCompact_segment a b).inter (isCompact_segment c d)
  have hSconvex : Convex ℝ S := (convex_segment a b).inter (convex_segment c d)
  
  set f : ℝ →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane := AffineMap.lineMap a b with hfdef
  set T : Set ℝ := Icc 0 1 ∩ f ⁻¹' S with hTdef
  
  
  have himage : f '' T = S := by
    refine subset_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) (fun x hx => ?_)
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact ht.2
    · have : x ∈ segment ℝ a b := hx.1
      rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap] at this
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := this
      exact ⟨t, ⟨ht, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  have hTne : T.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
    have : x ∈ f '' T := by rw [himage]; exact hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := this
    exact ⟨t, ht⟩
  have hTcompact : IsCompact T :=
    isCompact_Icc.of_isClosed_subset
      (isClosed_Icc.inter (hScompact.isClosed.preimage AffineMap.lineMap_continuous))
      inter_subset_left
  have hTconvex : Convex ℝ T := (convex_Icc 0 1).inter (hSconvex.affine_preimage f)
  
  obtain ⟨t₀, t₁, hTIcc⟩ : ∃ t₀ t₁, T = Icc t₀ t₁ :=
    ⟨_, _, eq_Icc_of_connected_compact ⟨hTne, hTconvex.isPreconnected⟩ hTcompact⟩
  have hle : t₀ ≤ t₁ := by
    rw [hTIcc] at hTne
    exact nonempty_Icc.1 hTne
  exact ⟨f t₀, f t₁, by rw [← himage, hTIcc, ← segment_eq_Icc hle, image_segment]⟩

name: Schoenflies.dist_left_lineMap_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem dist_left_lineMap_of_nonneg (a b : Plane) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    dist a (AffineMap.lineMap a b t) = t * dist a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_left_lineMap, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht]

name: Schoenflies.segment_lineMap_image
statement:
theorem segment_lineMap_image (a b : Plane) (p q : ℝ) :
    segment ℝ (AffineMap.lineMap a b p) (AffineMap.lineMap a b q)
      = (AffineMap.lineMap a b : ℝ →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane) '' segment ℝ p q
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Schoenflies.openSegment_lineMap_image
statement:
theorem openSegment_lineMap_image (a b : Plane) (p q : ℝ) :
    openSegment ℝ (AffineMap.lineMap a b p) (AffineMap.lineMap a b q)
      = (AffineMap.lineMap a b : ℝ →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane) '' openSegment ℝ p q
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Schoenflies.exists_param_of_mem_segment
statement:
theorem exists_param_of_mem_segment {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ segment ℝ a b) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧ AffineMap.lineMap a b t = x ∧ dist a x = t * dist a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap] at hx
  obtain ⟨t, ⟨ht0, ht1⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨t, ht0, ht1, rfl, dist_left_lineMap_of_nonneg a b ht0⟩

name: Schoenflies.parameter_le_of_distance
statement:
theorem parameter_le_of_distance (hab : a ≠ b) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (h : dist a (AffineMap.lineMap a b s) ≤ dist a (AffineMap.lineMap a b t)) : s ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < dist a b := dist_pos.2 hab
  rw [dist_left_lineMap_of_nonneg a b hs, dist_left_lineMap_of_nonneg a b ht] at h
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (by linarith) hd

name: Schoenflies.eq_of_dist_left_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_dist_left_eq (hab : a ≠ b) {x y : Plane} (hx : x ∈ segment ℝ a b)
    (hy : y ∈ segment ℝ a b) (h : dist a x = dist a y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < dist a b := dist_pos.2 hab
  obtain ⟨s, -, -, rfl, hsd⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hx
  obtain ⟨t, -, -, rfl, htd⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hy
  rw [hsd, htd] at h
  rw [mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hd) h]

name: Schoenflies.dist_le_of_mem_segment
statement:
theorem dist_le_of_mem_segment (hab : a ≠ b) {u v x : Plane} (hu : u ∈ segment ℝ a b)
    (hv : v ∈ segment ℝ a b) (huv : dist a u ≤ dist a v) (hx : x ∈ segment ℝ u v) :
    dist a u ≤ dist a x ∧ dist a x ≤ dist a v
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist a b := dist_nonneg
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, -, rfl, hpd⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hu
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, -, rfl, hqd⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hv
  have hpq : p ≤ q := parameter_le_of_distance hab hp0 hq0 huv
  
  rw [segment_lineMap_image, segment_eq_Icc hpq] at hx
  obtain ⟨t, ⟨hpt, htq⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [hpd, hqd, dist_left_lineMap_of_nonneg a b (hp0.trans hpt)]
  exact ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩

name: Schoenflies.mem_segment_of_dist_le
statement:
theorem mem_segment_of_dist_le (hab : a ≠ b) {u v x : Plane} (hu : u ∈ segment ℝ a b)
    (hv : v ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hx : x ∈ segment ℝ a b) (h₁ : dist a u ≤ dist a x)
    (h₂ : dist a x ≤ dist a v) : x ∈ segment ℝ u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, -, rfl, -⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hu
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, -, rfl, -⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hv
  obtain ⟨t, ht0, -, rfl, -⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hx
  have hpt : p ≤ t := parameter_le_of_distance hab hp0 ht0 h₁
  have htq : t ≤ q := parameter_le_of_distance hab ht0 hq0 h₂
  rw [segment_lineMap_image, segment_eq_Icc (hpt.trans htq)]
  exact ⟨t, ⟨hpt, htq⟩, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.dist_lt_of_mem_openSegment
statement:
theorem dist_lt_of_mem_openSegment (hab : a ≠ b) {u v x : Plane} (hu : u ∈ segment ℝ a b)
    (hv : v ∈ segment ℝ a b) (huv : u ≠ v) (hor : dist a u ≤ dist a v)
    (hx : x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v) : dist a u < dist a x ∧ dist a x < dist a v
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < dist a b := dist_pos.2 hab
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, -, rfl, hpd⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hu
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, -, rfl, hqd⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hv
  have hpq : p < q :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (parameter_le_of_distance hab hp0 hq0 hor) fun h => huv (by rw [h])
  rw [openSegment_lineMap_image, openSegment_eq_Ioo hpq] at hx
  obtain ⟨t, ⟨hpt, htq⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [hpd, hqd, dist_left_lineMap_of_nonneg a b (hp0.trans hpt.le)]
  exact ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩

name: Schoenflies.mem_openSegment_of_dist_lt
statement:
theorem mem_openSegment_of_dist_lt (hab : a ≠ b) {u v x : Plane} (hu : u ∈ segment ℝ a b)
    (hv : v ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hx : x ∈ segment ℝ a b) (h₁ : dist a u < dist a x)
    (h₂ : dist a x < dist a v) : x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < dist a b := dist_pos.2 hab
  obtain ⟨p, -, -, rfl, hpd⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hu
  obtain ⟨q, -, -, rfl, hqd⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hv
  obtain ⟨t, -, -, rfl, htd⟩ := exists_param_of_mem_segment hx
  rw [hpd, htd] at h₁
  rw [htd, hqd] at h₂
  have hpt : p < t := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h₁ hd.le
  have htq : t < q := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h₂ hd.le
  rw [openSegment_lineMap_image, openSegment_eq_Ioo (hpt.trans htq)]
  exact ⟨t, ⟨hpt, htq⟩, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.dist_le_left_of_notMem_openSegment
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  exact hout (mem_openSegment_of_dist_lt hab hu hv hy (lt_of_not_ge hcon) hlt)

name: Schoenflies.le_dist_right_of_notMem_openSegment
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  exact hout (mem_openSegment_of_dist_lt hab hu hv hy hlt (lt_of_not_ge hcon))

name: Schoenflies.segment_inside_of_ends_outside_oriented
statement:
theorem segment_inside_of_ends_outside_oriented (hab : a ≠ b) {u v s t x : Plane}
    (hu : u ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hv : v ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hpiece : dist a u ≤ dist a v)
    (hs : s ∈ segment ℝ a b) (ht : t ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hover : dist a s ≤ dist a t)
    (hxp : x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v) (hxo : x ∈ openSegment ℝ s t)
    (hsout : s ∉ openSegment ℝ u v) (htout : t ∉ openSegment ℝ u v) :
    segment ℝ u v ⊆ segment ℝ s t
proof:
:= by
  
  
  rcases eq_or_ne s t with rfl | hst
  · rw [openSegment_same, mem_singleton_iff] at hxo
    rw [← hxo] at hsout
    exact absurd hxp hsout
  
  rcases eq_or_ne u v with rfl | huv
  · rw [openSegment_same, mem_singleton_iff] at hxp
    rw [segment_same, singleton_subset_iff, ← hxp]
    exact openSegment_subset_segment ℝ s t hxo
  obtain ⟨hux, hxv⟩ := dist_lt_of_mem_openSegment hab hu hv huv hpiece hxp
  obtain ⟨hsx, hxt⟩ := dist_lt_of_mem_openSegment hab hs ht hst hover hxo
  
  have hsu : dist a s ≤ dist a u :=
    dist_le_left_of_notMem_openSegment hab hu hv hs hsout (hsx.trans hxv)
  have hvt : dist a v ≤ dist a t :=
    le_dist_right_of_notMem_openSegment hab hu hv ht htout (hux.trans hxt)
  intro y hy
  have hyab : y ∈ segment ℝ a b := (convex_segment a b).segment_subset hu hv hy
  obtain ⟨huy, hyv⟩ := dist_le_of_mem_segment hab hu hv hpiece hy
  exact mem_segment_of_dist_le hab hs ht hyab (hsu.trans huy) (hyv.trans hvt)

name: Schoenflies.same_ends_of_meeting_interiors_oriented
statement:
theorem same_ends_of_meeting_interiors_oriented (hab : a ≠ b) {u v s t x : Plane}
    (hu : u ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hv : v ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hfirst : dist a u ≤ dist a v)
    (hs : s ∈ segment ℝ a b) (ht : t ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hsecond : dist a s ≤ dist a t)
    (hxu : x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v) (hxs : x ∈ openSegment ℝ s t)
    (hsout : s ∉ openSegment ℝ u v) (htout : t ∉ openSegment ℝ u v)
    (huout : u ∉ openSegment ℝ s t) (hvout : v ∉ openSegment ℝ s t) :
    u = s ∧ v = t
proof:
:= by
  
  
  rcases eq_or_ne u v with rfl | huv
  · rw [openSegment_same, mem_singleton_iff] at hxu
    rw [← hxu] at huout
    exact absurd hxs huout
  rcases eq_or_ne s t with rfl | hst
  · rw [openSegment_same, mem_singleton_iff] at hxs
    rw [← hxs] at hsout
    exact absurd hxu hsout
  obtain ⟨hux, hxv⟩ := dist_lt_of_mem_openSegment hab hu hv huv hfirst hxu
  obtain ⟨hsx, hxt⟩ := dist_lt_of_mem_openSegment hab hs ht hst hsecond hxs
  
  have hsu : dist a s ≤ dist a u :=
    dist_le_left_of_notMem_openSegment hab hu hv hs hsout (hsx.trans hxv)
  have hus : dist a u ≤ dist a s :=
    dist_le_left_of_notMem_openSegment hab hs ht hu huout (hux.trans hxt)
  
  have hvt : dist a v ≤ dist a t :=
    le_dist_right_of_notMem_openSegment hab hu hv ht htout (hux.trans hxt)
  have htv : dist a t ≤ dist a v :=
    le_dist_right_of_notMem_openSegment hab hs ht hv hvout (hsx.trans hxv)
  exact ⟨eq_of_dist_left_eq hab hu hs (le_antisymm hus hsu),
    eq_of_dist_left_eq hab hv ht (le_antisymm hvt htv)⟩

name: Schoenflies.segment_inside_of_ends_outside
statement:
theorem segment_inside_of_ends_outside (hab : a ≠ b) {u v s t x : Plane}
    (hu : u ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hv : v ∈ segment ℝ a b)
    (hs : s ∈ segment ℝ a b) (ht : t ∈ segment ℝ a b)
    (hxp : x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v) (hxo : x ∈ openSegment ℝ s t)
    (hsout : s ∉ openSegment ℝ u v) (htout : t ∉ openSegment ℝ u v) :
    segment ℝ u v ⊆ segment ℝ s t
proof:
:= by
  have hxp' : x ∈ openSegment ℝ v u := by rwa [openSegment_symm ℝ v u]
  have hsout' : s ∉ openSegment ℝ v u := by rwa [openSegment_symm ℝ v u]
  have htout' : t ∉ openSegment ℝ v u := by rwa [openSegment_symm ℝ v u]
  have hxo' : x ∈ openSegment ℝ t s := by rwa [openSegment_symm ℝ t s]
  have hrevPiece : segment ℝ v u = segment ℝ u v := segment_symm ℝ v u
  have hrevOverlap : segment ℝ t s = segment ℝ s t := segment_symm ℝ t s
  rcases le_total (dist a u) (dist a v) with hp | hp <;>
    rcases le_total (dist a s) (dist a t) with ho | ho
  · exact segment_inside_of_ends_outside_oriented hab hu hv hp hs ht ho hxp hxo hsout htout
  · rw [← hrevOverlap]
    exact segment_inside_of_ends_outside_oriented hab hu hv hp ht hs ho hxp hxo' htout hsout
  · rw [← hrevPiece]
    exact segment_inside_of_ends_outside_oriented hab hv hu hp hs ht ho hxp' hxo hsout' htout'
  · rw [← hrevPiece, ← hrevOverlap]
    exact segment_inside_of_ends_outside_oriented hab hv hu hp ht hs ho hxp' hxo' htout' hsout'

name: Schoenflies.same_ends_of_meeting_interiors
statement:
theorem same_ends_of_meeting_interiors (hab : a ≠ b) {u v s t x : Plane}
    (hu : u ∈ segment ℝ a b) (hv : v ∈ segment ℝ a b)
    (hs : s ∈ segment ℝ a b) (ht : t ∈ segment ℝ a b)
    (hxu : x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v) (hxs : x ∈ openSegment ℝ s t)
    (hsout : s ∉ openSegment ℝ u v) (htout : t ∉ openSegment ℝ u v)
    (huout : u ∉ openSegment ℝ s t) (hvout : v ∉ openSegment ℝ s t) :
    (u = s ∧ v = t) ∨ (u = t ∧ v = s)
proof:
:= by
  have hxu' : x ∈ openSegment ℝ v u := by rwa [openSegment_symm ℝ v u]
  have hxs' : x ∈ openSegment ℝ t s := by rwa [openSegment_symm ℝ t s]
  have hsout' : s ∉ openSegment ℝ v u := by rwa [openSegment_symm ℝ v u]
  have htout' : t ∉ openSegment ℝ v u := by rwa [openSegment_symm ℝ v u]
  have huout' : u ∉ openSegment ℝ t s := by rwa [openSegment_symm ℝ t s]
  have hvout' : v ∉ openSegment ℝ t s := by rwa [openSegment_symm ℝ t s]
  rcases le_total (dist a u) (dist a v) with hp | hp <;>
    rcases le_total (dist a s) (dist a t) with ho | ho
  · exact Or.inl (same_ends_of_meeting_interiors_oriented hab hu hv hp hs ht ho hxu hxs
      hsout htout huout hvout)
  · exact Or.inr (same_ends_of_meeting_interiors_oriented hab hu hv hp ht hs ho hxu hxs'
      htout hsout huout' hvout')
  · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := same_ends_of_meeting_interiors_oriented hab hv hu hp hs ht ho hxu' hxs
      hsout' htout' hvout huout
    exact Or.inr ⟨h₂, h₁⟩
  · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := same_ends_of_meeting_interiors_oriented hab hv hu hp ht hs ho hxu' hxs'
      htout' hsout' hvout' huout'
    exact Or.inl ⟨h₂, h₁⟩

name: Schoenflies.poly_cons_of_ne_nil
statement:
theorem poly_cons_of_ne_nil {vs : List Plane} (h : vs ≠ []) (u : Plane) :
    poly (u :: vs) = segment ℝ u (vs.head h) ∪ poly vs
proof:
:= by
  match vs, h with
  | _ :: _, _ => rfl

name: Schoenflies.segsOf_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem segsOf_nil : segsOf [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.segsOf_singleton
statement: @[simp] theorem segsOf_singleton (v : Plane) : segsOf [v] = []
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.segsOf_cons_cons
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.segsOf_nondeg
statement: theorem segsOf_nondeg (vs : List Plane) : ∀ P ∈ segsOf vs, P.Nondeg
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction vs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons u tl ih =>
    match tl, ih with
    | [], _ => simp
    | v :: rest, ih =>
      rw [segsOf_cons_cons]
      split_ifs with huv
      · exact ih
      · intro P hP
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hP with rfl | hP
        · exact huv
        · exact ih P hP

name: Schoenflies.cover_segsOf
statement:
theorem cover_segsOf (vs : List Plane) :
    cover (segsOf vs) = poly vs ∨ (segsOf vs = [] ∧ (poly vs).Subsingleton)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction vs with
  | nil => exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, by simp⟩
  | cons u tl ih =>
    match tl, ih with
    | [], _ => exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, by simp [Set.Subsingleton]⟩
    | v :: rest, ih =>
      rw [segsOf_cons_cons, poly_cons_cons]
      by_cases huv : u = v
      · 
        
        subst huv
        rw [if_pos rfl, segment_same]
        have hmem : u ∈ poly (u :: rest) := mem_poly_of_mem (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        rcases ih with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · exact Or.inl (by rw [h, union_eq_self_of_subset_left (singleton_subset_iff.2 hmem)])
        · refine Or.inr ⟨h1, ?_⟩
          rw [union_eq_self_of_subset_left (singleton_subset_iff.2 hmem)]
          exact h2
      · rw [if_neg huv, cover_cons]
        refine Or.inl ?_
        rcases ih with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · rw [h]; rfl
        · 
          rw [h1, cover_nil, union_empty,
            h2.eq_singleton_of_mem (mem_poly_of_mem (List.mem_cons_self ..)),
            union_eq_self_of_subset_right (singleton_subset_iff.2 (right_mem_segment ℝ u v))]
          rfl

name: Schoenflies.cover_segsOf_eq
statement:
theorem cover_segsOf_eq {vs : List Plane} (ha : a ∈ poly vs) (hb : b ∈ poly vs)
    (hab : a ≠ b) : cover (segsOf vs) = poly vs
proof:
:= by
  rcases cover_segsOf vs with h | ⟨-, h⟩
  · exact h
  · exact absurd (h ha hb) hab

name: Schoenflies.exists_poly_eq_edgesCover
statement:
theorem exists_poly_eq_edgesCover {u v : Plane} {W : List Piece}
    (hW : (overlayGraph pieces points).IsWalk u W v) (hne : W ≠ []) :
    ∃ vs : List Plane, ∃ h : vs ≠ [], vs.head h = u ∧ vs.getLast h = v ∧
      poly vs = Graph.edgesCover segmentDrawing W
proof:
:= by
  induction hW with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | @cons u w v e W hl hW ih =>
    
    
    have hedge : Graph.edgeArc segmentDrawing e = segment ℝ u w := by
      rw [edgeArc_segmentDrawing]
      rcases (overlayGraph_isLink.1 hl).2 with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · rfl
      · exact segment_symm ℝ _ _
    rcases eq_or_ne W [] with rfl | hWne
    · have hwv : w = v := hW.eq_of_nil
      subst hwv
      refine ⟨[u, w], by simp, rfl, by simp, ?_⟩
      rw [poly_pair, Graph.edgesCover_cons, Graph.edgesCover_nil, union_empty, hedge]
    · obtain ⟨vs, hvs, hhead, hlast, hpoly⟩ := ih hWne
      refine ⟨u :: vs, by simp, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.getLast_cons hvs]; exact hlast
      · rw [poly_cons_of_ne_nil hvs, hhead, hpoly, Graph.edgesCover_cons, hedge]

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_reaches_end
statement:
theorem overlayGraph_reaches_end {P : Piece} (hP : P ∈ overlayPieces pieces points)
    (hz : x = P.1 ∨ x = P.2) :
    (overlayGraph pieces points).Reaches a P.1 ↔ (overlayGraph pieces points).Reaches a x
proof:
:= by
  have hlink : (overlayGraph pieces points).IsLink P P.1 P.2 :=
    overlayGraph_isLink.2 ⟨hP, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  rcases hz with rfl | rfl
  · exact Iff.rfl
  · exact ⟨fun h => h.trans (Graph.Reaches.of_isLink hlink),
      fun h => h.trans (Graph.Reaches.of_isLink hlink).symm⟩

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_mem_vertexSet_of_mem_cover
statement:
theorem overlayGraph_mem_vertexSet_of_mem_cover (hnd : ∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg)
    (hxp : x ∈ points) (hx : x ∈ cover pieces) : x ∈ V(overlayGraph pieces points)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← overlayPieces_cover pieces points] at hx
  simp only [cover, mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hx
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hxP⟩ := hx
  have hint : x ∉ P.interior := overlayPieces_avoids hnd x hxp P hP
  refine ⟨P, hP, ?_⟩
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  exact hint (mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right (Ne.symm hcon.1) (Ne.symm hcon.2) hxP)

name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_reaches
statement:
theorem overlayGraph_reaches (hnd : ∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg)
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (cover pieces))
    (hEnds : EndsAreCut pieces points) (hMeets : MeetsAreCut pieces points)
    (hap : a ∈ points) (hbp : b ∈ points) (ha : a ∈ cover pieces) (hb : b ∈ cover pieces) :
    (overlayGraph pieces points).Reaches a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdraw : Graph.IsDrawing (overlayGraph pieces points) segmentDrawing :=
    overlayGraph_isDrawing pieces points hnd hEnds hMeets
  have haV : a ∈ V(overlayGraph pieces points) :=
    overlayGraph_mem_vertexSet_of_mem_cover hnd hap ha
  have hbV : b ∈ V(overlayGraph pieces points) :=
    overlayGraph_mem_vertexSet_of_mem_cover hnd hbp hb
  
  
  have hlink : ∀ P ∈ overlayPieces pieces points,
      (overlayGraph pieces points).IsLink P P.1 P.2 := fun P hP =>
    overlayGraph_isLink.2 ⟨hP, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  
  set S : Set Plane :=
    ⋃ P ∈ {P | P ∈ overlayPieces pieces points ∧
      (overlayGraph pieces points).Reaches a P.1}, P.seg with hS
  set T : Set Plane :=
    ⋃ P ∈ {P | P ∈ overlayPieces pieces points ∧
      ¬ (overlayGraph pieces points).Reaches a P.1}, P.seg with hT
  have hSclosed : IsClosed S :=
    ((Set.Finite.subset (overlayPieces pieces points).finite_toSet
      fun _ hP => hP.1).isCompact_biUnion fun P _ => isCompact_segment P.1 P.2).isClosed
  have hTclosed : IsClosed T :=
    ((Set.Finite.subset (overlayPieces pieces points).finite_toSet
      fun _ hP => hP.1).isCompact_biUnion fun P _ => isCompact_segment P.1 P.2).isClosed
  
  have hunion : ∀ z ∈ cover pieces, z ∈ S ∨ z ∈ T := by
    intro z hz
    rw [← overlayPieces_cover pieces points] at hz
    simp only [cover, mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hz
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hzP⟩ := hz
    by_cases hr : (overlayGraph pieces points).Reaches a P.1
    · exact Or.inl (mem_biUnion (show P ∈ _ from ⟨hP, hr⟩) hzP)
    · exact Or.inr (mem_biUnion (show P ∈ _ from ⟨hP, hr⟩) hzP)
  
  have hdisj : ∀ z, z ∈ S → z ∈ T → False := by
    intro z hzS hzT
    simp only [hS, hT, mem_iUnion, mem_setOf_eq, exists_prop] at hzS hzT
    obtain ⟨P, ⟨hP, hPr⟩, hzP⟩ := hzS
    obtain ⟨Q, ⟨hQ, hQr⟩, hzQ⟩ := hzT
    have hPQ : P ≠ Q := by rintro rfl; exact hQr hPr
    obtain ⟨-, hincP, hincQ⟩ := hdraw.edge_inter (overlayGraph_mem_edgeSet.2 hP)
      (overlayGraph_mem_edgeSet.2 hQ) hPQ
      (by rwa [edgeArc_segmentDrawing]) (by rwa [edgeArc_segmentDrawing])
    have hzendP : z = P.1 ∨ z = P.2 := hincP.eq_or_eq_of_isLink (hlink P hP)
    have hzendQ : z = Q.1 ∨ z = Q.2 := hincQ.eq_or_eq_of_isLink (hlink Q hQ)
    exact hQr ((overlayGraph_reaches_end hQ hzendQ).2
      ((overlayGraph_reaches_end hP hzendP).1 hPr))
  
  have haS : a ∈ S := by
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hend⟩ := id haV
    refine mem_biUnion (show P ∈ _ from
      ⟨hP, (overlayGraph_reaches_end hP hend).2 (Graph.Reaches.refl haV)⟩) ?_
    rcases hend with rfl | rfl
    exacts [left_mem_segment ℝ _ _, right_mem_segment ℝ _ _]
  
  have hbS : b ∈ S := by
    by_contra hbnot
    have hbT : b ∈ T := (hunion b hb).resolve_left hbnot
    have hsub : cover pieces ⊆ Tᶜ ∪ Sᶜ := by
      intro w hw
      rcases hunion w hw with h | h
      · exact Or.inl fun h' => hdisj w h h'
      · exact Or.inr fun h' => hdisj w h' h
    obtain ⟨z, hzc, hzT, hzS⟩ := hconn Tᶜ Sᶜ hTclosed.isOpen_compl hSclosed.isOpen_compl
      hsub ⟨a, ha, fun h => hdisj a haS h⟩ ⟨b, hb, fun h => hdisj b h hbT⟩
    exact (hunion z hzc).elim hzS hzT
  
  simp only [hS, mem_iUnion, mem_setOf_eq, exists_prop] at hbS
  obtain ⟨P, ⟨hP, hPr⟩, hbP⟩ := hbS
  have hbend : b = P.1 ∨ b = P.2 :=
    hdraw.vertex_mem_edgeArc (hlink P hP) hbV (by rwa [edgeArc_segmentDrawing])
  exact (overlayGraph_reaches_end hP hbend).1 hPr

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_poly_of_cover
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_of_cover (hnd : ∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg)
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (cover pieces)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : a ∈ cover pieces) (hb : b ∈ cover pieces) :
    ∃ vs : List Plane, ∃ h : vs ≠ [], vs.head h = a ∧ vs.getLast h = b ∧
      poly vs ⊆ cover pieces ∧ IsArcBetween (poly vs) a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  obtain ⟨pts₀, hEnds₀, hMeets₀⟩ := exists_cut_points pieces
  set pts : List Plane := a :: b :: pts₀ with hpts
  have hEnds : EndsAreCut pieces pts := fun P hP z hz => by
    simp [hpts, hEnds₀ P hP z hz]
  have hMeets : MeetsAreCut pieces pts := by
    intro P hP Q hQ hPQ hne
    obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hu, hv⟩ := hMeets₀ P hP Q hQ hPQ hne
    exact ⟨u, v, huv, by simp [hpts, hu], by simp [hpts, hv]⟩
  have hdraw : Graph.IsDrawing (overlayGraph pieces pts) segmentDrawing :=
    overlayGraph_isDrawing pieces pts hnd hEnds hMeets
  
  have hreach : (overlayGraph pieces pts).Reaches a b :=
    overlayGraph_reaches hnd hconn hEnds hMeets (by simp [hpts]) (by simp [hpts]) ha hb
  obtain ⟨W, hpath⟩ := hreach.exists_isPath
  have hWne : W ≠ [] := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hab hpath.isWalk.eq_of_nil
  
  have harc : IsArcBetween (Graph.edgesCover segmentDrawing W) a b :=
    hdraw.path_isArcBetween hpath hWne
  obtain ⟨vs, hvs, hhead, hlast, hpoly⟩ := exists_poly_eq_edgesCover hpath.isWalk hWne
  refine ⟨vs, hvs, hhead, hlast, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hpoly, ← overlayGraph_pointSet pieces pts]
    exact Graph.edgesCover_subset_pointSet fun e he => hpath.edge_mem he
  · rw [hpoly]; exact harc

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_poly_of_poly
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_of_poly {vs : List Plane} (hconn : IsPreconnected (poly vs))
    (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : a ∈ poly vs) (hb : b ∈ poly vs) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws ⊆ poly vs ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b
proof:
:= by
  have hcov : cover (segsOf vs) = poly vs := cover_segsOf_eq ha hb hab
  have := exists_simple_poly_of_cover (segsOf_nondeg vs) (hcov ▸ hconn) hab
    (hcov ▸ ha) (hcov ▸ hb)
  rwa [hcov] at this

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_poly_of_isPolygonal
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_of_isPolygonal {A : Set Plane} (hA : IsPolygonal A)
    (hconn : IsPreconnected A) (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ A) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws ⊆ A ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vs, rfl⟩ := hA
  exact exists_simple_poly_of_poly hconn hab ha hb

name: Schoenflies.biUnion_list_cons
statement:
theorem biUnion_list_cons {α : Type*} (f : α → Set Plane) (x : α) (l : List α) :
    (⋃ y ∈ x :: l, f y) = f x ∪ ⋃ y ∈ l, f y
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_iUnion, exists_prop, List.mem_cons, mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl | hy, hz⟩
    · exact Or.inl hz
    · exact Or.inr ⟨y, hy, hz⟩
  · rintro (hz | ⟨y, hy, hz⟩)
    · exact ⟨x, Or.inl rfl, hz⟩
    · exact ⟨y, Or.inr hy, hz⟩

name: Schoenflies.cover_flatMap_list
statement:
theorem cover_flatMap_list {α : Type*} (f : α → List Piece) (l : List α) :
    cover (l.flatMap f) = ⋃ x ∈ l, cover (f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x l ih => rw [List.flatMap_cons, cover_append, ih, biUnion_list_cons]

name: Schoenflies.subset_of_finite_diff
statement:
theorem subset_of_finite_diff {U C : Set Plane} (hU : IsPreconnected U) (hC : IsClosed C)
    (hfin : (U \ C).Finite) (ha : a ∈ U) (hb : b ∈ U) (hab : a ≠ b) : U ⊆ C
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  by_contra hzC
  
  set D : Set Plane := C ∪ ((U \ C) \ {z}) with hD
  have hDclosed : IsClosed D := hC.union ((hfin.subset Set.sdiff_subset).isClosed)
  have hzD : z ∉ D := fun h => h.elim hzC fun h' => h'.2 rfl
  have hmemD : ∀ w ∈ U, w ≠ z → w ∈ D := fun w hw hwz =>
    (em (w ∈ C)).elim Or.inl fun h => Or.inr ⟨⟨hw, h⟩, hwz⟩
  
  obtain ⟨w, hwU, hwD, hwz⟩ := hU Dᶜ ({z} : Set Plane)ᶜ hDclosed.isOpen_compl
    isClosed_singleton.isOpen_compl
    (fun w hw => (em (w = z)).elim (fun h => Or.inl (h ▸ hzD)) fun h => Or.inr h)
    ⟨z, hz, hzD⟩
    ((em (a = z)).elim (fun h => ⟨b, hb, fun hbz => hab (h.trans (mem_singleton_iff.1 hbz).symm)⟩)
      fun h => ⟨a, ha, h⟩)
  exact hwD (hmemD w hwU hwz)

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_poly_of_biUnion
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_of_biUnion {L : List (List Plane)}
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (⋃ vs ∈ L, poly vs)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : a ∈ ⋃ vs ∈ L, poly vs) (hb : b ∈ ⋃ vs ∈ L, poly vs) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws ⊆ (⋃ vs ∈ L, poly vs) ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnd : ∀ P ∈ L.flatMap segsOf, P.Nondeg := by
    intro P hP
    obtain ⟨vs, -, hPvs⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 hP
    exact segsOf_nondeg vs P hPvs
  have hcovsub : ∀ vs : List Plane, cover (segsOf vs) ⊆ poly vs := by
    intro vs
    rcases cover_segsOf vs with h | ⟨h, -⟩
    · exact h.subset
    · rw [h, cover_nil]; exact empty_subset _
  have hflat : cover (L.flatMap segsOf) = ⋃ vs ∈ L, cover (segsOf vs) :=
    cover_flatMap_list segsOf L
  have hsub : cover (L.flatMap segsOf) ⊆ ⋃ vs ∈ L, poly vs := by
    rw [hflat]
    exact iUnion₂_mono fun vs _ => hcovsub vs
  
  have hdiff : ((⋃ vs ∈ L, poly vs) \ cover (L.flatMap segsOf)).Finite := by
    have hsmall : ∀ vs : List Plane, (poly vs \ cover (segsOf vs)).Subsingleton := by
      intro vs
      rcases cover_segsOf vs with h | ⟨-, h⟩
      · rw [h]; simp
      · exact h.anti Set.sdiff_subset
    refine (Set.Finite.biUnion L.finite_toSet
      fun vs _ => (hsmall vs).finite).subset ?_
    rintro z ⟨hzU, hzC⟩
    simp only [mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hzU
    obtain ⟨vs, hvs, hz⟩ := hzU
    refine mem_biUnion hvs ⟨hz, fun hmem => hzC ?_⟩
    rw [hflat]
    exact mem_biUnion hvs hmem
  have hclosed : IsClosed (cover (L.flatMap segsOf)) :=
    Set.Finite.isClosed_biUnion (L.flatMap segsOf).finite_toSet fun P _ =>
      (isCompact_segment P.1 P.2).isClosed
  have heq : cover (L.flatMap segsOf) = ⋃ vs ∈ L, poly vs :=
    subset_antisymm hsub (subset_of_finite_diff hconn hclosed hdiff ha hb hab)
  have := exists_simple_poly_of_cover hnd (heq ▸ hconn) hab (heq ▸ ha) (heq ▸ hb)
  rwa [heq] at this

name: Schoenflies.exists_lists_of_isPolygonal
statement:
theorem exists_lists_of_isPolygonal : ∀ {L : List (Set Plane)}, (∀ A ∈ L, IsPolygonal A) →
    ∃ M : List (List Plane), (⋃ vs ∈ M, poly vs) = ⋃ A ∈ L, A
  | [], _ => ⟨[], by simp⟩
  | A :: L, h => by
    obtain ⟨vs, rfl⟩
proof:
:= h A (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_lists_of_isPolygonal fun B hB => h B (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hB)
    refine ⟨vs :: M, ?_⟩
    rw [biUnion_list_cons (fun ws : List Plane => poly ws),
      biUnion_list_cons (fun B : Set Plane => B), hM]

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_poly_of_union
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_of_union {L : List (Set Plane)} (hL : ∀ A ∈ L, IsPolygonal A)
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (⋃ A ∈ L, A)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : a ∈ ⋃ A ∈ L, A) (hb : b ∈ ⋃ A ∈ L, A) :
    ∃ ws : List Plane, ∃ h : ws ≠ [], ws.head h = a ∧ ws.getLast h = b ∧
      poly ws ⊆ (⋃ A ∈ L, A) ∧ IsArcBetween (poly ws) a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_lists_of_isPolygonal hL
  have := exists_simple_poly_of_biUnion (L := M) (hM ▸ hconn) hab (hM ▸ ha) (hM ▸ hb)
  rwa [hM] at this

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_poly_of_isPreconnected
statement:
theorem exists_simple_poly_of_isPreconnected (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hconn : IsPreconnected Ω)
    (hx : x ∈ Ω) (hy : y ∈ Ω) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ vs : List Plane, ∃ h : vs ≠ [], vs.head h = x ∧ vs.getLast h = y ∧
      poly vs ⊆ Ω ∧ IsArcBetween (poly vs) x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨us, hus, hsub, hhead, hlast⟩ := exists_poly_of_isPreconnected hΩ hconn hx hy
  have hxu : x ∈ poly us := hhead ▸ head_mem_poly hus
  have hyu : y ∈ poly us := hlast ▸ getLast_mem_poly hus
  obtain ⟨vs, hvs, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ :=
    exists_simple_poly_of_poly (isConnected_poly hus).2 hxy hxu hyu
  exact ⟨vs, hvs, h1, h2, h3.trans hsub, h4⟩

name: Schoenflies.exists_simple_arc_of_isPreconnected
statement:
theorem exists_simple_arc_of_isPreconnected (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hconn : IsPreconnected Ω)
    (hx : x ∈ Ω) (hy : y ∈ Ω) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ A ⊆ Ω, IsPolygonal A ∧ IsArcBetween A x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vs, -, -, -, hsub, harc⟩ := exists_simple_poly_of_isPreconnected hΩ hconn hx hy hxy
  exact ⟨poly vs, hsub, ⟨vs, rfl⟩, harc⟩

name: Schoenflies.det_sub_right
statement:
private theorem det_sub_right (a b c : Plane) :
    Plane.det a (b - c) = Plane.det a b - Plane.det a c
proof:
:= by
  rw [show b - c = b + (-1 : ℝ) • c by module, Plane.det_add_right, Plane.det_smul_right]; ring

name: Schoenflies.det_neg_right
statement: private theorem det_neg_right (a b : Plane) : Plane.det a (-b) = -Plane.det a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (-b : Plane) = (-1 : ℝ) • b by module, Plane.det_smul_right]; ring

name: Schoenflies.det_zero_right
statement: private theorem det_zero_right (a : Plane) : Plane.det a 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (0 : Plane) = (0 : ℝ) • (0 : Plane) by module, Plane.det_smul_right, zero_mul]

name: Schoenflies.notMem_radial_of_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem notMem_radial_of_det_ne_zero (hd : Plane.IsDirection d) (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : Plane.det d (z - x) ≠ 0) : z ∉ segment ℝ x (x + r • d)
proof:
:= by
  intro hseg
  rcases ((mem_radial_iff hd hr).1 hseg).2 with hzx | hdir
  · exact h (by rw [hzx, sub_self, det_zero_right])
  · have hne : z - x ≠ 0 := fun h0 => h (by rw [h0, det_zero_right])
    have hrep : ‖z - x‖ • d = z - x := by rw [← hdir]; exact smul_norm_dir hne
    exact h (by rw [← hrep, Plane.det_smul_right, Plane.det_self, mul_zero])

name: Schoenflies.notMem_radial_of_det_perp_pos
statement:
theorem notMem_radial_of_det_perp_pos (hd : Plane.IsDirection d) (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : 0 < Plane.det (Plane.perp d) (z - x)) : z ∉ segment ℝ x (x + r • d)
proof:
:= by
  have hpd : Plane.det (Plane.perp d) d = -1 := by
    rw [Plane.det_comm, Plane.det_perp_self, hd.norm, one_pow]
  intro hseg
  rcases ((mem_radial_iff hd hr).1 hseg).2 with hzx | hdir
  · rw [hzx, sub_self, det_zero_right] at h; exact lt_irrefl 0 h
  · have hne : z - x ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, det_zero_right] at h
      exact lt_irrefl 0 h
    have hrep : ‖z - x‖ • d = z - x := by rw [← hdir]; exact smul_norm_dir hne
    rw [← hrep, Plane.det_smul_right, hpd] at h
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z - x)]

name: Schoenflies.isConnected_cone_of_convex
statement:
theorem isConnected_cone_of_convex {A : Set Plane} (hA : Convex ℝ A)
    (hne : (Plane.cone x A r).Nonempty) : IsConnected (Plane.cone x A r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Plane.cone_eq_image] at hne ⊢
  exact ⟨hne, ((hA.inter (convex_ball (0 : Plane) r)).isPreconnected).image _
    ((continuous_const.add continuous_id).continuousOn)⟩

name: Schoenflies.mem_cone_quarter
statement:
private theorem mem_cone_quarter {A : Set Plane} (hr : 0 < r) (v : Plane) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 2)
    (hvA : (r / 4) • v ∈ A) : x + (r / 4) • v ∈ Plane.cone x A r
proof:
:= by
  refine Plane.mem_cone_iff.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show x + (r / 4) • v - x = (r / 4) • v by module]; exact hvA
  · rw [dist_eq_norm, show x + (r / 4) • v - x = (r / 4) • v by module, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < r / 4)]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]

name: Schoenflies.isConnected_ball_diff_radial
statement:
theorem isConnected_ball_diff_radial (hd : Plane.IsDirection d) (hr : 0 < r) :
    IsConnected (ball x r \ segment ℝ x (x + r • d))
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := hd.ne_zero
  have hdp : Plane.det d (Plane.perp d) = 1 := by rw [Plane.det_perp_self, hd.norm, one_pow]
  have hpd : Plane.det (Plane.perp d) d = -1 := by rw [Plane.det_comm, hdp]
  have hnd : ‖d‖ = 1 := hd.norm
  have hnp : ‖Plane.perp d‖ = 1 := by rw [Plane.norm_perp, hnd]
  
  set A : Set Plane := Plane.cone x {u | 0 < Plane.det d u} r with hAdef
  set B : Set Plane := Plane.cone x {u | Plane.det d u < 0} r with hBdef
  set E : Set Plane := Plane.cone x {u | 0 < Plane.det (Plane.perp d) u} r with hEdef
  
  have hAne : x + (r / 4) • Plane.perp d ∈ A :=
    mem_cone_quarter hr _ (by rw [hnp]; norm_num)
      (by change 0 < Plane.det d _; rw [Plane.det_smul_right, hdp]; positivity)
  have hEne : x + (r / 4) • (-d) ∈ E :=
    mem_cone_quarter hr _ (by rw [norm_neg, hnd]; norm_num)
      (by
        change 0 < Plane.det (Plane.perp d) _
        rw [Plane.det_smul_right, det_neg_right, hpd]
        norm_num
        positivity)
  have hBne : x + (r / 4) • (-Plane.perp d) ∈ B :=
    mem_cone_quarter hr _ (by rw [norm_neg, hnp]; norm_num)
      (by
        change Plane.det d _ < 0
        rw [Plane.det_smul_right, det_neg_right, hdp]
        nlinarith)
  have hAE : x + (r / 4) • (Plane.perp d - d) ∈ A ∩ E := by
    have hvn : ‖Plane.perp d - d‖ ≤ 2 := by
      refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) ?_
      rw [hnp, hnd]; norm_num
    refine ⟨mem_cone_quarter hr _ hvn ?_, mem_cone_quarter hr _ hvn ?_⟩
    · change 0 < Plane.det d _
      rw [Plane.det_smul_right, det_sub_right, hdp, Plane.det_self]
      norm_num
      positivity
    · change 0 < Plane.det (Plane.perp d) _
      rw [Plane.det_smul_right, det_sub_right, Plane.det_self, hpd]
      norm_num
      positivity
  have hBE : x + (r / 4) • (-Plane.perp d - d) ∈ B ∩ E := by
    have hvn : ‖-Plane.perp d - d‖ ≤ 2 := by
      refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) ?_
      rw [norm_neg, hnp, hnd]; norm_num
    refine ⟨mem_cone_quarter hr _ hvn ?_, mem_cone_quarter hr _ hvn ?_⟩
    · change Plane.det d _ < 0
      rw [Plane.det_smul_right, det_sub_right, det_neg_right, hdp, Plane.det_self]
      nlinarith
    · change 0 < Plane.det (Plane.perp d) _
      rw [Plane.det_smul_right, det_sub_right, det_neg_right, Plane.det_self, hpd]
      norm_num
      positivity
  
  have hsplit : ball x r \ segment ℝ x (x + r • d) = (A ∪ E) ∪ (B ∪ E) := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hzb, hzs⟩
      have hdist : dist w x < r := mem_ball.1 hzb
      have hz : w ≠ x ∧ Plane.dir (w - x) ≠ d := by
        by_contra hcon
        push Not at hcon
        exact hzs ((mem_radial_iff hd hr).2 ⟨hdist.le,
          by rcases eq_or_ne w x with h | h; exacts [Or.inl h, Or.inr (hcon h)]⟩)
      rcases lt_trichotomy (Plane.det d (w - x)) 0 with hlt | heq | hgt
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Plane.mem_cone_iff.2 ⟨hlt, hdist⟩))
      · 
        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Plane.det_eq_zero_iff_smul d (w - x) hd0).1 heq
        have hcne : c ≠ 0 := by
          rintro rfl
          refine hz.1 (sub_eq_zero.1 ?_)
          rw [hc]; module
        have hcneg : c < 0 := by
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hcne with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd (by rw [hc, dir_smul_of_isDirection hd h]) hz.2
        refine Or.inl (Or.inr (Plane.mem_cone_iff.2 ⟨?_, hdist⟩))
        change 0 < Plane.det (Plane.perp d) (w - x)
        rw [hc, Plane.det_smul_right, hpd]
        nlinarith
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Plane.mem_cone_iff.2 ⟨hgt, hdist⟩))
    · rintro ((hz | hz) | (hz | hz))
      · exact ⟨Plane.cone_subset_ball hz,
          notMem_radial_of_det_ne_zero hd hr (ne_of_gt (Plane.mem_cone_iff.1 hz).1)⟩
      · exact ⟨Plane.cone_subset_ball hz,
          notMem_radial_of_det_perp_pos hd hr (Plane.mem_cone_iff.1 hz).1⟩
      · exact ⟨Plane.cone_subset_ball hz,
          notMem_radial_of_det_ne_zero hd hr (ne_of_lt (Plane.mem_cone_iff.1 hz).1)⟩
      · exact ⟨Plane.cone_subset_ball hz,
          notMem_radial_of_det_perp_pos hd hr (Plane.mem_cone_iff.1 hz).1⟩
  rw [hsplit]
  have hAc : IsConnected A :=
    isConnected_cone_of_convex (Plane.convex_det_right_pos d) ⟨_, hAne⟩
  have hBc : IsConnected B :=
    isConnected_cone_of_convex (Plane.convex_det_right_neg d) ⟨_, hBne⟩
  have hEc : IsConnected E :=
    isConnected_cone_of_convex (Plane.convex_det_right_pos (Plane.perp d)) ⟨_, hEne⟩
  exact IsConnected.union ⟨_, Or.inr hEne, Or.inr hEne⟩
    (IsConnected.union ⟨_, hAE.1, hAE.2⟩ hAc hEc) (IsConnected.union ⟨_, hBE.1, hBE.2⟩ hBc hEc)

name: Schoenflies.isDirection_mk_one_zero
statement: theorem isDirection_mk_one_zero : Plane.IsDirection (Plane.mk 1 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Plane.IsDirection, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: Schoenflies.isConnected_ball_diff_singleton
statement: theorem isConnected_ball_diff_singleton (hr : 0 < r) : IsConnected (ball x r \ {x})
proof:
:= by
  set d : Plane := Plane.mk 1 0 with hddef
  have hd : Plane.IsDirection d := isDirection_mk_one_zero
  have hnd : Plane.IsDirection (-d) := by rw [Plane.IsDirection, norm_neg]; exact hd.norm
  have hne : d ≠ -d := by
    intro h
    refine hd.ne_zero ?_
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) • d = 0 := by
      rw [two_smul]
      nth_rewrite 2 [h]
      module
    rcases smul_eq_zero.1 h2 with h' | h'
    · norm_num at h'
    · exact h'
  have hsplit : ball x r \ {x} =
      (ball x r \ segment ℝ x (x + r • d)) ∪ (ball x r \ segment ℝ x (x + r • (-d))) := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hzb, hzx⟩
      by_cases h : w ∈ segment ℝ x (x + r • d)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hzb, fun h' => hzx (radial_inter_radial hd hnd hne hr ⟨h, h'⟩)⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hzb, h⟩
    · have key : ∀ (e : Plane) (w : Plane), w ∉ segment ℝ x (x + r • e) → w ∉ ({x} : Set Plane) :=
        fun e w h hw => h (by rw [mem_singleton_iff] at hw; rw [hw]; exact left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)
      rintro (⟨hzb, h⟩ | ⟨hzb, h⟩)
      · exact ⟨hzb, key d w h⟩
      · exact ⟨hzb, key (-d) w h⟩
  rw [hsplit]
  refine IsConnected.union ?_ (isConnected_ball_diff_radial hd hr)
    (isConnected_ball_diff_radial hnd hr)
  
  have hnp : ‖Plane.perp d‖ = 1 := by rw [Plane.norm_perp, hd.norm]
  have hdp : Plane.det d (Plane.perp d) = 1 := by rw [Plane.det_perp_self, hd.norm, one_pow]
  have hmem : x + (r / 2) • Plane.perp d ∈ ball x r := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, show x + (r / 2) • Plane.perp d - x = (r / 2) • Plane.perp d by
      module, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < r / 2), hnp]
    linarith
  have hsub : x + (r / 2) • Plane.perp d - x = (r / 2) • Plane.perp d := by module
  have hdet : Plane.det d (x + (r / 2) • Plane.perp d - x) = r / 2 := by
    rw [hsub, Plane.det_smul_right, hdp, mul_one]
  refine ⟨x + (r / 2) • Plane.perp d, ⟨hmem, ?_⟩, hmem, ?_⟩
  · exact notMem_radial_of_det_ne_zero hd hr (by rw [hdet]; positivity)
  · refine notMem_radial_of_det_ne_zero hnd hr ?_
    rw [show Plane.det (-d) (x + (r / 2) • Plane.perp d - x)
        = -Plane.det d (x + (r / 2) • Plane.perp d - x) by
      rw [show (-d : Plane) = (-1 : ℝ) • d by module, Plane.det_smul_left]; ring, hdet]
    have : (0 : ℝ) < r / 2 := by positivity
    linarith

name: Schoenflies.IsLocalRadius.center_mem
statement: theorem IsLocalRadius.center_mem (h : IsLocalRadius S x r) : x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  (h.2 x (by rw [dist_self]; exact h.pos.le)).2 (Or.inl rfl)

name: Schoenflies.IsLocalRadius.ball_diff_eq_punctured
statement:
theorem IsLocalRadius.ball_diff_eq_punctured (h : IsLocalRadius S x r)
    (hzero : localDirs S x = ∅) : ball x r \ S = ball x r \ {x}
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_ball, mem_singleton_iff]
  refine and_congr_right fun hz => not_congr ?_
  rw [h.2 z hz.le, hzero]
  simp

name: Schoenflies.IsLocalRadius.ball_diff_eq_slit
statement:
theorem IsLocalRadius.ball_diff_eq_slit (h : IsLocalRadius S x r)
    (hone : localDirs S x = {d}) : ball x r \ S = ball x r \ segment ℝ x (x + r • d)
proof:
:= by
  have hdmem : d ∈ localDirs S x := by rw [hone]; rfl
  have hd : Plane.IsDirection d := isDirection_of_mem_localDirs hdmem
  ext z
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_ball]
  refine and_congr_right fun hz => not_congr ?_
  rw [h.2 z hz.le, hone, mem_radial_iff hd h.pos]
  simp [hz.le]

name: Schoenflies.IsLocalRadius.isConnected_ball_diff_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem IsLocalRadius.isConnected_ball_diff_of_subsingleton (h : IsLocalRadius S x r)
    (hsub : (localDirs S x).Subsingleton) : IsConnected (ball x r \ S)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hsub.eq_empty_or_singleton with hzero | ⟨e, hone⟩
  · rw [h.ball_diff_eq_punctured hzero]
    exact isConnected_ball_diff_singleton h.pos
  · rw [h.ball_diff_eq_slit hone]
    exact isConnected_ball_diff_radial
      (isDirection_of_mem_localDirs (show e ∈ localDirs S x by rw [hone]; rfl)) h.pos

name: Schoenflies.IsLocalRadius.isOpen_ball_diff
statement:
theorem IsLocalRadius.isOpen_ball_diff (h : IsLocalRadius S x r)
    (hfin : (localDirs S x).Finite) : IsOpen (ball x r \ S)
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : IsClosed (closedBall x r ∩ S) := by
    rw [h.closedBall_inter h.center_mem, insert_eq]
    exact isClosed_singleton.union
      (hfin.isClosed_biUnion fun e _ => (isCompact_segment _ _).isClosed)
  have heq : ball x r \ S = ball x r ∩ (closedBall x r ∩ S)ᶜ := by
    ext z
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_inter_iff, mem_compl_iff, mem_ball, mem_closedBall, not_and]
    exact and_congr_right fun hz => ⟨fun hnS _ => hnS, fun hf hS => hf hz.le hS⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact isOpen_ball.inter hclosed.isOpen_compl

name: Schoenflies.localDirs_union_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem localDirs_union_of_disjoint {C : Set Plane} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hC : Disjoint (closedBall x r) C) : localDirs (S ∪ C) x = localDirs S x
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ (localDirs_mono subset_union_left)
  rintro e ⟨he, t, ht, hsub⟩
  refine ⟨he, min t r, lt_min ht hr, fun w hw => ?_⟩
  
  rw [← radial_inter_closedBall he (lt_min ht hr) (min_le_left t r)] at hw
  rcases hsub hw.1 with hwS | hwC
  · exact hwS
  · exact absurd hwC (Set.disjoint_left.1 hC
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (min_le_right t r) hw.2))

name: Schoenflies.IsLocalRadius.union_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem IsLocalRadius.union_of_disjoint {C : Set Plane} (h : IsLocalRadius S x r)
    (hC : Disjoint (closedBall x r) C) : IsLocalRadius (S ∪ C) x r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.pos, fun w hw => ?_⟩
  rw [localDirs_union_of_disjoint h.pos hC]
  refine ⟨?_, fun hcase => Or.inl ((h.2 w hw).2 hcase)⟩
  rintro (hwS | hwC)
  · exact (h.2 w hw).1 hwS
  · exact absurd hwC (Set.disjoint_left.1 hC (mem_closedBall.2 hw))

name: Schoenflies.mem_localSectors
statement:
theorem mem_localSectors (hz : z ∈ ball x r \ S) :
    connectedComponentIn (ball x r \ S) z ∈ localSectors S x r
proof: := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.subset_ball_diff_of_mem_localSectors
statement:
theorem subset_ball_diff_of_mem_localSectors (hN : N ∈ localSectors S x r) :
    N ⊆ ball x r \ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := hN
  exact connectedComponentIn_subset _ _

name: Schoenflies.isConnected_of_mem_localSectors
statement: theorem isConnected_of_mem_localSectors (hN : N ∈ localSectors S x r) : IsConnected N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hN
  exact ⟨⟨z, mem_connectedComponentIn hz⟩, isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn⟩

name: Schoenflies.isOpen_of_mem_localSectors
statement:
theorem isOpen_of_mem_localSectors (h : IsLocalRadius S x r) (hfin : (localDirs S x).Finite)
    (hN : N ∈ localSectors S x r) : IsOpen N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := hN
  exact Plane.isOpen_connectedComponentIn (h.isOpen_ball_diff hfin)

name: Schoenflies.sUnion_localSectors
statement: theorem sUnion_localSectors : ⋃₀ localSectors S x r = ball x r \ S
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ fun w hw => ⟨_, mem_localSectors hw, mem_connectedComponentIn hw⟩
  rintro w ⟨N, hN, hw⟩
  exact subset_ball_diff_of_mem_localSectors hN hw

name: Schoenflies.localSectors_pairwiseDisjoint
statement: theorem localSectors_pairwiseDisjoint : (localSectors S x r).PairwiseDisjoint id
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨z₁, -, rfl⟩ _ ⟨z₂, -, rfl⟩ hne
  simp only [Function.onFun, id]
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro w hw₁ hw₂
  exact hne ((connectedComponentIn_eq hw₁).trans (connectedComponentIn_eq hw₂).symm)

name: Schoenflies.localSectors_finite
statement:
theorem localSectors_finite (h : IsLocalRadius S x r) (hfin : (localDirs S x).Finite) :
    (localSectors S x r).Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsub : (localDirs S x).Subsingleton
  · refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton (ball x r \ S)) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact mem_singleton_iff.2 (subset_antisymm (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _)
      ((h.isConnected_ball_diff_of_subsingleton hsub).isPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn
        hz (subset_refl _)))
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Set.not_subsingleton_iff.1 hsub
    have h2 : ∃ a ∈ localDirs S x, ∃ b ∈ localDirs S x, a ≠ b := ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩
    refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.image
      (fun p : Plane × Plane => Plane.cone x (Plane.arcCCW p.1 p.2) r)
      (Plane.sectorPairs_finite hfin)) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hzp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 ((h.ball_diff_eq_iUnion_cone hfin h2) ▸ hz)
    exact ⟨p, hp, (h.connectedComponentIn_eq_cone hfin h2 (Plane.mem_sectorPairs_iff.1 hp)
      hzp).symm⟩

name: Schoenflies.cone_mem_localSectors
statement:
theorem cone_mem_localSectors (h : IsLocalRadius S x r) (hfin : (localDirs S x).Finite)
    (h2 : ∃ a ∈ localDirs S x, ∃ b ∈ localDirs S x, a ≠ b) {e w : Plane}
    (hp : Plane.IsSectorPair (localDirs S x) e w) :
    Plane.cone x (Plane.arcCCW e w) r ∈ localSectors S x r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (h.isConnected_cone hp).nonempty
  exact ⟨z, h.cone_subset_ball_diff hp hz, h.connectedComponentIn_eq_cone hfin h2 hp hz⟩

name: Schoenflies.localSectors_eq_of_subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hwb, hwS⟩ := h.exists_mem_ball_diff hfin
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact mem_singleton_iff.2 (subset_antisymm (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _)
      ((h.isConnected_ball_diff_of_subsingleton hsub).isPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn
        hz (subset_refl _)))
  · rintro _ rfl
    refine ⟨w, ⟨hwb, hwS⟩, subset_antisymm (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _) ?_⟩
    exact (h.isConnected_ball_diff_of_subsingleton hsub).isPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn
      ⟨hwb, hwS⟩ (subset_refl _)

name: Schoenflies.IsLocalRadius.openSegment_subset_connectedComponentIn
statement:
theorem IsLocalRadius.openSegment_subset_connectedComponentIn (h : IsLocalRadius S x r)
    (hy : y ∈ ball x r) (hyS : y ∉ S) :
    openSegment ℝ x y ⊆ connectedComponentIn (ball x r \ S) y
proof:
:= by
  
  have hTsub : AffineMap.lineMap x y '' Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ ball x r \ S := by
    rintro w ⟨θ, ⟨hθ0, hθ1⟩, rfl⟩
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hθ1 with rfl | hlt
    · rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_one]; exact ⟨hy, hyS⟩
    · exact h.openSegment_subset_ball_diff hy hyS
        (by rw [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap]; exact ⟨θ, ⟨hθ0, hlt⟩, rfl⟩)
  have hconn : IsPreconnected (AffineMap.lineMap x y '' Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
    ((convex_Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1).affine_image (AffineMap.lineMap x y)).isPreconnected
