name: Schoenflies.not_connected_meshGraph_of_fresh_nil
statement:
theorem not_connected_meshGraph_of_fresh_nil {N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (anchors : List Plane) :
    ¬ (meshGraph N [] anchors).Connected
proof:
:= by
  intro hconn
  have hinv : ∀ {u v : Plane}, (meshGraph N [] anchors).Reaches u v →
      Plane.supNorm u = Plane.supNorm v := by
    rintro u v ⟨W, hW⟩
    induction hW with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons hl _ ih => exact (supNorm_eq_of_isLink_of_fresh_nil hN hl).trans ih
  
  have houter : (Plane.mk 1 1 : Plane) ∈ V(meshGraph N [] anchors) :=
    end_mem_vertexSet_meshGraph (R := (Plane.mk 1 1, Plane.mk (-1) 1))
      (outer_ringPieces_mem hN (by simp [ringPieces])) (Or.inl rfl)
  have hinner : (Plane.mk ((N : ℝ)⁻¹) ((N : ℝ)⁻¹) : Plane) ∈ V(meshGraph N [] anchors) :=
    end_mem_vertexSet_meshGraph
      (R := (Plane.mk ((N : ℝ)⁻¹) ((N : ℝ)⁻¹), Plane.mk (-(N : ℝ)⁻¹) ((N : ℝ)⁻¹)))
      (mem_meshSegments.2 (Or.inl ⟨(N : ℝ)⁻¹, inv_mem_meshRadii hN, by simp [ringPieces]⟩))
      (Or.inl rfl)
  have heq := hinv (hconn.reaches houter hinner)
  rw [supNorm_mk, supNorm_mk, abs_one, max_self, abs_of_nonneg (inv_cast_pos hN).le,
    max_self] at heq
  exact absurd heq.symm (ne_of_lt (inv_cast_lt_one hN))

name: Schoenflies.not_isTwoConnected_squareMesh_of_fresh_nil
statement:
theorem not_isTwoConnected_squareMesh_of_fresh_nil (δ : ℝ) (anchors : List Plane) :
    ¬ (squareMesh δ [] anchors).IsTwoConnected

:= fun h =>
  not_connected_meshGraph_of_fresh_nil (two_le_meshCount δ) anchors h.connected

name: Graph.IsPath.append_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem IsPath.append_of_disjoint : ∀ {u v : α} {W₁ : List β}, G.IsPath u W₁ v →
    ∀ {w : α} {W₂ : List β}, G.IsPath v W₂ w →
      (∀ x ∈ G.walkVertices u W₁, x ∈ G.walkVertices v W₂ → x = v) →
      G.IsPath u (W₁ ++ W₂) w
proof:
:= by
  intro u v W₁ h₁
  induction h₁ with
  | nil hx => intro w W₂ h₂ _; simpa using h₂
  | @cons u₀ w₀ v₀ e W hl hW hfresh ih =>
    intro w W₂ h₂ hdisj
    refine IsPath.cons hl (ih h₂ fun x hx hx2 =>
      hdisj x (mem_walkVertices_cons_of_mem hl hx) hx2) ?_
    intro hmem
    rw [walkVertices] at hmem
    simp only [List.append_eq, coveredVertices_append, Set.mem_insert_iff,
      Set.mem_union] at hmem
    rcases hmem with hu | hcov
    · exact hfresh (hu ▸ mem_walkVertices_self)
    rcases hcov with hcov | hcov
    · exact hfresh (mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered hcov)
    · 
      have : u₀ = v₀ :=
        hdisj u₀ mem_walkVertices_self (mem_walkVertices_of_mem_covered hcov)
      exact absurd (IsPath.eq_nil_of_eq (this ▸ IsPath.cons hl hW hfresh)) (by simp)

name: Graph.IsPath.cons_cases
statement:
theorem IsPath.cons_cases {u v : α} {e : β} {W : List β} (h : G.IsPath u (e :: W) v) :
    ∃ w, G.IsLink e u w ∧ G.IsPath w W v ∧ u ∉ G.walkVertices w W
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | cons hl hW hfresh => exact ⟨_, hl, hW, hfresh⟩

name: Schoenflies.walkVertices_subset_of_edges
proof:
:= by
  rcases Graph.mem_walkVertices_iff.1 hx with rfl | ⟨Q, hQ, hinc⟩
  · exact hu
  · obtain ⟨y, -, hends⟩ := hinc
    rcases hends with ⟨rfl, -⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩
    exacts [hW Q hQ (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _), hW Q hQ (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _)]

name: Schoenflies.edgesCover_eq_seg
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hzQ⟩ := Graph.mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hz
    rw [edgeArc_segmentDrawing] at hzQ
    exact ((hW Q).1 hQ).2 hzQ
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hzQ, hsub⟩ := subdivide_covers_source points pieces P hP z hz
    refine Graph.mem_edgesCover ((hW (orientPiece Q)).2
      ⟨mem_overlayPieces.2 ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩, by rwa [orientPiece_seg]⟩) ?_
    rw [edgeArc_segmentDrawing, orientPiece_seg]
    exact hzQ

name: Schoenflies.mem_sideB
statement: theorem mem_sideB {x : Plane} (h : x ∈ sideB.seg) : x 1 = -1
proof: := (mem_segment_horiz.1 h).1

name: Schoenflies.mem_sideL
statement: theorem mem_sideL {x : Plane} (h : x ∈ sideL.seg) : x 0 = -1
proof: := (mem_segment_vert.1 h).1

name: Schoenflies.mem_sideR
statement: theorem mem_sideR {x : Plane} (h : x ∈ sideR.seg) : x 0 = 1
proof: := (mem_segment_vert.1 h).1

name: Schoenflies.sideT_inter_sideL
statement:
theorem sideT_inter_sideL {x : Plane} (h : x ∈ sideT.seg) (h' : x ∈ sideL.seg) :
    x = Plane.mk (-1) 1
proof:
:=
  plane_eq_of_coords (by rw [mem_sideL h', Plane.mk_zero]) (by rw [mem_sideT h, Plane.mk_one])

name: Schoenflies.sideL_inter_sideB
statement:
theorem sideL_inter_sideB {x : Plane} (h : x ∈ sideL.seg) (h' : x ∈ sideB.seg) :
    x = Plane.mk (-1) (-1)
proof:
:=
  plane_eq_of_coords (by rw [mem_sideL h, Plane.mk_zero]) (by rw [mem_sideB h', Plane.mk_one])

name: Schoenflies.sideB_inter_sideR
statement:
theorem sideB_inter_sideR {x : Plane} (h : x ∈ sideB.seg) (h' : x ∈ sideR.seg) :
    x = Plane.mk 1 (-1)
proof:
:=
  plane_eq_of_coords (by rw [mem_sideR h', Plane.mk_zero]) (by rw [mem_sideB h, Plane.mk_one])

name: Schoenflies.sideT_inter_sideR
statement:
theorem sideT_inter_sideR {x : Plane} (h : x ∈ sideT.seg) (h' : x ∈ sideR.seg) :
    x = Plane.mk 1 1
proof:
:=
  plane_eq_of_coords (by rw [mem_sideR h', Plane.mk_zero]) (by rw [mem_sideT h, Plane.mk_one])

name: Schoenflies.sideT_disjoint_sideB
statement: theorem sideT_disjoint_sideB {x : Plane} (h : x ∈ sideT.seg) (h' : x ∈ sideB.seg) : False
proof:
:= by
  have := (mem_sideT h).symm.trans (mem_sideB h'); norm_num at this

name: Schoenflies.sideL_disjoint_sideR
statement: theorem sideL_disjoint_sideR {x : Plane} (h : x ∈ sideL.seg) (h' : x ∈ sideR.seg) : False
proof:
:= by
  have := (mem_sideL h).symm.trans (mem_sideR h'); norm_num at this

name: Schoenflies.sides_cover
statement: theorem sides_cover : sideT.seg ∪ sideL.seg ∪ sideB.seg ∪ sideR.seg = modelCurve
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ringSet_one, ← cover_ringPieces zero_le_one]
  simp only [ringPieces, cover_cons, cover_nil, Set.union_empty, sideT, sideL, sideB, sideR]
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_union]
  tauto

name: Schoenflies.side_seg_subset_modelCurve
statement:
theorem side_seg_subset_modelCurve {P : Piece}
    (h : P = sideT ∨ P = sideL ∨ P = sideB ∨ P = sideR) : P.seg ⊆ modelCurve
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sides_cover]
  rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  exacts [fun x hx => Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl hx)), fun x hx => Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr hx)),
    fun x hx => Or.inl (Or.inr hx), fun x hx => Or.inr hx]

name: Schoenflies.meshGraph_outer_cycle
statement:
theorem meshGraph_outer_cycle {N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) {fresh : List Plane}
    (hfresh : ∀ z ∈ fresh, z ∈ modelCurve) (anchors : List Plane)
    (hsub : SubdividesToPath (meshSegments N fresh) (meshPoints N fresh anchors)) :
    ∃ (e : Piece) (u v x : Plane) (D : List Piece),
      (meshGraph N fresh anchors).IsLongCycle e u v D x ∧
        (∀ Q ∈ e :: D, Q.seg ⊆ modelCurve) ∧
        Graph.edgesCover segmentDrawing (e :: D) = modelCurve
proof:
:= by
  have hmemT := outer_ringPieces_mem (fresh := fresh) hN sideT_mem_ringPieces
  have hmemL := outer_ringPieces_mem (fresh := fresh) hN sideL_mem_ringPieces
  have hmemB := outer_ringPieces_mem (fresh := fresh) hN sideB_mem_ringPieces
  have hmemR := outer_ringPieces_mem (fresh := fresh) hN sideR_mem_ringPieces
  obtain ⟨WT, hpT, hcT⟩ := hsub _ hmemT (ringPieces_nondeg one_pos _ sideT_mem_ringPieces)
  obtain ⟨WL, hpL, hcL⟩ := hsub _ hmemL (ringPieces_nondeg one_pos _ sideL_mem_ringPieces)
  obtain ⟨WB, hpB, hcB⟩ := hsub _ hmemB (ringPieces_nondeg one_pos _ sideB_mem_ringPieces)
  obtain ⟨WR, hpR, hcR⟩ := hsub _ hmemR (ringPieces_nondeg one_pos _ sideR_mem_ringPieces)
  have hsegT : ∀ Q ∈ WT, Q.seg ⊆ sideT.seg := fun Q hQ => ((hcT Q).1 hQ).2
  have hsegL : ∀ Q ∈ WL, Q.seg ⊆ sideL.seg := fun Q hQ => ((hcL Q).1 hQ).2
  have hsegB : ∀ Q ∈ WB, Q.seg ⊆ sideB.seg := fun Q hQ => ((hcB Q).1 hQ).2
  have hsegR : ∀ Q ∈ WR, Q.seg ⊆ sideR.seg := fun Q hQ => ((hcR Q).1 hQ).2
  
  have hVT : ∀ x ∈ (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh)
      (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).walkVertices sideT.1 WT, x ∈ sideT.seg := fun x hx =>
    walkVertices_subset_of_edges (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _) hsegT hx
  have hVL : ∀ x ∈ (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh)
      (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).walkVertices sideL.1 WL, x ∈ sideL.seg := fun x hx =>
    walkVertices_subset_of_edges (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _) hsegL hx
  have hVB : ∀ x ∈ (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh)
      (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).walkVertices sideB.1 WB, x ∈ sideB.seg := fun x hx =>
    walkVertices_subset_of_edges (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _) hsegB hx
  
  have hp1 : (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh) (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).IsPath
      sideT.1 (WT ++ WL) sideL.2 :=
    hpT.append_of_disjoint hpL fun x hx hx2 => sideT_inter_sideL (hVT x hx) (hVL x hx2)
  have hV1 : ∀ x ∈ (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh) (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).walkVertices
      sideT.1 (WT ++ WL), x ∈ sideT.seg ∪ sideL.seg := by
    refine fun x hx => walkVertices_subset_of_edges (Or.inl (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      (fun Q hQ => ?_) hx
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hQ with h | h
    exacts [(hsegT Q h).trans Set.subset_union_left, (hsegL Q h).trans Set.subset_union_right]
  
  have hp2 : (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh) (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).IsPath
      sideT.1 ((WT ++ WL) ++ WB) sideB.2 := by
    refine hp1.append_of_disjoint hpB fun x hx hx2 => ?_
    rcases hV1 x hx with h | h
    · exact absurd (sideT_disjoint_sideB h (hVB x hx2)) not_false
    · exact sideL_inter_sideB h (hVB x hx2)
  have hV2 : ∀ x ∈ (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh) (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).walkVertices
      sideT.1 ((WT ++ WL) ++ WB), x ∈ sideT.seg ∪ sideL.seg ∪ sideB.seg := by
    refine fun x hx => walkVertices_subset_of_edges
      (Or.inl (Or.inl (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _))) (fun Q hQ => ?_) hx
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hQ with h | h
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 h with h' | h'
      exacts [(hsegT Q h').trans (Set.subset_union_left.trans Set.subset_union_left),
        (hsegL Q h').trans (Set.subset_union_right.trans Set.subset_union_left)]
    · exact (hsegB Q h).trans Set.subset_union_right
  
  have hRne : sideR.1 ≠ sideR.2 := ringPieces_nondeg one_pos _ sideR_mem_ringPieces
  have hWRne : WR ≠ [] := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hRne hpR.isWalk.eq_of_nil
  obtain ⟨eR, L, hL⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil
    (show WR.reverse ≠ [] by simpa using hWRne)
  have hpRrev := hpR.reverse
  rw [hL] at hpRrev
  obtain ⟨w, hlink, htail, hfr⟩ := hpRrev.cons_cases
  have heRmem : eR ∈ WR := by
    rw [← List.mem_reverse, hL]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  have hLmem : ∀ Q ∈ L, Q ∈ WR := fun Q hQ => by
    rw [← List.mem_reverse, hL]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hQ
  have hwR : w ∈ sideR.seg := by
    rcases hlink.2 with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    exacts [hsegR eR heRmem (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _),
      hsegR eR heRmem (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)]
  have hVRtail : ∀ x ∈ (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh)
      (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).walkVertices w L, x ∈ sideR.seg := fun x hx =>
    walkVertices_subset_of_edges hwR (fun Q hQ => hsegR Q (hLmem Q hQ)) hx
  have hrevV : (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh)
        (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).walkVertices sideB.2 L.reverse
      = (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh) (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).walkVertices w L :=
    htail.isWalk.reverse_walkVertices
  
  have hp3 : (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh) (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).IsPath
      sideT.1 (((WT ++ WL) ++ WB) ++ L.reverse) w := by
    refine hp2.append_of_disjoint htail.reverse fun x hx hx2 => ?_
    rw [hrevV] at hx2
    have hxR : x ∈ sideR.seg := hVRtail x hx2
    rcases hV2 x hx with (h | h) | h
    · refine absurd (show sideR.2 ∈ (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh)
        (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).walkVertices w L from ?_) hfr
      rwa [show sideR.2 = x from (sideT_inter_sideR h hxR).symm]
    · exact absurd (sideL_disjoint_sideR h hxR) not_false
    · exact sideB_inter_sideR h hxR
  
  have hnondegR : eR.Nondeg :=
    meshGraph_edge_nondeg (anchors := anchors) hN hfresh ((hcR eR).1 heRmem).1
  have hnotT : eR ∉ WT := fun hmem => hnondegR (by
    have h1 := sideT_inter_sideR (hsegT eR hmem (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      (hsegR eR heRmem (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
    have h2 := sideT_inter_sideR (hsegT eR hmem (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      (hsegR eR heRmem (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
    exact h1.trans h2.symm)
  have hnotL : eR ∉ WL := fun hmem =>
    sideL_disjoint_sideR (hsegL eR hmem (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      (hsegR eR heRmem (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
  have hnotB : eR ∉ WB := fun hmem => hnondegR (by
    have h1 := sideB_inter_sideR (hsegB eR hmem (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      (hsegR eR heRmem (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
    have h2 := sideB_inter_sideR (hsegB eR hmem (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
      (hsegR eR heRmem (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _))
    exact h1.trans h2.symm)
  have hnotLrev : eR ∉ L.reverse := by
    have hnodup : (eR :: L).Nodup := hL ▸ hpR.reverse.nodup
    rw [List.mem_reverse]
    exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnodup).1
  have hnotD : eR ∉ ((WT ++ WL) ++ WB) ++ L.reverse := by
    intro hmem
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hmem with h | h
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 h with h' | h'
      · rcases List.mem_append.1 h' with h'' | h''
        exacts [hnotT h'', hnotL h'']
      · exact hnotB h'
    · exact hnotLrev h
  
  have hmT : sideT.seg ⊆ modelCurve := side_seg_subset_modelCurve (Or.inl rfl)
  have hmL : sideL.seg ⊆ modelCurve := side_seg_subset_modelCurve (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
  have hmB : sideB.seg ⊆ modelCurve := side_seg_subset_modelCurve (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))
  have hmR : sideR.seg ⊆ modelCurve := side_seg_subset_modelCurve (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)))
  have hsegsAll : ∀ Q ∈ eR :: (((WT ++ WL) ++ WB) ++ L.reverse), Q.seg ⊆ modelCurve := by
    intro Q hQ
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hQ with rfl | h
    · exact (hsegR Q heRmem).trans hmR
    rcases List.mem_append.1 h with h' | h'
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 h' with h'' | h''
      · rcases List.mem_append.1 h'' with h3 | h3
        exacts [(hsegT Q h3).trans hmT, (hsegL Q h3).trans hmL]
      · exact (hsegB Q h'').trans hmB
    · exact (hsegR Q (hLmem Q (List.mem_reverse.1 h'))).trans hmR
  
  have hthird : sideT.2 ∈ (overlayGraph (meshSegments N fresh)
      (meshPoints N fresh anchors)).walkVertices sideT.1 (((WT ++ WL) ++ WB) ++ L.reverse) :=
    Graph.walkVertices_mono
      (List.Subset.trans (List.subset_append_left _ _)
        (List.Subset.trans (List.subset_append_left _ _) (List.subset_append_left _ _)))
      hpT.isWalk.target_mem_walkVertices
  have hne₁ : sideT.2 ≠ sideT.1 := mk_ne_mk_of_fst (by norm_num)
  have hne₂ : sideT.2 ≠ w := by
    intro h
    have := mem_sideR (h ▸ hwR)
    rw [sideT, Plane.mk_zero] at this
    norm_num at this
  refine ⟨eR, sideT.1, w, sideT.2, ((WT ++ WL) ++ WB) ++ L.reverse,
    ⟨⟨hlink, hp3, hnotD⟩, hthird, hne₁, hne₂⟩, hsegsAll, ?_⟩
  have hcovT : Graph.edgesCover segmentDrawing WT = sideT.seg := edgesCover_eq_seg hmemT hcT
  have hcovL : Graph.edgesCover segmentDrawing WL = sideL.seg := edgesCover_eq_seg hmemL hcL
  have hcovB : Graph.edgesCover segmentDrawing WB = sideB.seg := edgesCover_eq_seg hmemB hcB
  have hcovR : Graph.edgesCover segmentDrawing WR = sideR.seg := edgesCover_eq_seg hmemR hcR
  refine subset_antisymm (fun z hz => ?_) (fun z hz => ?_)
  · obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hzQ⟩ := Graph.mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hz
    rw [edgeArc_segmentDrawing] at hzQ
    exact hsegsAll Q hQ hzQ
  · rw [← sides_cover] at hz
    rcases hz with ((hz | hz) | hz) | hz
    · rw [← hcovT] at hz
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hzQ⟩ := Graph.mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hz
      exact Graph.mem_edgesCover (List.mem_cons_of_mem _
        (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ hQ)))) hzQ
    · rw [← hcovL] at hz
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hzQ⟩ := Graph.mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hz
      exact Graph.mem_edgesCover (List.mem_cons_of_mem _
        (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_right _ hQ)))) hzQ
    · rw [← hcovB] at hz
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hzQ⟩ := Graph.mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hz
      exact Graph.mem_edgesCover (List.mem_cons_of_mem _
        (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_right _ hQ))) hzQ
    · rw [← hcovR] at hz
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hzQ⟩ := Graph.mem_edgesCover_iff.1 hz
      rw [← List.mem_reverse, hL] at hQ
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hQ with rfl | hQ'
      · exact Graph.mem_edgesCover List.mem_cons_self hzQ
      · exact Graph.mem_edgesCover (List.mem_cons_of_mem _
          (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_reverse.2 hQ'))) hzQ

name: Schoenflies.squareMesh_outer_cycle_of_subdividesToPath
statement:
theorem squareMesh_outer_cycle_of_subdividesToPath {fresh : List Plane}
    (hfresh : ∀ z ∈ fresh, z ∈ modelCurve)
    (δ : ℝ) (anchors : List Plane)
    (hsub : SubdividesToPath (meshSegments (meshCount δ) fresh)
      (meshPoints (meshCount δ) fresh anchors)) :
    ∃ (e : Piece) (u v x : Plane) (D : List Piece),
      (squareMesh δ fresh anchors).IsLongCycle e u v D x ∧
        (∀ Q ∈ e :: D, Q.seg ⊆ modelCurve) ∧
        Graph.edgesCover segmentDrawing (e :: D) = modelCurve
proof:
:=
  meshGraph_outer_cycle (two_le_meshCount δ) hfresh anchors hsub

name: Schoenflies.squareMesh_outer_cycleGraph_isTwoConnected_of_subdividesToPath
statement:
theorem squareMesh_outer_cycleGraph_isTwoConnected_of_subdividesToPath {fresh : List Plane}
    (hfresh : ∀ z ∈ fresh, z ∈ modelCurve) (δ : ℝ) (anchors : List Plane)
    (hsub : SubdividesToPath (meshSegments (meshCount δ) fresh)
      (meshPoints (meshCount δ) fresh anchors)) :
    ∃ (e : Piece) (u : Plane) (D : List Piece),
      ((squareMesh δ fresh anchors).cycleGraph u e D).IsTwoConnected ∧
        Graph.edgesCover segmentDrawing (e :: D) = modelCurve
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, u, v, x, D, hlc, -, hcov⟩ :=
    squareMesh_outer_cycle_of_subdividesToPath hfresh δ anchors hsub
  exact ⟨e, u, D, Graph.IsLongCycle.isTwoConnected hlc, hcov⟩

name: Schoenflies.Plane.continuous_tent
statement: theorem continuous_tent (r p : ℝ) : Continuous (tent r p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tent; fun_prop

name: Schoenflies.Plane.pos_of_lt_lt
statement: theorem pos_of_lt_lt (h₁ : -r < p) (h₂ : p < r) : 0 < r
proof: := by linarith

name: Schoenflies.Plane.tent_le_one
statement: theorem tent_le_one (h₁ : -r < p) (h₂ : p < r) (u : ℝ) : tent r p u ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total u p with h | h
  · exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (by rw [div_le_one (by linarith)]; linarith)
  · exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (by rw [div_le_one (by linarith)]; linarith)

name: Schoenflies.Plane.tent_nonneg
statement:
theorem tent_nonneg (h₁ : -r < p) (h₂ : p < r) (hu : -r ≤ u) (hu' : u ≤ r) :
    0 ≤ tent r p u
proof:
:=
  le_min (div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))

name: Schoenflies.Plane.tent_self
statement: @[simp] theorem tent_self (h₁ : -r < p) (h₂ : p < r) : tent r p p = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tent, div_self (by linarith), div_self (by linarith), min_self]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.tent_left
statement: theorem tent_left (h₁ : -r < p) (h₂ : p < r) : tent r p (-r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < r := pos_of_lt_lt h₁ h₂
  rw [tent, show -r + r = 0 by ring, zero_div]
  exact min_eq_left (div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))

name: Schoenflies.Plane.tent_right
statement: theorem tent_right (h₁ : -r < p) (h₂ : p < r) : tent r p r = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < r := pos_of_lt_lt h₁ h₂
  rw [tent, show r - r = 0 by ring, zero_div]
  exact min_eq_right (div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))

name: Schoenflies.Plane.bend_of_le
statement: theorem bend_of_le (h : u ≤ p) : bend r p q u = -r + (u + r) * (q + r) / (p + r)
proof: := if_pos h

name: Schoenflies.Plane.bend_of_gt
statement: theorem bend_of_gt (h : p < u) : bend r p q u = r - (r - u) * (r - q) / (r - p)
proof:
:=
  if_neg (not_le.2 h)

name: Schoenflies.Plane.bend_left
statement: theorem bend_left (h : -r ≤ p) : bend r p q (-r) = -r
proof:
:= by
  rw [bend_of_le h]; simp

name: Schoenflies.Plane.bend_right
statement: theorem bend_right (h : p < r) : bend r p q r = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [bend_of_gt h]; simp

name: Schoenflies.Plane.bend_self
statement: theorem bend_self (h : -r < p) : bend r p q p = q
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p + r ≠ 0 := by linarith
  rw [bend_of_le le_rfl, mul_comm, mul_div_assoc, div_self hp, mul_one]; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.bend_refl
statement: theorem bend_refl (h₁ : -r < p) (h₂ : p < r) (u : ℝ) : bend r p p u = u
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt u p with h | h
  · rw [bend_of_le h, mul_div_assoc, div_self (by linarith : p + r ≠ 0), mul_one]; ring
  · rw [bend_of_gt h, mul_div_assoc, div_self (by linarith : r - p ≠ 0), mul_one]; ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.bend_le_of_le
statement: theorem bend_le_of_le (h₁ : -r < p) (h₂ : -r < q) (h : u ≤ p) : bend r p q u ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [bend_of_le h]
  have : (u + r) * (q + r) / (p + r) ≤ q + r := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    nlinarith
  linarith

name: Schoenflies.Plane.lt_bend_of_lt
statement: theorem lt_bend_of_lt (h₁ : p < r) (h₂ : q < r) (h : p < u) : q < bend r p q u
proof:
:= by
  rw [bend_of_gt h]
  have : (r - u) * (r - q) / (r - p) < r - q := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    nlinarith
  linarith

name: Schoenflies.Plane.bend_mem
statement:
theorem bend_mem (h₁ : -r < p) (h₂ : p < r) (h₃ : -r < q) (h₄ : q < r) (hu : -r ≤ u)
    (hu' : u ≤ r) : -r ≤ bend r p q u ∧ bend r p q u ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt u p with h | h
  · refine ⟨?_, le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (bend_le_of_le h₁ h₃ h) h₄)⟩
    rw [bend_of_le h]
    have : 0 ≤ (u + r) * (q + r) / (p + r) := div_nonneg (by nlinarith) (by linarith)
    linarith
  · refine ⟨le_of_lt (lt_trans h₃ (lt_bend_of_lt h₂ h₄ h)), ?_⟩
    rw [bend_of_gt h]
    have : 0 ≤ (r - u) * (r - q) / (r - p) := div_nonneg (by nlinarith) (by linarith)
    linarith

name: Schoenflies.Plane.bend_bend
statement:
theorem bend_bend (h₁ : -r < p) (h₂ : p < r) (h₃ : -r < q) (h₄ : q < r) (u : ℝ) :
    bend r q p (bend r p q u) = u
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt u p with h | h
  · have hp : p + r ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hq : q + r ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [bend_of_le (bend_le_of_le h₁ h₃ h), bend_of_le h]
    field_simp
    ring
  · have hp : r - p ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hq : r - q ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [bend_of_gt (lt_bend_of_lt h₂ h₄ h), bend_of_gt h]
    field_simp
    ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.bend_eq_right
statement:
theorem bend_eq_right (h₁ : p + r ≠ 0) (h₂ : r - p ≠ 0) (h : p ≤ u) :
    bend r p q u = r - (r - u) * (r - q) / (r - p)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h with rfl | h'
  · rw [bend_of_le le_rfl]
    field_simp
    ring
  · exact bend_of_gt h'

name: Schoenflies.Plane.continuousOn_bend
statement:
theorem continuousOn_bend (r : ℝ) {s : Set Plane} {P Q U : Plane → ℝ} (hs : IsClosed s)
    (hP : Continuous P) (hQ : Continuous Q) (hU : Continuous U)
    (h1 : ∀ z ∈ s, P z + r ≠ 0) (h2 : ∀ z ∈ s, r - P z ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousOn (fun z => bend r (P z) (Q z) (U z)) s
proof:
:= by
  have hcover : s = (s ∩ {z | U z ≤ P z}) ∪ (s ∩ {z | P z ≤ U z}) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases le_total (U z) (P z) with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hz, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hz, h⟩
    · rintro (⟨hz, _⟩ | ⟨hz, _⟩) <;> exact hz
  rw [hcover]
  refine (continuousOn_union_iff_of_isClosed (hs.inter (isClosed_le hU hP))
    (hs.inter (isClosed_le hP hU))).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ContinuousOn.congr (f := fun z => -r + (U z + r) * (Q z + r) / (P z + r)) ?_ ?_
    · exact continuousOn_const.add
        (((hU.continuousOn.add continuousOn_const).mul
          (hQ.continuousOn.add continuousOn_const)).div
            (hP.continuousOn.add continuousOn_const) fun z hz => h1 z hz.1)
    · exact fun z hz => bend_of_le hz.2
  · refine ContinuousOn.congr (f := fun z => r - (r - U z) * (r - Q z) / (r - P z)) ?_ ?_
    · exact continuousOn_const.sub
        (((continuousOn_const.sub hU.continuousOn).mul
          (continuousOn_const.sub hQ.continuousOn)).div
            (continuousOn_const.sub hP.continuousOn) fun z hz => h2 z hz.1)
    · exact fun z hz => bend_eq_right (h1 z hz.1) (h2 z hz.1) hz.2

name: Schoenflies.Plane.abs_sub_le_supDist
statement: theorem abs_sub_le_supDist (z c : Plane) (l : Fin 2) : |z l - c l| ≤ supDist z c
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases l
  · exact abs_sub_zero_le_supDist z c
  · exact abs_sub_one_le_supDist z c

name: Schoenflies.Plane.supDist_le_of_forall
statement:
theorem supDist_le_of_forall {z c : Plane} {r : ℝ} (h : ∀ l : Fin 2, |z l - c l| ≤ r) :
    supDist z c ≤ r
proof:
:=
  max_le (h 0) (h 1)

name: Schoenflies.Plane.exists_abs_sub_eq_of_supDist_eq
statement:
theorem exists_abs_sub_eq_of_supDist_eq {z c : Plane} {r : ℝ} (h : supDist z c = r) :
    ∃ l : Fin 2, |z l - c l| = r
proof:
:= by
  rcases max_choice |z 0 - c 0| |z 1 - c 1| with hm | hm
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [← h]; exact hm.symm⟩
  · exact ⟨1, by rw [← h]; exact hm.symm⟩

name: Schoenflies.Plane.abs_sub_lt_of_mem_openSquare
statement:
theorem abs_sub_lt_of_mem_openSquare {z c : Plane} {r : ℝ} (hz : z ∈ openSquare c r)
    (l : Fin 2) : |z l - c l| < r
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_sub_le_supDist z c l) hz

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_Ioo_of_mem_openSquare
statement:
theorem mem_Ioo_of_mem_openSquare {z c : Plane} {r : ℝ} (hz : z ∈ openSquare c r) (l : Fin 2) :
    z l - c l ∈ Ioo (-r) r
proof:
:= by
  have := abs_sub_lt_of_mem_openSquare hz l
  rw [abs_lt] at this
  exact ⟨this.1, this.2⟩

name: Schoenflies.Plane.fin2_eq_of_ne_of_ne
statement: theorem fin2_eq_of_ne_of_ne {i j l : Fin 2} (h₁ : j ≠ i) (h₂ : l ≠ i) : l = j
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases l <;> simp_all

name: Schoenflies.Plane.IsShear.inv
statement:
theorem IsShear.inv (h : IsShear r a b k k') : IsShear r a b (k + k') (-k') where
  peak
proof:
:= h.peak
  base := h.base
  mid := h.top
  top := by rw [show k + k' + -k' = k by ring]; exact h.mid

name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_apply_same
statement:
theorem shear_apply_same :
    shear c r a b k k' i j z i =
      c i + bend r (a + k * shearWeight c r b j z) (a + (k + k') * shearWeight c r b j z)
        (z i - c i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shear, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    if_true, mul_one]
  ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_apply_ne
statement: theorem shear_apply_ne (h : l ≠ i) : shear c r a b k k' i j z l = z l
proof:
:= by
  simp [shear, h]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_Ioo_of_weight
statement:
theorem mem_Ioo_of_weight {w : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Ioo (-r) r) (hak : a + k ∈ Ioo (-r) r)
    (hw : w ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : a + k * w ∈ Ioo (-r) r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hak
  obtain ⟨h5, h6⟩ := hw
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h5 with rfl | hw0
  · simpa using ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_pos hw0 (show (0:ℝ) < a + k + r by linarith),
        mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - w by linarith) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ a + r by linarith)]
    · nlinarith [mul_pos hw0 (show (0:ℝ) < r - a - k by linarith),
        mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - w by linarith) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ r - a by linarith)]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.shearWeight_mem
statement:
theorem shearWeight_mem (h : IsShear r a b k k') (hz : z ∈ closedSquare c r) :
    shearWeight c r b j z ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hb := abs_sub_le_supDist z c j
  have : |z j - c j| ≤ r := le_trans hb hz
  rw [abs_le] at this
  exact ⟨tent_nonneg h.peak.1 h.peak.2 this.1 this.2, tent_le_one h.peak.1 h.peak.2 _⟩

name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_mid_mem
statement:
theorem shear_mid_mem (h : IsShear r a b k k') (hz : z ∈ closedSquare c r) :
    a + k * shearWeight c r b j z ∈ Ioo (-r) r
proof:
:=
  mem_Ioo_of_weight h.base h.mid (shearWeight_mem h hz)

name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_top_mem
statement:
theorem shear_top_mem (h : IsShear r a b k k') (hz : z ∈ closedSquare c r) :
    a + (k + k') * shearWeight c r b j z ∈ Ioo (-r) r
proof:
:=
  mem_Ioo_of_weight h.base h.top (shearWeight_mem h hz)

name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_mapsTo
statement:
theorem shear_mapsTo (h : IsShear r a b k k') (i j : Fin 2) :
    MapsTo (shear c r a b k k' i j) (closedSquare c r) (closedSquare c r)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  refine supDist_le_of_forall fun l => ?_
  by_cases hl : l = i
  · subst hl
    rw [shear_apply_same]
    have hu : |z l - c l| ≤ r := le_trans (abs_sub_le_supDist z c l) hz
    rw [abs_le] at hu
    have := bend_mem (shear_mid_mem (j := j) h hz).1 (shear_mid_mem (j := j) h hz).2
      (shear_top_mem (j := j) h hz).1 (shear_top_mem (j := j) h hz).2 hu.1 hu.2
    rw [show c l + bend r (a + k * shearWeight c r b j z)
      (a + (k + k') * shearWeight c r b j z) (z l - c l) - c l
      = bend r (a + k * shearWeight c r b j z)
        (a + (k + k') * shearWeight c r b j z) (z l - c l) by ring, abs_le]
    exact this
  · rw [shear_apply_ne hl]
    exact le_trans (abs_sub_le_supDist z c l) hz

name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_shear
statement:
theorem shear_shear (h : IsShear r a b k k') (hij : j ≠ i) (hz : z ∈ closedSquare c r) :
    shear c r a b (k + k') (-k') i j (shear c r a b k k' i j z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have hweight : shearWeight c r b j (shear c r a b k k' i j z) = shearWeight c r b j z := by
    rw [shearWeight, shearWeight, shear_apply_ne hij]
  ext l
  by_cases hl : l = i
  · subst hl
    rw [shear_apply_same, hweight, shear_apply_same, show
      c l + bend r (a + k * shearWeight c r b j z) (a + (k + k') * shearWeight c r b j z)
        (z l - c l) - c l
      = bend r (a + k * shearWeight c r b j z) (a + (k + k') * shearWeight c r b j z)
        (z l - c l) by ring, show k + k' + -k' = k by ring]
    rw [bend_bend (shear_mid_mem (j := j) h hz).1 (shear_mid_mem (j := j) h hz).2
      (shear_top_mem (j := j) h hz).1 (shear_top_mem (j := j) h hz).2]
    ring
  · rw [shear_apply_ne hl, shear_apply_ne hl]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_eq_self_of_boundary
statement:
theorem shear_eq_self_of_boundary (h : IsShear r a b k k') (hij : j ≠ i)
    (hz : z ∈ closedSquare c r) (hbd : supDist z c = r) : shear c r a b k k' i j z = z
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < r := pos_of_lt_lt h.peak.1 h.peak.2
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_abs_sub_eq_of_supDist_eq hbd
  ext l
  by_cases hl : l = i
  · subst hl
    rw [shear_apply_same]
    by_cases hml : m = l
    · 
      subst hml
      rcases (abs_eq hr.le).1 hm with he | he
      · rw [he, bend_right (shear_mid_mem (j := j) h hz).2]
        linarith
      · rw [he, bend_left (shear_mid_mem (j := j) h hz).1.le]
        linarith
    · 
      have hmj : m = j := fin2_eq_of_ne_of_ne hij hml
      subst hmj
      have hw : shearWeight c r b m z = 0 := by
        rcases (abs_eq hr.le).1 hm with he | he
        · rw [shearWeight, he]; exact tent_right h.peak.1 h.peak.2
        · rw [shearWeight, show z m - c m = -r by linarith [he]]
          exact tent_left h.peak.1 h.peak.2
      rw [hw]
      simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
      rw [bend_refl h.base.1 h.base.2]
      ring
  · rw [shear_apply_ne hl]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_continuousOn
statement:
theorem shear_continuousOn (h : IsShear r a b k k') (i j : Fin 2) :
    ContinuousOn (shear c r a b k k' i j) (closedSquare c r)
proof:
:= by
  have hW : Continuous fun z : Plane => shearWeight c r b j z :=
    (continuous_tent r b).comp ((continuous_coord j).sub continuous_const)
  have hU : Continuous fun z : Plane => z i - c i := (continuous_coord i).sub continuous_const
  have hP : Continuous fun z : Plane => a + k * shearWeight c r b j z :=
    continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul hW)
  have hQ : Continuous fun z : Plane => a + (k + k') * shearWeight c r b j z :=
    continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul hW)
  have hbend := continuousOn_bend r (s := closedSquare c r) (isClosed_closedSquare c r) hP hQ hU
    (fun z hz => by linarith [(shear_mid_mem (j := j) h hz).1])
    (fun z hz => by linarith [(shear_mid_mem (j := j) h hz).2])
  exact continuous_id.continuousOn.add ((hbend.sub hU.continuousOn).smul continuousOn_const)

name: Schoenflies.Plane.IsSquareMover.symm
statement:
theorem symm (h : IsSquareMover c r M N) : IsSquareMover c r N M where
  mapsTo
proof:
:= h.mapsTo_inv
  mapsTo_inv := h.mapsTo
  continuousOn := h.continuousOn_inv
  continuousOn_inv := h.continuousOn
  invOn := h.invOn.symm
  fixes := h.fixes_inv
  fixes_inv := h.fixes

name: Schoenflies.Plane.IsSquareMover.bijOn
statement:
theorem bijOn (h : IsSquareMover c r M N) :
    BijOn M (closedSquare c r) (closedSquare c r)
proof:
:=
  h.invOn.bijOn h.mapsTo h.mapsTo_inv

name: Schoenflies.Plane.IsSquareMover.image_eq
statement:
theorem image_eq (h : IsSquareMover c r M N) :
    M '' closedSquare c r = closedSquare c r
proof: := h.bijOn.image_eq

name: Schoenflies.Plane.IsSquareMover.comp
statement:
theorem comp (h : IsSquareMover c r M N) (h' : IsSquareMover c r M' N') :
    IsSquareMover c r (M' ∘ M) (N ∘ N') where
  mapsTo
proof:
:= h'.mapsTo.comp h.mapsTo
  mapsTo_inv := h.mapsTo_inv.comp h'.mapsTo_inv
  continuousOn := h'.continuousOn.comp h.continuousOn h.mapsTo
  continuousOn_inv := h.continuousOn_inv.comp h'.continuousOn_inv h'.mapsTo_inv
  invOn := by
    constructor
    · intro z hz
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [h'.invOn.1 (h.mapsTo hz), h.invOn.1 hz]
    · intro z hz
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [h.invOn.2 (h'.mapsTo_inv hz), h'.invOn.2 hz]
  fixes := fun z hz hbd => by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, h.fixes z hz hbd, h'.fixes z hz hbd]
  fixes_inv := fun z hz hbd => by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, h'.fixes_inv z hz hbd, h.fixes_inv z hz hbd]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.isSquareMover_shear
statement:
theorem isSquareMover_shear (h : IsShear r a b k k') (hij : j ≠ i) :
    IsSquareMover c r (shear c r a b k k' i j) (shear c r a b (k + k') (-k') i j) where
  mapsTo
proof:
:= shear_mapsTo h i j
  mapsTo_inv := shear_mapsTo h.inv i j
  continuousOn := shear_continuousOn h i j
  continuousOn_inv := shear_continuousOn h.inv i j
  invOn := by
    refine ⟨fun z hz => shear_shear h hij hz, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hz' := shear_shear h.inv hij hz
    rwa [show k + k' + -k' = k by ring, neg_neg] at hz'
  fixes := fun z hz hbd => shear_eq_self_of_boundary h hij hz hbd
  fixes_inv := fun z hz hbd => shear_eq_self_of_boundary h.inv hij hz hbd

name: Schoenflies.Plane.exists_squareMover
statement:
theorem exists_squareMover {c x y : Plane} {r : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ openSquare c r)
    (hy : y ∈ openSquare c r) :
    ∃ M N : Plane → Plane, IsSquareMover c r M N ∧ M x = y ∧ N y = x
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 := mem_Ioo_of_mem_openSquare hx 0
  have hx1 := mem_Ioo_of_mem_openSquare hx 1
  have hy0 := mem_Ioo_of_mem_openSquare hy 0
  have hy1 := mem_Ioo_of_mem_openSquare hy 1
  have hne : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 := by decide
  have hne' : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 := by decide
  
  have h₁ : IsShear r (x 0 - c 0) (x 1 - c 1) 0 (y 0 - x 0) := by
    refine ⟨hx1, hx0, by simpa using hx0, ?_⟩
    rw [show x 0 - c 0 + (0 + (y 0 - x 0)) = y 0 - c 0 by ring]
    exact hy0
  
  have h₂ : IsShear r (x 1 - c 1) (y 0 - c 0) 0 (y 1 - x 1) := by
    refine ⟨hy0, hx1, by simpa using hx1, ?_⟩
    rw [show x 1 - c 1 + (0 + (y 1 - x 1)) = y 1 - c 1 by ring]
    exact hy1
  have hmover := (isSquareMover_shear (c := c) h₁ hne).comp (isSquareMover_shear (c := c) h₂ hne')
  have hMx : (shear c r (x 1 - c 1) (y 0 - c 0) 0 (y 1 - x 1) 1 0 ∘
      shear c r (x 0 - c 0) (x 1 - c 1) 0 (y 0 - x 0) 0 1) x = y := by
    
    have hW₁ : shearWeight c r (x 1 - c 1) 1 x = 1 := by
      rw [shearWeight, tent_self hx1.1 hx1.2]
    have hfirst0 : shear c r (x 0 - c 0) (x 1 - c 1) 0 (y 0 - x 0) 0 1 x 0 = y 0 := by
      rw [shear_apply_same, hW₁]
      simp only [add_zero, zero_add, mul_one]
      rw [bend_self hx0.1]
      ring
    have hfirst1 : shear c r (x 0 - c 0) (x 1 - c 1) 0 (y 0 - x 0) 0 1 x 1 = x 1 :=
      shear_apply_ne hne
    have hW₂ : shearWeight c r (y 0 - c 0) 0
        (shear c r (x 0 - c 0) (x 1 - c 1) 0 (y 0 - x 0) 0 1 x) = 1 := by
      rw [shearWeight, hfirst0, tent_self hy0.1 hy0.2]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    ext l
    revert l
    rw [Fin.forall_fin_two]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [shear_apply_ne hne', hfirst0]
    · rw [shear_apply_same, hW₂, hfirst1]
      simp only [add_zero, zero_add, mul_one]
      rw [bend_self hx1.1]
      ring
  refine ⟨_, _, hmover, hMx, ?_⟩
  have hinv := hmover.invOn.1 (show supDist x c ≤ r from hx.le)
  rwa [hMx] at hinv

name: Schoenflies.Plane.add_smul_single_apply
statement:
theorem add_smul_single_apply (z : Plane) (t : ℝ) (l : Fin 2) :
    (z + t • EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ)) l = z l + t
proof:
:= by
  simp [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.dist_add_smul_single
statement:
theorem dist_add_smul_single (z : Plane) (t : ℝ) (l : Fin 2) :
    dist (z + t • EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ)) z = |t|
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, PiLp.norm_single]
  simp

name: Schoenflies.Plane.interior_closedSquare
statement:
theorem interior_closedSquare (c : Plane) (r : ℝ) :
    interior (closedSquare c r) = openSquare c r
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : openSquare c r ⊆ closedSquare c r := fun z hz => show supDist z c ≤ r from hz.le
  refine Subset.antisymm (fun z hz => ?_) (interior_maximal hsub (isOpen_openSquare c r))
  by_contra hzo
  have hzc : z ∈ closedSquare c r := interior_subset hz
  have heq : supDist z c = r := le_antisymm hzc (not_lt.1 hzo)
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_abs_sub_eq_of_supDist_eq heq
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 isOpen_interior z hz
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := hl ▸ abs_nonneg _
  have key : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < ε → |(z l - c l) + t| ≤ r := by
    intro t ht
    have hmem : z + t • EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ) ∈ closedSquare c r :=
      interior_subset (hball (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_add_smul_single]; exact ht))
    have := le_trans (abs_sub_le_supDist (z + t • EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ)) c l) hmem
    rwa [add_smul_single_apply, show z l + t - c l = z l - c l + t by ring] at this
  rcases (abs_eq hr).1 hl with he | he
  · have := (abs_le.1 (key (ε / 2) (by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith))).2
    rw [he] at this
    linarith
  · have := (abs_le.1 (key (-(ε / 2)) (by rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith))).1
    rw [he] at this
    linarith

name: Schoenflies.Plane.frontier_closedSquare
statement:
theorem frontier_closedSquare (c : Plane) (r : ℝ) :
    frontier (closedSquare c r) = {z | supDist z c = r}
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isClosed_closedSquare c r).frontier_eq, interior_closedSquare]
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact le_antisymm h1 (not_lt.1 h2)
  · intro h
    exact ⟨le_of_eq h, by rw [openSquare, mem_setOf_eq, h]; exact lt_irrefl r⟩

name: Schoenflies.Plane.IsSquareMover.eqOn_frontier
statement:
theorem IsSquareMover.eqOn_frontier {M N : Plane → Plane} (h : IsSquareMover c r M N) :
    EqOn M id (frontier (closedSquare c r))
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [frontier_closedSquare, mem_setOf_eq] at hz
  exact h.fixes z (le_of_eq hz) hz

name: Schoenflies.Plane.IsSquareMover.homeomorph_apply
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.Plane.IsSquareMover.homeomorph_symm_apply
proof: := rfl

name: Schoenflies.Plane.iInter_eq_singleton_of_mem_tail
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := eq_singleton_iInter_of_diam_tendsto_zero hne hK hmono hdiam
  have hvmem : v ∈ ⋂ n, K n := by
    refine mem_iInter.2 fun n => ?_
    rcases le_total N n with h | h
    · exact hv n h
    · exact hmono h (hv N le_rfl)
  rw [hp] at hvmem
  rw [hp, mem_singleton_iff.1 hvmem]

    intro x hx

      T.homeo.toFun x = Q.homeo.toFun x :=
        h₂.homeo_eqOn (h₁.sourceSkeletonSet_subset hx)

name: Schoenflies.Plane.germs_split'
statement:
theorem germs_split' (h : det r₁ r₂ ≠ 0) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsmall : s * |inner ℝ r₁ r₂| < t * |det r₁ r₂|) :
    (t • r₁ - s • perp r₁ ∈ arcCCW r₂ r₁ ∧ t • r₂ + s • perp r₂ ∈ arcCCW r₂ r₁) ∧
      (t • r₁ + s • perp r₁ ∈ arcCCW r₁ r₂ ∧ t • r₂ - s • perp r₂ ∈ arcCCW r₁ r₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : inner ℝ r₁ r₂ ≤ |inner ℝ r₁ r₂| := le_abs_self _
  have hle' : inner ℝ r₂ r₁ ≤ |inner ℝ r₁ r₂| := by
    rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hle
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with hneg | hpos
  · 
    have h' : 0 < det r₂ r₁ := by rw [det_comm r₂ r₁]; linarith
    have habs : |det r₁ r₂| = det r₂ r₁ := by rw [abs_of_neg hneg, det_comm r₁ r₂]; ring
    have hsmall' : s * inner ℝ r₂ r₁ < t * det r₂ r₁ := by
      rw [habs] at hsmall
      nlinarith
    have H := germs_split h' hs hsmall'
    exact ⟨⟨H.2.2, H.2.1⟩, ⟨H.1.2, H.1.1⟩⟩
  · have habs : |det r₁ r₂| = det r₁ r₂ := abs_of_pos hpos
    have hsmall' : s * inner ℝ r₁ r₂ < t * det r₁ r₂ := by
      rw [habs] at hsmall
      nlinarith
    exact germs_split hpos hs hsmall'

name: Schoenflies.Plane.arcCCW_disjoint'
statement: theorem arcCCW_disjoint' (h : det r₁ r₂ ≠ 0) : Disjoint (arcCCW r₁ r₂) (arcCCW r₂ r₁)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with hneg | hpos
  · have h' : 0 < det r₂ r₁ := by rw [det_comm r₂ r₁]; linarith
    exact (arcCCW_disjoint h').symm
  · exact arcCCW_disjoint hpos

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_ray_or_mem_arcCCW'
statement:
theorem mem_ray_or_mem_arcCCW' (h : det r₁ r₂ ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ d = c • r₁) ∨ (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ d = c • r₂) ∨
      d ∈ arcCCW r₁ r₂ ∨ d ∈ arcCCW r₂ r₁
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with hneg | hpos
  · have h' : 0 < det r₂ r₁ := by rw [det_comm r₂ r₁]; linarith
    rcases mem_ray_or_mem_arcCCW h' hd with h1 | h1 | h1 | h1
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h1)
    · exact Or.inl h1
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr h1))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h1))
  · exact mem_ray_or_mem_arcCCW hpos hd

name: Schoenflies.Plane.notMem_arcCCW_smul
statement:
theorem notMem_arcCCW_smul (u w : Plane) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    c • u ∉ arcCCW u w ∧ c • u ∉ arcCCW w u
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : det u (c • u) = 0 := by rw [det_smul_right, det_self, mul_zero]
  have e2 : det (c • u) u = 0 := by rw [det_smul_left, det_self, mul_zero]
  have e3 : det (c • u) w = c * det u w := det_smul_left _ _ _
  have e4 : det w (c • u) = c * det w u := det_smul_right _ _ _
  have e5 : det w u = -det u w := det_comm w u
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩)
    · rw [e1] at h1; exact lt_irrefl 0 h1
    · rw [e3] at h1; rw [e5] at h2; nlinarith
    · rw [e1] at h2; exact lt_irrefl 0 h2
  · rintro (⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨h2, _⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
    · rw [e2] at h2; exact lt_irrefl 0 h2
    · rw [e2] at h2; exact lt_irrefl 0 h2
    · rw [e4, e5] at h2; nlinarith

name: Schoenflies.Plane.isLinearMap_det_right
statement: theorem isLinearMap_det_right (u : Plane) : IsLinearMap ℝ fun d : Plane => det u d
proof:

proof:

name: Schoenflies.Plane.convex_det_right_pos

:=

name: Schoenflies.Plane.convex_det_left_neg
statement: theorem convex_det_left_neg (w : Plane) : Convex ℝ {d : Plane | det d w < 0}
proof:

  convex_halfSpace_lt (isLinearMap_det_left w) 0

name: Schoenflies.Plane.isConnected_arcCCW_ball
statement:
theorem isConnected_arcCCW_ball (h : det u w ≠ 0) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    IsConnected (arcCCW u w ∩ ball (0 : Plane) ρ)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hne : u + w ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hw : w = -u := by linear_combination (norm := module) hz
    rw [hw, show (-u : Plane) = (-1 : ℝ) • u by module, det_smul_right, det_self,
      mul_zero] at h
    exact h rfl
  have hnpos : 0 < ‖u + w‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hne
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεball⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε * ‖u + w‖ < ρ := by
    refine ⟨ρ / (2 * ‖u + w‖), by positivity, ?_⟩
    have : ρ / (2 * ‖u + w‖) * ‖u + w‖ = ρ / 2 := by field_simp
    rw [this]; linarith
  have hball : ∀ σ : ℝ, |σ| = ε → σ • (u + w) ∈ ball (0 : Plane) ρ := by
    intro σ hσ
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hσ]
    exact hεball
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with hneg | hpos
  · 
    have h' : 0 < det w u := by rw [det_comm w u]; linarith
    have harc : arcCCW u w = {d : Plane | det w d < 0} ∪ {d : Plane | det d u < 0} := by
      ext d
      rw [mem_arcCCW_rev_iff h']
      simp only [mem_union, mem_setOf_eq]
    have hd0 : (-ε) • (u + w) ∈ ball (0 : Plane) ρ :=
      hball _ (by rw [abs_of_neg (neg_neg_iff_pos.2 hε), neg_neg])
    have hA : (-ε) • (u + w) ∈ {d : Plane | det w d < 0} := by
      change det w ((-ε) • (u + w)) < 0
      rw [det_smul_right, det_add_right, det_self, add_zero]
      nlinarith
    have hB : (-ε) • (u + w) ∈ {d : Plane | det d u < 0} := by
      change det ((-ε) • (u + w)) u < 0
      rw [det_smul_left, det_add_left, det_self, zero_add]
      nlinarith
    refine ⟨⟨_, by rw [harc]; exact ⟨Or.inl hA, hd0⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [harc, union_inter_distrib_right]
    exact IsPreconnected.union _ ⟨hA, hd0⟩ ⟨hB, hd0⟩
      ((convex_det_right_neg w).inter (convex_ball _ _)).isPreconnected
      ((convex_det_left_neg u).inter (convex_ball _ _)).isPreconnected
  · 
    have harc : arcCCW u w = {d : Plane | 0 < det u d} ∩ {d : Plane | 0 < det d w} := by
      ext d
      rw [mem_arcCCW_iff hpos]
      simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_setOf_eq]
    have hmem : ε • (u + w) ∈ arcCCW u w ∩ ball (0 : Plane) ρ := by
      refine ⟨?_, hball _ (abs_of_pos hε)⟩
      rw [harc]
      constructor
      · change 0 < det u (ε • (u + w))
        rw [det_smul_right, det_add_right, det_self, zero_add]
        positivity
      · change 0 < det (ε • (u + w)) w
        rw [det_smul_left, det_add_left, det_self, add_zero]
        positivity
    refine ⟨⟨_, hmem⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [harc]
    exact (((convex_det_right_pos u).inter (convex_det_left_pos w)).inter
      (convex_ball _ _)).isPreconnected

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_cone_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cone_iff {v : Plane} {A : Set Plane} :
    x ∈ cone v A ρ ↔ x - v ∈ A ∧ dist x v < ρ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.Plane.cone_subset_ball
statement: theorem cone_subset_ball {v : Plane} {A : Set Plane} : cone v A ρ ⊆ ball v ρ
proof: := inter_subset_right

name: Schoenflies.Plane.isOpen_cone
statement: theorem isOpen_cone {v : Plane} {A : Set Plane} (hA : IsOpen A) : IsOpen (cone v A ρ)
proof:
:=
  (hA.preimage (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).inter isOpen_ball

name: Schoenflies.Plane.cone_eq_image
statement:
theorem cone_eq_image (v : Plane) (A : Set Plane) (ρ : ℝ) :
    cone v A ρ = (fun d => v + d) '' (A ∩ ball (0 : Plane) ρ)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hy, hb⟩
    refine ⟨y - v, ⟨hy, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, ← dist_eq_norm]
      exact hb
    · change v + (y - v) = y
      module
  · rintro ⟨d, ⟨hd, hb⟩, rfl⟩
    have he : v + d - v = d := by module
    refine ⟨by rw [mem_setOf_eq, he]; exact hd, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, he]
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hb
    exact hb

name: Schoenflies.Plane.isConnected_cone_arcCCW
statement:
theorem isConnected_cone_arcCCW (v : Plane) (h : det u w ≠ 0) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    IsConnected (cone v (arcCCW u w) ρ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cone_eq_image]
  have hc : Continuous fun d : Plane => v + d := continuous_const.add continuous_id
  exact (isConnected_arcCCW_ball h hρ).image _ hc.continuousOn

name: Schoenflies.Plane.det_eq_inner_perp
statement: theorem det_eq_inner_perp (u v : Plane) : det u v = inner ℝ (perp u) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_eq, det]
  simp [perp]
  ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.abs_det_le
statement: theorem abs_det_le (u v : Plane) : |det u v| ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_eq_inner_perp]
  calc |inner ℝ (perp u) v| ≤ ‖perp u‖ * ‖v‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ = ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ := by rw [norm_perp]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.coordAlong_param
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordAlong_param (hu : IsDirection u) (a : Plane) (t s : ℝ) :
    coordAlong a u (a + t • u + s • perp u) = t
proof:
:= by
  have h : a + t • u + s • perp u - a = t • u + s • perp u := by module
  rw [coordAlong, h, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inner_perp_self, hu.norm]
  ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.coordAcross_param
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordAcross_param (hu : IsDirection u) (a : Plane) (t s : ℝ) :
    coordAcross a u (a + t • u + s • perp u) = s
proof:
:= by
  have h : a + t • u + s • perp u - a = t • u + s • perp u := by module
  rw [coordAcross, h, det_germ_self, hu.norm]
  ring

name: Schoenflies.Plane.frame_decomp
statement:
theorem frame_decomp (hu : IsDirection u) (a x : Plane) :
    x = a + (coordAlong a u x) • u + (coordAcross a u x) • perp u
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : u 0 ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have := hu.norm
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq] at this
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖u i‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2 := by rw [this]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by positivity)] at h2
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two, sq_abs] using h2
  have hal : coordAlong a u x = u 0 * (x 0 - a 0) + u 1 * (x 1 - a 1) := by
    rw [coordAlong, inner_eq]; simp
  have hac : coordAcross a u x = u 0 * (x 1 - a 1) - u 1 * (x 0 - a 0) := by
    rw [coordAcross, det]; simp
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · simp only [hal, hac]
    simp [perp]
    linear_combination (a 0 - x 0) * hnorm
  · simp only [hal, hac]
    simp [perp]
    linear_combination (a 1 - x 1) * hnorm

name: Schoenflies.Plane.abs_coordAlong_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_coordAlong_sub_le (hu : IsDirection u) (a x y : Plane) :
    |coordAlong a u x - coordAlong a u y| ≤ dist x y
proof:
:= by
  have h : coordAlong a u x - coordAlong a u y = inner ℝ u (x - y) := by
    rw [coordAlong, coordAlong, ← inner_sub_right]
    congr 1
    module
  rw [h, dist_eq_norm]
  calc |inner ℝ u (x - y)| ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖x - y‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ = ‖x - y‖ := by rw [hu.norm, one_mul]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.abs_coordAcross_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_coordAcross_sub_le (hu : IsDirection u) (a x y : Plane) :
    |coordAcross a u x - coordAcross a u y| ≤ dist x y
proof:
:= by
  have h : coordAcross a u x - coordAcross a u y = det u (x - y) := by
    simp only [coordAcross, det]
    simp
    ring
  rw [h, dist_eq_norm]
  calc |det u (x - y)| ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖x - y‖ := abs_det_le _ _
    _ = ‖x - y‖ := by rw [hu.norm, one_mul]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_strip_iff
statement:
theorem mem_strip_iff {t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ : ℝ} :
    x ∈ strip a u t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ ↔ t₁ < coordAlong a u x ∧ coordAlong a u x < t₂ ∧
      s₁ < coordAcross a u x ∧ coordAcross a u x < s₂
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.Plane.continuous_coordAlong
statement: theorem continuous_coordAlong (a u : Plane) : Continuous (coordAlong a u)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_const.inner (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))

name: Schoenflies.Plane.continuous_coordAcross
statement: theorem continuous_coordAcross (a u : Plane) : Continuous (coordAcross a u)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_det_right u).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)

name: Schoenflies.Plane.isOpen_strip
statement: theorem isOpen_strip (a u : Plane) (t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ : ℝ) : IsOpen (strip a u t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂)
proof:
:= by
  have key : strip a u t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ =
      ({x : Plane | t₁ < coordAlong a u x} ∩ {x : Plane | coordAlong a u x < t₂}) ∩
        ({x : Plane | s₁ < coordAcross a u x} ∩ {x : Plane | coordAcross a u x < s₂}) := by
    ext y
    simp only [mem_strip_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_setOf_eq]
    tauto
  rw [key]
  exact ((isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_coordAlong a u)).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_coordAlong a u) continuous_const)).inter
    ((isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_coordAcross a u)).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_coordAcross a u) continuous_const))

name: Schoenflies.Plane.convex_strip
statement: theorem convex_strip (a u : Plane) (t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ : ℝ) : Convex ℝ (strip a u t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂)
proof:
:= by
  have key : strip a u t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ =
      ({x : Plane | t₁ + inner ℝ u a < inner ℝ u x} ∩ {x : Plane | inner ℝ u x < t₂ + inner ℝ u a})
        ∩ ({x : Plane | s₁ + det u a < det u x} ∩ {x : Plane | det u x < s₂ + det u a}) := by
    ext y
    have h1 : coordAlong a u y = inner ℝ u y - inner ℝ u a := by
      rw [coordAlong, inner_sub_right]
    have h2 : coordAcross a u y = det u y - det u a := by
      simp only [coordAcross, det]
      simp
      ring
    simp only [mem_strip_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_setOf_eq, h1, h2]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩; exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨a1, a2⟩, ⟨a3, a4⟩⟩; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  rw [key]
  have hlin : IsLinearMap ℝ fun x : Plane => inner ℝ u x :=
    ⟨fun x y => inner_add_right _ _ _, fun c x => by rw [real_inner_smul_right, smul_eq_mul]⟩
  exact ((convex_halfSpace_gt hlin _).inter (convex_halfSpace_lt hlin _)).inter
    ((convex_halfSpace_gt (isLinearMap_det_right u) _).inter
      (convex_halfSpace_lt (isLinearMap_det_right u) _))

name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_strip_param
statement:
theorem mem_strip_param (hu : IsDirection u) (a : Plane) {t s t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ : ℝ} :
    a + t • u + s • perp u ∈ strip a u t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ ↔ t₁ < t ∧ t < t₂ ∧ s₁ < s ∧ s < s₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_strip_iff, coordAlong_param hu, coordAcross_param hu]

name: Schoenflies.Plane.dist_foot
statement:
theorem dist_foot (hu : IsDirection u) (a x : Plane) :
    dist x (a + (coordAlong a u x) • u) = |coordAcross a u x|
proof:
:= by
  have h := frame_decomp hu a x
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  have hx : x - (a + (coordAlong a u x) • u) = (coordAcross a u x) • perp u := by
    nth_rewrite 1 [h]
    module
  rw [hx, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_perp, hu.norm, mul_one]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.one_ne_zero'
statement: theorem one_ne_zero' : (1 : ZMod (m + 3)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [show (1 : ZMod (m + 3)) = ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) by norm_num,
    ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at h
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd one_pos h
  omega

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.succ_ne_self
statement: theorem succ_ne_self : i + 1 ≠ i
proof: := fun h => one_ne_zero' (m := m) (by linear_combination h)

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.vertex_ne
statement: theorem vertex_ne : P.vertex i ≠ P.vertex (i + 1)
proof:
:= fun h =>
  succ_ne_self i (P.vertex_inj h).symm

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.sub_ne_zero_of_edge
statement: theorem sub_ne_zero_of_edge : P.vertex (i + 1) - P.vertex i ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  sub_ne_zero.2 (P.vertex_ne i).symm

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.len_pos
statement: theorem len_pos : 0 < P.len i
proof: := norm_pos_iff.2 sub_ne_zero_of_edge

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.isDirection_tang
statement: theorem isDirection_tang : IsDirection (P.tang i)
proof: := isDirection_dir sub_ne_zero_of_edge

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.len_smul_tang
statement: theorem len_smul_tang : (P.len i) • P.tang i = P.vertex (i + 1) - P.vertex i
proof:
:= by
  rw [tang, dir, smul_smul, len, mul_inv_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 sub_ne_zero_of_edge),
    one_smul]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.off_zero_zero
statement: theorem off_zero_zero : P.off i 0 0 = P.vertex i
proof: := by rw [off]; module

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.pt_zero
statement: theorem pt_zero : P.pt i 0 = P.vertex i
proof: := off_zero_zero

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.pt_len
statement: theorem pt_len : P.pt i (P.len i) = P.vertex (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pt, off, zero_smul, add_zero, len_smul_tang]
  module

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.off_sub_vertex
statement: theorem off_sub_vertex : P.off i t s - P.vertex i = t • P.tang i + s • perp (P.tang i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [off]; module

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.pt_sub_vertex
statement: theorem pt_sub_vertex : P.pt i c - P.vertex i = c • P.tang i
proof:
:= by
  rw [pt, off_sub_vertex, zero_smul, add_zero]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.dist_pt_vertex
statement: theorem dist_pt_vertex : dist (P.pt i c) (P.vertex i) = |c|
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, pt_sub_vertex, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, isDirection_tang.norm, mul_one]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.dist_off_vertex_le
statement: theorem dist_off_vertex_le : dist (P.off i t s) (P.vertex i) ≤ |t| + |s|
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, off_sub_vertex]
  calc ‖t • P.tang i + s • perp (P.tang i)‖ ≤ ‖t • P.tang i‖ + ‖s • perp (P.tang i)‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
    _ = |t| + |s| := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_perp,
          isDirection_tang.norm, mul_one, mul_one]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.coordAlong_off
statement: @[simp] theorem coordAlong_off : coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) (P.off i t s) = t
proof:
:=
  coordAlong_param isDirection_tang _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.coordAcross_off
statement: @[simp] theorem coordAcross_off : coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) (P.off i t s) = s
proof:
:=
  coordAcross_param isDirection_tang _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.off_coord
statement:
theorem off_coord (P : ClosedPolygon m) (i : ZMod (m + 3)) (x : Plane) :
    x = P.off i (coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x) (coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x)
proof:
:=
  frame_decomp isDirection_tang _ _

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.off_injective
statement: theorem off_injective (h : P.off i t s = P.off i t' s') : t = t' ∧ s = s'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have := congrArg (coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i)) h
    simpa using this
  · have := congrArg (coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i)) h
    simpa using this

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.mem_edge_iff
statement:
theorem mem_edge_iff {x : Plane} :
    x ∈ P.edge i ↔ ∃ c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (P.len i), x = P.pt i c
proof:
:= by
  rw [edge, segment_eq_image' ℝ]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨θ, ⟨hθ0, hθ1⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨θ * P.len i, ⟨mul_nonneg hθ0 len_pos.le, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · nlinarith [len_pos (P := P) (i := i)]
    · rw [pt, off, zero_smul, add_zero, ← len_smul_tang]
      simp [smul_smul]
  · rintro ⟨c, ⟨hc0, hc1⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨c / P.len i, ⟨div_nonneg hc0 len_pos.le, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [div_le_one len_pos]; exact hc1
    · rw [pt, off, zero_smul, add_zero, ← len_smul_tang]
      simp [smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (len_pos (P := P) (i := i)).ne']

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.pt_mem_edge
statement: theorem pt_mem_edge (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (P.len i)) : P.pt i c ∈ P.edge i
proof:
:=
  mem_edge_iff.2 ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.vertex_mem_edge
statement: theorem vertex_mem_edge : P.vertex i ∈ P.edge i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pt_zero]; exact pt_mem_edge ⟨le_refl _, len_pos.le⟩

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.vertex_mem_carrier
statement: theorem vertex_mem_carrier : P.vertex i ∈ P.carrier
proof: := Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, vertex_mem_edge⟩

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.edge_subset_carrier
statement: theorem edge_subset_carrier : P.edge i ⊆ P.carrier
proof: := Set.subset_iUnion _ i

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.rayIn_succ
statement: theorem rayIn_succ : P.rayIn (i + 1) = -P.tang i
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayIn, tang, add_sub_cancel_right, dir, dir, norm_sub_rev]
  module

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.vertex_pred_ne
statement: theorem vertex_pred_ne : P.vertex (i - 1) - P.vertex i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := P.vertex_ne (i - 1)
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  exact sub_ne_zero.2 h

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero
statement: theorem det_rays_ne_zero : det (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, h₁⟩ := dir_eq_smul (vertex_pred_ne (P := P) (i := i))
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, h₂⟩ := dir_eq_smul (sub_ne_zero_of_edge (P := P) (i := i))
  rw [rayIn, tang, h₁, h₂, det_smul_left, det_smul_right]
  exact mul_ne_zero hc₁.ne' (mul_ne_zero hc₂.ne' (P.corner i))

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.mem_edge_pred_sub
statement:
theorem mem_edge_pred_sub {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ P.edge (i - 1)) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ x - P.vertex i = c • P.rayIn i
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_edge_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨c, ⟨hc0, hc1⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨P.len (i - 1) - c, by linarith, ?_⟩
  have hsucc : i - 1 + 1 = i := sub_add_cancel i 1
  have hr : P.rayIn i = -P.tang (i - 1) := by
    have := rayIn_succ (P := P) (i := i - 1)
    rwa [hsucc] at this
  have hv : P.vertex i = P.vertex (i - 1 + 1) := by rw [hsucc]
  have hlen : P.vertex (i - 1 + 1) = P.vertex (i - 1) + (P.len (i - 1)) • P.tang (i - 1) := by
    rw [len_smul_tang]; module
  rw [pt, off, zero_smul, add_zero, hr, hv, hlen]
  module

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.mem_edge_sub
statement:
theorem mem_edge_sub {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ P.edge i) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ x - P.vertex i = c • P.tang i
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_edge_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨c, ⟨hc0, _⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨c, hc0, pt_sub_vertex⟩

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.pt_eq
statement: theorem pt_eq : P.pt i c = P.vertex i + c • P.tang i
proof: := by rw [pt, off, zero_smul, add_zero]

name: Schoenflies.StripData.lam_pos
statement: theorem lam_pos : 0 < D.lam
proof: := lt_trans D.rho_pos D.rho_lt_lam

name: Schoenflies.StripData.R_pos
statement: theorem R_pos : 0 < D.R
proof: := by have := D.lam_pos; linarith [D.two_lam_lt_R]

name: Schoenflies.StripData.rho_lt_R
statement: theorem rho_lt_R : D.rho < D.R
proof:
:= by
  have := D.lam_pos; have := D.rho_lt_lam; linarith [D.two_lam_lt_R]

name: Schoenflies.StripData.mem_blockL_iff
statement:
theorem mem_blockL_iff : x ∈ D.blockL i ↔
    D.lam < coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x ∧
      coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x < P.len i - D.lam ∧
      0 < coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x ∧
      coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x < D.rho
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.StripData.mem_blockR_iff
statement:
theorem mem_blockR_iff : x ∈ D.blockR i ↔
    D.lam < coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x ∧
      coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x < P.len i - D.lam ∧
      -D.rho < coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x ∧
      coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x < 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Schoenflies.StripData.mem_blockL_off
statement:
theorem mem_blockL_off {t s : ℝ} : P.off i t s ∈ D.blockL i ↔
    D.lam < t ∧ t < P.len i - D.lam ∧ 0 < s ∧ s < D.rho
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_blockL_iff, ClosedPolygon.coordAlong_off, ClosedPolygon.coordAcross_off]

name: Schoenflies.StripData.mem_blockR_off
statement:
theorem mem_blockR_off {t s : ℝ} : P.off i t s ∈ D.blockR i ↔
    D.lam < t ∧ t < P.len i - D.lam ∧ -D.rho < s ∧ s < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_blockR_iff, ClosedPolygon.coordAlong_off, ClosedPolygon.coordAcross_off]

name: Schoenflies.StripData.isOpen_blockL
statement: theorem isOpen_blockL : IsOpen (D.blockL i)
proof: := isOpen_strip _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.StripData.isOpen_blockR
statement: theorem isOpen_blockR : IsOpen (D.blockR i)
proof: := isOpen_strip _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.StripData.isOpen_sectorL
statement: theorem isOpen_sectorL : IsOpen (D.sectorL i)
proof: := isOpen_cone (isOpen_arcCCW _ _)

name: Schoenflies.StripData.isOpen_sectorR
statement: theorem isOpen_sectorR : IsOpen (D.sectorR i)
proof: := isOpen_cone (isOpen_arcCCW _ _)

name: Schoenflies.StripData.convex_blockL
statement: theorem convex_blockL : Convex ℝ (D.blockL i)
proof: := convex_strip _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.StripData.convex_blockR
statement: theorem convex_blockR : Convex ℝ (D.blockR i)
proof: := convex_strip _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Schoenflies.StripData.isConnected_sectorL
statement: theorem isConnected_sectorL : IsConnected (D.sectorL i)
proof:
:=
  isConnected_cone_arcCCW _ (by rw [det_comm]; exact neg_ne_zero.2 ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero)
    D.R_pos

name: Schoenflies.StripData.isConnected_sectorR
statement: theorem isConnected_sectorR : IsConnected (D.sectorR i)
proof:
:=
  isConnected_cone_arcCCW _ ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero D.R_pos

name: Schoenflies.StripData.exists_foot
statement:
theorem exists_foot (h : x ∈ D.blockL i ∪ D.blockR i) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.Icc D.lam (P.len i - D.lam), dist x (P.pt i c) < D.rho
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases h with h | h
    · exact ⟨(D.mem_blockL_iff.1 h).1.le, (D.mem_blockL_iff.1 h).2.1.le⟩
    · exact ⟨(D.mem_blockR_iff.1 h).1.le, (D.mem_blockR_iff.1 h).2.1.le⟩
  · rw [ClosedPolygon.pt_eq, dist_foot ClosedPolygon.isDirection_tang]
    rcases h with h | h
    · obtain ⟨_, _, h1, h2⟩ := D.mem_blockL_iff.1 h
      rw [abs_of_pos h1]; exact h2
    · obtain ⟨_, _, h1, h2⟩ := D.mem_blockR_iff.1 h
      rw [abs_of_neg h2]; linarith

name: Schoenflies.StripData.sector_subset_ball
statement: theorem sector_subset_ball : D.sectorL i ⊆ ball (P.vertex i) D.R
proof: := cone_subset_ball

name: Schoenflies.StripData.sectorR_subset_ball
statement: theorem sectorR_subset_ball : D.sectorR i ⊆ ball (P.vertex i) D.R
proof: := cone_subset_ball

name: Schoenflies.StripData.germ_ineq
statement:
theorem germ_ineq {t s : ℝ} (ht : D.lam < t) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s < D.rho) :
    s * |inner ℝ (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)| < t * |det (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)|
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < |det (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)| := abs_pos.2 ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero
  have habs : (0 : ℝ) ≤ |inner ℝ (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)| := abs_nonneg _
  have h1 : s * |inner ℝ (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)| ≤ s * (1 + |inner ℝ (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)|) := by
    nlinarith
  have h2 : s * (1 + |inner ℝ (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)|) <
      D.rho * (1 + |inner ℝ (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)|) := by nlinarith
  have h3 := D.germ i
  nlinarith

name: Schoenflies.StripData.blockL_sub_mem_arcL_start
statement:
theorem blockL_sub_mem_arcL_start (h : x ∈ D.blockL i) :
    x - P.vertex i ∈ arcCCW (P.tang i) (P.rayIn i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := D.mem_blockL_iff.1 h
  have hx := ClosedPolygon.off_coord P i x
  rw [hx, ClosedPolygon.off_sub_vertex]
  exact (germs_split' ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero h3 (D.germ_ineq h1 h3 h4)).1.2

name: Schoenflies.StripData.blockL_sub_mem_arcL_finish
statement:
theorem blockL_sub_mem_arcL_finish (h : x ∈ D.blockL i) :
    x - P.vertex (i + 1) ∈ arcCCW (P.tang (i + 1)) (P.rayIn (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := D.mem_blockL_iff.1 h
  set t := coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x with ht
  set s := coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x with hs
  have hx : x = P.off i t s := ClosedPolygon.off_coord P i x
  have hr : P.rayIn (i + 1) = -P.tang i := ClosedPolygon.rayIn_succ
  have hkey : x - P.vertex (i + 1) =
      (P.len i - t) • P.rayIn (i + 1) - s • perp (P.rayIn (i + 1)) := by
    have hv : P.vertex (i + 1) = P.vertex i + (P.len i) • P.tang i := by
      rw [ClosedPolygon.len_smul_tang]; module
    rw [hx, ClosedPolygon.off, hv, hr]
    have hp : perp (-P.tang i) = -perp (P.tang i) := by
      ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [perp]
    rw [hp]
    module
  rw [hkey]
  exact (germs_split' ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero h3
    (D.germ_ineq (i := i + 1) (by linarith) h3 h4)).1.1

name: Schoenflies.StripData.blockR_sub_mem_arcR_start
statement:
theorem blockR_sub_mem_arcR_start (h : x ∈ D.blockR i) :
    x - P.vertex i ∈ arcCCW (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := D.mem_blockR_iff.1 h
  set t := coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x with ht
  set s := coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x with hs
  have hx : x = P.off i t s := ClosedPolygon.off_coord P i x
  have hkey : x - P.vertex i = t • P.tang i - (-s) • perp (P.tang i) := by
    rw [hx, ClosedPolygon.off_sub_vertex]; module
  rw [hkey]
  exact (germs_split' ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero (by linarith)
    (D.germ_ineq h1 (by linarith) (by linarith))).2.2

name: Schoenflies.StripData.blockR_sub_mem_arcR_finish
statement:
theorem blockR_sub_mem_arcR_finish (h : x ∈ D.blockR i) :
    x - P.vertex (i + 1) ∈ arcCCW (P.rayIn (i + 1)) (P.tang (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := D.mem_blockR_iff.1 h
  set t := coordAlong (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x with ht
  set s := coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) x with hs
  have hx : x = P.off i t s := ClosedPolygon.off_coord P i x
  have hr : P.rayIn (i + 1) = -P.tang i := ClosedPolygon.rayIn_succ
  have hkey : x - P.vertex (i + 1) =
      (P.len i - t) • P.rayIn (i + 1) + (-s) • perp (P.rayIn (i + 1)) := by
    have hv : P.vertex (i + 1) = P.vertex i + (P.len i) • P.tang i := by
      rw [ClosedPolygon.len_smul_tang]; module
    rw [hx, ClosedPolygon.off, hv, hr]
    have hp : perp (-P.tang i) = -perp (P.tang i) := by
      ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [perp]
    rw [hp]
    module
  rw [hkey]
  exact (germs_split' ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero (by linarith)
    (D.germ_ineq (i := i + 1) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith))).2.1

name: Schoenflies.StripData.pt_mem_edge_of_trim
statement:
theorem pt_mem_edge_of_trim {c : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc D.lam (P.len i - D.lam)) :
    P.pt i c ∈ P.edge i
proof:
:=
  ClosedPolygon.pt_mem_edge ⟨le_trans D.lam_pos.le hc.1, le_trans hc.2 (by linarith [D.lam_pos])⟩

name: Schoenflies.StripData.block_notMem_edge
statement: theorem block_notMem_edge (h : x ∈ D.blockL i ∪ D.blockR i) (hj : j ≠ i) : x ∉ P.edge j
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hd⟩ := D.exists_foot h
  have := D.sep_trim_edge i j hj c hc x hx
  rw [dist_comm] at hd
  linarith [D.rho_pos]

name: Schoenflies.StripData.block_notMem_own_edge
statement: theorem block_notMem_own_edge (h : x ∈ D.blockL i ∪ D.blockR i) : x ∉ P.edge i
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  rw [ClosedPolygon.mem_edge_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := hx
  have hzero : coordAcross (P.vertex i) (P.tang i) (P.pt i c) = 0 := by
    rw [ClosedPolygon.pt]; exact ClosedPolygon.coordAcross_off
  rcases h with h | h
  · have hpos := (D.mem_blockL_iff.1 h).2.2.1
    rw [hzero] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  · have hneg := (D.mem_blockR_iff.1 h).2.2.2
    rw [hzero] at hneg
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hneg

name: Schoenflies.StripData.block_notMem_carrier
statement: theorem block_notMem_carrier (h : x ∈ D.blockL i ∪ D.blockR i) : x ∉ P.carrier
proof:
:= by
  rintro hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
  by_cases hij : j = i
  · exact D.block_notMem_own_edge h (hij ▸ hj)
  · exact D.block_notMem_edge h hij hj

name: Schoenflies.StripData.block_notMem_ball_vertex
statement:
theorem block_notMem_ball_vertex (h : x ∈ D.blockL i ∪ D.blockR i) (hj1 : j ≠ i)
    (hj2 : j ≠ i + 1) : x ∉ ball (P.vertex j) D.R
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hd⟩ := D.exists_foot h
  have hne1 : i ≠ j - 1 := fun he => hj2 (by rw [he]; ring)
  have := D.sep_vertex_edge j i hne1 (Ne.symm hj1) _ (D.pt_mem_edge_of_trim hc)
  have h1 : dist (P.vertex j) (P.pt i c) ≤ dist (P.vertex j) x + dist x (P.pt i c) :=
    dist_triangle _ _ _
  rw [mem_ball] at hx
  rw [dist_comm] at hx
  linarith [D.rho_lt_R]

name: Schoenflies.StripData.sector_notMem_far_edge
statement:
theorem sector_notMem_far_edge (h : x ∈ ball (P.vertex i) D.R) (hj1 : j ≠ i - 1) (hj2 : j ≠ i) :
    x ∉ P.edge j
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  have := D.sep_vertex_edge i j hj1 hj2 x hx
  rw [mem_ball, dist_comm] at h
  linarith [D.R_pos]

name: Schoenflies.StripData.sectorL_notMem_carrier
statement: theorem sectorL_notMem_carrier (h : x ∈ D.sectorL i) : x ∉ P.carrier
proof:
:= by
  rintro hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · rw [hji] at hj
    obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := ClosedPolygon.mem_edge_sub hj
    exact ((notMem_arcCCW_smul (P.tang i) (P.rayIn i) hc).1) (he ▸ h.1)
  by_cases hjp : j = i - 1
  · rw [hjp] at hj
    obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := ClosedPolygon.mem_edge_pred_sub (i := i) hj
    exact ((notMem_arcCCW_smul (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i) hc).2) (he ▸ h.1)
  · exact D.sector_notMem_far_edge (i := i) h.2 hjp hji hj

name: Schoenflies.StripData.sectorR_notMem_carrier
statement: theorem sectorR_notMem_carrier (h : x ∈ D.sectorR i) : x ∉ P.carrier
proof:
:= by
  rintro hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · rw [hji] at hj
    obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := ClosedPolygon.mem_edge_sub hj
    exact ((notMem_arcCCW_smul (P.tang i) (P.rayIn i) hc).2) (he ▸ h.1)
  by_cases hjp : j = i - 1
  · rw [hjp] at hj
    obtain ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := ClosedPolygon.mem_edge_pred_sub (i := i) hj
    exact ((notMem_arcCCW_smul (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i) hc).1) (he ▸ h.1)
  · exact D.sector_notMem_far_edge (i := i) h.2 hjp hji hj

name: Schoenflies.StripData.sideL_disjoint_carrier
statement: theorem sideL_disjoint_carrier : Disjoint D.sideL P.carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro y hy hc
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hy
  rcases hi with hi | hi
  · exact D.sectorL_notMem_carrier hi hc
  · exact D.block_notMem_carrier (Or.inl hi) hc

name: Schoenflies.StripData.sideR_disjoint_carrier
statement: theorem sideR_disjoint_carrier : Disjoint D.sideR P.carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro y hy hc
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hy
  rcases hi with hi | hi
  · exact D.sectorR_notMem_carrier hi hc
  · exact D.block_notMem_carrier (Or.inr hi) hc

name: Schoenflies.StripData.blockL_disjoint_blockR
statement: theorem blockL_disjoint_blockR (hL : x ∈ D.blockL i) (hR : x ∈ D.blockR j) : False
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : j = i
  · rw [hij] at hR
    exact absurd (D.mem_blockL_iff.1 hL).2.2.1 (asymm (D.mem_blockR_iff.1 hR).2.2.2)
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hd⟩ := D.exists_foot (Or.inl hL)
    obtain ⟨c', hc', hd'⟩ := D.exists_foot (Or.inr hR)
    have hsep := D.sep_trim_edge i j hij c hc _ (D.pt_mem_edge_of_trim hc')
    have h1 : dist (P.pt i c) (P.pt j c') ≤ dist (P.pt i c) x + dist x (P.pt j c') :=
      dist_triangle _ _ _
    rw [dist_comm] at hd
    linarith

name: Schoenflies.StripData.blockL_disjoint_sectorR
statement: theorem blockL_disjoint_sectorR (hL : x ∈ D.blockL i) (hR : x ∈ D.sectorR j) : False
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : j = i
  · subst hij
    exact (arcCCW_disjoint' (ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero (P := P) (i := j))).ne_of_mem
      hR.1 (D.blockL_sub_mem_arcL_start hL) rfl
  by_cases hij2 : j = i + 1
  · subst hij2
    exact (arcCCW_disjoint' (ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero (P := P) (i := i + 1))).ne_of_mem
      hR.1 (D.blockL_sub_mem_arcL_finish hL) rfl
  · exact D.block_notMem_ball_vertex (Or.inl hL) hij hij2 hR.2

name: Schoenflies.StripData.sectorL_disjoint_blockR
statement: theorem sectorL_disjoint_blockR (hL : x ∈ D.sectorL i) (hR : x ∈ D.blockR j) : False
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    exact (arcCCW_disjoint' (ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero (P := P) (i := i))).ne_of_mem
      (D.blockR_sub_mem_arcR_start hR) hL.1 rfl
  by_cases hij2 : i = j + 1
  · subst hij2
    exact (arcCCW_disjoint' (ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero (P := P) (i := j + 1))).ne_of_mem
      (D.blockR_sub_mem_arcR_finish hR) hL.1 rfl
  · exact D.block_notMem_ball_vertex (Or.inr hR) hij hij2 hL.2

name: Schoenflies.StripData.sectorL_disjoint_sectorR
statement: theorem sectorL_disjoint_sectorR (hL : x ∈ D.sectorL i) (hR : x ∈ D.sectorR j) : False
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    exact (arcCCW_disjoint' (ClosedPolygon.det_rays_ne_zero (P := P) (i := i))).ne_of_mem
      hR.1 hL.1 rfl
  · have hsep := D.sep_vertex i j hij
    have hdL : dist x (P.vertex i) < D.R := hL.2
    have hdR : dist x (P.vertex j) < D.R := hR.2
    have h1 : dist (P.vertex i) (P.vertex j) ≤ dist (P.vertex i) x + dist x (P.vertex j) :=
      dist_triangle _ _ _
    rw [dist_comm (P.vertex i) x] at h1
    linarith

name: Schoenflies.StripData.sideL_disjoint_sideR
statement: theorem sideL_disjoint_sideR : Disjoint D.sideL D.sideR
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro y hy hz
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hy
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hz
  rcases hi with hi | hi <;> rcases hj with hj | hj
  · exact D.sectorL_disjoint_sectorR hi hj
  · exact D.sectorL_disjoint_blockR hi hj
  · exact D.blockL_disjoint_sectorR hi hj
  · exact D.blockL_disjoint_blockR hi hj

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.isDirection_rayIn
statement: theorem isDirection_rayIn : IsDirection (P.rayIn i)
proof: := isDirection_dir vertex_pred_ne

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.off_sub_vertex_succ
statement:
theorem off_sub_vertex_succ :
    P.off i t s - P.vertex (i + 1) = (t - P.len i) • P.tang i + s • perp (P.tang i)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : P.vertex (i + 1) = P.vertex i + (P.len i) • P.tang i := by
    rw [len_smul_tang]; module
  rw [off, hv]; module

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.dist_off_vertex_succ_le
statement: theorem dist_off_vertex_succ_le : dist (P.off i t s) (P.vertex (i + 1)) ≤ |t - P.len i| + |s|
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, off_sub_vertex_succ]
  calc ‖(t - P.len i) • P.tang i + s • perp (P.tang i)‖
      ≤ ‖(t - P.len i) • P.tang i‖ + ‖s • perp (P.tang i)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = |t - P.len i| + |s| := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_perp,
          isDirection_tang.norm, mul_one, mul_one]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.dist_pt_vertex_succ
statement: theorem dist_pt_vertex_succ : dist (P.pt i c) (P.vertex (i + 1)) = |c - P.len i|
proof:
:= by
  rw [pt, dist_eq_norm, off_sub_vertex_succ, zero_smul, add_zero, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    isDirection_tang.norm, mul_one]

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.vertex_add_smul_rayIn
statement:
theorem vertex_add_smul_rayIn (P : ClosedPolygon m) (i : ZMod (m + 3)) (c : ℝ) :
    P.vertex i + c • P.rayIn i = P.pt (i - 1) (P.len (i - 1) - c)
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : i - 1 + 1 = i := sub_add_cancel i 1
  have hr : P.rayIn i = -P.tang (i - 1) := by
    have h := rayIn_succ (P := P) (i := i - 1)
    rwa [hsucc] at h
  have hlen : P.vertex i = P.vertex (i - 1) + (P.len (i - 1)) • P.tang (i - 1) := by
    rw [len_smul_tang, hsucc]; module
  rw [pt_eq, hr, hlen]
  module

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.mem_edge_pred_of_smul_rayIn
statement:
theorem mem_edge_pred_of_smul_rayIn (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ P.len (i - 1)) :
    P.vertex i + c • P.rayIn i ∈ P.edge (i - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertex_add_smul_rayIn]
  exact pt_mem_edge ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.mem_edge_of_smul_tang
statement:
theorem mem_edge_of_smul_tang (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ P.len i) :
    P.vertex i + c • P.tang i ∈ P.edge i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pt_eq]
  exact pt_mem_edge ⟨hc0, hc1⟩

name: Schoenflies.StripData.mem_overlapL_start
statement:
theorem mem_overlapL_start :
    P.off i (3 * D.lam / 2) (D.rho / 2) ∈ D.blockL i ∩ D.sectorL i
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : P.off i (3 * D.lam / 2) (D.rho / 2) ∈ D.blockL i :=
    D.mem_blockL_off.2 ⟨D.lam_lt_three_halves_lam, D.three_halves_lam_lt,
      by linarith [D.rho_pos], by linarith [D.rho_pos]⟩
  refine ⟨hmem, D.blockL_sub_mem_arcL_start hmem, ?_⟩
  
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ClosedPolygon.dist_off_vertex_le ?_
  rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [D.lam_pos] : (0:ℝ) < 3 * D.lam / 2),
    abs_of_pos (by linarith [D.rho_pos] : (0:ℝ) < D.rho / 2)]
  exact D.overlap_dist_lt

name: Schoenflies.StripData.mem_overlapL_finish
statement:
theorem mem_overlapL_finish :
    P.off i (P.len i - 3 * D.lam / 2) (D.rho / 2) ∈ D.blockL i ∩ D.sectorL (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : D.lam < P.len i - 3 * D.lam / 2 := by
    have := D.lam_pos; have := D.four_lam_lt_len i; linarith
  have h2 : P.len i - 3 * D.lam / 2 < P.len i - D.lam := by have := D.lam_pos; linarith
  have hmem : P.off i (P.len i - 3 * D.lam / 2) (D.rho / 2) ∈ D.blockL i :=
    D.mem_blockL_off.2 ⟨h1, h2, by linarith [D.rho_pos], by linarith [D.rho_pos]⟩
  refine ⟨hmem, D.blockL_sub_mem_arcL_finish hmem, ?_⟩
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ClosedPolygon.dist_off_vertex_succ_le ?_
  rw [show P.len i - 3 * D.lam / 2 - P.len i = -(3 * D.lam / 2) by ring,
    abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith [D.lam_pos] : (0:ℝ) < 3 * D.lam / 2),
    abs_of_pos (by linarith [D.rho_pos] : (0:ℝ) < D.rho / 2)]
  exact D.overlap_dist_lt

name: Schoenflies.StripData.mem_overlapR_start

    D.mem_blockR_off.2 ⟨D.lam_lt_three_halves_lam, D.three_halves_lam_lt,
      by linarith [D.rho_pos], by linarith [D.rho_pos]⟩
  refine ⟨hmem, D.blockR_sub_mem_arcR_start hmem, ?_⟩
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ClosedPolygon.dist_off_vertex_le ?_
  rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [D.lam_pos] : (0:ℝ) < 3 * D.lam / 2),
    abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith [D.rho_pos] : (0:ℝ) < D.rho / 2)]

name: Schoenflies.StripData.mem_overlapR_finish
